featuredPapers.title: RSI-Opt: Recursive Self-Improvement Optimizer Agents For Model Training
featuredPapers.authors: Binghang Lu, Yige Sun, Guang Lin
featuredPapers.summary:
Conventional neural-network training typically follows a predefined optimization recipe, motivating a LLM agent that monitors training dynamics and adjusts optimizer settings as training progresses, but a fixed agent policy does not accumulate experience across runs. 传统的神经网络培训通常遵循预定义的优化方案，激励LLM代理监控培训动态并随着培训的进展调整优化器设置，但固定代理策略不会在整个运行过程中积累经验。

A meta-agent rewrites this policy using evidence from earlier runs, and an archive retains evaluated policies for further evolution. 元代理使用早期运行的证据重写此策略，存档保留评估的策略以供进一步演进。

On the Burgers PDE, it reduces mean relative $L_2$ error by approximately 2.7-fold with Opus 5.5 and 8.8-fold with GPT-6.1 over the fixed-prompt agent baseline, although PDE transfer varies across LLMs and tasks. 在Burgers PDE上，使用Opus 5.5 ，平均相对$ L_2 $误差减少约2.7倍，使用GPT-6.1 ，平均相对相对误差减少约8.8倍，尽管PDE转移因LLM和任务而异。
Controlled comparisons show that the evolved policy combines reusable optimization knowledge with adaptation to each task: initial decisions capture most observed gains on seen tasks, while continued adaptation improves outcomes on unseen tasks. 受控比较表明，演化后的策略将可重用的优化知识与对每个任务的适应性相结合：初始决策捕获了所见任务中观察到的最多收益，而持续的适应性则改善了未见任务的结果。
These findings demonstrate how procedures and executable tools accumulated across training runs can improve optimizer-agent performance and support transfer to scientific machine learning. 这些研究结果表明，在培训运行中积累的程序和可执行工具如何提高优化器代理的性能，并支持向科学机器学习的转移。

featuredPapers.title: TGR-EvoDAG: A DAG-based Multi-Agent Code Evolution Framework for Generative Recommendation on Tencent
featuredPapers.authors: Junlin He, Junzhang Zhu, Yudong Li
featuredPapers.summary:
Large Language Model (LLM) agents have enabled automated code evolution for algorithm discovery. 大型语言模型（ LLM ）代理已经为算法发现启用了自动代码演化。
However, current recursive self-improvement (RSI) research for sequential recommendation faces a dilemma: general-purpose frameworks lack domain-specific feedback, while recommender-specific frameworks rely on linear evolution. 然而，目前针对顺序推荐的递归自我改进（ RSI ）研究面临着一个困境：通用框架缺乏特定领域的反馈，而推荐者特定的框架依赖于线性进化。
Crucially, naively integrating them fails when applied to Generative Recommendation (GR). 至关重要的是，当应用于生成式推荐（ GR ）时，天真地整合它们是失败的。
Unlike end-to-end models, GR relies on a module-cascaded pipeline (tokenization, pre-training, and alignment). 与端到端模型不同， GR依赖于模块级联管道（标记化、预训练和对齐）。
In this paradigm, existing evolution methods suffer from: i) cost blindness, squandering budgets by ignoring stage-asymmetric retraining overheads; and ii) short-sighted evaluation, discarding promising upstream innovations that temporarily regress metrics before downstream adaptation. 在这种范式中，现有的演进方法受到以下问题的困扰： i ）成本盲目性，通过忽略阶段性非对称再培训开销而浪费预算;和ii ）短视的评估，放弃有前途的上游创新，这些创新在下游适应之前暂时退化指标。
To bridge these gaps, we propose TGR-EvoDAG, a multi-agent code evolution framework tailored for GR. 为了弥合这些差距，我们提出了TGR-EvoDAG ，这是一个为GR量身定制的多智能体代码演化框架。
TGR-EvoDAG models code evolution as a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) to maintain multiple evolution branches and merge complementary innovations, unifying advanced search with rich GR diagnostic feedback. TGR-EvoDAG将代码进化建模为有向无环图（ DAG ） ，以维护多个进化分支并合并互补创新，将高级搜索与丰富的GR诊断反馈统一起来。
We further introduce stage-aware cost planning to optimize GPU-hour budgets, and active downstream co-adaptation to navigate temporary regressions and unlock cross-stage gains. 我们进一步引入了阶段感知成本规划，以优化GPU小时预算，以及积极的下游共同适应，以应对临时回归并解锁跨阶段收益。
On public Amazon datasets, TGR-EvoDAG enables the first autonomous evolution of a complete GR pipeline, improving offline metrics by up to 37.4% and Agent4Rec simulated user satisfaction by 19.7% over the strongest baseline. 在公共Amazon数据集上， TGR-EvoDAG实现了完整GR管道的首次自主演进，使离线指标提高了37.4% ， Agent4Rec模拟用户满意度比最强基线提高了19.7%。
Furthermore, in industrial deployment on Tencent's large-scale commercial media platform, the evolved GR achieves a 12.16% relative improvement in offline Hit@1 and a statistically significant 0.40% increase in online click-through rate (CTR). 此外，在腾讯大型商业媒体平台的行业部署中，演进后的GR在线下点击率@ 1上实现了12.16%的相对提升，在线点击率（ CTR ）上实现了0.40%的统计显著提升。
highlights: first autonomous evolution of a complete GR pipeline

featuredPapers.title: HarnessMM: Recursive Self-Improvement for Harness Token Efficiency
featuredPapers.authors: Yuhua Jiang, Chang Xu, Feifei Gao
featuredPapers.summary:
Agent harnesses repeatedly invoke reasoning after tool feedback, even when an earlier call has already fixed the next action. 客服代表在工具反馈后反复调用推理，即使之前的呼叫已经修复了下一个操作。
We introduce HarnessMM (Harness Minus Minus), a method for improving harness token efficiency through guarded decision reuse and recursive self-improvement (RSI). 我们引入了HarnessMM （ Harness Minus Minus ） ，这是一种通过保护决策重用和递归自我改进（ RSI ）来提高利用令牌效率的方法。
RSI iteratively refines companion harness configurations from training feedback, with validation selecting the configuration for deployment. RSI从培训反馈中迭代优化配套线束配置，并通过验证选择要部署的配置。
A controller at the model-tool boundary reuses resolved decisions to replace later reasoning callbacks while actor weights remain fixed. 模型-工具边界的控制器重用已解析的决策来替换后来的推理回调，而参与者权重保持不变。
Executable Decision Graphs store exact actions, literal arguments, causal dependencies, and public guards. 可执行决策图存储精确操作、字面参数、因果依赖关系和公共防护。
Guarded Decision Reuse activates these persistent decisions from observed receipts; Certified Callback Substitution executes them through the native interface and records removal of the registered slow callback. Guarded Decision Reuse从观察到的回执中激活这些持续的决策； Certified Callback Substitution通过本机界面执行这些决策，并记录已注册的慢速回调的删除。
New semantic decisions, unsupported evidence, and selector abstention invoke the original actor again. 新的语义决策、不受支持的证据和选择器弃权会再次调用原始参与者。
The representation restricts what feedback may change, while complete-task measurements establish quality and cost. 表示形式限制了反馈可能发生的变化，而完整的任务测量则确定了质量和成本。
On HumanEval, HarnessMM preserves Codex success at 90.82\% while reducing Tokens/task (k) from 66.72 to 47.02 (29.54\% saving). 在HumanEval上， HarnessMM将Codex的成功率保持在90.82\ % ，同时将代币/任务（ k ）从66.72降低到47.02 （节省29.54\ % ）。
For DeepSeek Harness, success rises from 71.43\% to 85.71\% while Tokens/task (k) fall from 96.28 to 11.62 (87.93\% saving). 对于DeepSeek线束，成功率从71.43\ %上升到85.71\ % ，而代币/任务（ k ）从96.28下降到11.62 （节省87.93\ % ）。
A separate MBPP ablation measures 26.91\% lower cost than single-use graphs and 19.52\% lower cost than retained callbacks. 单独的MBPP消融比一次性使用图表成本低26.91\ % ，比保留的回拨成本低19.52\ %。
These results establish guarded decision reuse as a practical way to reduce repeated reasoning in existing harnesses. 这些结果确立了谨慎决策重用作为减少现有线束中重复推理的实用方法。

featuredPapers.title: An Agentic Approach with Evidence-Grounded Verification for Multimodal Emotion Reasoning in Conversation
featuredPapers.authors: Elyas Rashno, Farhana Zulkernine
featuredPapers.summary:
LLM-based multimodal emotion reasoning systems perform well on standard benchmarks, but improving them through instruction tuning can be computationally expensive. 基于LLM的多模态情感推理系统在标准基准上表现良好，但通过指令调整来改进它们的计算成本可能很高。
Agentic pipelines built from frozen models avoid this cost, but introduce a different challenge: when a prediction is wrong, the system must identify which agent or stage caused the error. 基于冻结模型构建的代理管道避免了这一成本，但引入了一个不同的挑战：当预测错误时，系统必须确定导致错误的代理或阶段。
We address this problem with an agentic framework for traceable multimodal emotion reasoning and prompt-space adaptation. 我们通过可追溯的多模态情感推理和即时空间适应的代理框架来解决这个问题。
Modality-specific perception agents analyze visual, acoustic, and lexical inputs and post evidence-cited observations to a shared board. 模态特定的感知代理分析视觉、声学和词汇输入，并将证据引用的观察结果发布到共享板。
An integration agent combines these observations with retrieved multimodal examples to produce an emotion description, label set, and supporting citations, while an MLLM critic can request one revision before the output is finalized. 集成代理将这些观察结果与检索到的多模态示例相结合，以生成情感描述、标签集和支持引用，而MLLM批评者可以在输出最终确定之前请求一个修订。
For incorrect predictions, a separate evidence-grounded verification stage applies deterministic checks to verify that cited evidence and references are valid, and an entailment check to determine whether the final claims are supported by that evidence. 对于不正确的预测，一个单独的基于证据的验证阶段应用确定性检查来验证引用的证据和参考文献是否有效，并进行牵连检查以确定最终索赔是否得到该证据的支持。
Detected failures are then grouped by the responsible component and failure type, converted into targeted prompt patches, and accepted only after validation on a held-out set. 然后，检测到的故障按负责组件和故障类型分组，转换为有针对性的提示修补程序，并仅在保留集上进行验证后才接受。
This adapts the agent prompts without updating model weights. 这将在不更新模型权重的情况下调整代理提示。
On the MER2025 dataset, targeted prompt adaptation outperforms the frozen static pipeline on all four MLLMs, ranging from 2B to 38B parameters, and matches or outperforms undifferentiated reflection baselines on each of them: VideoLLaMA3-2B, Phi-3.5-vision-instruct, Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, and InternVL2.5-38B. 在MER2025数据集上，有针对性的提示适应在所有四个MLLM （范围从2B到38B参数）上都优于冻结的静态管线，并且在每个MLLM上匹配或优于未分化的反射基线： VideoLLaMA3-2B、Phi-3.5-vision-instruct、Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct和InternVL2.5-38B。
It improves F-score by 0.6--2.2 points depending on the backbone, including an increase from 52.3 to 54.5 on Qwen2.5-VL-7B. 它根据骨干将F分数提高了0.6-2.2分，包括在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上从52.3分提高到54.5分。

featuredPapers.title: Compact-Bench: Measuring What Context Compaction Costs Long-Horizon Coding Agents
featuredPapers.authors: Ruopei Sun, Jianfeng Cai, Kangwen Zhao
featuredPapers.summary:
Context compaction lets long-horizon coding agents continue beyond their context windows, but can erase the state needed to finish a task. 上下文压缩允许长距离编码代理继续超出其上下文窗口，但可以擦除完成任务所需的状态。
Prior evaluations measure efficiency, retained information, or end-to-end success, leaving the effect of a specific history replacement difficult to isolate. 先前的评估衡量效率、保留的信息或端到端的成功，使特定历史记录替换的影响难以隔离。
Compact-Bench pairs full-history and summary-only continuations from a shared repository state, and evaluates recurring details and successive production compactions. Compact-Bench将共享存储库状态的完整历史记录和仅总结的延续配对，并评估重复的详细信息和连续的生产压缩。
It covers 35 SWE-bench repairs, 146 agentic sessions, and 106 production chains. 它涵盖35个SWE-bench维修， 146个代理会话和106个生产链。
Across 14 summarizer backbones, stable damage ranges from 5-64% of 22 full-history successes: Claude Opus 4.8 preserves the most repairs, while DeepSeek-Flash damages the most. 在14个汇总器主干中，稳定的损坏范围在22个全历史成功案例的5-64%之间： Claude Opus 4.8保留了最多的修复，而DeepSeek-Flash损坏最多。
With Kimi-K3 as summarizer, the Kimi Code prompt preserves the most task continuations (19/22), whereas Claude Code retains the most recurring details (15.0%). 以Kimi-K3为总结者， Kimi Code提示保留了最多的任务延续（ 19/22 ） ，而Claude Code保留了最常见的细节（ 15.0% ）。
LLM summaries retain at most 16.0% of recurring details, compared with 79.1% for mechanical extraction; production summaries retain 15.7% at the first boundary. LLM总结最多保留16.0 ％的经常性细节，而机械提取为79.1 ％ ；生产总结保留第一个边界的15.7 ％。
Failures recur across methods: one repair is damaged by 13/14 backbones, and another by all 5 prompts. 故障在各种方法中重复发生：一次修复被13/14骨架损坏，另一次被全部5个提示损坏。
These results show that reliable compaction requires preserving the progress needed to complete a task, and that retaining relevant information alone does not ensure successful continuation. 这些结果表明，可靠的压实要求保留完成任务所需的进度，而仅保留相关信息并不能确保成功延续。
Code is available at https://github.com/cai-jianfeng/compact-bench and data is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/caijanfeng/compact-bench. 代码可在https://github.com/cai-jianfeng/compact-bench上获得，数据可在https://huggingface.co/datasets/caijanfeng/compact-bench上获得。

featuredPapers.title: Tool-Calling LLM Agents Under Realistic MCP Faults: Scale Does Not Purchase Fault Tolerance
featuredPapers.authors: Antonio Ken Iannillo, Joshua Segun Owotogbe, Roberto Natella
featuredPapers.summary:
LLM agents increasingly rely on external tools exposed via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), yet current benchmarks assume tools respond correctly and on time, leaving agent resilience to realistic tool failures untested. LLM代理越来越依赖于通过模型上下文协议（ MCP ）公开的外部工具，但当前的基准假设工具响应正确且及时，使得代理对现实工具故障的弹性未经测试。
We introduce MCP-Injector, a drop-in, protocol-aware fault-injection middleware that interposes on the MCP tool-call path with controlled persistence (permanent, transient, intermittent) and seedable schedules. 我们介绍了MCP-Injector ，这是一种插入式、协议感知的故障注入中间件，它插入MCP工具调用路径，具有受控的持久性（永久、暂时、间歇性）和可播种的时间表。
Its fault model is calibrated to the observed incident distribution (failure mode x persistence) of the public MCP ecosystem, mined from 57,240 issue and pull-request threads across 1,774 open-source MCP repositories. 其故障模型针对公共MCP生态系统的观察事件分布（故障模式x持久性）进行了校准，从1774个开源MCP存储库中的57,240个问题和拉取请求线程中挖掘。
In a 1,350-cell experiment crossing two backbone sizes (20B, 120B), three agent stacks (custom multi-round plan-and-execute, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangChain), and three fault injection conditions, we find that faults drawn from this permanent-heavy stress profile cause severe quality degradation (task-completion score falls by 60%, from 8.08 to 3.23 out of 10), and that scale does not purchase fault tolerance for the two gpt-oss backbones we test: the 120B retains no larger share of its fault-free score under faults (resilience-ratio model, $p = 0.96$), and its completion rate under faults is, if anything, lower (91.1% vs.
95.6%; difference 4.4 points, 95% CI $[-0.2, 9.3]$). 95.6% ；差异4.4分， 95% CI $ [-0.2, 9.3] $ ）。
Agent stacks differ in how well they absorb faults, which suggests that framework-level error handling matters more than model scale. 代理堆栈在吸收故障方面存在差异，这表明框架级错误处理比模型规模更重要。
These results demonstrate that capability benchmarks alone can mask operational brittleness, motivating protocol-aware fault injection as a complementary evaluation dimension for tool-calling agents. 这些结果表明，单独的能力基准可以掩盖操作脆性，激励协议感知故障注入作为工具调用代理的补充评估维度。

featuredPapers.title: AM-Bench: A Unified Taxonomy and Evaluation Suite for Agentic Misalignment
featuredPapers.authors: Eric Zhang, Terry Jingchen Zhang, Chijioke Ugwuanyi
featuredPapers.summary:
As LLM-based agents are deployed with increasing autonomy in real-world environments, a critical failure mode emerges: agentic misalignment, where agents choose harmful actions over failure. 随着基于LLM的代理在现实环境中以越来越大的自主权进行部署，出现了一种关键的故障模式：代理错位，即代理选择有害操作而不是故障。
However, existing safety benchmarks primarily evaluate whether agents comply with explicitly harmful instructions, leaving the conditions that cause agents to choose harmful actions poorly understood. 但是，现有的安全基准主要评估客服代表是否遵守了明显有害的指示，导致客服代表选择有害行为的条件知之甚少。
To address this limitation, we propose AM-Bench, a unified taxonomy and 35 scenario evaluation benchmark spanning seven industries for agentic misalignment grounded in the fraud triangle, a well-established criminological framework explaining goal-directed misconduct. 为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了AM-Bench ，这是一个跨越七个行业的统一分类法和35个场景评估基准，基于欺诈三角形，这是一个完善的犯罪学框架，可以解释目标导向的不当行为。
We adapt this framework to agentic environments and construct our evaluation suite and detection systems along three dimensions: perceived threat, perceived opportunity, and reasoning. 我们将此框架适应代理环境，并沿着三个维度构建我们的评估套件和检测系统：感知威胁、感知机会和推理。
We operationalize each dimension into structured subcategories rooted in prior theory: five threat categories derived from the instrumental convergence thesis, seven opportunity categories drawn from the Emergent Strategic Reasoning Risks (ESRR) taxonomy, and a novel four-question binary reasoning framework synthesized from prior literature. 我们将每个维度可操作化为植根于先前理论的结构化子类别：源自工具收敛论的五个威胁类别，源自新兴战略推理风险（ ESRR ）分类法的七个机会类别，以及从先前文献中合成的新型四问题二元推理框架。
Our evaluation of 10 frontier models reveals a 62-percentage-point gap in misalignment across scenarios, with Gemini 3 Flash and Gemini 3.1 Pro exhibiting the highest levels of agentic misalignment while Claude Sonnet 4.6 displays near-zero rates across all conditions. 我们对10个前沿模型的评估显示，不同场景之间的错位差距为62个百分点，其中Gemini 3 Flash和Gemini 3.1 Pro在所有条件下都表现出最高水平的代理错位，而Claude Sonnet 4.6在所有条件下的错位率接近于零。
Our reasoning framework further reveals that models may exhibit harmful behaviours without explicit situational awareness or explanation, complicating both mitigation and detection. 我们的推理框架进一步揭示，模型可能在没有明确的态势感知或解释的情况下表现出有害行为，从而使缓解和检测变得复杂。
AM-Bench scenarios and code are available at https://github.com/AI4Collaboration/Agentic-Misalignment-Bench AM-Bench场景和代码可在https://github.com/AI4Collaboration/Agentic-Misalignment-Bench上获得

featuredPapers.title: daVinci-Env: Open SWE Environment Synthesis at Scale
featuredPapers.authors: Dayuan Fu, Shenyu Wu, Yunze Wu
featuredPapers.summary:
Training capable software engineering (SWE) agents demands large-scale, executable, and verifiable environments that provide dynamic feedback loops for iterative code editing, test execution, and solution refinement. 具有培训能力的软件工程（ SWE ）代理需要大规模、可执行和可验证的环境，这些环境为迭代代码编辑、测试执行和解决方案优化提供动态反馈循环。
However, existing open-source datasets remain limited in scale and repository diversity, while industrial solutions are opaque with unreleased infrastructure, creating a prohibitive barrier for most academic research groups. 然而，现有的开源数据集在规模和存储库多样性方面仍然有限，而工业解决方案因未发布的基础设施而变得不透明，为大多数学术研究小组造成了令人望而却步的障碍。
We present OpenSWE, the largest fully transparent framework for SWE agent training in Python, comprising 45,320 executable Docker environments spanning over 12.8k repositories, with all Dockerfiles, evaluation scripts, and infrastructure fully open-sourced for reproducibility. 我们展示了OpenSWE ，这是最大的完全透明的Python SWE代理培训框架，包括跨越12.8k存储库的45,320个可执行Docker环境，所有Docker文件、评估脚本和基础设施都完全开源以实现可重现性。
OpenSWE is built through a multi-agent synthesis pipeline deployed across a 64-node distributed cluster, automating repository exploration, Dockerfile construction, evaluation script generation, and iterative test analysis. OpenSWE通过部署在64节点分布式集群中的多代理合成管道构建，自动化存储库探索、Dockerfile构建、评估脚本生成和迭代测试分析。
Beyond scale, we propose a quality-centric filtering pipeline that characterizes the inherent difficulty of each environment, filtering out instances that are either unsolvable or insufficiently challenging and retaining only those that maximize learning efficiency. 除了规模之外，我们还提出了一个以质量为中心的过滤管道，该管道描述了每个环境的固有难度，过滤掉无法解决或挑战性不足的实例，并仅保留那些最大限度地提高学习效率的实例。
With $891K spent on environment construction and an additional $576K on trajectory sampling and difficulty-aware curation, the entire project represents a total investment of approximately $1.47 million, yielding about 13,000 curated trajectories from roughly 9,000 quality guaranteed environments. 整个项目在环境建设上花费了89.1万美元，在轨迹采样和难度感知管理上又花费了57.6万美元，总投资约为147万美元，从大约9,000个质量保证的环境中产生了约13,000个精心策划的轨迹。
Extensive experiments validate OpenSWE's effectiveness: OpenSWE-32B and OpenSWE-72B achieve 62.4% and 66.0% on SWE-bench Verified, establishing SOTA among Qwen2.5 series. 广泛的实验验证了OpenSWE的有效性： OpenSWE-32B和OpenSWE-72B在SWE-bench Verified上分别达到62.4%和66.0% ，在Qwen2.5系列中确立了SOTA。
Moreover, SWE-focused training yields substantial out-of-domain improvements, including up to 12 points on mathematical reasoning and 5 points on science benchmarks, without degrading factual recall. 此外，以SWE为重点的培训产生了大量的域外改进，包括高达12分的数学推理和5分的科学基准，而不会降低事实回忆。

featuredPapers.title: CASE: Confusion-Aware Skill Evolution for Frozen Multimodal Emotion Models
featuredPapers.authors: Siyu Wu, Zeyu Liang, Linghao Wang
featuredPapers.summary:
Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have substantially advanced Multimodal Emotion Recognition (MER) by enabling fine-grained emotion understanding through reasoning over multimodal evidence. 多模态大型语言模型（ MLLM ）通过对多模态证据进行推理，实现了细粒度的情感理解，从而大幅提升了多模态情感识别（ MER ）。
However, they still exhibit systematic confusion between semantically adjacent emotions with highly overlapping multimodal cues. 然而，它们仍然表现出语义上相邻的情绪与高度重叠的多模态线索之间的系统混淆。
Existing approaches typically address these errors through global parameter adaptation, making confusion correction costly and inflexible. 现有方法通常通过全局参数适应来解决这些错误，这使得混淆校正成本高昂且不灵活。
We instead observe that emotion confusion is highly localized and therefore better addressed through reusable pair-specific expertise. 相反，我们观察到情绪混乱是高度本地化的，因此通过可重复使用的特定于配对的专业知识可以更好地解决。
Building on this insight, we propose Confusion-Aware Skill Evolution (CASE), the first agent-skill framework for MER. 基于这一见解，我们提出了混淆感知技能进化（ CASE ） ，这是MER的第一个客服代表技能框架。
CASE maintains a sparse, self-evolving library of pair-specific EmotionSkills that externalize affective expertise from model parameters, enabling the learned expertise to be continuously refined and readily transferred across diverse frozen MLLM backbones. CASE维护了一个稀疏、自我进化的配对特定情感技能库，将情感专业知识从模型参数中外化，使学习的专业知识能够不断完善，并易于在不同的冷冻MLM骨干中转移。
During inference, CASE dynamically retrieves the appropriate EmotionSkill to reinforce boundary-aware reasoning while keeping the MLLM backbone frozen. 在推理期间， CASE动态检索适当的EmotionSkill ，以加强边界感知推理，同时保持MLM骨干网冻结。
Extensive experiments on CA-MER, DFEW, and EMER demonstrate the effectiveness and transferability of CASE across both general-purpose and emotion-specialized MLLMs. 在CA-MER、DFEW和EMER上的广泛实验证明了CASE在通用和情感专用MLLM中的有效性和可转移性。
Notably, CASE improves the average accuracy of Qwen3-VL-8B on the CA-MER benchmark from 46.80% to 59.13%, while achieving consistent gains across MLLMs. 值得注意的是， CASE将Qwen3-VL-8B在CA-MER基准上的平均准确率从46.80%提高到59.13% ，同时在传销中实现了一致的增长。

featuredPapers.title: PlaceReasoner-Beta: Reasoning-Driven Macro Placement and Benchmarking
featuredPapers.authors: Qiufeng Li, Chengxuan Wang, Rongqian Chen
featuredPapers.summary:
Automated macro placement remains a fundamental challenge in VLSI physical design. 自动化宏观放置仍然是VLSI物理设计中的一个基本挑战。
Despite decades of research, existing approaches predominantly optimize hand-crafted proxy objectives, such as estimated wirelength, and typically produce placements through one-shot numerical optimization, limiting their ability to incorporate visual layout context, codified design expertise, and downstream physical-design feedback in a unified loop. 尽管有数十年的研究，现有的方法主要是优化手工制作的代理目标，例如估计的线长，并且通常通过一次性的数值优化来产生布局，从而限制了它们在统一循环中整合视觉布局背景、编纂设计专业知识和下游物理设计反馈的能力。
We present PlaceReasoner-Beta, a verifier-guided multi-agent framework that reformulates macro placement as a closed-loop reasoning problem rather than black-box optimization. 我们提出了PlaceReasoner-Beta ，这是一个验证者引导的多智能体框架，它将宏观放置重新表述为一个闭环推理问题，而不是黑盒优化。
A vision-language model (VLM) planner generates candidate placements from the floorplan image, macro specifications, and connectivity structure; a geometric verifier enforces physical legality and expert placement principles; a physical verifier refines candidates using early implementation feedback; and a post-route optimizer further improves promising layouts using final PPA. 视觉语言模型（ VLM ）规划器根据平面图图像、宏规范和连接结构生成候选布局；几何验证器执行物理合法性和专家布局原则；物理验证器使用早期实施反馈优化候选；路线后优化器使用最终PPA进一步改进有希望的布局。
To enable reproducible evaluation, we introduce PlaceReasoner-Bench, a fully open end-to-end benchmark built from open RTL designs, EDA tools, and technology libraries. 为了实现可重现的评估，我们引入了PlaceReasoner-Bench ，这是一个完全开放的端到端基准，由开放的RTL设计、EDA工具和技术库构建而成。
It comprises 8 designs at two aspect ratios, yielding 16 tasks with fixed floorplans and I/O assignments, so methods differ only in macro positions and orientations and are evaluated using routed PPA and DRC rather than pre-route proxies.
Across the benchmark, PlaceReasoner-Beta achieves the best timing among DRC-clean methods on all square tasks, reducing post-route TNS by 61.2% at 1:1 and 53.0% at 2:1 relative to the classical baseline field.
It also shortens routed wirelength on most designs despite never explicitly optimizing it, demonstrating that reasoning over spatial structure under physical-design feedback can improve end-to-end layout quality beyond proxy-objective optimization.
highlights: Automated macro placement remains a fundamental challenge in VLSI physical design.

featuredPapers.title: GaP: A Graph-as-Policy Multi-Agent Self-Learning Harness For Variational Automation Tasks
featuredPapers.authors: Kaiyuan Chen, Shuangyu Xie, Letian Fu
featuredPapers.summary:
For robots to work reliably in commercial and industrial applications, recent advances in agentic coding systems have potential to combine interpretable robot programming with the open-world adaptability of model-free policies.
We focus on "Variational Automation" (VA), a class of tasks that have larger variations in object geometry and pose than fixed automation.
Model-free policies often struggle to close the reliability gap for VA tasks, which must be executed persistently and reliably in commercial and industrial applications.
Motivated by prior work on Task and Motion Planning (TAMP) and the Robot Operating System (ROS), we introduce Graph-as-Policy (GaP), a multi-agent coding harness that generates directed computation graphs with perception, planning, and control nodes from a Modular Open Robot Skill Library (MORSL).
GaP generates an internal simulation environment to rehearse task instances with different graphs in parallel to iteratively refine the graph structure and parameters to improve success rates and throughput.
Evaluation with 8 new open VA task benchmarks, 4 in simulation and 4 in real-world, suggests that GaP can achieve success rates that significantly outperform baselines.

featuredPapers.title: Benchmarks Are Surprisingly Compaction-Friendly
featuredPapers.authors: Jeanne Salle, Hardik Bhatnagar, Matthias Bethge
featuredPapers.summary:
Long horizon agentic tasks are now pushing LLM agents past their context window.
To continue the task, the agent scaffold has to free up the context window, a process known as context compaction.
Compaction is generally lossy by design: agents can silently lose task constraints, instructions, or their reasoning behind earlier decisions.
Although compaction is a standard component of coding agent scaffolds, it has not been studied systematically with frontier models on realistic, long horizon agentic tasks.
Previous work evaluate smaller open weight models on toy or synthetic trajectories.
We fix the agent scaffold (OpenCode), implement five compaction strategies inside it, and evaluate three frontier models on three long horizon benchmarks (PaperBench, ProgramBench, PostTrainBench).
For the two 1M context models, the compaction threshold does not measurably affect the task performance, whereas GPT-5.3-Codex, the model with the smallest context window, performs worse at lower thresholds on PaperBench and, less clearly, on PostTrainBench.
No compaction method outperforms default self-summarization, and methods that discard more content cost some models up to 20 points while leaving other models the same.
Compaction can, however, silently remove task constraints: on ProgramBench, the first compaction summary already drops about one third of the task's anticheating rules on average, and this rises monotonically with the number of compactions.
On real user-agent sessions from SWE-chat, instructions about how the agent should work and what it should not do are dropped around 6 times more than specifications of what to build.
We argue that current benchmarks are compaction-friendly: i.e., the objective is fixed and the agent's progress stays on disk, so most of what compaction discards can be recovered, except constraints that don't exist anywhere else.
highlights: first compaction summary already drops about one third of the task's anticheating rules on average
Long horizon agentic tasks are now pushing LLM agents past their context window.

featuredPapers.title: CEMIR vs. FISER: a comparative study of reasoning-based and enrichment-based approaches to pragmatic intent recognition
featuredPapers.authors: Ziya Hosseynzadeh, Farjad Fallah, Farnoosh Fallah
featuredPapers.summary:
Intent recognition in human-robot interaction requires agents to resolve ambiguous natural language instructions by inferring the speaker's underlying goals.
Research has increasingly focused on two notable paradigms for addressing this task: structured symbolic reasoning and multimodal input enrichment.
However, it remains unclear whether enrichment-based methods provide benefit in settings where the ambiguity concerns unstated human intent rather than missing observable scene information.
In this paper, we present a comparative and diagnostic study benchmarking FISER - a framework utilizing structured social and embodied reasoning - against CEMIR (Context-Enriched Multimodal Intent Recognition), a method that performs multimodal enrichment by synthesizing narratives and photorealistic images from textual prompts.
By evaluating both approaches across four Large Language Models (LLMs), ranging from Qwen2.5-Omni-3B to GPT-5, on the HandMeThat v2 benchmark, we analyze their capability to resolve pragmatic ambiguities.
Our statistical analysis, employing multiple-comparison correction, reveals no statistically significant difference in performance between FISER and CEMIR across any model or difficulty level.
This pattern holds across all sixteen model-by-difficulty comparisons, as well as in a targeted ablation isolating CEMIR's narrative and visual components.
Instead, performance is primarily associated with backbone capability and the inherent difficulty of the ambiguity.
These findings suggest a boundary condition for text-derived multimodal enrichment: when the relevant task constraints are already available in the textual instruction, synthetic multimodal augmentation may not provide measurable benefit over structured reasoning on the same text.
highlights: present a comparative and diagnostic study benchmarking FISER - a framework

featuredPapers.title: Before the Ticket: Grounding HPC User Support in Documentation and Resolved Tickets with an Agentic LLM Assistant
featuredPapers.authors: Elham J. Barezi, Primus C Kabuo, Niveditha Nerella
featuredPapers.summary:
Most questions that reach an HPC help desk have already been answered in the center's user guides or in a ticket someone else filed last semester; users still file new tickets because the guides are hard to navigate and the ticket history is not theirs to search.
We present an assistant that answers from both sources: an orchestrator calls two tools over the Model Context Protocol, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over the live documentation and a Llama-3-8B model fine-tuned with QLoRA on 11,244 query-resolution pairs mined from historical tickets, and merges their answers.
Every model runs on-premises or on the university's hosted LLM service because ticket data may not leave the institution.
On 400 held-out tickets from Purdue's Rosen Center for Advanced Computing, disjoint from training and free of near-duplicates, and evaluated by two judges from model families that generated none of the answers, fine-tuning on resolutions rewritten into self-service guidance is the clear winner in agreement with RCAC's resolutions (BERTScore F1 improves from 0.06 to 0.27 over the base model) and is judged most correct on average.
The end-to-end system does not improve on its tools, although they are complementary: choosing the better answer per question would exceed either tool (judged correctness 3.41 versus 3.20, an oracle bound), while the merge follows the documentation tool in 78% of answers.
Returning one tool's answer instead recovers the fine-tuned tool's quality (3.19 versus 2.66), but neither a learned selector nor an LLM verifier beats that tool alone.

featuredPapers.title: S$^2$-MAS: A Society-Scale Multi-Agent Simulation Framework with 500 Million Household Persona Agents
featuredPapers.authors: Yang Li, Yike Wang, Di Wan
featuredPapers.summary:
Simulating economic responses at society scale requires agents whose decisions reflect household circumstances.
We introduce S$^2$-MAS, a society-scale multi-agent simulation framework built on 500 million synthetic household personas grounded in real-survey data.
Its Genese engine separates decisions from state updates, while reusable financial scenarios and application ledgers track consumption, cash, debt and payments.
Trained with SFT + RLCD on 2.93 million examples, sharp-421m-mlx achieves 74.55% accuracy and 38.37% question-macro F1 on one-shot consumer financial-choice tasks derived from held-out survey responses.
Its accuracy exceeds GLM-5.3-Flash, Jev 1.13, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, GPT-6-Luna and GPT-6-Astra in the common benchmark (full test for the first four; matched 500-group sample for Astra).
We evaluate eight financial task families and simulate 12 million distinct household agents in paired purchase-funding conditions.
Jointly raising purchase goals and approved credit limits increases consumption, with responses differing across age and income groups.
Education, employment and household-size differences persist after age-income standardization and mainly reflect transitions from deferral to purchase.
Asset and debt groups differ in cash drawdown, repayment and closing debt.
S$^2$-MAS links heterogeneous household decisions to evolving consumption, cash and repayment paths, supporting economic experiments across household groups and population scales.

featuredPapers.title: Correct Answers, Closed Gates: SolveBind for GUI Agents at the Verification Barrier
featuredPapers.authors: Xinhao Song, Haoxuan Peng, Su Su
featuredPapers.summary:
Websites and applications deploy CAPTCHAs and anti-automation mechanisms that use behavioral signals such as interaction trajectories and timing, not outcomes alone, to distinguish humans from automated agents.
We call these protected GUI environments, where correctly solving a verification task is insufficient for end-to-end task completion.
Agents must turn solver outputs into accepted interactions and adapt execution to runtime feedback under time constraints.
We introduce SolveBind, a GUI-agent framework combining hierarchical solving with runtime supervision.
A hierarchical solving tree decomposes verification into interdependent Perceive, Ground, Solve, Act, and Verify capabilities.
A runtime supervisor grounds action commitments in tool-derived evidence, revises them as evidence arrives, and mediates execution under explicit recovery budgets.
Across nine CAPTCHA task families and nine backbone models, SolveBind achieves the highest success rate on eight backbones, outperforming the strongest baseline by 13.3-34.5 percentage points.
It achieves the highest success rate on all six AndroidWorld backbones.
In a paired GPT-5.5 analysis, MobileAgent produces correct answers but fails dynamic verification on 13 of 90 tasks; SolveBind succeeds on seven of these tasks.
With automatic submission, removing binding reduces success from 82.22% to 71.56% and increases latency and token usage.
Recovery caps reduce execution cost with a small observed success trade-off: removing them raises success from 82.22% to 83.56%, while increasing latency and token usage to 3.7x and 2.4x their full-supervision values, respectively.
These results support evidence-grounded execution control while identifying a success-cost trade-off in recovery and failure boundaries of heuristic submission rules.

featuredPapers.title: Muse Glimmer 30B: An On-Device Agentic Model
featuredPapers.authors: Arash Ebrahim Abtahizadeh, Muna Aghamelu, Adil Ahmed
featuredPapers.summary:
We introduce Muse Glimmer, an open-source 30B parameter causal language model with perception encoder, purpose-built for autonomous agentic tasks on consumer hardware.
Muse Glimmer integrates multi-step reasoning, reliable tool use and failure recovery into a single model that runs locally on consumer devices without requiring cloud infrastructure.
The model accepts text and image inputs and produces text outputs, was trained on data from over a hundred languages, and is quantized to approximately 4-bit precision for efficient single-GPU inference.
Muse Glimmer achieves state-of-the-art performance for its size class on agentic benchmarks, setting a new standard compared to the models of its size: Gemma4-31B and Qwen3.6-27B on tool use, multi-step planning, and agentic task completion.
We release the model under the Apache 2.0 license to foster open-source development of capable, safe, local AI agents.

featuredPapers.title: Trial by Trace: Benchmarking AI Agent Harnesses for Reliability and Failure Attribution
featuredPapers.authors: Zhiyong Cao, Hengjie Zhu, Yongxin Wang
featuredPapers.summary:
LLM agents are increasingly used to solve real-world problems, and their effectiveness depends on both the underlying models and the harnesses that support their operation.
However, most existing benchmarks focus on model capabilities and overall agent performance, with limited attention to the evaluation of agent harnesses.
To address this gap, we introduce TraceTrial-Bench, which organizes harness reliability into seven components covering context, execution, governance, lifecycle, observability, tools, and verification.
We construct 95 expert-level, mechanism-oriented tasks with executable or state-based ground truth to support semantically equivalent comparisons while preserving the native behavior of each harness.
We design a Trajectory Tracing (TT) module to capture agent execution traces and introduce a two-layer evaluation framework that separately assesses agent performance and harness reliability.
In addition, we design a Multi-source Evidence Acquisition (MEA) module to provide evidence from the agent context, harness, and execution environment for LLM-based evaluation, and develop a Failure Attribution (FA) module that uses explicit mechanism chains to support attribution at the run level.
Across 4 harnesses, 9 models, and 95 tasks, our evaluation of 3,420 runs yields macro-averaged harness scores ranging from 59.8% to 72.0%, while 31.1% of runs achieve task success despite failing at least one harness criterion.
TraceTrial-Bench provides an auditable and reproducible foundation for comparing agent harnesses, diagnosing their failures, and studying how harness design interacts with model behavior.

featuredPapers.title: Ontology-Guided Knowledge Graph Construction from Structured Metadata and Climate Science Publications
featuredPapers.authors: Aayush Acharya, Qi Zhang, Eduard Dragut
featuredPapers.summary:
The rapid expansion of scientific literature far outpaces the speed of manual curation, creating a fundamental bottleneck in extracting structured knowledge from scientific texts.
To address this, we introduce an agentic, ontology-guided framework for knowledge graph (KG) construction.
Our framework utilizes specialized agents for document understanding, information extraction, ontology conformance, and entity linking.
First, an LLM extracts factual knowledge in the form of triples with explicit textual evidence from research papers.
Then the triplets undergo a multistage verification process to ground the triplets in the ontology.
By enforcing schema constraints and requiring evidence in the form of text fragments, we ensure the data is both semantically consistent and traceable.
In an agreement study over 1,000 extracted triplets, Gemini-2.5-flash achieves Cohen's $\kappa$ scores of 0.640--0.700 against three human annotators, matching the human--human agreement range of 0.616--0.689.
We applied this framework to 2,000 scientific publications and construct a novel, ontology-grounded KG for climate science with 133,990 nodes and 755,308 relations; of the 23,327 triplets that the publications contribute after validation, 98.96\% are judged correct.
The pipeline code and KG is publicly available https://github.com/aayushacharya/climatekg.
highlights: To address this, we introduce an agentic, ontology-guided framework for knowledge graph (KG) construction.

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: RSI-Opt: Recursive Self-Improvement Optimizer Agents For Model Training
papers.summary:
Conventional neural-network training typically follows a predefined optimization recipe, motivating a LLM agent that monitors training dynamics and adjusts optimizer settings as training progresses, but a fixed agent policy does not accumulate experience across runs. 传统的神经网络培训通常遵循预定义的优化方案，激励LLM代理监控培训动态并随着培训的进展调整优化器设置，但固定代理策略不会在整个运行过程中积累经验。
We introduce RSI-Opt, a plug-and-play Recursive Self-Improvement Optimizer Agents which evolves the knowledge that guides this process: a prompt, a playbook of procedures, a library of tested optimizer code, and a decision cadence. 我们引入了RSI-Opt ，这是一种即插即用的递归自我改进优化代理，它演变了指导此过程的知识：提示、过程剧本、经过测试的优化器代码库和决策节奏。
A meta-agent rewrites this policy using evidence from earlier runs, and an archive retains evaluated policies for further evolution. 元代理使用早期运行的证据重写此策略，存档保留评估的策略以供进一步演进。
Across 5 generations on three training tasks, the meta-agents develop reusable procedures and code and conduct their own CPU proxy experiments. 在三个训练任务的5代中，元代理开发可重用的过程和代码，并进行自己的CPU代理实验。
RSI-Opt substantially improves optimizer-agent performance, with representative raw-space summary $z$-scores increasing from $+10.48$ to $+14.33$ on the evolution suite with Opus 5.5 and from $-0.36$ to $+3.11$ on held-out tasks with GPT-5.5 through cross-model policy transfer. RSI-Opt大大提高了优化器-代理的性能，具有代表性的原始空间摘要$ z $ -分数在带有Opus 5.5的进化套件中从$ +10.48 $增加到$ +14.33 $ ，在带有GPT-5.5的保留任务中通过跨模型策略转移从$ -0.36 $增加到$ +3.11 $。
On the Burgers PDE, it reduces mean relative $L_2$ error by approximately 2.7-fold with Opus 5.5 and 8.8-fold with GPT-6.1 over the fixed-prompt agent baseline, although PDE transfer varies across LLMs and tasks. 在Burgers PDE上，使用Opus 5.5 ，平均相对$ L_2 $误差减少约2.7倍，使用GPT-6.1 ，平均相对相对误差减少约8.8倍，尽管PDE转移因LLM和任务而异。
Controlled comparisons show that the evolved policy combines reusable optimization knowledge with adaptation to each task: initial decisions capture most observed gains on seen tasks, while continued adaptation improves outcomes on unseen tasks. 受控比较表明，演化后的策略将可重用的优化知识与对每个任务的适应性相结合：初始决策捕获了所见任务中观察到的最多收益，而持续的适应性则改善了未见任务的结果。
These findings demonstrate how procedures and executable tools accumulated across training runs can improve optimizer-agent performance and support transfer to scientific machine learning. 这些研究结果表明，在培训运行中积累的程序和可执行工具如何提高优化器代理的性能，并支持向科学机器学习的转移。
highlights: A meta-agent rewrites this policy using evidence from earlier runs, and an archive retains evaluated policies for furthe

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: TGR-EvoDAG: A DAG-based Multi-Agent Code Evolution Framework for Generative Recommendation on Tencent
papers.summary:
Large Language Model (LLM) agents have enabled automated code evolution for algorithm discovery. 大型语言模型（ LLM ）代理已经为算法发现启用了自动代码演化。
However, current recursive self-improvement (RSI) research for sequential recommendation faces a dilemma: general-purpose frameworks lack domain-specific feedback, while recommender-specific frameworks rely on linear evolution. 然而，目前针对顺序推荐的递归自我改进（ RSI ）研究面临着一个困境：通用框架缺乏特定领域的反馈，而推荐者特定的框架依赖于线性进化。
Crucially, naively integrating them fails when applied to Generative Recommendation (GR). 至关重要的是，当应用于生成式推荐（ GR ）时，天真地整合它们是失败的。
Unlike end-to-end models, GR relies on a module-cascaded pipeline (tokenization, pre-training, and alignment). 与端到端模型不同， GR依赖于模块级联管道（标记化、预训练和对齐）。
In this paradigm, existing evolution methods suffer from: i) cost blindness, squandering budgets by ignoring stage-asymmetric retraining overheads; and ii) short-sighted evaluation, discarding promising upstream innovations that temporarily regress metrics before downstream adaptation. 在这种范式中，现有的演进方法受到以下问题的困扰： i ）成本盲目性，通过忽略阶段性非对称再培训开销而浪费预算;和ii ）短视的评估，放弃有前途的上游创新，这些创新在下游适应之前暂时退化指标。
To bridge these gaps, we propose TGR-EvoDAG, a multi-agent code evolution framework tailored for GR. 为了弥合这些差距，我们提出了TGR-EvoDAG ，这是一个为GR量身定制的多智能体代码演化框架。
TGR-EvoDAG models code evolution as a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) to maintain multiple evolution branches and merge complementary innovations, unifying advanced search with rich GR diagnostic feedback. TGR-EvoDAG将代码进化建模为有向无环图（ DAG ） ，以维护多个进化分支并合并互补创新，将高级搜索与丰富的GR诊断反馈统一起来。
We further introduce stage-aware cost planning to optimize GPU-hour budgets, and active downstream co-adaptation to navigate temporary regressions and unlock cross-stage gains. 我们进一步引入了阶段感知成本规划，以优化GPU小时预算，以及积极的下游共同适应，以应对临时回归并解锁跨阶段收益。
On public Amazon datasets, TGR-EvoDAG enables the first autonomous evolution of a complete GR pipeline, improving offline metrics by up to 37.4% and Agent4Rec simulated user satisfaction by 19.7% over the strongest baseline. 在公共Amazon数据集上， TGR-EvoDAG实现了完整GR管道的首次自主演进，使离线指标提高了37.4% ， Agent4Rec模拟用户满意度比最强基线提高了19.7%。
Furthermore, in industrial deployment on Tencent's large-scale commercial media platform, the evolved GR achieves a 12.16% relative improvement in offline Hit@1 and a statistically significant 0.40% increase in online click-through rate (CTR). 此外，在腾讯大型商业媒体平台的行业部署中，演进后的GR在线下点击率@ 1上实现了12.16%的相对提升，在线点击率（ CTR ）上实现了0.40%的统计显著提升。
highlights: first autonomous evolution of a complete GR pipeline

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: HarnessMM: Recursive Self-Improvement for Harness Token Efficiency
papers.summary:
Agent harnesses repeatedly invoke reasoning after tool feedback, even when an earlier call has already fixed the next action. 客服代表在工具反馈后反复调用推理，即使之前的呼叫已经修复了下一个操作。
We introduce HarnessMM (Harness Minus Minus), a method for improving harness token efficiency through guarded decision reuse and recursive self-improvement (RSI). 我们引入了HarnessMM （ Harness Minus Minus ） ，这是一种通过保护决策重用和递归自我改进（ RSI ）来提高利用令牌效率的方法。
RSI iteratively refines companion harness configurations from training feedback, with validation selecting the configuration for deployment. RSI从培训反馈中迭代优化配套线束配置，并通过验证选择要部署的配置。
A controller at the model-tool boundary reuses resolved decisions to replace later reasoning callbacks while actor weights remain fixed. 模型-工具边界的控制器重用已解析的决策来替换后来的推理回调，而参与者权重保持不变。
Executable Decision Graphs store exact actions, literal arguments, causal dependencies, and public guards. 可执行决策图存储精确操作、字面参数、因果依赖关系和公共防护。
Guarded Decision Reuse activates these persistent decisions from observed receipts; Certified Callback Substitution executes them through the native interface and records removal of the registered slow callback. Guarded Decision Reuse从观察到的回执中激活这些持续的决策； Certified Callback Substitution通过本机界面执行这些决策，并记录已注册的慢速回调的删除。
New semantic decisions, unsupported evidence, and selector abstention invoke the original actor again. 新的语义决策、不受支持的证据和选择器弃权会再次调用原始参与者。
The representation restricts what feedback may change, while complete-task measurements establish quality and cost. 表示形式限制了反馈可能发生的变化，而完整的任务测量则确定了质量和成本。
On HumanEval, HarnessMM preserves Codex success at 90.82\% while reducing Tokens/task (k) from 66.72 to 47.02 (29.54\% saving). 在HumanEval上， HarnessMM将Codex的成功率保持在90.82\ % ，同时将代币/任务（ k ）从66.72降低到47.02 （节省29.54\ % ）。
For DeepSeek Harness, success rises from 71.43\% to 85.71\% while Tokens/task (k) fall from 96.28 to 11.62 (87.93\% saving). 对于DeepSeek线束，成功率从71.43\ %上升到85.71\ % ，而代币/任务（ k ）从96.28下降到11.62 （节省87.93\ % ）。
A separate MBPP ablation measures 26.91\% lower cost than single-use graphs and 19.52\% lower cost than retained callbacks. 单独的MBPP消融比一次性使用图表成本低26.91\ % ，比保留的回拨成本低19.52\ %。
These results establish guarded decision reuse as a practical way to reduce repeated reasoning in existing harnesses. 这些结果确立了谨慎决策重用作为减少现有线束中重复推理的实用方法。
highlights: Agent harnesses repeatedly invoke reasoning after tool feedback, even when an earlier call has already fixed the next ac

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: An Agentic Approach with Evidence-Grounded Verification for Multimodal Emotion Reasoning in Conversation
papers.summary:
LLM-based multimodal emotion reasoning systems perform well on standard benchmarks, but improving them through instruction tuning can be computationally expensive. 基于LLM的多模态情感推理系统在标准基准上表现良好，但通过指令调整来改进它们的计算成本可能很高。
Agentic pipelines built from frozen models avoid this cost, but introduce a different challenge: when a prediction is wrong, the system must identify which agent or stage caused the error. 基于冻结模型构建的代理管道避免了这一成本，但引入了一个不同的挑战：当预测错误时，系统必须确定导致错误的代理或阶段。
We address this problem with an agentic framework for traceable multimodal emotion reasoning and prompt-space adaptation. 我们通过可追溯的多模态情感推理和即时空间适应的代理框架来解决这个问题。
Modality-specific perception agents analyze visual, acoustic, and lexical inputs and post evidence-cited observations to a shared board. 模态特定的感知代理分析视觉、声学和词汇输入，并将证据引用的观察结果发布到共享板。
An integration agent combines these observations with retrieved multimodal examples to produce an emotion description, label set, and supporting citations, while an MLLM critic can request one revision before the output is finalized. 集成代理将这些观察结果与检索到的多模态示例相结合，以生成情感描述、标签集和支持引用，而MLLM批评者可以在输出最终确定之前请求一个修订。
For incorrect predictions, a separate evidence-grounded verification stage applies deterministic checks to verify that cited evidence and references are valid, and an entailment check to determine whether the final claims are supported by that evidence. 对于不正确的预测，一个单独的基于证据的验证阶段应用确定性检查来验证引用的证据和参考文献是否有效，并进行牵连检查以确定最终索赔是否得到该证据的支持。
Detected failures are then grouped by the responsible component and failure type, converted into targeted prompt patches, and accepted only after validation on a held-out set. 然后，检测到的故障按负责组件和故障类型分组，转换为有针对性的提示修补程序，并仅在保留集上进行验证后才接受。
This adapts the agent prompts without updating model weights. 这将在不更新模型权重的情况下调整代理提示。
On the MER2025 dataset, targeted prompt adaptation outperforms the frozen static pipeline on all four MLLMs, ranging from 2B to 38B parameters, and matches or outperforms undifferentiated reflection baselines on each of them: VideoLLaMA3-2B, Phi-3.5-vision-instruct, Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, and InternVL2.5-38B. 在MER2025数据集上，有针对性的提示适应在所有四个MLLM （范围从2B到38B参数）上都优于冻结的静态管线，并且在每个MLLM上匹配或优于未分化的反射基线： VideoLLaMA3-2B、Phi-3.5-vision-instruct、Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct和InternVL2.5-38B。
It improves F-score by 0.6--2.2 points depending on the backbone, including an increase from 52.3 to 54.5 on Qwen2.5-VL-7B. 它根据骨干将F分数提高了0.6-2.2分，包括在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上从52.3分提高到54.5分。
highlights: outperforms the frozen static pipeline on all four MLLMs

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: Compact-Bench: Measuring What Context Compaction Costs Long-Horizon Coding Agents
papers.summary:
Context compaction lets long-horizon coding agents continue beyond their context windows, but can erase the state needed to finish a task. 上下文压缩允许长距离编码代理继续超出其上下文窗口，但可以擦除完成任务所需的状态。
Prior evaluations measure efficiency, retained information, or end-to-end success, leaving the effect of a specific history replacement difficult to isolate. 先前的评估衡量效率、保留的信息或端到端的成功，使特定历史记录替换的影响难以隔离。
Compact-Bench pairs full-history and summary-only continuations from a shared repository state, and evaluates recurring details and successive production compactions. Compact-Bench将共享存储库状态的完整历史记录和仅总结的延续配对，并评估重复的详细信息和连续的生产压缩。
It covers 35 SWE-bench repairs, 146 agentic sessions, and 106 production chains. 它涵盖35个SWE-bench维修， 146个代理会话和106个生产链。
Across 14 summarizer backbones, stable damage ranges from 5-64% of 22 full-history successes: Claude Opus 4.8 preserves the most repairs, while DeepSeek-Flash damages the most. 在14个汇总器主干中，稳定的损坏范围在22个全历史成功案例的5-64%之间： Claude Opus 4.8保留了最多的修复，而DeepSeek-Flash损坏最多。
With Kimi-K3 as summarizer, the Kimi Code prompt preserves the most task continuations (19/22), whereas Claude Code retains the most recurring details (15.0%). 以Kimi-K3为总结者， Kimi Code提示保留了最多的任务延续（ 19/22 ） ，而Claude Code保留了最常见的细节（ 15.0% ）。
LLM summaries retain at most 16.0% of recurring details, compared with 79.1% for mechanical extraction; production summaries retain 15.7% at the first boundary. LLM总结最多保留16.0 ％的经常性细节，而机械提取为79.1 ％ ；生产总结保留第一个边界的15.7 ％。
Failures recur across methods: one repair is damaged by 13/14 backbones, and another by all 5 prompts. 故障在各种方法中重复发生：一次修复被13/14骨架损坏，另一次被全部5个提示损坏。
These results show that reliable compaction requires preserving the progress needed to complete a task, and that retaining relevant information alone does not ensure successful continuation. 这些结果表明，可靠的压实要求保留完成任务所需的进度，而仅保留相关信息并不能确保成功延续。
Code is available at https://github.com/cai-jianfeng/compact-bench and data is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/caijanfeng/compact-bench. 代码可在https://github.com/cai-jianfeng/compact-bench上获得，数据可在https://huggingface.co/datasets/caijanfeng/compact-bench上获得。

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: Tool-Calling LLM Agents Under Realistic MCP Faults: Scale Does Not Purchase Fault Tolerance
papers.summary:
LLM agents increasingly rely on external tools exposed via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), yet current benchmarks assume tools respond correctly and on time, leaving agent resilience to realistic tool failures untested. LLM代理越来越依赖于通过模型上下文协议（ MCP ）公开的外部工具，但当前的基准假设工具响应正确且及时，使得代理对现实工具故障的弹性未经测试。
We introduce MCP-Injector, a drop-in, protocol-aware fault-injection middleware that interposes on the MCP tool-call path with controlled persistence (permanent, transient, intermittent) and seedable schedules. 我们介绍了MCP-Injector ，这是一种插入式、协议感知的故障注入中间件，它插入MCP工具调用路径，具有受控的持久性（永久、暂时、间歇性）和可播种的时间表。
Its fault model is calibrated to the observed incident distribution (failure mode x persistence) of the public MCP ecosystem, mined from 57,240 issue and pull-request threads across 1,774 open-source MCP repositories. 其故障模型针对公共MCP生态系统的观察事件分布（故障模式x持久性）进行了校准，从1774个开源MCP存储库中的57,240个问题和拉取请求线程中挖掘。
In a 1,350-cell experiment crossing two backbone sizes (20B, 120B), three agent stacks (custom multi-round plan-and-execute, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangChain), and three fault injection conditions, we find that faults drawn from this permanent-heavy stress profile cause severe quality degradation (task-completion score falls by 60%, from 8.08 to 3.23 out of 10), and that scale does not purchase fault tolerance for the two gpt-oss backbones we test: the 120B retains no larger share of its fault-free score under faults (resilience-ratio model, $p = 0.96$), and its completion rate under faults is, if anything, lower (91.1% vs.
95.6%; difference 4.4 points, 95% CI $[-0.2, 9.3]$). 95.6% ；差异4.4分， 95% CI $ [-0.2, 9.3] $ ）。
Agent stacks differ in how well they absorb faults, which suggests that framework-level error handling matters more than model scale. 代理堆栈在吸收故障方面存在差异，这表明框架级错误处理比模型规模更重要。
These results demonstrate that capability benchmarks alone can mask operational brittleness, motivating protocol-aware fault injection as a complementary evaluation dimension for tool-calling agents. 这些结果表明，单独的能力基准可以掩盖操作脆性，激励协议感知故障注入作为工具调用代理的补充评估维度。

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: AM-Bench: A Unified Taxonomy and Evaluation Suite for Agentic Misalignment
papers.summary:
As LLM-based agents are deployed with increasing autonomy in real-world environments, a critical failure mode emerges: agentic misalignment, where agents choose harmful actions over failure. 随着基于LLM的代理在现实环境中以越来越大的自主权进行部署，出现了一种关键的故障模式：代理错位，即代理选择有害操作而不是故障。
However, existing safety benchmarks primarily evaluate whether agents comply with explicitly harmful instructions, leaving the conditions that cause agents to choose harmful actions poorly understood. 但是，现有的安全基准主要评估客服代表是否遵守了明显有害的指示，导致客服代表选择有害行为的条件知之甚少。
To address this limitation, we propose AM-Bench, a unified taxonomy and 35 scenario evaluation benchmark spanning seven industries for agentic misalignment grounded in the fraud triangle, a well-established criminological framework explaining goal-directed misconduct. 为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了AM-Bench ，这是一个跨越七个行业的统一分类法和35个场景评估基准，基于欺诈三角形，这是一个完善的犯罪学框架，可以解释目标导向的不当行为。
We adapt this framework to agentic environments and construct our evaluation suite and detection systems along three dimensions: perceived threat, perceived opportunity, and reasoning. 我们将此框架适应代理环境，并沿着三个维度构建我们的评估套件和检测系统：感知威胁、感知机会和推理。
We operationalize each dimension into structured subcategories rooted in prior theory: five threat categories derived from the instrumental convergence thesis, seven opportunity categories drawn from the Emergent Strategic Reasoning Risks (ESRR) taxonomy, and a novel four-question binary reasoning framework synthesized from prior literature. 我们将每个维度可操作化为植根于先前理论的结构化子类别：源自工具收敛论的五个威胁类别，源自新兴战略推理风险（ ESRR ）分类法的七个机会类别，以及从先前文献中合成的新型四问题二元推理框架。
Our evaluation of 10 frontier models reveals a 62-percentage-point gap in misalignment across scenarios, with Gemini 3 Flash and Gemini 3.1 Pro exhibiting the highest levels of agentic misalignment while Claude Sonnet 4.6 displays near-zero rates across all conditions. 我们对10个前沿模型的评估显示，不同场景之间的错位差距为62个百分点，其中Gemini 3 Flash和Gemini 3.1 Pro在所有条件下都表现出最高水平的代理错位，而Claude Sonnet 4.6在所有条件下的错位率接近于零。
Our reasoning framework further reveals that models may exhibit harmful behaviours without explicit situational awareness or explanation, complicating both mitigation and detection. 我们的推理框架进一步揭示，模型可能在没有明确的态势感知或解释的情况下表现出有害行为，从而使缓解和检测变得复杂。
AM-Bench scenarios and code are available at https://github.com/AI4Collaboration/Agentic-Misalignment-Bench AM-Bench场景和代码可在https://github.com/AI4Collaboration/Agentic-Misalignment-Bench上获得
highlights: AM-Bench scenarios and code are available at https://github.com/AI4Collaboration/Agentic-Misalignment-Bench

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: daVinci-Env: Open SWE Environment Synthesis at Scale
papers.summary:
Training capable software engineering (SWE) agents demands large-scale, executable, and verifiable environments that provide dynamic feedback loops for iterative code editing, test execution, and solution refinement. 具有培训能力的软件工程（ SWE ）代理需要大规模、可执行和可验证的环境，这些环境为迭代代码编辑、测试执行和解决方案优化提供动态反馈循环。
However, existing open-source datasets remain limited in scale and repository diversity, while industrial solutions are opaque with unreleased infrastructure, creating a prohibitive barrier for most academic research groups. 然而，现有的开源数据集在规模和存储库多样性方面仍然有限，而工业解决方案因未发布的基础设施而变得不透明，为大多数学术研究小组造成了令人望而却步的障碍。
We present OpenSWE, the largest fully transparent framework for SWE agent training in Python, comprising 45,320 executable Docker environments spanning over 12.8k repositories, with all Dockerfiles, evaluation scripts, and infrastructure fully open-sourced for reproducibility. 我们展示了OpenSWE ，这是最大的完全透明的Python SWE代理培训框架，包括跨越12.8k存储库的45,320个可执行Docker环境，所有Docker文件、评估脚本和基础设施都完全开源以实现可重现性。
OpenSWE is built through a multi-agent synthesis pipeline deployed across a 64-node distributed cluster, automating repository exploration, Dockerfile construction, evaluation script generation, and iterative test analysis. OpenSWE通过部署在64节点分布式集群中的多代理合成管道构建，自动化存储库探索、Dockerfile构建、评估脚本生成和迭代测试分析。
Beyond scale, we propose a quality-centric filtering pipeline that characterizes the inherent difficulty of each environment, filtering out instances that are either unsolvable or insufficiently challenging and retaining only those that maximize learning efficiency. 除了规模之外，我们还提出了一个以质量为中心的过滤管道，该管道描述了每个环境的固有难度，过滤掉无法解决或挑战性不足的实例，并仅保留那些最大限度地提高学习效率的实例。
With $891K spent on environment construction and an additional $576K on trajectory sampling and difficulty-aware curation, the entire project represents a total investment of approximately $1.47 million, yielding about 13,000 curated trajectories from roughly 9,000 quality guaranteed environments. 整个项目在环境建设上花费了89.1万美元，在轨迹采样和难度感知管理上又花费了57.6万美元，总投资约为147万美元，从大约9,000个质量保证的环境中产生了约13,000个精心策划的轨迹。
Extensive experiments validate OpenSWE's effectiveness: OpenSWE-32B and OpenSWE-72B achieve 62.4% and 66.0% on SWE-bench Verified, establishing SOTA among Qwen2.5 series. 广泛的实验验证了OpenSWE的有效性： OpenSWE-32B和OpenSWE-72B在SWE-bench Verified上分别达到62.4%和66.0% ，在Qwen2.5系列中确立了SOTA。
Moreover, SWE-focused training yields substantial out-of-domain improvements, including up to 12 points on mathematical reasoning and 5 points on science benchmarks, without degrading factual recall. 此外，以SWE为重点的培训产生了大量的域外改进，包括高达12分的数学推理和5分的科学基准，而不会降低事实回忆。

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: CASE: Confusion-Aware Skill Evolution for Frozen Multimodal Emotion Models
papers.summary:
Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have substantially advanced Multimodal Emotion Recognition (MER) by enabling fine-grained emotion understanding through reasoning over multimodal evidence. 多模态大型语言模型（ MLLM ）通过对多模态证据进行推理，实现了细粒度的情感理解，从而大幅提升了多模态情感识别（ MER ）。
However, they still exhibit systematic confusion between semantically adjacent emotions with highly overlapping multimodal cues. 然而，它们仍然表现出语义上相邻的情绪与高度重叠的多模态线索之间的系统混淆。
Existing approaches typically address these errors through global parameter adaptation, making confusion correction costly and inflexible. 现有方法通常通过全局参数适应来解决这些错误，这使得混淆校正成本高昂且不灵活。
We instead observe that emotion confusion is highly localized and therefore better addressed through reusable pair-specific expertise. 相反，我们观察到情绪混乱是高度本地化的，因此通过可重复使用的特定于配对的专业知识可以更好地解决。
Building on this insight, we propose Confusion-Aware Skill Evolution (CASE), the first agent-skill framework for MER. 基于这一见解，我们提出了混淆感知技能进化（ CASE ） ，这是MER的第一个客服代表技能框架。
CASE maintains a sparse, self-evolving library of pair-specific EmotionSkills that externalize affective expertise from model parameters, enabling the learned expertise to be continuously refined and readily transferred across diverse frozen MLLM backbones. CASE维护了一个稀疏、自我进化的配对特定情感技能库，将情感专业知识从模型参数中外化，使学习的专业知识能够不断完善，并易于在不同的冷冻MLM骨干中转移。
During inference, CASE dynamically retrieves the appropriate EmotionSkill to reinforce boundary-aware reasoning while keeping the MLLM backbone frozen. 在推理期间， CASE动态检索适当的EmotionSkill ，以加强边界感知推理，同时保持MLM骨干网冻结。
Extensive experiments on CA-MER, DFEW, and EMER demonstrate the effectiveness and transferability of CASE across both general-purpose and emotion-specialized MLLMs. 在CA-MER、DFEW和EMER上的广泛实验证明了CASE在通用和情感专用MLLM中的有效性和可转移性。
Notably, CASE improves the average accuracy of Qwen3-VL-8B on the CA-MER benchmark from 46.80% to 59.13%, while achieving consistent gains across MLLMs. 值得注意的是， CASE将Qwen3-VL-8B在CA-MER基准上的平均准确率从46.80%提高到59.13% ，同时在传销中实现了一致的增长。

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: Benchmarks Are Surprisingly Compaction-Friendly
papers.summary:
Long horizon agentic tasks are now pushing LLM agents past their context window.
To continue the task, the agent scaffold has to free up the context window, a process known as context compaction.
Compaction is generally lossy by design: agents can silently lose task constraints, instructions, or their reasoning behind earlier decisions.
Although compaction is a standard component of coding agent scaffolds, it has not been studied systematically with frontier models on realistic, long horizon agentic tasks.
Previous work evaluate smaller open weight models on toy or synthetic trajectories.
We fix the agent scaffold (OpenCode), implement five compaction strategies inside it, and evaluate three frontier models on three long horizon benchmarks (PaperBench, ProgramBench, PostTrainBench).
For the two 1M context models, the compaction threshold does not measurably affect the task performance, whereas GPT-5.3-Codex, the model with the smallest context window, performs worse at lower thresholds on PaperBench and, less clearly, on PostTrainBench.
No compaction method outperforms default self-summarization, and methods that discard more content cost some models up to 20 points while leaving other models the same.
Compaction can, however, silently remove task constraints: on ProgramBench, the first compaction summary already drops about one third of the task's anticheating rules on average, and this rises monotonically with the number of compactions.
On real user-agent sessions from SWE-chat, instructions about how the agent should work and what it should not do are dropped around 6 times more than specifications of what to build.
We argue that current benchmarks are compaction-friendly: i.e., the objective is fixed and the agent's progress stays on disk, so most of what compaction discards can be recovered, except constraints that don't exist anywhere else.
highlights: first compaction summary already drops about one third of the task's anticheating rules on average
Long horizon agentic tasks are now pushing LLM agents past their context window.

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: CEMIR vs. FISER: a comparative study of reasoning-based and enrichment-based approaches to pragmatic intent recognition
papers.summary:
Intent recognition in human-robot interaction requires agents to resolve ambiguous natural language instructions by inferring the speaker's underlying goals.
Research has increasingly focused on two notable paradigms for addressing this task: structured symbolic reasoning and multimodal input enrichment.
However, it remains unclear whether enrichment-based methods provide benefit in settings where the ambiguity concerns unstated human intent rather than missing observable scene information.
In this paper, we present a comparative and diagnostic study benchmarking FISER - a framework utilizing structured social and embodied reasoning - against CEMIR (Context-Enriched Multimodal Intent Recognition), a method that performs multimodal enrichment by synthesizing narratives and photorealistic images from textual prompts.
By evaluating both approaches across four Large Language Models (LLMs), ranging from Qwen2.5-Omni-3B to GPT-5, on the HandMeThat v2 benchmark, we analyze their capability to resolve pragmatic ambiguities.
Our statistical analysis, employing multiple-comparison correction, reveals no statistically significant difference in performance between FISER and CEMIR across any model or difficulty level.
This pattern holds across all sixteen model-by-difficulty comparisons, as well as in a targeted ablation isolating CEMIR's narrative and visual components.
Instead, performance is primarily associated with backbone capability and the inherent difficulty of the ambiguity.
These findings suggest a boundary condition for text-derived multimodal enrichment: when the relevant task constraints are already available in the textual instruction, synthetic multimodal augmentation may not provide measurable benefit over structured reasoning on the same text.
highlights: present a comparative and diagnostic study benchmarking FISER - a framework

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: Before the Ticket: Grounding HPC User Support in Documentation and Resolved Tickets with an Agentic LLM Assistant
papers.summary:
Most questions that reach an HPC help desk have already been answered in the center's user guides or in a ticket someone else filed last semester; users still file new tickets because the guides are hard to navigate and the ticket history is not theirs to search.
We present an assistant that answers from both sources: an orchestrator calls two tools over the Model Context Protocol, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over the live documentation and a Llama-3-8B model fine-tuned with QLoRA on 11,244 query-resolution pairs mined from historical tickets, and merges their answers.
Every model runs on-premises or on the university's hosted LLM service because ticket data may not leave the institution.
On 400 held-out tickets from Purdue's Rosen Center for Advanced Computing, disjoint from training and free of near-duplicates, and evaluated by two judges from model families that generated none of the answers, fine-tuning on resolutions rewritten into self-service guidance is the clear winner in agreement with RCAC's resolutions (BERTScore F1 improves from 0.06 to 0.27 over the base model) and is judged most correct on average.
The end-to-end system does not improve on its tools, although they are complementary: choosing the better answer per question would exceed either tool (judged correctness 3.41 versus 3.20, an oracle bound), while the merge follows the documentation tool in 78% of answers.
Returning one tool's answer instead recovers the fine-tuned tool's quality (3.19 versus 2.66), but neither a learned selector nor an LLM verifier beats that tool alone.
highlights: present an assistant that answers from both sources: an orchestrator calls two tools over the Model
Every model runs on-premises or on the university's hosted LLM service because ticket data may not leave the institution

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: S$^2$-MAS: A Society-Scale Multi-Agent Simulation Framework with 500 Million Household Persona Agents
papers.summary:
Simulating economic responses at society scale requires agents whose decisions reflect household circumstances.
We introduce S$^2$-MAS, a society-scale multi-agent simulation framework built on 500 million synthetic household personas grounded in real-survey data.
Its Genese engine separates decisions from state updates, while reusable financial scenarios and application ledgers track consumption, cash, debt and payments.
Trained with SFT + RLCD on 2.93 million examples, sharp-421m-mlx achieves 74.55% accuracy and 38.37% question-macro F1 on one-shot consumer financial-choice tasks derived from held-out survey responses.
Its accuracy exceeds GLM-5.3-Flash, Jev 1.13, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, GPT-6-Luna and GPT-6-Astra in the common benchmark (full test for the first four; matched 500-group sample for Astra).
We evaluate eight financial task families and simulate 12 million distinct household agents in paired purchase-funding conditions.
Jointly raising purchase goals and approved credit limits increases consumption, with responses differing across age and income groups.
Education, employment and household-size differences persist after age-income standardization and mainly reflect transitions from deferral to purchase.
Asset and debt groups differ in cash drawdown, repayment and closing debt.
S$^2$-MAS links heterogeneous household decisions to evolving consumption, cash and repayment paths, supporting economic experiments across household groups and population scales.
highlights: first four; matched 500-group sample for Astra)
Simulating economic responses at society scale requires agents whose decisions reflect household circumstances.

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: Correct Answers, Closed Gates: SolveBind for GUI Agents at the Verification Barrier
papers.summary:
Websites and applications deploy CAPTCHAs and anti-automation mechanisms that use behavioral signals such as interaction trajectories and timing, not outcomes alone, to distinguish humans from automated agents.
We call these protected GUI environments, where correctly solving a verification task is insufficient for end-to-end task completion.
Agents must turn solver outputs into accepted interactions and adapt execution to runtime feedback under time constraints.
We introduce SolveBind, a GUI-agent framework combining hierarchical solving with runtime supervision.
A hierarchical solving tree decomposes verification into interdependent Perceive, Ground, Solve, Act, and Verify capabilities.
A runtime supervisor grounds action commitments in tool-derived evidence, revises them as evidence arrives, and mediates execution under explicit recovery budgets.
Across nine CAPTCHA task families and nine backbone models, SolveBind achieves the highest success rate on eight backbones, outperforming the strongest baseline by 13.3-34.5 percentage points.
It achieves the highest success rate on all six AndroidWorld backbones.
In a paired GPT-5.5 analysis, MobileAgent produces correct answers but fails dynamic verification on 13 of 90 tasks; SolveBind succeeds on seven of these tasks.
With automatic submission, removing binding reduces success from 82.22% to 71.56% and increases latency and token usage.
Recovery caps reduce execution cost with a small observed success trade-off: removing them raises success from 82.22% to 83.56%, while increasing latency and token usage to 3.7x and 2.4x their full-supervision values, respectively.
These results support evidence-grounded execution control while identifying a success-cost trade-off in recovery and failure boundaries of heuristic submission rules.

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: Muse Glimmer 30B: An On-Device Agentic Model
papers.summary:
We introduce Muse Glimmer, an open-source 30B parameter causal language model with perception encoder, purpose-built for autonomous agentic tasks on consumer hardware.
Muse Glimmer integrates multi-step reasoning, reliable tool use and failure recovery into a single model that runs locally on consumer devices without requiring cloud infrastructure.
The model accepts text and image inputs and produces text outputs, was trained on data from over a hundred languages, and is quantized to approximately 4-bit precision for efficient single-GPU inference.
Muse Glimmer achieves state-of-the-art performance for its size class on agentic benchmarks, setting a new standard compared to the models of its size: Gemma4-31B and Qwen3.6-27B on tool use, multi-step planning, and agentic task completion.
We release the model under the Apache 2.0 license to foster open-source development of capable, safe, local AI agents.
highlights: We release the model under the Apache 2.0 license to foster open-source development of capable, safe, local AI agents.

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: Ontology-Guided Knowledge Graph Construction from Structured Metadata and Climate Science Publications
papers.summary:
The rapid expansion of scientific literature far outpaces the speed of manual curation, creating a fundamental bottleneck in extracting structured knowledge from scientific texts.
To address this, we introduce an agentic, ontology-guided framework for knowledge graph (KG) construction.
Our framework utilizes specialized agents for document understanding, information extraction, ontology conformance, and entity linking.
First, an LLM extracts factual knowledge in the form of triples with explicit textual evidence from research papers.
Then the triplets undergo a multistage verification process to ground the triplets in the ontology.
By enforcing schema constraints and requiring evidence in the form of text fragments, we ensure the data is both semantically consistent and traceable.
In an agreement study over 1,000 extracted triplets, Gemini-2.5-flash achieves Cohen's $\kappa$ scores of 0.640--0.700 against three human annotators, matching the human--human agreement range of 0.616--0.689.
We applied this framework to 2,000 scientific publications and construct a novel, ontology-grounded KG for climate science with 133,990 nodes and 755,308 relations; of the 23,327 triplets that the publications contribute after validation, 98.96\% are judged correct.
The pipeline code and KG is publicly available https://github.com/aayushacharya/climatekg.
highlights: To address this, we introduce an agentic, ontology-guided framework for knowledge graph (KG) construction.

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: HyScale: Scaling Long-Context Training for Learned Sparse Attention
papers.summary:
We present HyScale, a long-context training system for learned sparse attention.
Learned sparse attention is a promising architecture for million-token contexts, widely adopted in production since DeepSeek-V3.2.
Selection, however, grows into the training bottleneck.
For each query, it scores every previous token whereas sparse attention reads only $k$; worse, current systems materialize a full score table and repeat selection during recomputation.
Our key insight is that the output of selection is not an activation, but rather a set of indices.
Building on it, HyScale introduces HyTopK and selection replay.
HyTopK finds each query's exact top-$k$ on the fly without a score table, while selection replay reuses forward-pass selection in recomputation.
Together with holistic system optimizations tackling end-to-end training challenges, HyScale speeds up GLM-5.1 training on 1M-token sequences by 2.07$\times$ over Megatron-LM on 512 H20 GPUs.
It also speeds up the CSA layers of DeepSeek-V4-Flash and the QSA layers of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next by 2.01$\times$ and 1.57$\times$ at 1M tokens on 32 H800 GPUs.
highlights: We present HyScale, a long-context training system for learned sparse attention.

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: MCPHunt: An Evaluation Framework for Cross-Boundary Data Propagation in Multi-Server MCP Agents
papers.summary:
Multi-server MCP agents create an information-flow control (IFC) problem: faithful tool composition can turn individually benign read/write permissions into cross-boundary credential propagation -- a structural side effect of workflow topology, not necessarily malicious model behavior.
We present MCPHunt, to our knowledge the first controlled benchmark that isolates non-adversarial, exact-match credential propagation across multi-server MCP trust boundaries, with three methodological contributions: (1) canary-based taint tracking that reduces propagation detection to objective string matching; (2) an environment-controlled coverage design with risky, benign, and hard-negative conditions that validates pipeline soundness and adds a matched alternative-value control (same tasks, distinct synthetic credentials); (3) completion-requires-secret (CRS) stratification that disentangles task-mandated propagation (faithful execution of verbatim-transfer instructions) from policy-violating propagation (credentials included despite the option to redact).
Across 3,615 main-benchmark traces from 5 models spanning 147 tasks and 9 mechanism families, policy-violating propagation rates of 11.5-41.3% persist across all models.
This propagation is pathway-specific (rates from 0.0% to 74.4% across mechanisms for GPT-5.4) and concentrated in browser-mediated data flows; under the matched alternative-value control, propagation persists (25.9% vs.
20.4%; the matched-pair CI spans zero, so the comparison neither distinguishes nor equates the two rates).
A prompt-mitigation study across 3 models shows policy-violating propagation rates as low as 0.3% (98% relative reduction from baseline) while preserving 80.5% utility, but effectiveness varies across models, motivating data-flow-aware defenses beyond prompting.
Code, traces, and the labeling pipeline are publicly available under MIT and CC BY 4.0.
highlights: first controlled benchmark that isolates non-adversarial

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: VETTA: Coordinating Turn- and Token-Level Credit Assignment for Multi-Turn LLM Agents
papers.summary:
Multi-turn LLM agents often receive sparse task feedback across several interactions, while generating each response token by token.
This creates two related credit-assignment questions: which responses helped achieve the outcome, and which generation decisions mattered within each response?
Existing methods typically focus on only one level: turn-level methods evaluate complete responses but do not distinguish the decisions within them; token-level methods can propagate feedback across turns but do not explicitly model credit for each response.
These complementary limitations motivate learning credit at both levels and coordinating it in a single policy update.
We introduce VETTA, a credit assignment method that jointly learns turn- and token-level values through separate heads on a shared lightweight critic.
VETTA computes advantages along both temporal sequences and combines each turn advantage with a within-response-centered token residual for PPO updates.
Furthermore, to reduce value-learning cost, the critic retains only early Transformer blocks from the pretrained checkpoint used to initialize the actor.
Experiments on four agent benchmarks demonstrate VETTA's strong performance.
With Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, VETTA achieves success rates of 95.5% on ALFWorld, 76.0% on WebShop, and 52.2% on ScienceWorld.
With Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct, it reaches 84.9% and 80.7% success on Sokoban under sparse and dense rewards, respectively.
Critic-depth comparisons further show strong task performance with substantially lower critic-side computation.
These results demonstrate that coordinating turn- and token-level credit with a lightweight shared critic improves agent performance while keeping value estimation efficient.
Code is available at https://github.com/Jiaju-Chen/VETTA-official.
highlights: Multi-turn LLM agents often receive sparse task feedback across several interactions, while generating each response tok
