featuredPapers.title: Correlated Failures of AI Approval Monitors
featuredPapers.authors: Luca Zanolini
featuredPapers.summary:
Before an AI agent takes a consequential action, such as paying, messaging or changing code, several monitors check it. 在AI代理采取相应的行动（例如支付、发送消息或更改代码）之前，几个监视器会对其进行检查。
Their verdicts are combined by aggregating scores or by counting approvals, whatever inputs the monitors share. 他们的判断通过汇总分数或通过计算批准（监视器共享的任何输入）进行组合。
Monitors that share a base model or a poisoned input, however, may fail together. 然而，共享基本模型或中毒输入的监视器可能会一起失败。
We borrow the fail-prone systems of distributed computing: lists of monitor sets that may fail together. 我们借鉴了分布式计算的易失败系统：可能一起失败的监视器集列表。
A rule is safe if it executes no bad action and live if it blocks no good one. 如果规则不执行不良操作，则是安全的；如果规则阻止不良操作，则是安全的。
We measured twelve small open-weights monitors on payment approval under two pre-registered protocols. 我们在两个预先注册的协议下测量了十二个小型开放式权重监视器的付款审批。
Without pre-registration, we also measured three closed frontier models (Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Astra, Gemini 4 Argon) and the open DeepSeek-V3.2. 在没有预先注册的情况下，我们还测量了三个封闭的前沿模型（ Claude Opus 5.5、GPT-6 Astra、Gemini 4 Argon ）和开放的DeepSeek-V3.2。
Every reliable fooling of a monitor into approving a fraud came through an evidence source and reached only that source's readers. 每次可靠地欺骗监视器批准欺诈行为都是通过证据来源进行的，并且只接触到该来源的读者。
Fooling it into blocking a correct payment depended on injection resistance, a monitor's refusal to follow instructions planted in its data. 欺骗它阻止正确的付款取决于注射阻力，监视器拒绝遵循其数据中的说明。
Small models and DeepSeek obeyed such notes. 小模特和DeepSeek都遵守这样的规定。
The three closed models ignored them in all but one case, and Opus also resisted persuasion tailored to it. 除了一个案例外，三个封闭的模型都忽略了他们， Opus也拒绝了为它量身定制的说服。
On new data, a rule that counts sources instead of votes blocked 0.9% of correct payments, against 7.4% for the best counting rule, at equal safety. 在新数据上，计算来源而不是投票的规则阻止了0.9%的正确付款，而最佳计数规则为7.4% ，安全性相等。
The pre-registered worst-case test failed. 预先注册的最坏情况测试失败。
One attack left the approvers on a single source, so no rule over the twelve language-model monitors survives every measured attack. 一次攻击将审批人留在单一来源上，因此在每次测量的攻击中，都没有十二种语言模型监视器的规则。
Adding a rule engine, which cannot be persuaded, restored the condition for a safe and live rule on the measured attacks. 添加无法说服的规则引擎，恢复了测量攻击的安全和实时规则的条件。
Diversify the inputs, harden the monitors, count sources, not votes. 使输入多样化，强化监视器，计算来源，而不是投票。
highlights: Before an AI agent takes a consequential action, such as paying, messaging or changing code, several monitors check it.
Their verdicts are combined by aggregating scores or by counting approvals, whatever inputs the monitors share.

featuredPapers.title: What the Author Wrote, What the Agent Reads: Silent Cue Loss in Enterprise Document Ingestion
featuredPapers.authors: Yikai Zhao, Saurabh Pandey, Pradeep Kumar Misra
featuredPapers.summary:
Enterprise agents act on documents. 企业代理根据文档执行操作。
Before an agent can follow a policy, answer a compliance question or file a ticket, some ingestion layer must turn a Word file or PDF into tokens - and that layer is where an agent deployed in the wild silently loses information. 在代理可以遵循策略、回答合规性问题或提交工单之前，某些接收层必须将Word文件或PDF转换为令牌-该层是部署在野外的代理静默丢失信息的地方。
We show that one layer is lost by every mainstream converter - the meaning an author encodes in how text looks - and that the loss makes agents confidently wrong rather than visibly incomplete. 我们表明，每个主流转换器都会丢失一层-作者在文本外观中编码的含义-并且丢失会使代理自信地出错，而不是明显不完整。
We build a task from 76 real policy documents: recover the requirements the author singled out, scored against the file's own OOXML properties by a deterministic matcher with no LLM judge. 我们从76个真实的政策文件中构建了一个任务：恢复作者挑选出的要求，由一个没有LLM法官的确定性匹配器根据文件自己的OOXML属性进行评分。
Formatting-blind ingestion collapses from micro F1 0.690 to 0.150 (docling) and 0.075 (plain text), a gap that replicates across six answering models from two vendors - five Claude models spanning the Opus, Sonnet and Haiku tiers, and OpenAI's GPT-5.6. 格式盲摄取从微型F1 0.690到0.150 （ docling ）和0.075 （纯文本） ，这一差距在两个供应商的六个应答模型中复制-五个克劳德模型跨越Opus ， Sonnet和Haiku层，以及OpenAI的GPT-5.6。
An agent that cannot see the cue guesses, and docling's false-positive rate on requirements the author did not flag is four times ours. 无法看到提示猜测的客服代表，以及docling对作者未标记的要求的误报率是我们的四倍。
A span-level leave-one-out localises the loss to two cues - highlight (+0.302) and colour (+0.262), both Holm-adjusted p < 1e-4 - while bold, italic, monospace and strikethrough each sit within +/-0.003 of zero. 跨度级别的留一将损失局限于两个线索-高光（ +0.302 ）和颜色（ +0.262 ） ，霍尔姆调整的p < 1e-4 -而粗体，斜体，等宽和删除线各自位于零的+/-0.003内。
The same asymmetry appears in PDF. 同样的不对称也出现在PDF中。
Colour is also the cue no mainstream converter preserves and no parsing benchmark scores, and it is common: 32.8% of 6,460 documents carry a deliberate colour or highlight, 10.3% on an obligation. 颜色也是没有主流转换器保留的提示，没有解析基准分数，而且很常见： 6,460份文件中有32.8%的文件带有故意的颜色或高亮， 10.3%的文件带有义务。
A pre-registered test shows that typing a cue for the agent adds +0.085 beyond merely preserving it (Holm-adjusted p = 0.049). 预先注册的测试表明，为药剂键入提示不仅仅是保留它，还增加了+0.085 （霍尔姆调整的p = 0.049 ）。
We validate the labels against rendered page images through an independent modality (kappa = 0.72) and bound what wording alone can achieve (AUC 0.664). 我们通过独立的模态（ kappa = 0.72 ）根据渲染的页面图像验证标签，并限定单独的措辞可以实现的目标（ AUC 0.664 ）。
For agent builders the practical finding is that ingestion, not reasoning, is where this reliability is won or lost, and that the fix is cheap and measurable. 对于代理构建者来说，实际发现是，摄取而不是推理是赢得或失去这种可靠性的地方，并且修复成本低廉且可衡量。
highlights: What the Author Wrote, What the Agent Reads

featuredPapers.title: Effects of Theory of Mind and Prosocial Beliefs on Steering Human-Aligned Behaviors of LLMs in Ultimatum Games
featuredPapers.authors: Neemesh Yadav, Yihuai Lan, Shan Dong
featuredPapers.summary:
Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown potential in simulating human behaviors and performing theory-of-mind (ToM) reasoning, crucial for complex social interactions. 大型语言模型（ LLM ）在模拟人类行为和执行思维理论（ ToM ）推理方面显示出潜力，这对于复杂的社会互动至关重要。
We investigate ToM reasoning's role in aligning agentic behaviors with human norms in negotiation tasks, using the ultimatum game as our referenced task. 我们研究了ToM推理在谈判任务中使代理行为与人类规范保持一致的作用，使用最后通牒博弈作为我们的参考任务。
We initialized LLM agents with different prosocial beliefs (Greedy, Fair, Selfless) and reasoning methods (chain of thought and ToM reasoning of varying levels), examining their decision-making processes and outcomes across multiple LLMs, including reasoning models like o3-mini and DeepSeek-R1 Distilled Qwen 32B. 我们初始化了具有不同亲社会信念（贪婪、公平、无私）和推理方法（不同层次的思维链和ToM推理）的LLM代理，检查了他们在多个LLM中的决策过程和结果，包括o3-mini和DeepSeek-R1 Distilled Qwen 32B等推理模型。
We perform 2,700 simulations to show that ToM reasoning enhances behavioral alignment with human norms, decision-making consistency, and negotiation outcomes. 我们进行了2,700次模拟，表明ToM推理增强了行为与人类规范、决策一致性和谈判结果的一致性。
Consistent with prior findings, reasoning LLMs exhibit limited capability compared to ToM-enhanced LLMs, with different game roles benefiting from different ToM orders. 与先前的调查结果一致，与ToM增强型LLM相比，推理LLM表现出有限的能力，不同的游戏角色受益于不同的ToM订单。
Agents almost always chose strategies consistent with their assigned beliefs, and doing so aligned better with human norms in nearly every role, yet Greedy and Selfless agents still fell short of their norms in outcomes. 代理几乎总是选择符合其指定信念的策略，并且在几乎所有角色中都更符合人类规范，但贪婪和无私的代理在结果方面仍未达到其规范。
Human verification further revealed that Llama 3.3 70B produces reasoning most consistent with its actions and beliefs. 人类验证进一步表明， Llama 3.3 70B产生的推理最符合其行为和信仰。
Our findings advance understanding of ToM's role in human-AI interaction and cooperative decision-making. 我们的研究结果促进了对ToM在人工智能互动和合作决策中的作用的理解。
The code used for our experiments can be found at https://github.com/Stealth-py/UltimatumToM. 用于我们实验的代码可以在https://github.com/Stealth-py/UltimatumToM上找到。

featuredPapers.title: HGM-Dual: Lineage-Aware Guided Agent Harness Optimization for Long-Horizon Planning
featuredPapers.authors: Sudipta Paul, Pengrui Quan, Aounon Kumar
featuredPapers.summary:
Harness optimization, which improves an agent's prompts, tools, and workflows, is an increasingly effective way to enhance agents built on frozen or closed-source LLMs. 线束优化可改善客服代表的提示、工具和工作流程，是增强基于冻结或闭源LLM构建的客服代表的一种越来越有效的方法。
Leading approaches such as the Darwin--Godel Machine and the Huxley--Godel Machine (HGM) rely on recursive self-improvement and were developed mainly for coding, where the competence needed to improve the agent coincides with the competence being improved. Darwin--Godel Machine和Huxley--Godel Machine （ HGM ）等领先方法依赖于递归自我改进，主要用于编码，其中改进代理所需的能力与提高的能力相吻合。
Planning tasks, in which an agent must produce a sequence of tool calls that jointly satisfies interacting constraints, break this alignment. 计划任务，其中代理必须生成一系列共同满足相互作用约束的工具调用，打破了这种一致性。
There, open-ended self-modification repeatedly explores ineffective changes and consumes substantial evaluation budgets. 在那里，开放式自我修改反复探索无效的变革，并消耗大量的评估预算。
We introduce HGM-Dual, a diagnostic-guided framework for budget-efficient harness evolution for planning agents. 我们推出了HGM-Dual ，这是一种诊断指导框架，用于规划代理的预算高效线束演变。
First, HGM-Dual represents agent evolution as lineage-aware context. 首先， HGM-Dual将药剂进化表示为血统感知上下文。
This context records what each ancestor changed, which behaviors improved or regressed, and which modifications were ineffective, giving the editor explicit edit-outcome attribution instead of an unstructured archive of past agents. 此上下文记录了每个祖先发生了哪些变化，哪些行为得到了改善或退化，哪些修改无效，从而为编辑者提供了明确的编辑结果归因，而不是过去代理的非结构化存档。
Second, HGM-Dual introduces error-conditioned dual-path child generation. 其次， HGM-Dual引入了错误条件双路径子生成。
For each selected parent, it generates a general child that preserves open-ended exploration and specialized children that target the harness components most likely responsible for the parent's highest-ranked constraint violations. 对于每个选定的父项，它生成一个保留开放式探索和专用子项的通用子项，这些子项针对最有可能对父项最高排名的约束违规负责的线束组件。
HGM-Dual outperforms the strongest baseline by up to 14.45% relative improvement in case accuracy while matching HGM variants' final performance with 2x-4x fewer evaluation budget. HGM-Dual在病例准确性方面比最强基线提高了14.45% ，同时以2-4倍的评估预算匹配HGM变体的最终性能。

featuredPapers.title: CompLit: Scientific Literature Search Benchmarks Must Cover Implicit, Cumulative, and Unmet Needs
featuredPapers.authors: Dayoon Ko, Jihyuk Kim, Soyeong Jeong
featuredPapers.summary:
How much can we trust an agent to find the paper we need? 我们在多大程度上可以信任客服代表找到我们需要的文件？
As researchers, we search the literature from what we have read toward what we have not. 作为研究人员，我们从我们读过的内容中搜索文献，从我们没有的文献中搜索。
We thus describe what we want in our own terms, which a paper may show only implicitly; our requirements grow as we read; and what we seek may lie in an empty region no paper yet covers. 因此，我们用自己的术语描述我们想要的东西，论文可能只能隐含地显示；我们的要求随着我们的阅读而增长；我们寻求的东西可能在于一个没有论文覆盖的空白区域。
We introduce CompLit, a literature search benchmark spanning all eight arXiv domains, with one diagnostic setting for each of these needs. 我们引入了CompLit ，这是一个涵盖所有八个arXiv域的文献搜索基准，针对这些需求中的每一个都有一个诊断设置。
The strongest agents, Codex (GPT-5.6-Sol) and Claude Code (Opus 4.8), answer 86-87% of Standard queries, yet fall to 66-68% when requirements are implicit (implicit), lose another 6 and 15pp, respectively, as they accumulate (cumulative), and abstain on at most 53% of the queries no paper satisfies (unmet). 最强的代理， Codex （ GPT-5.6-Sol ）和Claude Code （ Opus 4.8 ） ，回答了86-87%的标准查询，但当要求是隐含的（隐含的）时，则下降到66-68% ，当它们累积（累积）时，分别又损失了6和15个百分点，并且对最多53%的没有论文满足（未满足）的查询投弃权票。
No agent leads in every domain, and all are less accurate on papers from before 2019 or after 2023. 每个领域都没有客服代表潜在客户，而且2019年之前或2023年之后的文件都不太准确。
Tracing their search, we find that agents often reach the right paper, or the closest one, yet misjudge it. 追踪他们的搜索，我们发现客服代表通常会找到正确的论文或最近的论文，但却误判了它。
Doing well on CompLit is a step toward agents that we can trust to find the paper we need, or to tell us that none exists. 在CompLit上做得好是朝着我们可以信任的代理迈出的一步，可以找到我们需要的论文，或者告诉我们没有论文。
highlights: How much can we trust an agent to find the paper we need?

featuredPapers.title: ASPIRE: Agentic /Skills Discovery for Robotics
featuredPapers.authors: Runyu Lu, Yubo Wu, Ethan Kou
featuredPapers.summary:
Traditional robot programming is notoriously challenging: it requires orchestrating multimodal perception, managing physical contact dynamics, and handling diverse environment configurations and execution failures. 众所周知，传统的机器人编程具有挑战性：它需要协调多模态感知、管理身体接触动态以及处理各种环境配置和执行失败。
We introduce ASPIRE (Agentic Skill Programming through Iterative Robot Exploration), a continual learning system that autonomously writes and refines robot control programs in a code-as-policy paradigm while compounding experience into a reusable skill library. 我们引入了ASPIRE （ Agentic Skill Programming through Iterative Robot Exploration ，通过迭代机器人探索实现代理技能编程） ，这是一个持续学习系统，可以在代码即策略范式中自主编写和改进机器人控制程序，同时将经验复合成可重用的技能库。
ASPIRE operates in an open-ended learning loop, consisting of three components: (1) a closed-loop robot execution engine that exposes fine-grained multimodal traces, enabling the agent to autonomously diagnose failures, synthesize repairs, and validate outcomes; (2) a continually expanding skill library that distills validated fixes into reusable, transferable robotic knowledge; and (3) an evolutionary search procedure that generates diverse programs, systematically debugging them to explore beyond single-trajectory refinement.
ASPIRE surpasses prior methods by up to 77% on manipulation tasks under perturbation, 72% on Robosuite's bimanual handover task, and up to 32% on long-horizon household tasks. ASPIRE在扰动下的操纵任务上比以前的方法高出77% ，在Robosuite的双手动交接任务上高出72% ，在长时间的家务上高出32%。
The accumulated skill library further enables zero-shot generalization: on representative unseen long-horizon tasks, ASPIRE achieves 31% success, outperforming the 4% success rate of prior methods. 累积的技能库进一步实现了零点泛化：在代表性的看不见的长视野任务上， ASPIRE取得了31%的成功，优于先前方法的4%的成功率。
Performance scales with the capabilities of frontier models. 性能随着前沿模型的功能而扩展。
With Claude Opus 5.5, ASPIRE nearly saturates these benchmarks, achieving 99% average success across all 80 LIBERO-Pro tasks and 100% success on representative Robosuite and BEHAVIOR-1K tasks. 凭借Claude Opus 5.5 ， ASPIRE几乎饱和了这些基准，在所有80项LIBERO-Pro任务中取得了99%的平均成功，在具有代表性的Robosuite和BEHAVIOR-1K任务中取得了100%的成功。
Beyond simulation, skills discovered in simulation reduce real-world robot programming effort across embodiments and robot APIs, while skills acquired through online interaction with physical robots enable ASPIRE to solve a Rubik's Cube with progressively improving efficiency. 除了模拟之外，在模拟中发现的技能减少了跨实施例和机器人API的真实世界机器人编程工作，而通过与物理机器人在线交互获得的技能使ASPIRE能够以逐步提高的效率解决魔方。

featuredPapers.title: REMORY: Learning Residual Memory for Context Compaction
featuredPapers.authors: Hanchen Xia, Baoyou Chen, Yutang Ge
featuredPapers.summary:
Long-horizon agents compact their history to continue within a finite context window, but a textual summary alone may not support every subsequent decision. 长期客服代表压缩其历史记录，以便在有限的上下文窗口内继续，但仅靠文本摘要可能无法支持后续的每个决策。
We introduce REMORY, a neural memory network that supplements the summary with a bounded sequence of soft memory tokens. 我们介绍了REMORY ，这是一个神经记忆网络，用有界的软记忆令牌序列来补充摘要。
Given the history and summary, the network learns to generate tokens that help a frozen LLM approximate the continuation it would produce with the full history. 鉴于历史和摘要，网络学习生成令牌，帮助被冻结的LLM近似于它将产生的完整历史的延续。
The tokens are conditioned on the summary and appended after it, forming an analogue of a residual connection along the sequence dimension. 令牌以摘要为条件，并在其后附加，形成沿序列维度的残余连接的模拟。
On SummHay, REMORY improves source attribution at nearly unchanged insight coverage and approaches the full-context joint score using only 5.2% of the input positions. 在SummHay上， REMORY在几乎不变的洞察覆盖率下提高了源归因，并且仅使用5.2%的输入位置来接近全上下文联合得分。
Across long-horizon agent benchmarks, Qwen3.8-27B and GLM-5.3-Flash show consistent gains with residual memory. 在长期代理基准测试中， Qwen3.8-27B和GLM-5.3-Flash显示出与残留内存一致的增益。
Both models also exhibit substantially fewer repeated tool outputs and tool errors on BrowseComp and Terminal-Bench 2.1. 两种型号在BrowseComp和Terminal-Bench 2.1上的重复工具输出和工具错误也大大减少。
highlights: We introduce REMORY, a neural memory network that supplements the summary with a bounded sequence of soft memory tokens.

featuredPapers.title: Recursive Code Evolution for Task-Oriented Semantic Communications
featuredPapers.authors: Yan Gong, Zheng Chu, Wei Koong Chai
featuredPapers.summary:
Semantic communication jointly optimizes inference accuracy, channel use, and computation, yet the underlying communication program is typically specified before training. 语义通信共同优化推理精度、信道使用和计算，但基础通信程序通常在训练前指定。
This paper presents ComRSI (Communications-Oriented Recursive Self-Improvement), a framework for recursively evolving that program through large-language-model-assisted code edits. 本文提出了ComRSI （面向通信的递归自我改进） ，这是一个通过大语言模型辅助代码编辑递归演进该程序的框架。
A fixed agent modifies the encoder, channel adapters, decoder, loss, and training policy; a protected evaluator screens candidates under prescribed budgets and resource constraints. 固定代理修改编码器、通道适配器、解码器、丢失和培训策略；受保护的评估员在规定的预算和资源限制下筛选候选人。
Accepted code and textual feedback inform subsequent proposals, while candidate weights are trained from scratch. 接受的代码和文本反馈为后续提案提供信息，而候选人权重则从头开始训练。
In the original ten-generation CIFAR-100 lineage, eight accepted revisions produce an attention-pooled code achieving 74.3% test accuracy over an Additive White Gaussian Noise (AWGN) channel at 32 complex symbols per image, compared with 67.2% at 256 symbols for the initial design. 在最初的十代CIFAR-100系列中，八个可接受的修订版在每个图像32个复杂符号的情况下，通过加性白高斯噪声（ AWGN ）通道产生了一个集中注意力的代码，实现了74.3 ％的测试准确率，而初始设计的256个符号为67.2 ％。
The program also improves fading-channel accuracy and transfers to Tiny-ImageNet after retraining. 该程序还提高了衰落通道的准确性，并在重新训练后传输到Tiny-ImageNet。
A repeat study with ten searches per method compares ComRSI against non-recursive agents with and without textual history. 一项每种方法10次搜索的重复研究将ComRSI与有和无文本历史的非递归药物进行了比较。
Mean final search scores balancing accuracy, transmission rate, and computational cost are 0.7587, 0.7376, and 0.7089, respectively; the mean numbers of accepted revisions per search are 6.0, 5.0, and 2.1. 平衡准确性、传输率和计算成本的平均最终搜索分数分别为0.7587、0.7376和0.7089 ；每次搜索接受的修订的平均数为6.0、5.0和2.1。
The advantage over the memoryless agent is supported by a two-sided rank test, whereas the difference from the history-equipped agent remains statistically inconclusive at this sample size. 与无记忆代理相比，双侧等级检验支持了无记忆代理的优势，而在此样本量下，与配备历史记录的代理之间的差异在统计上仍然不确定。
Archived proposals show that pooling can yield a large improvement, while retained history supports subsequent refinement. 存档的提案表明，池化可以带来很大的改进，而保留的历史支持后续的改进。
These results support recursive program optimization within the evaluated setting and expose its remaining rate-robustness and compute-placement trade-offs. 这些结果支持在评估设置内的递归程序优化，并暴露了其剩余的速率鲁棒性和计算放置权衡。
highlights: Accepted code and textual feedback inform subsequent proposals, while candidate weights are trained from scratch.

featuredPapers.title: World of SWECraft: Agent Collaboration at Scale via Simulated Software Worlds
featuredPapers.authors: Shannon Zejiang Shen, Yapei Chang, Qiyao Liang
featuredPapers.summary:
As teams of AI agents take on larger projects and long-standing open problems, agent collaboration offers another dimension for scaling inference-time compute. 随着人工智能代理团队承担更大的项目和长期悬而未决的问题，代理协作为扩展推理时间计算提供了另一个维度。
To understand what makes such collaboration effective and scalable, we develop Software World, a framework for simulating multi-agent coworking in realistic software ecosystems. 为了理解是什么让这种协作变得有效和可扩展，我们开发了软件世界，这是一个在现实软件生态系统中模拟多代理共同工作的框架。
It comes with a pipeline to create environments of real, interdependent Python packages of different topics, sizes, and dependency structures, which we call software worlds. 它附带了一个管道，用于创建具有不同主题、大小和依赖结构的真实、相互依赖的Python包的环境，我们称之为软件世界。
In a simulation, agents maintain packages in the world with a high-level goal of improving software efficiency, and they are free to discover tasks to work on and collaborate with others. 在模拟中，代理维护世界上的软件包，其高级目标是提高软件效率，并且他们可以自由发现要处理的任务并与他人协作。
We evaluate agents' work in a world collectively by measuring speedup in hidden dependent packages. 我们通过测量隐藏的依赖包中的加速来共同评估客服代表在世界中的工作。
The framework allows us to study different elements of collaboration by varying communication, ownership, and resource allocation. 该框架使我们能够通过不同的沟通、所有权和资源分配来研究不同的协作要素。
We run simulations in three different worlds, totaling more than 10,000 hours of agent work across eight models. 我们在三个不同的世界中运行模拟，在八个模型中总计超过10,000小时的代理工作。
Overall, performance improvement scales with inference-time compute, with the best model improving downstream efficiency by up to 31%. 总体而言，性能改进可通过推理时间计算进行扩展，最佳模型可将下游效率提高高达31%。
We show that most agents can find meaningful tasks via collaboration, but some frontier models can prematurely stop looking for improvements and make little progress. 我们表明，大多数客服代表可以通过协作找到有意义的任务，但有些前沿模型可能会过早停止寻求改进，几乎没有取得进展。
We release the simulation framework and traces to support future studies of agent collaboration at https://szj.io/sw. 我们在https://szj.io/sw上发布了模拟框架和跟踪，以支持未来对代理协作的研究。

featuredPapers.title: DiffResearch: Accelerating Deep Research with Diffusion Language Models
featuredPapers.authors: Alan-Barsag Gazzaev, Alexey Gavrilov, Mikhail Mozikov
featuredPapers.summary:
Deep research systems iteratively plan, gather evidence, synthesize, and revise, making end-to-end latency a key bottleneck for interactive use. 深度研究系统迭代规划、收集证据、合成和修改，使端到端延迟成为交互式使用的关键瓶颈。
Almost all production systems are built on autoregressive (AR) language models and inherit left-to-right decoding in planning and long-form writing. 几乎所有的生产系统都是基于自回归（ AR ）语言模型构建的，并在规划和长格式写作中继承了从左到右的解码。
We present DiffResearch, an open multi-agent deep research framework that places a diffusion language model (dLLM) at the core of every stage, and measure how a diffusion backbone changes latency and report quality. 我们介绍DiffResearch ，这是一个开放的多智能体深度研究框架，将扩散语言模型（ dLLM ）置于每个阶段的核心，并测量扩散主干如何改变延迟和报告质量。
Holding the agentic scaffold, retrieval code, prompts, and evaluation fixed, we swap the backbone between an open diffusion model and a comparable AR model. 通过固定代理支架、检索代码、提示和评估，我们在开放扩散模型和可比AR模型之间交换骨干。
Across 100 Deep Research Bench tasks, the diffusion backbone is roughly 6 times faster end-to-end, driven by order-of-magnitude reductions in planning and writing. 在100个深度研究平台任务中，扩散骨干网的端到端速度大约快6倍，这得益于规划和写作方面的数量级减少。
We further introduce dFast, a decomposition mode that reads intermediate denoising states and extracts subqueries before generation finishes, providing a 1.99 times median speedup for decomposition in isolation with no loss of report quality. 我们进一步引入了dFast ，这是一种分解模式，可在生成完成之前读取中间去噪状态并提取子查询，孤立地提供1.99倍的中位数加速分解，而不会损失报告质量。
On the benchmark's RACE rubric, dFast obtains the best overall score among the three configurations. 在基准的比赛评分中， dFast获得了三种配置中的最佳总分。
Finally, in a public system-level leaderboard snapshot, an instance built on a stronger diffusion model ranks above several commercial systems. 最后，在公共系统级排行榜快照中，基于更强大的扩散模型构建的实例排在几个商业系统之上。
We release DiffResearch under an Apache-2.0 license. 我们以Apache-2.0许可证发布DiffResearch。

featuredPapers.title: Agentic Music Post-Production
featuredPapers.authors: Jaywon Koo, Junghyun Koo, Marco A. Martinez-Ramirez
featuredPapers.summary:
We introduce MixAgent, an agentic pipeline for music post-production that follows the workflow of audio engineers to build interpretable and editable mixing plans guided by a reference song. 我们推出了MixAgent ，这是一个音乐后期制作的代理管道，遵循音频工程师的工作流程，在参考歌曲的指导下构建可解释和可编辑的混音计划。
A grouping agent first routes related input tracks, such as drum recordings, into subgroups. 分组代理首先将相关输入轨道（如鼓录音）路由到子组中。
A planning agent then uses retrieved examples to choose and order audio effects, such as volume control and reverb, for tracks, subgroups, and the full mix. 然后，规划代理使用检索到的示例来选择和排序音频效果，例如音量控制和混响，用于曲目、子组和完整混合。
To refine the mix, a detector identifies what needs correction, and a critic proposes numerical parameter adjustments from tracks to the full mix. 为了优化组合，检测器识别需要校正的内容，评论家提出从曲目到完整组合的数值参数调整。
In our experiments, prompting recent multimodal models to listen and revise often worsens the mix, making reliable correction a central challenge. 在我们的实验中，促使最近的多模态模型倾听和修改往往会恶化组合，使可靠的校正成为核心挑战。
We therefore build MixCritic, a dataset of 45,657 repair critiques derived from parameters fitted to professional mixes, and train the critic with supervised fine-tuning followed by preference optimization on rendered audio outcomes. 因此，我们构建了MixCritic ，这是一个包含45,657个修复批评的数据集，这些修复批评来自适合专业混音的参数，并对批评者进行有监督的微调，然后对渲染的音频结果进行偏好优化。
On MedleyDB, learned refinement reduces error by 19% relative to the initial mix, with preference optimization reducing it by 8.4% over supervised training alone. 在MedleyDB上，学习优化相对于初始组合减少了19%的误差，偏好优化比单独的监督训练减少了8.4%。
Retrieved examples further improve effects selection, and a human listening test shows that MixAgent gets higher quality ratings than mixes produced by Qwen3-Omni, Gemini 3.8 Flash and GPT-4o-audio. 检索到的示例进一步改进了效果选择，人工聆听测试显示， MixAgent获得的质量评分高于Qwen3-Omni、Gemini 3.8 Flash和GPT-4o-音频产生的混合效果。

featuredPapers.title: Interface-Induced Trajectory Censoring
featuredPapers.authors: Wenbo Wang, Di Sang
featuredPapers.summary:
Agent evaluations report a tool-call rate read off the serving stack. 客服代表评估报告从服务堆栈中读取的工具调用率。
That number can be zero while the model is emitting well-formed calls: the interface censors the trajectory before anything downstream sees it. 当模型发出格式正确的调用时，该数字可以为零：接口会在下游看到轨迹之前对其进行审查。
On BFCL v4's own data, executor and scorer, holding weights, cases, decoding and seeds fixed and changing only the serving adapter, the same model scores 0.00 or 0.96 / 0.19. 在BFCL v4自己的数据、执行器和记分器上，保持权重、案例、解码和种子固定并仅更改服务适配器，同一型号的分数为0.00或0.96/0.19。
A 2x2 over chat template and parser locates the effect exactly: both main effects are exactly zero and all of it sits in the interaction -- no component is defective, and repairing one side of the contract buys precisely nothing. 2x2聊天模板和解析器准确地定位了效果：两个主要效果都完全为零，并且所有效果都位于交互中-没有组件有缺陷，并且修复合约的一侧完全没有购买任何东西。
On tau-bench's 115 interactive retail tasks the same swap moves server-parsed calls from 0 to 636 and tasks reaching any tool execution from 0 to 103. 在tau-bench的115个交互式零售任务上，相同的交换将服务器解析的调用从0移动到636 ，并且任务达到从0到103的任何工具执行。
Our probe reproduces the funnel across a 21x scale range of Qwen2.5-Coder: the server parses 0/100 at every size while well-formed emitted calls rise to 80/100 at 32B (~72 after calibration against an adjudicated gold standard). 我们的探头在Qwen2.5-Coder的21倍比例范围内重现漏斗：服务器解析0/100的各种大小，而格式良好的发射呼叫在32B时升至80/100 （根据裁定的黄金标准校准后约为72 ）。
Under a matched envelope, across a comparable scale span, the silent fraction stays at 0-2, a prediction committed to the repository before the run. 在匹配的信封下，在可比的比例范围内，静默分数保持在0-2 ，这是在运行前提交给存储库的预测。
Llama-3.1-8B's 23% rate of calling the task function itself as a tool falls to 0 under one strict:true flag.
The mismatch reaches inside the training loop, and its consequence is scale-dependent: in verl's AgentLoop at 7B, 45 of 115 generations carry a complete call; 0 are accepted, 0 execute, 0 return an observation.
At 1.5B the same zero is over-determined, so we report the two scales separately.
At evaluation time, repairing the adapter restores the mechanism but not a significant outcome gain: parsing 0->84, rescues 0->9, pass rate 53->62 (n.s.).
We release a 98-line preflight check that catches every silent failure here.
The observed tool-call rate is not a property of the model alone; it is a property of the model-interface stack that measures it.
highlights: Agent evaluations report a tool-call rate read off the serving stack.

featuredPapers.title: RegoMender: A Multi-agent Framework for Automated Rego Policy Repair
featuredPapers.authors: Ruijie Zhang, Huaxiao Yin, Li Hu
featuredPapers.summary:
Policy-as-Code (PaC) has emerged as a foundational paradigm in cloud-native systems.
However, repairing Rego policies remains challenging due to their strict syntax, declarative semantics, and specific verification requirements.
Existing automated program repair (APR) methods are mainly designed for mainstream languages and struggle to accommodate the unique policy logic and repair workflows of Rego.
Thus, Rego policy repair remains a manual process driven by trial and error.
To address this, we introduce RegoBench, the first automated Rego policy benchmark comprising 1,159 real-world defects, and propose RegoMender, a feedback-guided multi-agent framework.
Collaborating via a shared blackboard and an atomic toolkit, RegoMender dynamically executes patching, rewriting, or rolling back, to resolve complex repair scenarios.
Evaluated on RegoBench, RegoMender achieves syntactic and test-based semantic success rates of 82.9\% and 77.9\%, respectively, outperforming the strongest baseline by 13.4\%.
Unlike other approaches whose performance drops in complex scenarios, RegoMender maintains effectiveness across single-step and chained repair tasks.
Furthermore, it generalizes strongly across HCL and SQL and achieves an 86.4\% repair rate on 132 real-world CVE vulnerabilities, proving its robustness and practical utility for security.

Policy-as-Code (PaC) has emerged as a foundational paradigm in cloud-native systems.

featuredPapers.title: Self-Improving Agents with World Model Predictive Paths
featuredPapers.authors: Haori Lu, Tianyu Gao, Yaoyao Liu
featuredPapers.summary:
Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly expected to interact with environments and improve their decisions during deployment.
However, how anticipating future outcomes and drawing on accumulated interaction experience can jointly support decision-making remains underexplored.
We propose a test-time framework, inspired by Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control, that combines multi-branch predictive analysis with experience-based adaptation.
At each step, the agent proposes multiple candidate actions and imagines their outcomes with a world model, so that alternatives can be compared without being executed in the environment.
Since language environments provide neither explicit dynamics nor costs, the predicted outcomes are evaluated for task progress and risk, and MPPI-style weights over the resulting costs guide the final decision.
A dual-branch experience memory enables self-improvement: the planner branch refines candidate generation and action selection, while the world model branch improves next-observation prediction.
Experiments on ALFWorld and ScienceWorld across three backbones demonstrate the strong overall performance of our method and the effectiveness of experience-guided predictive control.
Our code will be made publicly available.

featuredPapers.title: Automating ML for Science: Can Frontier Agents Climb Scientific Hills in the Wild?
featuredPapers.authors: Ming Zhong, Stacy Li, Nicholas Carlini
featuredPapers.summary:
Frontier coding agents are increasingly framed as end-to-end automated researchers, and ML for science offers a demanding test of that promise: improving a scientific model often requires domain insight beyond routine ML engineering.
We introduce Agent4Sci, a long-horizon testbed for measuring how far today's agents can improve the published best models on scientific ML benchmarks, spanning 20 benchmarks across 11 domains.
Rather than ranking agents on a leaderboard, Agent4Sci asks what kinds of progress agents can make on these tasks under in-the-wild conditions, and where they fall short.
Empirically, today's frontier agents advance the published best on every benchmark, with Claude Opus reaching 10.4% mean relative improvement and no run flagged for academic misconduct.
These gains, however, come almost entirely from a bag of ML-engineering tricks rather than research-level insight.
Trajectory analysis surfaces three recurring limitations in this setting: novelty miscalibration, resource under-utilization, and rapid collapse into local engineering sweeps.
Lightweight plug-in skills for research ideation, experiment management, and scheduled checklists raise Claude Opus from 10.4% to 20.1% and Codex from 4.4% to 8.1%, while yielding more diverse, domain-relevant interventions.
Agent4Sci gives the community a way to track and push frontier agents from ML engineering toward domain insight on real-world ML-for-science problems.
Code and data are available on GitHub (https://github.com/maszhongming/agent4sci) and Hugging Face (https://huggingface.co/datasets/MingZhong/agent4sci).
highlights: These gains, however, come almost entirely from a bag of ML-engineering tricks rather than research-level insight.
