papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: FlashNext-RL: A System Optimization Study for Long-Horizon Agentic RL of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
papers.summary:
Long-horizon agentic reinforcement learning (RL) requires both efficient rollout generation and training on long sequences. 长视野代理强化学习（ RL ）需要有效的推出生成和长序列的训练。
However, the memory requirements and model-specific operators of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next make this difficult with existing open-source implementations. 但是， Qwen3.8-Flash-Next的内存要求和模型特定运算符使得现有的开源实现很难做到这一点。
To resolve these limitations, we introduce FlashNext-RL, a model-specific RL training optimization framework based on prime-rl, with vLLM for software engineering (SWE) rollout generation. 为了解决这些限制，我们引入了FlashNext-RL ，这是一种基于prime-rl的特定模型RL训练优化框架，其中vLLM用于软件工程（ SWE ）推出生成。
Our main focus is BF16 training of the full 48-layer model on a single 8xB200 node, with the first two layers, the n-gram table, the sparse-attention indexer and the multi-token prediction head frozen. 我们的主要重点是在单个8xB200节点上对全48层模型进行BF16训练，前两层即n-gram表、稀疏注意力索引器和多令牌预测头被冻结。
We optimize host offload, gradient accumulation and the kernels for mixture-of-experts, sparse attention and the gated residual stream. 我们针对混合专家、稀疏注意力和门控残留流优化主机卸载、梯度累积和内核。
In the full-model development study, non-padding training throughput increases from approximately 395 tokens/s/GPU in the initial 32K-token configuration to 4,438 tokens/s/GPU in the optimized 131K-token configuration, with hardware matmul throughput (aka without considering the cost of attention components) increasing from approximately 20 to 213 TFLOPs/GPU. 在全模型开发研究中，非填充训练吞吐量从初始32K令牌配置中的约395个令牌/s/GPU增加到优化131K令牌配置中的4,438个令牌/s/GPU ，硬件数学吞吐量（又称不考虑注意力组件成本）从约20个TFLOPs/GPU增加到213个。
A controlled cumulative study on an 8-layer model further quantifies the contributions of individual optimizations. 对8层模型的受控累积研究进一步量化了个体优化的贡献。
Together with three inference nodes, the system supports a live SWE RL run with a target batch of 1,024 trainable rollouts and a 131,072-token context limit. 该系统与三个推理节点一起，支持实时SWE RL运行，目标批次为1,024个可培训部署和131,072个令牌上下文限制。
Over steps 5-15, an iteration takes 22.4 minutes on average, with bounded entropy and trainer-sampler mismatch KL. 在步骤5-15中，迭代平均需要22.4分钟，有界熵和训练器-采样器不匹配KL。
These results highlight the importance of tailoring RL training to the model's architecture, memory layout and kernel requirements, rather than relying only on general-purpose RL infrastructure. 这些结果强调了根据模型的架构、内存布局和内核要求定制RL训练的重要性，而不是仅依赖于通用RL基础设施。

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: BIRD-RL: Scaling Agentic Reinforcement Learning over Stateful Data-Centric Environments
papers.summary:
While agentic reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for training small language models (SLMs), existing frameworks are predominantly tool-centric and struggle with data-centric environments. 虽然代理强化学习（ RL ）已成为训练小型语言模型（ SLM ）的一个有前途的范例，但现有框架主要以工具为中心，并且在以数据为中心的环境中挣扎。
Specifically, applying tool-centric frameworks to stateful tasks like SQL debugging introduces severe spatial inefficiencies since proper environment isolation typically requires a separate database container per rollout. 具体来说，将以工具为中心的框架应用于SQL调试等有状态任务会引入严重的空间效率低下，因为适当的环境隔离通常需要每个部署一个单独的数据库容器。
Naively reusing databases without tracking evolving states across multi-turn interactions causes trajectory contamination and cross-trajectory interference, which severely destabilizes policy updates. 天真地重复使用数据库而不跟踪多回合交互中不断变化的状态会导致轨迹污染和跨轨迹干扰，从而严重破坏政策更新的稳定性。
To overcome these bottlenecks, we introduce BIRD-RL, a novel four-stage agentic RL curriculum that alternately enhances foundational agent reasoning and trajectory-adaptive on-policy exploration to circumvent the instability inherently associated with direct end-to-end learning. 为了克服这些瓶颈，我们引入了BIRD-RL ，这是一种新颖的四阶段代理RL课程，可交替增强基础代理推理和轨迹自适应策略上探索，以规避与直接端到端学习固有的不稳定性。
Crucially, to support this curriculum, BIRD-RL is driven by a Trajectory-scoped Persistent Execution Infrastructure, which enables safe database replica reuse while preserving trajectory isolation. 至关重要的是，为了支持该课程， BIRD-RL由轨迹范围的持久执行基础设施驱动，该基础设施可以实现安全的数据库副本重用，同时保持轨迹隔离。
This design improves spatial RL efficiency by 12.8x, successfully enabling scalable agentic RL for complex data-centric tasks without needs of Kubernettes. 这种设计将空间RL效率提高了12.8倍，成功地为复杂的以数据为中心的任务实现了可扩展的代理RL ，而无需Kubernettes。
Empirical evaluations on the BIRD-CRITIC-SQLite benchmark demonstrate that our 7B and 14B models achieve Success Rates of 44.40% and 48.00%, respectively, showing competitive performance against strong proprietary model-based agents such as Claude-Opus-4.6 Agent (48.20%). 对BIRD-CRITIC-SQLite基准的实证评估表明，我们的7B和14B模型的成功率分别为44.40%和48.00% ，与Claude-Opus-4.6 Agent （ 48.20% ）等强大的基于模型的专有代理相比，表现出竞争力。
Furthermore, BIRD-RL successfully trains unified SLMs capable of both advanced SQL debugging and generation, highlighting its broader potential for multi-objective optimization across heterogeneous, real-world data-centric tasks. 此外， BIRD-RL成功培训了能够进行高级SQL调试和生成的统一SLM ，突出了其在异构、以实际数据为中心的任务中进行多目标优化的更广泛潜力。

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: Recursive Self-Improvement on a Budget: Scoring Code Edits Before They Run
papers.summary:
A coding agent that rewrites its own scaffold has to choose which proposed edit to expand before that edit has been evaluated, and the search then has to return one agent. 重写自己脚手架的编码代理必须在评估编辑之前选择要扩展的拟议编辑，然后搜索必须返回一个代理。
Each run fits one linear readout on the parent's steering-split solve rate and eight coordinates of the proposed diff, from 96 scaffold edits labeled by four evaluations of a 16-instance fit split, and then freezes the coefficients. 每次运行拟合父级转向拆分求解率的一个线性读数和提议的diff的八个坐标，从由16实例拟合拆分的四个评估标记的96个脚手架编辑中，然后冻结系数。
HumanEval+ reserves 48 instances as the steering split and Polyglot reserves 64. HumanEval +保留48个实例作为转向拆分和Polyglot保留64。
That split scores parents and keeps an archive of four nodes. 该拆分对父节点进行评分，并保留四个节点的存档。
Huxley-G\"odel Machine selection draws a parent by Thompson sampling on the steering counts of nodes that have already been evaluated, and it expands the child that parent proposes. Huxley-G\ "odel Machine选择在已经评估的节点的转向计数上绘制Thompson采样的父节点，并扩展父节点提出的子节点。
Every method then returns the earliest evaluated node whose steering-split solve count is maximal. 然后，每个方法返回其steering-split求解计数最大的最早计算节点。
The tables report the held-out score of that node on the other 100 HumanEval+ instances and the other 145 Polyglot instances, next to the root scaffold and the calibration edit with the highest fit-split label. 这些表格报告了该节点在其他100个HumanEval +实例和其他145个Polyglot实例上的保留分数，仅次于根支架和具有最高拟合拆分标签的校准编辑。
Twelve runs of GPT-4o return a node at 87.0% on held-out HumanEval+, against 84.2% for the parent-rate ablation. 在保留的HumanEval +中， 12次GPT-4o检测以87.0%的速度返回一个淋巴结，而父速率消融为84.2%。
On that split Huxley-G\"odel Machine selection returns 85.1%, the root is at 81.2%, and the calibration-best edit is at 82.8%. 在该分割Huxley-G\ "odel Machine选择上，返回85.1 ％ ，根为81.2 ％ ，校准最佳编辑为82.8 ％。
On the same split Claude Sonnet 4.5 returns 86.6%, beside 86.5% for Huxley-G\"odel Machine selection, 85.3% for the parent-rate ablation, and 85.1% for the calibration-best edit. 在同一分割上， Claude Sonnet 4.5返回86.6% ， Huxley-G\ "odel Machine选择返回86.5% ，父速率消融返回85.3% ，校准最佳编辑返回85.1%。
highlights: HumanEval+ reserves 48 instances as the steering split and Polyglot reserves 64.

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: VeriEvolve: Evaluator-First Evolution for Tool-Using Agents
papers.summary:
A central obstacle to self-improving agents is the absence of a reliable fitness signal for realistic stateful tasks. 自我提升智能体的一个主要障碍是缺乏可靠的适应性信号，无法完成逼真的状态化任务。
We introduce \textsc{VeriEvolve}, an evaluator-first evolution framework that constructs this missing evaluation layer before optimizing the agent. 我们引入了\ textsc {VeriEvolve} ，这是一个评估者优先的演化框架，在优化代理之前构建了这个缺失的评估层。
From task instruction, VeriEvolve synthesizes instruction-grounded challenge states and an executable evaluator that checks them. 根据任务指令， VeriEvolve合成基于指令的质询状态和检查它们的可执行评估器。
During each round of workflow evolution, the evaluator is frozen and serves as the fitness signal. 在每轮工作流程演进过程中，评估者都会被冻结，并充当健康信号。
Between rounds, VeriEvolve revises the evaluator by converting the end states of strong and weak runs into a pair of counterfactual test cases. 在两轮之间， VeriEvolve通过将强运行和弱运行的结束状态转换为一对反事实测试用例来修改评估者。
Across all 30 MCPMark Filesystem tasks, VeriEvolve constructs 30 evaluators with 141 challenge states, achieving 141/141 agreement on the generated suites and 113/122 agreement on held-out states produced by executor agents. 在所有30个MCPMark文件系统任务中， VeriEvolve构建了30个具有141个挑战状态的评估器，就生成的套件达成了141/141协议，并就执行代理产生的保留状态达成了113/122协议。
Evaluator-guided evolution increases externally verified success from 6/30 to 18/30 for GLM-5.2 and from 27/30 to 30/30 for Claude; refinement removes all three false positives that the weak executor exposes. 评估者指导的进化将GLM-5.2的外部验证成功率从6/30提高到18/30 ， Claude从27/30提高到30/30 ；细化消除了弱执行者暴露的所有三个误报。
Cross-environment studies on PostgreSQL, Playwright, Notion, and GitHub further expose complementary limits from observability, state representation, and search/execution capacity. PostgreSQL、Playwright、Notion和GitHub的跨环境研究进一步揭示了可观察性、状态表示和搜索/执行能力的互补限制。
These results show that executable evaluators can be synthesized and used to guide search when task success is observable and an external verifier is available for calibration. 这些结果表明，当任务成功可观察且外部验证器可用于校准时，可以合成可执行评估器并用于指导搜索。
highlights: first evolution framework that constructs this missing evaluation layer before optimizing the agent

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: Correlated Failures of AI Approval Monitors
papers.summary:
Before an AI agent takes a consequential action, such as paying, messaging or changing code, several monitors check it. 在AI代理采取相应的行动（例如支付、发送消息或更改代码）之前，几个监视器会对其进行检查。
Their verdicts are combined by aggregating scores or by counting approvals, whatever inputs the monitors share. 他们的判断通过汇总分数或通过计算批准（监视器共享的任何输入）进行组合。
Monitors that share a base model or a poisoned input, however, may fail together. 然而，共享基本模型或中毒输入的监视器可能会一起失败。
We borrow the fail-prone systems of distributed computing: lists of monitor sets that may fail together. 我们借鉴了分布式计算的易失败系统：可能一起失败的监视器集列表。
A rule is safe if it executes no bad action and live if it blocks no good one. 如果规则不执行不良操作，则是安全的；如果规则阻止不良操作，则是安全的。
We measured twelve small open-weights monitors on payment approval under two pre-registered protocols. 我们在两个预先注册的协议下测量了十二个小型开放式权重监视器的付款审批。
Without pre-registration, we also measured three closed frontier models (Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Astra, Gemini 4 Argon) and the open DeepSeek-V3.2. 在没有预先注册的情况下，我们还测量了三个封闭的前沿模型（ Claude Opus 5.5、GPT-6 Astra、Gemini 4 Argon ）和开放的DeepSeek-V3.2。
Every reliable fooling of a monitor into approving a fraud came through an evidence source and reached only that source's readers. 每次可靠地欺骗监视器批准欺诈行为都是通过证据来源进行的，并且只接触到该来源的读者。
Fooling it into blocking a correct payment depended on injection resistance, a monitor's refusal to follow instructions planted in its data. 欺骗它阻止正确的付款取决于注射阻力，监视器拒绝遵循其数据中的说明。
Small models and DeepSeek obeyed such notes. 小模特和DeepSeek都遵守这样的规定。
The three closed models ignored them in all but one case, and Opus also resisted persuasion tailored to it. 除了一个案例外，三个封闭的模型都忽略了他们， Opus也拒绝了为它量身定制的说服。
On new data, a rule that counts sources instead of votes blocked 0.9% of correct payments, against 7.4% for the best counting rule, at equal safety. 在新数据上，计算来源而不是投票的规则阻止了0.9%的正确付款，而最佳计数规则为7.4% ，安全性相等。
The pre-registered worst-case test failed. 预先注册的最坏情况测试失败。
One attack left the approvers on a single source, so no rule over the twelve language-model monitors survives every measured attack. 一次攻击将审批人留在单一来源上，因此在每次测量的攻击中，都没有十二种语言模型监视器的规则。
Adding a rule engine, which cannot be persuaded, restored the condition for a safe and live rule on the measured attacks. 添加无法说服的规则引擎，恢复了测量攻击的安全和实时规则的条件。
Diversify the inputs, harden the monitors, count sources, not votes. 使输入多样化，强化监视器，计算来源，而不是投票。
highlights: Before an AI agent takes a consequential action, such as paying, messaging or changing code, several monitors check it.
Their verdicts are combined by aggregating scores or by counting approvals, whatever inputs the monitors share.

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: What the Author Wrote, What the Agent Reads: Silent Cue Loss in Enterprise Document Ingestion
papers.summary:
Enterprise agents act on documents. 企业代理根据文档执行操作。
Before an agent can follow a policy, answer a compliance question or file a ticket, some ingestion layer must turn a Word file or PDF into tokens - and that layer is where an agent deployed in the wild silently loses information. 在代理可以遵循策略、回答合规性问题或提交工单之前，某些接收层必须将Word文件或PDF转换为令牌-该层是部署在野外的代理静默丢失信息的地方。
We show that one layer is lost by every mainstream converter - the meaning an author encodes in how text looks - and that the loss makes agents confidently wrong rather than visibly incomplete. 我们表明，每个主流转换器都会丢失一层-作者在文本外观中编码的含义-并且丢失会使代理自信地出错，而不是明显不完整。
We build a task from 76 real policy documents: recover the requirements the author singled out, scored against the file's own OOXML properties by a deterministic matcher with no LLM judge. 我们从76个真实的政策文件中构建了一个任务：恢复作者挑选出的要求，由一个没有LLM法官的确定性匹配器根据文件自己的OOXML属性进行评分。
Formatting-blind ingestion collapses from micro F1 0.690 to 0.150 (docling) and 0.075 (plain text), a gap that replicates across six answering models from two vendors - five Claude models spanning the Opus, Sonnet and Haiku tiers, and OpenAI's GPT-5.6. 格式盲摄取从微型F1 0.690到0.150 （ docling ）和0.075 （纯文本） ，这一差距在两个供应商的六个应答模型中复制-五个克劳德模型跨越Opus ， Sonnet和Haiku层，以及OpenAI的GPT-5.6。
An agent that cannot see the cue guesses, and docling's false-positive rate on requirements the author did not flag is four times ours. 无法看到提示猜测的客服代表，以及docling对作者未标记的要求的误报率是我们的四倍。
A span-level leave-one-out localises the loss to two cues - highlight (+0.302) and colour (+0.262), both Holm-adjusted p < 1e-4 - while bold, italic, monospace and strikethrough each sit within +/-0.003 of zero. 跨度级别的留一将损失局限于两个线索-高光（ +0.302 ）和颜色（ +0.262 ） ，霍尔姆调整的p < 1e-4 -而粗体，斜体，等宽和删除线各自位于零的+/-0.003内。
The same asymmetry appears in PDF. 同样的不对称也出现在PDF中。
Colour is also the cue no mainstream converter preserves and no parsing benchmark scores, and it is common: 32.8% of 6,460 documents carry a deliberate colour or highlight, 10.3% on an obligation. 颜色也是没有主流转换器保留的提示，没有解析基准分数，而且很常见： 6,460份文件中有32.8%的文件带有故意的颜色或高亮， 10.3%的文件带有义务。
A pre-registered test shows that typing a cue for the agent adds +0.085 beyond merely preserving it (Holm-adjusted p = 0.049). 预先注册的测试表明，为药剂键入提示不仅仅是保留它，还增加了+0.085 （霍尔姆调整的p = 0.049 ）。
We validate the labels against rendered page images through an independent modality (kappa = 0.72) and bound what wording alone can achieve (AUC 0.664). 我们通过独立的模态（ kappa = 0.72 ）根据渲染的页面图像验证标签，并限定单独的措辞可以实现的目标（ AUC 0.664 ）。
For agent builders the practical finding is that ingestion, not reasoning, is where this reliability is won or lost, and that the fix is cheap and measurable. 对于代理构建者来说，实际发现是，摄取而不是推理是赢得或失去这种可靠性的地方，并且修复成本低廉且可衡量。
highlights: What the Author Wrote, What the Agent Reads

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: Effects of Theory of Mind and Prosocial Beliefs on Steering Human-Aligned Behaviors of LLMs in Ultimatum Games
papers.summary:
Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown potential in simulating human behaviors and performing theory-of-mind (ToM) reasoning, crucial for complex social interactions. 大型语言模型（ LLM ）在模拟人类行为和执行思维理论（ ToM ）推理方面显示出潜力，这对于复杂的社会互动至关重要。
We investigate ToM reasoning's role in aligning agentic behaviors with human norms in negotiation tasks, using the ultimatum game as our referenced task. 我们研究了ToM推理在谈判任务中使代理行为与人类规范保持一致的作用，使用最后通牒博弈作为我们的参考任务。
We initialized LLM agents with different prosocial beliefs (Greedy, Fair, Selfless) and reasoning methods (chain of thought and ToM reasoning of varying levels), examining their decision-making processes and outcomes across multiple LLMs, including reasoning models like o3-mini and DeepSeek-R1 Distilled Qwen 32B. 我们初始化了具有不同亲社会信念（贪婪、公平、无私）和推理方法（不同层次的思维链和ToM推理）的LLM代理，检查了他们在多个LLM中的决策过程和结果，包括o3-mini和DeepSeek-R1 Distilled Qwen 32B等推理模型。
We perform 2,700 simulations to show that ToM reasoning enhances behavioral alignment with human norms, decision-making consistency, and negotiation outcomes. 我们进行了2,700次模拟，表明ToM推理增强了行为与人类规范、决策一致性和谈判结果的一致性。
Consistent with prior findings, reasoning LLMs exhibit limited capability compared to ToM-enhanced LLMs, with different game roles benefiting from different ToM orders. 与先前的调查结果一致，与ToM增强型LLM相比，推理LLM表现出有限的能力，不同的游戏角色受益于不同的ToM订单。
Agents almost always chose strategies consistent with their assigned beliefs, and doing so aligned better with human norms in nearly every role, yet Greedy and Selfless agents still fell short of their norms in outcomes. 代理几乎总是选择符合其指定信念的策略，并且在几乎所有角色中都更符合人类规范，但贪婪和无私的代理在结果方面仍未达到其规范。
Human verification further revealed that Llama 3.3 70B produces reasoning most consistent with its actions and beliefs. 人类验证进一步表明， Llama 3.3 70B产生的推理最符合其行为和信仰。
Our findings advance understanding of ToM's role in human-AI interaction and cooperative decision-making. 我们的研究结果促进了对ToM在人工智能互动和合作决策中的作用的理解。
The code used for our experiments can be found at https://github.com/Stealth-py/UltimatumToM. 用于我们实验的代码可以在https://github.com/Stealth-py/UltimatumToM上找到。
highlights: Effects of Theory of Mind and Prosocial Beliefs on Steering Human
Human verification further revealed that Llama 3.3 70B produces reasoning most consistent with its actions and beliefs.

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: CompLit: Scientific Literature Search Benchmarks Must Cover Implicit, Cumulative, and Unmet Needs
papers.summary:
How much can we trust an agent to find the paper we need? 我们在多大程度上可以信任客服代表找到我们需要的文件？
As researchers, we search the literature from what we have read toward what we have not. 作为研究人员，我们从我们读过的内容中搜索文献，从我们没有的文献中搜索。
We thus describe what we want in our own terms, which a paper may show only implicitly; our requirements grow as we read; and what we seek may lie in an empty region no paper yet covers. 因此，我们用自己的术语描述我们想要的东西，论文可能只能隐含地显示；我们的要求随着我们的阅读而增长；我们寻求的东西可能在于一个没有论文覆盖的空白区域。
We introduce CompLit, a literature search benchmark spanning all eight arXiv domains, with one diagnostic setting for each of these needs. 我们引入了CompLit ，这是一个涵盖所有八个arXiv域的文献搜索基准，针对这些需求中的每一个都有一个诊断设置。
The strongest agents, Codex (GPT-5.6-Sol) and Claude Code (Opus 4.8), answer 86-87% of Standard queries, yet fall to 66-68% when requirements are implicit (implicit), lose another 6 and 15pp, respectively, as they accumulate (cumulative), and abstain on at most 53% of the queries no paper satisfies (unmet). 最强的代理， Codex （ GPT-5.6-Sol ）和Claude Code （ Opus 4.8 ） ，回答了86-87%的标准查询，但当要求是隐含的（隐含的）时，则下降到66-68% ，当它们累积（累积）时，分别又损失了6和15个百分点，并且对最多53%的没有论文满足（未满足）的查询投弃权票。
No agent leads in every domain, and all are less accurate on papers from before 2019 or after 2023. 每个领域都没有客服代表潜在客户，而且2019年之前或2023年之后的文件都不太准确。
Tracing their search, we find that agents often reach the right paper, or the closest one, yet misjudge it. 追踪他们的搜索，我们发现客服代表通常会找到正确的论文或最近的论文，但却误判了它。
Doing well on CompLit is a step toward agents that we can trust to find the paper we need, or to tell us that none exists. 在CompLit上做得好是朝着我们可以信任的代理迈出的一步，可以找到我们需要的论文，或者告诉我们没有论文。
highlights: How much can we trust an agent to find the paper we need?

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: ASPIRE: Agentic /Skills Discovery for Robotics
papers.summary:
Traditional robot programming is notoriously challenging: it requires orchestrating multimodal perception, managing physical contact dynamics, and handling diverse environment configurations and execution failures. 众所周知，传统的机器人编程具有挑战性：它需要协调多模态感知、管理身体接触动态以及处理各种环境配置和执行失败。
We introduce ASPIRE (Agentic Skill Programming through Iterative Robot Exploration), a continual learning system that autonomously writes and refines robot control programs in a code-as-policy paradigm while compounding experience into a reusable skill library. 我们引入了ASPIRE （ Agentic Skill Programming through Iterative Robot Exploration ，通过迭代机器人探索实现代理技能编程） ，这是一个持续学习系统，可以在代码即策略范式中自主编写和改进机器人控制程序，同时将经验复合成可重用的技能库。
ASPIRE operates in an open-ended learning loop, consisting of three components: (1) a closed-loop robot execution engine that exposes fine-grained multimodal traces, enabling the agent to autonomously diagnose failures, synthesize repairs, and validate outcomes; (2) a continually expanding skill library that distills validated fixes into reusable, transferable robotic knowledge; and (3) an evolutionary search procedure that generates diverse programs, systematically debugging them to explore beyond single-trajectory refinement.
ASPIRE surpasses prior methods by up to 77% on manipulation tasks under perturbation, 72% on Robosuite's bimanual handover task, and up to 32% on long-horizon household tasks. ASPIRE在扰动下的操纵任务上比以前的方法高出77% ，在Robosuite的双手动交接任务上高出72% ，在长时间的家务上高出32%。
The accumulated skill library further enables zero-shot generalization: on representative unseen long-horizon tasks, ASPIRE achieves 31% success, outperforming the 4% success rate of prior methods. 累积的技能库进一步实现了零点泛化：在代表性的看不见的长视野任务上， ASPIRE取得了31%的成功，优于先前方法的4%的成功率。
Performance scales with the capabilities of frontier models. 性能随着前沿模型的功能而扩展。
With Claude Opus 5.5, ASPIRE nearly saturates these benchmarks, achieving 99% average success across all 80 LIBERO-Pro tasks and 100% success on representative Robosuite and BEHAVIOR-1K tasks. 凭借Claude Opus 5.5 ， ASPIRE几乎饱和了这些基准，在所有80项LIBERO-Pro任务中取得了99%的平均成功，在具有代表性的Robosuite和BEHAVIOR-1K任务中取得了100%的成功。
Beyond simulation, skills discovered in simulation reduce real-world robot programming effort across embodiments and robot APIs, while skills acquired through online interaction with physical robots enable ASPIRE to solve a Rubik's Cube with progressively improving efficiency. 除了模拟之外，在模拟中发现的技能减少了跨实施例和机器人API的真实世界机器人编程工作，而通过与物理机器人在线交互获得的技能使ASPIRE能够以逐步提高的效率解决魔方。
highlights: surpasses prior methods by up to 77% on manipulation tasks under perturbation

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: REMORY: Learning Residual Memory for Context Compaction
papers.summary:
Long-horizon agents compact their history to continue within a finite context window, but a textual summary alone may not support every subsequent decision. 长期客服代表压缩其历史记录，以便在有限的上下文窗口内继续，但仅靠文本摘要可能无法支持后续的每个决策。
We introduce REMORY, a neural memory network that supplements the summary with a bounded sequence of soft memory tokens. 我们介绍了REMORY ，这是一个神经记忆网络，用有界的软记忆令牌序列来补充摘要。
Given the history and summary, the network learns to generate tokens that help a frozen LLM approximate the continuation it would produce with the full history. 鉴于历史和摘要，网络学习生成令牌，帮助被冻结的LLM近似于它将产生的完整历史的延续。
The tokens are conditioned on the summary and appended after it, forming an analogue of a residual connection along the sequence dimension. 令牌以摘要为条件，并在其后附加，形成沿序列维度的残余连接的模拟。
On SummHay, REMORY improves source attribution at nearly unchanged insight coverage and approaches the full-context joint score using only 5.2% of the input positions. 在SummHay上， REMORY在几乎不变的洞察覆盖率下提高了源归因，并且仅使用5.2%的输入位置来接近全上下文联合得分。
Across long-horizon agent benchmarks, Qwen3.8-27B and GLM-5.3-Flash show consistent gains with residual memory. 在长期代理基准测试中， Qwen3.8-27B和GLM-5.3-Flash显示出与残留内存一致的增益。
Both models also exhibit substantially fewer repeated tool outputs and tool errors on BrowseComp and Terminal-Bench 2.1. 两种型号在BrowseComp和Terminal-Bench 2.1上的重复工具输出和工具错误也大大减少。
highlights: We introduce REMORY, a neural memory network that supplements the summary with a bounded sequence of soft memory tokens.

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: Agentic Music Post-Production
papers.summary:
We introduce MixAgent, an agentic pipeline for music post-production that follows the workflow of audio engineers to build interpretable and editable mixing plans guided by a reference song. 我们推出了MixAgent ，这是一个音乐后期制作的代理管道，遵循音频工程师的工作流程，在参考歌曲的指导下构建可解释和可编辑的混音计划。
A grouping agent first routes related input tracks, such as drum recordings, into subgroups. 分组代理首先将相关输入轨道（如鼓录音）路由到子组中。
A planning agent then uses retrieved examples to choose and order audio effects, such as volume control and reverb, for tracks, subgroups, and the full mix. 然后，规划代理使用检索到的示例来选择和排序音频效果，例如音量控制和混响，用于曲目、子组和完整混合。
To refine the mix, a detector identifies what needs correction, and a critic proposes numerical parameter adjustments from tracks to the full mix. 为了优化组合，检测器识别需要校正的内容，评论家提出从曲目到完整组合的数值参数调整。
In our experiments, prompting recent multimodal models to listen and revise often worsens the mix, making reliable correction a central challenge. 在我们的实验中，促使最近的多模态模型倾听和修改往往会恶化组合，使可靠的校正成为核心挑战。
We therefore build MixCritic, a dataset of 45,657 repair critiques derived from parameters fitted to professional mixes, and train the critic with supervised fine-tuning followed by preference optimization on rendered audio outcomes. 因此，我们构建了MixCritic ，这是一个包含45,657个修复批评的数据集，这些修复批评来自适合专业混音的参数，并对批评者进行有监督的微调，然后对渲染的音频结果进行偏好优化。
On MedleyDB, learned refinement reduces error by 19% relative to the initial mix, with preference optimization reducing it by 8.4% over supervised training alone. 在MedleyDB上，学习优化相对于初始组合减少了19%的误差，偏好优化比单独的监督训练减少了8.4%。
Retrieved examples further improve effects selection, and a human listening test shows that MixAgent gets higher quality ratings than mixes produced by Qwen3-Omni, Gemini 3.8 Flash and GPT-4o-audio. 检索到的示例进一步改进了效果选择，人工聆听测试显示， MixAgent获得的质量评分高于Qwen3-Omni、Gemini 3.8 Flash和GPT-4o-音频产生的混合效果。

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: Interface-Induced Trajectory Censoring
papers.summary:
Agent evaluations report a tool-call rate read off the serving stack. 客服代表评估报告从服务堆栈中读取的工具调用率。
That number can be zero while the model is emitting well-formed calls: the interface censors the trajectory before anything downstream sees it. 当模型发出格式正确的调用时，该数字可以为零：接口会在下游看到轨迹之前对其进行审查。
On BFCL v4's own data, executor and scorer, holding weights, cases, decoding and seeds fixed and changing only the serving adapter, the same model scores 0.00 or 0.96 / 0.19. 在BFCL v4自己的数据、执行器和记分器上，保持权重、案例、解码和种子固定并仅更改服务适配器，同一型号的分数为0.00或0.96/0.19。
A 2x2 over chat template and parser locates the effect exactly: both main effects are exactly zero and all of it sits in the interaction -- no component is defective, and repairing one side of the contract buys precisely nothing. 2x2聊天模板和解析器准确地定位了效果：两个主要效果都完全为零，并且所有效果都位于交互中-没有组件有缺陷，并且修复合约的一侧完全没有购买任何东西。
On tau-bench's 115 interactive retail tasks the same swap moves server-parsed calls from 0 to 636 and tasks reaching any tool execution from 0 to 103. 在tau-bench的115个交互式零售任务上，相同的交换将服务器解析的调用从0移动到636 ，并且任务达到从0到103的任何工具执行。
Our probe reproduces the funnel across a 21x scale range of Qwen2.5-Coder: the server parses 0/100 at every size while well-formed emitted calls rise to 80/100 at 32B (~72 after calibration against an adjudicated gold standard). 我们的探头在Qwen2.5-Coder的21倍比例范围内重现漏斗：服务器解析0/100的各种大小，而格式良好的发射呼叫在32B时升至80/100 （根据裁定的黄金标准校准后约为72 ）。
Under a matched envelope, across a comparable scale span, the silent fraction stays at 0-2, a prediction committed to the repository before the run. 在匹配的信封下，在可比的比例范围内，静默分数保持在0-2 ，这是在运行前提交给存储库的预测。
Llama-3.1-8B's 23% rate of calling the task function itself as a tool falls to 0 under one strict:true flag.
The mismatch reaches inside the training loop, and its consequence is scale-dependent: in verl's AgentLoop at 7B, 45 of 115 generations carry a complete call; 0 are accepted, 0 execute, 0 return an observation.
At 1.5B the same zero is over-determined, so we report the two scales separately.
At evaluation time, repairing the adapter restores the mechanism but not a significant outcome gain: parsing 0->84, rescues 0->9, pass rate 53->62 (n.s.).
We release a 98-line preflight check that catches every silent failure here.
The observed tool-call rate is not a property of the model alone; it is a property of the model-interface stack that measures it.
highlights: Agent evaluations report a tool-call rate read off the serving stack.

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: Automating ML for Science: Can Frontier Agents Climb Scientific Hills in the Wild?
papers.summary:
Frontier coding agents are increasingly framed as end-to-end automated researchers, and ML for science offers a demanding test of that promise: improving a scientific model often requires domain insight beyond routine ML engineering.
We introduce Agent4Sci, a long-horizon testbed for measuring how far today's agents can improve the published best models on scientific ML benchmarks, spanning 20 benchmarks across 11 domains.
Rather than ranking agents on a leaderboard, Agent4Sci asks what kinds of progress agents can make on these tasks under in-the-wild conditions, and where they fall short.
Empirically, today's frontier agents advance the published best on every benchmark, with Claude Opus reaching 10.4% mean relative improvement and no run flagged for academic misconduct.
These gains, however, come almost entirely from a bag of ML-engineering tricks rather than research-level insight.
Trajectory analysis surfaces three recurring limitations in this setting: novelty miscalibration, resource under-utilization, and rapid collapse into local engineering sweeps.
Lightweight plug-in skills for research ideation, experiment management, and scheduled checklists raise Claude Opus from 10.4% to 20.1% and Codex from 4.4% to 8.1%, while yielding more diverse, domain-relevant interventions.
Agent4Sci gives the community a way to track and push frontier agents from ML engineering toward domain insight on real-world ML-for-science problems.
Code and data are available on GitHub (https://github.com/maszhongming/agent4sci) and Hugging Face (https://huggingface.co/datasets/MingZhong/agent4sci).
highlights: These gains, however, come almost entirely from a bag of ML-engineering tricks rather than research-level insight.

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: ReAPO: Retry-Aware Policy Optimization for Efficient Exploration in LLM Reasoning
papers.summary:
RLVR improves language-model reasoning, but commonly relies on independent stochastic rollouts for exploration, which can repeatedly sample similar failed strategies.
Prior work has seen success with approaches that guide exploration by introducing dependence into the sampling process by including incorrect solutions in the context for subsequent attempts.
Still, these methods introduce the additional question of how to assign credit to each attempt.
We propose to view the credit assignment through the lens of Stochastic Shortest Paths, a framework in classical reinforcement learning that seeks to minimize the expected cumulative cost to reach a terminal state (in our case, a verified successful response).
We show that, under suitable simplifying assumptions, this perspective naturally leads to a simple modification to GRPO, which we call Retry-Aware Policy Optimization (ReAPO).
ReAPO allocates additional generation to failed trajectories, allowing successful retries to be reinforced without rewarding preceding failures, and assigns credit in a theoretically principled way to each attempt.
Across Qwen3 and OLMo-2 models from 0.6B to 4B and eight mathematical and scientific reasoning benchmarks, ReAPO improves first-attempt performance over GRPO as well as natural recent baseline algorithms, while additional ablations demonstrate the utility of both serial sampling and ReAPO's credit assignment.
On Qwen3-0.6B, ReAPO also outperforms GRPO with twice the group size or twice the training steps, reaching their peak accuracy with 39% and 31% fewer generated tokens, respectively.
Taken together, our results suggest that ReAPO is a simple yet effective approach for improving LM reasoning performance through improved exploration and retry-aware credit assignment.
highlights: outperforms GRPO with twice the group size or twice the training steps

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: FrontierCS 2: A Benchmark for Computer Science R&D
papers.summary:
Can LLM agents make contributions to frontier computer science R&D?
We introduce FrontierCS 2, a benchmark of 48 open-ended tasks.
We take a paper and the code its authors released and delete the paper's contribution.
The deleted code becomes the human reference that sets the bar.
Earlier open-ended benchmarks give each agent a problem statement and grade one program after the run.
FrontierCS 2 places the agent inside a research environment.
The agent inherits a working repository and may submit a patch at any point.
For each patch, a judge returns a development-suite score but keeps the evaluator, the held-out final suite and the reference private, and grades the final submission on that suite against the reference.
The tasks span 13 domains, from machine-learning systems and high-performance computing to databases, security and robotics.
Beyond these 48 tasks, FrontierCS 2 keeps a private set of more than 100 tasks, to be announced in the future.
We evaluate 12 agents.
The best one is Claude Opus 5.5, passing 58% of its runs.
No run passes on 16 tasks.
A higher score is not the same as a pass: most runs that beat the reference on the combined final score still fall short on some metric or workload.
On a shared capability scale for agents and tasks, the median task is roughly as difficult as what the strongest agent can handle.
highlights: Can LLM agents make contributions to frontier computer science R&D?

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: TIDE: Tree-Induced Fine-Grained Diagnostic Evaluation from Model Behaviors
papers.summary:
Benchmark performance is the dominant standard for comparing large language models (LLMs), typically summarized by a single aggregate score, such as accuracy, pass rate, or rubric score.
This aggregate score provides limited information about a model's underlying capabilities, yet understanding these capabilities is crucial for model development and evaluation.
To this end, we propose Tree-Induced Diagnostic Evaluation (TIDE), which recasts diagnostic evaluation as behavior-driven decision-tree induction to perform fine-grained capability diagnosis.
TIDE recursively builds a hierarchical capability tree from benchmark samples and model scores: at each node, an LLM judge proposes candidate splits and performs sample-to-group classification, and behavior-based information gain selects among them.
We apply TIDE to five models across four benchmarks to demonstrate its effectiveness, and find fine-grained capability contrasts invisible at the aggregate level: Claude Opus 4.6 achieves 100% on microeconomic market reasoning where GPT-5.4 scores 83.3%, but trails GPT-5.4 on contract law reasoning with 77.8% versus 88.9%.
We hope TIDE can be extended to past and future benchmarks so that the rich behavioral signal in evaluation results is fully leveraged for understanding model capabilities.

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: From Reasoning to Action: Benchmarking Frontier AI Models on LIBERO-10 Robot Manipulation Tasks
papers.summary:
Recent advances in frontier AI models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in visual understanding, reasoning, planning, and tool use, raising the possibility of using general-purpose AI models for robot manipulation without task-specific training.
However, their manipulation capabilities have not been systematically evaluated on standardized robotics benchmarks.
In this report, we present a unified closed-loop manipulation framework for evaluating frontier AI models on the LIBERO-10 benchmark.
Our framework enables models to control a robot directly through visual observations, robot proprioception, and structured tool calls, primarily by specifying target end-effector poses and gripper commands, without task-specific fine-tuning or pretrained manipulation skills.
We evaluate six frontier AI models, including GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Luna, Claude Opus 5, Claude Opus 5.5, and Gemini-4 Argon, across three reasoning effort levels, resulting in 18 configurations and 1,800 evaluation episodes.
Our results show that GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest success rate of 44%, followed by Gemini-4 Argon at 43%.
Increasing reasoning effort generally improves manipulation performance, but the benefits vary across models and come at additional inference cost.
We also observe substantial differences across tasks, with models performing relatively well on object placement tasks but struggling with precise spatial arrangements and complex multi-step interactions.
These findings demonstrate both the potential and limitations of frontier AI models for robot manipulation, highlighting the challenges of translating reasoning capabilities into reliable physical actions.
We release our evaluation framework and experimental results to support reproducible benchmarking and future research on reasoning-based robot manipulation.
highlights: present a unified closed-loop manipulation framework
However, their manipulation capabilities have not been systematically evaluated on standardized robotics benchmarks.

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: UserSWE: Evaluating Coding Agents in Multi-Turn Conversations with Dynamic Users
papers.summary:
As coding agents become more capable, developers increasingly use them to fix bugs through multi-turn interactions.
Existing benchmarks do not adequately cover this scenario.
Most present a complete issue report in a single turn without interaction.
Their evaluation can produce both false positives and false negatives, accepting incorrect patches or rejecting correct ones.
We introduce UserSWE for evaluating coding agents' ability to fix repository-level bugs through multi-turn interactions with dynamic users and execution-grounded verdicts at every turn.
Its construction pipeline turns repository history and existing single-turn benchmarks into multi-turn tasks.
At each turn, information pools constrain what the simulated user can reveal, while a persona chain sampled from a transition model calibrated on 20,859 development sessions governs how it speaks.
Tests run after every turn, and a pair of agents from different model families writes and gates each verdict, using test results as primary evidence and model judgment only for aspects the tests cannot resolve.
We evaluate eleven agents on 72 tasks from 42 repositories and find that agent rankings change with the interaction budget.
Claude Fable 5.1 resolves the most tasks in one turn, GPT-6-Astra resolves the most by the eighth turn, and Claude Opus 5 leads at most intermediate budgets.
These results indicate that single-turn performance is insufficient to characterize interactive coding ability.
highlights: As coding agents become more capable, developers increasingly use them to fix bugs through multi-turn interactions.

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: Controlling Output Rankings in LLM-Based Search via Generative Engine Optimization
papers.summary:
The way customers search for and choose products is changing with the rise of large language models (LLMs).
LLM-based search, or generative engines, provides direct product recommendations to users, rather than traditional online search results that require users to explore options themselves.
However, these recommendations are strongly influenced by the initial retrieval order of LLMs, which disadvantages small businesses and independent creators by limiting their visibility.
In this work, we propose CORE, an optimization method that \textbf{C}ontrols \textbf{O}utput \textbf{R}ankings in g\textbf{E}nerative Engines for LLM-based search.
Since the LLM's interactions with the search engine are black-box, CORE targets the content returned by search engines as the primary means of influencing output rankings.
Specifically, CORE optimizes retrieved content by appending strategically designed optimization content to steer the ranking of outputs.
We introduce three types of optimization content: string-based, reasoning-based, and review-based, demonstrating their effectiveness in shaping output rankings.
To evaluate CORE in realistic settings, we introduce ProductBench, a large-scale benchmark with 15 product categories and 200 products per category, where each product is associated with its top-10 recommendations collected from Amazon's search interface.
Extensive experiments on four LLMs with search capabilities (GPT-4o, Gemini-2.5, Claude-4, and Grok-3) demonstrate that CORE achieves an average Promotion Success Rate of \textbf{91.4\% @Top-5}, \textbf{86.6\% @Top-3}, and \textbf{80.3\% @Top-1}, across 15 product categories, outperforming existing ranking manipulation methods while preserving the fluency of optimized content.
highlights: outperforming existing ranking manipulation methods while preserving the fluency of optimized content

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: Closing the Sim-to-Real Gap: An Evaluation Framework for Autonomous Cyber Defense Configuration of Commercial EDR
papers.summary:
Leading commercial endpoint detection and response (EDR) products have shifted from operator-configured rule sets to multi-component systems where autonomous AI components operate alongside, and increasingly in place of, operator-deployed policies.
Autonomous defense agents using commercial EDR as their hardening tool are no longer tuning a passive tool, but a black-box autonomous system capable of making vendor-specific decisions.
We present the first evaluation framework for autonomous defense agents hardening commercial EDR.
We instantiate it in a Game of Active Directory (GOAD) lab with Horizon3's NodeZero as the autonomous pentester and Microsoft Defender XDR as the primary EDR under test.
We extend the same framework to CrowdStrike Falcon and SentinelOne Singularity to test whether our Microsoft Defender XDR findings hold across vendors.
We run a sample benchmark of defense agents with two large language model (LLM) backbones (Claude Sonnet 4.6 and Cisco Foundation-Sec-8B).
We report three lessons learned that neither simulation nor open source EDR evaluation can surface: (i) commercial EDR telemetry is engineered for Security Operations Center (SOC) analyst workflows rather than for measuring policy effectiveness; (ii) per-policy attribution is important for separating the defense agent's actions from the EDR's autonomous actions; and (iii) EDR behavior varies between runs, largely because containment varies and accumulates.
Together, these findings highlight a sim-to-real gap for enterprise defense and motivate evaluation methodology for benchmarking autonomous defense agents in environments with black-box, autonomous tools.
highlights: first evaluation framework for autonomous defense agents hardening commercial EDR
We present the first evaluation framework for autonomous defense agents hardening commercial EDR.

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: Quality-Diversity Red-Teaming: Automated Generation of High-Quality and Diverse Attackers for Large Language Models
papers.summary:
Ensuring the safety and robustness of large language models (LLMs) is a fundamental challenge and a critical prerequisite for the responsible deployment of artificial intelligence.
Red-teaming, a systematic framework to identify adversarial prompts that elicit harmful responses from target LLMs, has emerged as a crucial safety evaluation paradigm.
Within this framework, the diversity of adversarial prompts is critical for a comprehensive safety assessment.
However, previous red-teaming approaches often pursue diversity through simplistic metrics such as word frequency or sentence embedding similarity, which may not capture meaningful variation in attack strategies.
In addition, the common practice of training a single attacker model restricts coverage across all potential attack styles and risk categories.
This paper introduces Quality-Diversity Red-Teaming (QDRT), a new framework designed to address these limitations.
QDRT achieves goal-driven diversity through behavior-conditioned training and implements a behavioral replay buffer in an open-ended manner.
In addition, it trains multiple specialized attackers capable of generating high-quality attacks across diverse styles and risk categories.
Our empirical evaluation demonstrates that QDRT generates attacks that are both more diverse and more effective against a wide range of target LLMs, including open-source models \texttt{GPT-2}, \texttt{Llama-3}, \texttt{Gemma-2}, \texttt{Qwen2.5}, and commercial models \texttt{GPT-4.1} and \texttt{GPT-5-Chat}.
This work advances the field of LLM safety by providing a systematic and effective approach to automated red-teaming, ultimately supporting the responsible deployment of LLMs.
Our code is available at https://github.com/lamda-bbo/QDRT.
highlights: Within this framework, the diversity of adversarial prompts is critical for a comprehensive safety assessment.

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: OmniSimulator: Aligning Small Language Models for Authentic Heterogeneous Behavior Modeling
papers.summary:
Large language models (LLMs) have shown great potential as general-purpose user simulators for interactive systems.
Prior studies have demonstrated that training on high-quality data can substantially improve model reasoning and downstream task performance.
However, the upper bound of user simulation is still constrained by the model's reasoning paradigm: native chain-of-thought often degenerates into shallow pattern matching and fails to adequately model the behavioral factors underlying real user decisions.
In this paper, we propose OmniSimulator, a novel training framework designed to improve the predictive ability of small LLMs for realistic user simulation on short-video platform environments.
Specifically, OmniSimulator organizes behavior-oriented reasoning through a structured schema with five dimensions, carefully selects data from real user-behavior scenarios, and introduces a teacher model to generate high-quality reasoning traces under the proposed schema, helping small models learn behavior-relevant reasoning patterns rather than relying on superficial behavioral correlations.
Based on this process, we construct 9,881 high-quality training instances from three months of historical interaction trajectories of 200 real users, averaging about 50 distilled examples per user.
Experimental results show that OmniSimulator improves the average score of Qwen3-8B by 34.33%, achieves performance competitive with Claude-Sonnet-4.5, and supports smaller-scale, self-hosted deployment.
These results suggest that learning structured behavior-oriented reasoning patterns is a promising direction towards scalable and high-fidelity LLM-based user simulation.
highlights: Large language models (LLMs) have shown great potential as general-purpose user simulators for interactive systems.

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: Building a Nested LADDER for LLM Unstructured Post-Training Pruning
papers.summary:
Non-uniform allocation can improve post-training pruning of large language models, yet quality can still degrade sharply at high sparsity.
To control degradation as sparsity increases, we introduce LADDER (Layer-Wise Allocation via Damage-Driven Evaluation and Refinement), which allocates sparsity incrementally.
At each step, it evaluates pruning an additional fraction of weights from each eligible layer and commits the layer update that causes the least end-to-end degradation per removed parameter.
This process produces non-uniform sparsity profiles and exactly nested masks across multiple budgets.
We evaluate LADDER on five OPT, Llama, and Qwen models across 10-90% sparsity, using SparseGPT as its candidate-generation backend and comparing against uniform and adaptive allocation baselines.
Results reveal a clear operating-regime trade-off: LADDER is comparable or slightly weaker at benign sparsity but becomes substantially more robust from 70% onward.
This high-sparsity advantage largely persists after posterior distillation across four of five models and translates into improved retention of aggregate zero-shot accuracy.
highlights: Building a Nested LADDER for LLM Unstructured Post
Non-uniform allocation can improve post-training pruning of large language models, yet quality can still degrade sharply

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: SPARE: Sparsity Allocation via Routing Entropy for Efficient MoEs
papers.summary:
Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures scale model capacity efficiently, yet their substantial memory footprint poses a major barrier to deployment.
Expert pruning reduces this footprint, but most methods focus on which experts to remove and prune every layer equally.
We propose SPARE (Sparsity Allocation via Routing Entropy), a training-free, selector-agnostic method that decides how many experts to remove from each layer using routing entropy, the entropy of tokens' normalized Top-K gate weights on calibration data.
When a token's gate weight is spread evenly, removing one active expert discards little of it, so SPARE prunes layers with more diffuse routing more aggressively.
A perturbation bound under random pruning formalizes this intuition, and controlled interventions with a fixed selector link concentrated routing to larger output changes.
With the same selector and budget, SPARE improves average accuracy over uniform allocation on Mixtral, Qwen3, and DeepSeek models, especially at high pruning ratios.
At 50% expert pruning, it raises the eight-task average of Qwen3-30B-A3B from 57.2% to 63.8%, and the math, code, and science average of DeepSeek-R1 from 80.1 to 82.8.

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: D-Skill: Distilling Teacher Knowledge through Agent Skills
papers.summary:
Frontier language-model agents excel at complex tasks, but high inference costs make transferring their capabilities to smaller models essential.
Traditional knowledge distillation achieves this through parameter updates, requiring access to the student's weights and additional training compute while encoding the transferred knowledge implicitly in the parameters.
We introduce D-Skill, a framework that treats the teacher as a black box and distills its behavioral advantage into an interpretable natural-language skill by analyzing paired rollouts and identifying behavioral divergences and agreements.
The resulting lessons are consolidated offline, with any compatible skill-update backend, into a skill document that is provided to the student at inference time.
D-Skill constructs the skill entirely offline from fixed trajectories, without labels, further environment interaction, or weight updates after rollout collection.
Across SpreadsheetBench-Verified, ALFWorld, and chess puzzles spanning multiple teacher-student pairs, D-Skill closes 75%-95% of the teacher-student gap without touching model weights.
After a single offline pass over the paired traces, D-Skill outperforms one-epoch SFT baselines and remains competitive with multi-epoch SFT.
Under the same model family, the resulting student also incurs 5.7x-8.3x lower inference cost per task than the teacher.
Our results demonstrate that natural-language skill distillation offers a performant, interpretable, and efficient alternative to weight-based capability transfer.
highlights: outperforms one-epoch SFT baselines and remains competitive with multi-epoch SFT

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: AssetForge: Asset-Augmented Task Synthesis for Business Automation Agents
papers.summary:
Training business automation agents requires executable tasks that connect a natural-language request to an application state and a verifiable end state.
Traditional Rubrics requires Authors to recreate application interfaces, initial records, policy evidence, and outcome checks for each task, entangling business logic with repeated infrastructure work.
We introduce AssetForge, an asset-augmented task-construction pipeline that pairs a reusable construction-asset library with task-specific Rubrics.
The assets provide application interfaces, world-state components, policy/evidence carriers, and native assertion definitions; the Rubric directs their instantiation for a particular business task.
Executable checks and an additional model-based review validate each candidate, return targeted feedback, and support bounded repair before acceptance.
On AutomationBench v1.0.6 public-600, fine-tuning Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on 6,000 AssetForge examples yields 41.17% on the official strict pass@1 metric, 4.4 times the 9.33% base score (+31.83 points).
With the same backbone and GLM-5.3 supervision, AssetForge reaches 41.17% versus 30.33% for traditional Rubrics, a 10.84-point gain (35.7% relative) at the same accepted-example scale (6,000 versus 6,000 examples).
Both DeepSeek- and GLM-supervised AssetForge models improve AppWorld completion over the base model on Test-Normal and Test-Challenge.
These results establish the advantage of AssetForge's complete construction pipeline on AutomationBench public: the coupled asset-Rubric interface directs Authors toward business logic, while executable checks and model-based review validate their tasks.
highlights: We introduce AssetForge, an asset-augmented task-construction pipeline that pairs a reusable construction-asset library

papers.groupName: Agent / RSI / Agentic RL 主题
papers.title: Harness Scaling for Generalizable Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary:
Agent harnesses have become a central component of modern agentic systems, shaping how models use tools, manage context, and coordinate long-horizon interaction. 智能体线束已成为现代智能体系统的核心组成部分，塑造了模型使用工具、管理上下文和协调长距离交互的方式。
Realizing the benefits of these harnesses depends on how effectively the underlying model can make use of them, motivating reinforcement learning directly through the harness. 实现这些线束的好处取决于底层模型如何有效地利用它们，直接通过线束激励强化学习。
However, existing approaches typically train through a single fixed harness, which can lead to specialization and limited transfer across harness configurations. 然而，现有方法通常通过单个固定线束进行训练，这可能导致线束配置的专业化和有限的转移。
To address this, we introduce \textbf{Harness Scaling}, a new scaling dimension for agentic RL that extends training from a single harness to diverse execution configurations. 为了解决这个问题，我们引入了\ textbf {线束缩放} ，这是代理RL的新缩放维度，将训练从单个线束扩展到不同的执行配置。
Concretely, we construct a factorized harness space, select a compact training subset with balanced factorial coverage, and organize cross-harness training to combine global coverage with controlled variation for the same task. 具体来说，我们构建了一个分解的线束空间，选择了一个具有平衡分解覆盖率的紧凑训练子集，并组织了交叉训练，将全局覆盖率与同一任务的受控变化相结合。
Across multiple benchmarks, model scales, and RL algorithms, Harness Scaling consistently improves generalization to unseen white-box configurations. 在多个基准、模型缩放和RL算法中，线束缩放始终如一地改进了对看不见的白盒配置的泛化。
Moreover, models trained through structured white-box variation transfer effectively to unseen external black-box harnesses, outperforming models trained through a single complex black-box harness. 此外，通过结构化白盒变异训练的模型有效地转移到看不见的外部黑盒线束，优于通过单个复杂的黑盒线束训练的模型。
These results establish harness diversity as a meaningful scaling dimension for agentic RL and highlight the importance of how this diversity is organized for cross-harness generalization. 这些结果确立了线束多样性作为代理RL的一个有意义的缩放维度，并强调了如何组织这种多样性以进行交叉线束泛化的重要性。
highlights: outperforming models trained through a single complex black-box harness
