papers.groupName: Agent / RSI / Agentic RL 主题
papers.title: HGM-Dual: Lineage-Aware Guided Agent Harness Optimization for Long-Horizon Planning
papers.summary:
Harness optimization, which improves an agent's prompts, tools, and workflows, is an increasingly effective way to enhance agents built on frozen or closed-source LLMs. 线束优化可改善客服代表的提示、工具和工作流程，是增强基于冻结或闭源LLM构建的客服代表的一种越来越有效的方法。
Leading approaches such as the Darwin--Godel Machine and the Huxley--Godel Machine (HGM) rely on recursive self-improvement and were developed mainly for coding, where the competence needed to improve the agent coincides with the competence being improved. Darwin--Godel Machine和Huxley--Godel Machine （ HGM ）等领先方法依赖于递归自我改进，主要用于编码，其中改进代理所需的能力与提高的能力相吻合。
Planning tasks, in which an agent must produce a sequence of tool calls that jointly satisfies interacting constraints, break this alignment. 计划任务，其中代理必须生成一系列共同满足相互作用约束的工具调用，打破了这种一致性。
There, open-ended self-modification repeatedly explores ineffective changes and consumes substantial evaluation budgets. 在那里，开放式自我修改反复探索无效的变革，并消耗大量的评估预算。
We introduce HGM-Dual, a diagnostic-guided framework for budget-efficient harness evolution for planning agents. 我们推出了HGM-Dual ，这是一种诊断指导框架，用于规划代理的预算高效线束演变。
First, HGM-Dual represents agent evolution as lineage-aware context. 首先， HGM-Dual将药剂进化表示为血统感知上下文。
This context records what each ancestor changed, which behaviors improved or regressed, and which modifications were ineffective, giving the editor explicit edit-outcome attribution instead of an unstructured archive of past agents. 此上下文记录了每个祖先发生了哪些变化，哪些行为得到了改善或退化，哪些修改无效，从而为编辑者提供了明确的编辑结果归因，而不是过去代理的非结构化存档。
Second, HGM-Dual introduces error-conditioned dual-path child generation. 其次， HGM-Dual引入了错误条件双路径子生成。
For each selected parent, it generates a general child that preserves open-ended exploration and specialized children that target the harness components most likely responsible for the parent's highest-ranked constraint violations. 对于每个选定的父项，它生成一个保留开放式探索和专用子项的通用子项，这些子项针对最有可能对父项最高排名的约束违规负责的线束组件。
HGM-Dual outperforms the strongest baseline by up to 14.45% relative improvement in case accuracy while matching HGM variants' final performance with 2x-4x fewer evaluation budget. HGM-Dual在病例准确性方面比最强基线提高了14.45% ，同时以2-4倍的评估预算匹配HGM变体的最终性能。
highlights: outperforms the strongest baseline by up to 14

papers.groupName: Agent / RSI / Agentic RL 主题
papers.title: Recursive Code Evolution for Task-Oriented Semantic Communications
papers.summary:
Semantic communication jointly optimizes inference accuracy, channel use, and computation, yet the underlying communication program is typically specified before training. 语义通信共同优化推理精度、信道使用和计算，但基础通信程序通常在训练前指定。
This paper presents ComRSI (Communications-Oriented Recursive Self-Improvement), a framework for recursively evolving that program through large-language-model-assisted code edits. 本文提出了ComRSI （面向通信的递归自我改进） ，这是一个通过大语言模型辅助代码编辑递归演进该程序的框架。
A fixed agent modifies the encoder, channel adapters, decoder, loss, and training policy; a protected evaluator screens candidates under prescribed budgets and resource constraints. 固定代理修改编码器、通道适配器、解码器、丢失和培训策略；受保护的评估员在规定的预算和资源限制下筛选候选人。
Accepted code and textual feedback inform subsequent proposals, while candidate weights are trained from scratch. 接受的代码和文本反馈为后续提案提供信息，而候选人权重则从头开始训练。
In the original ten-generation CIFAR-100 lineage, eight accepted revisions produce an attention-pooled code achieving 74.3% test accuracy over an Additive White Gaussian Noise (AWGN) channel at 32 complex symbols per image, compared with 67.2% at 256 symbols for the initial design. 在最初的十代CIFAR-100系列中，八个可接受的修订版在每个图像32个复杂符号的情况下，通过加性白高斯噪声（ AWGN ）通道产生了一个集中注意力的代码，实现了74.3 ％的测试准确率，而初始设计的256个符号为67.2 ％。
The program also improves fading-channel accuracy and transfers to Tiny-ImageNet after retraining. 该程序还提高了衰落通道的准确性，并在重新训练后传输到Tiny-ImageNet。
A repeat study with ten searches per method compares ComRSI against non-recursive agents with and without textual history. 一项每种方法10次搜索的重复研究将ComRSI与有和无文本历史的非递归药物进行了比较。
Mean final search scores balancing accuracy, transmission rate, and computational cost are 0.7587, 0.7376, and 0.7089, respectively; the mean numbers of accepted revisions per search are 6.0, 5.0, and 2.1. 平衡准确性、传输率和计算成本的平均最终搜索分数分别为0.7587、0.7376和0.7089 ；每次搜索接受的修订的平均数为6.0、5.0和2.1。
The advantage over the memoryless agent is supported by a two-sided rank test, whereas the difference from the history-equipped agent remains statistically inconclusive at this sample size. 与无记忆代理相比，双侧等级检验支持了无记忆代理的优势，而在此样本量下，与配备历史记录的代理之间的差异在统计上仍然不确定。
Archived proposals show that pooling can yield a large improvement, while retained history supports subsequent refinement. 存档的提案表明，池化可以带来很大的改进，而保留的历史支持后续的改进。
These results support recursive program optimization within the evaluated setting and expose its remaining rate-robustness and compute-placement trade-offs. 这些结果支持在评估设置内的递归程序优化，并暴露了其剩余的速率鲁棒性和计算放置权衡。
highlights: Accepted code and textual feedback inform subsequent proposals, while candidate weights are trained from scratch.

papers.groupName: Agent / RSI / Agentic RL 主题
papers.title: World of SWECraft: Agent Collaboration at Scale via Simulated Software Worlds
papers.summary:
As teams of AI agents take on larger projects and long-standing open problems, agent collaboration offers another dimension for scaling inference-time compute. 随着人工智能代理团队承担更大的项目和长期悬而未决的问题，代理协作为扩展推理时间计算提供了另一个维度。
To understand what makes such collaboration effective and scalable, we develop Software World, a framework for simulating multi-agent coworking in realistic software ecosystems. 为了理解是什么让这种协作变得有效和可扩展，我们开发了软件世界，这是一个在现实软件生态系统中模拟多代理共同工作的框架。
It comes with a pipeline to create environments of real, interdependent Python packages of different topics, sizes, and dependency structures, which we call software worlds. 它附带了一个管道，用于创建具有不同主题、大小和依赖结构的真实、相互依赖的Python包的环境，我们称之为软件世界。
In a simulation, agents maintain packages in the world with a high-level goal of improving software efficiency, and they are free to discover tasks to work on and collaborate with others. 在模拟中，代理维护世界上的软件包，其高级目标是提高软件效率，并且他们可以自由发现要处理的任务并与他人协作。
We evaluate agents' work in a world collectively by measuring speedup in hidden dependent packages. 我们通过测量隐藏的依赖包中的加速来共同评估客服代表在世界中的工作。
The framework allows us to study different elements of collaboration by varying communication, ownership, and resource allocation. 该框架使我们能够通过不同的沟通、所有权和资源分配来研究不同的协作要素。
We run simulations in three different worlds, totaling more than 10,000 hours of agent work across eight models. 我们在三个不同的世界中运行模拟，在八个模型中总计超过10,000小时的代理工作。
Overall, performance improvement scales with inference-time compute, with the best model improving downstream efficiency by up to 31%. 总体而言，性能改进可通过推理时间计算进行扩展，最佳模型可将下游效率提高高达31%。
We show that most agents can find meaningful tasks via collaboration, but some frontier models can prematurely stop looking for improvements and make little progress. 我们表明，大多数客服代表可以通过协作找到有意义的任务，但有些前沿模型可能会过早停止寻求改进，几乎没有取得进展。
We release the simulation framework and traces to support future studies of agent collaboration at https://szj.io/sw. 我们在https://szj.io/sw上发布了模拟框架和跟踪，以支持未来对代理协作的研究。
highlights: We evaluate agents' work in a world collectively by measuring speedup in hidden dependent packages.

papers.groupName: Agent / RSI / Agentic RL 主题
papers.title: DiffResearch: Accelerating Deep Research with Diffusion Language Models
papers.summary:
Deep research systems iteratively plan, gather evidence, synthesize, and revise, making end-to-end latency a key bottleneck for interactive use. 深度研究系统迭代规划、收集证据、合成和修改，使端到端延迟成为交互式使用的关键瓶颈。
Almost all production systems are built on autoregressive (AR) language models and inherit left-to-right decoding in planning and long-form writing. 几乎所有的生产系统都是基于自回归（ AR ）语言模型构建的，并在规划和长格式写作中继承了从左到右的解码。
We present DiffResearch, an open multi-agent deep research framework that places a diffusion language model (dLLM) at the core of every stage, and measure how a diffusion backbone changes latency and report quality. 我们介绍DiffResearch ，这是一个开放的多智能体深度研究框架，将扩散语言模型（ dLLM ）置于每个阶段的核心，并测量扩散主干如何改变延迟和报告质量。
Holding the agentic scaffold, retrieval code, prompts, and evaluation fixed, we swap the backbone between an open diffusion model and a comparable AR model. 通过固定代理支架、检索代码、提示和评估，我们在开放扩散模型和可比AR模型之间交换骨干。
Across 100 Deep Research Bench tasks, the diffusion backbone is roughly 6 times faster end-to-end, driven by order-of-magnitude reductions in planning and writing. 在100个深度研究平台任务中，扩散骨干网的端到端速度大约快6倍，这得益于规划和写作方面的数量级减少。
We further introduce dFast, a decomposition mode that reads intermediate denoising states and extracts subqueries before generation finishes, providing a 1.99 times median speedup for decomposition in isolation with no loss of report quality. 我们进一步引入了dFast ，这是一种分解模式，可在生成完成之前读取中间去噪状态并提取子查询，孤立地提供1.99倍的中位数加速分解，而不会损失报告质量。
On the benchmark's RACE rubric, dFast obtains the best overall score among the three configurations. 在基准的比赛评分中， dFast获得了三种配置中的最佳总分。
Finally, in a public system-level leaderboard snapshot, an instance built on a stronger diffusion model ranks above several commercial systems. 最后，在公共系统级排行榜快照中，基于更强大的扩散模型构建的实例排在几个商业系统之上。
We release DiffResearch under an Apache-2.0 license. 我们以Apache-2.0许可证发布DiffResearch。
highlights: Deep research systems iteratively plan, gather evidence, synthesize, and revise, making end-to-end latency a key bottlen

papers.groupName: Agent / RSI / Agentic RL 主题
papers.title: RegoMender: A Multi-agent Framework for Automated Rego Policy Repair
papers.summary:
Policy-as-Code (PaC) has emerged as a foundational paradigm in cloud-native systems.
However, repairing Rego policies remains challenging due to their strict syntax, declarative semantics, and specific verification requirements.
Existing automated program repair (APR) methods are mainly designed for mainstream languages and struggle to accommodate the unique policy logic and repair workflows of Rego.
Thus, Rego policy repair remains a manual process driven by trial and error.
To address this, we introduce RegoBench, the first automated Rego policy benchmark comprising 1,159 real-world defects, and propose RegoMender, a feedback-guided multi-agent framework.
Collaborating via a shared blackboard and an atomic toolkit, RegoMender dynamically executes patching, rewriting, or rolling back, to resolve complex repair scenarios.
Evaluated on RegoBench, RegoMender achieves syntactic and test-based semantic success rates of 82.9\% and 77.9\%, respectively, outperforming the strongest baseline by 13.4\%.
Unlike other approaches whose performance drops in complex scenarios, RegoMender maintains effectiveness across single-step and chained repair tasks.
Furthermore, it generalizes strongly across HCL and SQL and achieves an 86.4\% repair rate on 132 real-world CVE vulnerabilities, proving its robustness and practical utility for security.
highlights: first automated Rego policy benchmark comprising 1
Policy-as-Code (PaC) has emerged as a foundational paradigm in cloud-native systems.

papers.groupName: Agent / RSI / Agentic RL 主题
papers.title: Self-Improving Agents with World Model Predictive Paths
papers.summary:
Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly expected to interact with environments and improve their decisions during deployment.
However, how anticipating future outcomes and drawing on accumulated interaction experience can jointly support decision-making remains underexplored.
We propose a test-time framework, inspired by Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control, that combines multi-branch predictive analysis with experience-based adaptation.
At each step, the agent proposes multiple candidate actions and imagines their outcomes with a world model, so that alternatives can be compared without being executed in the environment.
Since language environments provide neither explicit dynamics nor costs, the predicted outcomes are evaluated for task progress and risk, and MPPI-style weights over the resulting costs guide the final decision.
A dual-branch experience memory enables self-improvement: the planner branch refines candidate generation and action selection, while the world model branch improves next-observation prediction.
Experiments on ALFWorld and ScienceWorld across three backbones demonstrate the strong overall performance of our method and the effectiveness of experience-guided predictive control.
Our code will be made publicly available.

papers.groupName: Agent / RSI / Agentic RL 主题
papers.title: Telling FIBS: Probes Effectively Detect Sabotage and Catch Unverbalized Deception
papers.summary:
Recent incidents have highlighted the challenge of monitoring LLM agents and the danger of models deceiving people.
We show that white-box deception detection via probes can be scaled up to frontier monitoring settings by collecting the largest deception dataset to date for training probes and introducing a novel probe architecture which can aggregate information across many layers and tokens.
Our probes surpass black-box monitors on agentic coding benchmarks, achieving 98.3% AUROC in SHADE-Arena and 98.0% in BashArena (vs.
97.7%, 97.6% resp.
for action-only text monitors), and show improved efficacy as the underlying model is scaled up.
We further test probes on several cases where deception cannot be determined from the context alone; in these cases of introspective deception, the ground truth can only be determined through careful elicitation or knowledge of a model's training data.
In one such evaluation, we show that probes can distinguish transcripts containing a model's true hidden goal from other goals with an AUROC of up to 99.7%.
Our probes also detect deception on prominent open-weight models which lie about politically sensitive topics when put under pressure.
We release our training dataset, dubbed FIBS, to help drive frontier deployment of effective probes, and encourage the community to expand upon it with further examples of deception and sabotage.
highlights: surpass black-box monitors on agentic coding benchmarks

papers.groupName: Agent / RSI / Agentic RL 主题
papers.title: Memory-Centric Continual Learning for AI Agents
papers.summary:
Autonomous agents powered by foundation models can reason, plan, and use tools, but their fixed weights and context limits hinder sustained learning from experience over long-term deployment.
While external memory systems attempt to bridge this gap, they mostly act as passive retrieval caches, evaluated primarily by whether they can recall stored facts or past interactions.
Whether memory can drive genuine continual learning remains an open question.
In this paper, we introduce Memory-Centric Continual Learning (MCCL), arguing that memory should be judged by whether it improves future actions, not merely what it retrieves.
MCCL has three main parts.
First, a three-axis taxonomy organizes memory by where state is stored (substrates), what form it takes (assets), and how it is managed (policies).
This defines a two-loop lifecycle that updates memory state in an inner loop while refining management policies in an outer loop based on task feedback.
Second, an evaluation protocol measures retention under interference, adaptation to change, and task transfer to isolate genuine behavioral gains from simple context expansion.
Third, a memory scaling framework models how agent performance scales with experience, storage capacity, and compute budgets across non-parametric and parametric memory.
Together, these components reframe agent memory from passive lookup to continuous learning, offering a principled route toward self-improving autonomous agents.
highlights: Whether memory can drive genuine continual learning remains an open question.

papers.groupName: Agent / RSI / Agentic RL 主题
papers.title: Retrieval Augmented Generation Compositionality
papers.summary:
Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds large language models in external knowledge.
Modern pipelines combine embedding, chunking, retrieval, reranking, query augmentation, context compression, and agentic verification, yet these techniques are typically evaluated one at a time.
It remains unclear whether their isolated gains survive composition, whether retrieval quality and answer faithfulness favor the same design choices, and whether conclusions from small corpora hold at large scale.
We pre-declare three hypotheses and introduce LASAGNA, an open-source framework for controlled RAG evaluation.
We test 450 configurations across eight benchmarks and corpora ranging from 5K to 200K documents.
Three findings emerge.
First, individually strong techniques from different phases of a RAG pipeline do not necessarily compose: three retrieval techniques predict a +47% combined improvement but deliver only +17% when used together.
Second, component gains stack differently for retrieval and faithfulness, and optimizing one can hurt the other.
Third, the best composition changes as the corpus grows: the combination that wins on a small corpus may not remain best at large scale.
These findings show that gains measured in isolation are not reliable predictors of realistic performance, and that new RAG techniques should be tested with the full surrounding stack.
We call on researchers to do so and supply LASAGNA to simplify these experiments.
highlights: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds large language models in external knowledge.
We pre-declare three hypotheses and introduce LASAGNA, an open-source framework for controlled RAG evaluation.

papers.groupName: Agent / RSI / Agentic RL 主题
papers.title: Self-organizing reinforcement learning: a learner-free swarm approaches the explore-exploit optimum
papers.summary:
The explore/exploit trade-off is the core problem of reinforcement learning (RL).
We show that a minimal foraging swarm approaches its optimum - the ideal-free / Nash allocation of a multi-agent resource-sharing game (an equilibrium, not a return maximum) - with no learner and no reward signal.
Agents explore by heavy-tailed (Levy) flights, recruit neighbours to a discovery through a threshold cascade on their proximity network, and disperse as a patch crowds; this cascade cycle balances exploration and exploitation and drives foragers toward the ideal free distribution.
The swarm attains the shape of this optimum (committed foragers track richness with slope 0.94) but not its exact equilibrium - it stays measurably exploitable - reaching it dynamically (~150 steps) through the coupling of recruitment to movement: remove the coupling and matching collapses (0.94 -> 0.08).
The RL sits at the level of the problem and the allocation reached, not the micro-rule: no step evaluates payoff (reward-free by construction, though the crowd signal is informationally tied to payoff), and the swarm reaches the allocation without learning it (quality plateaus and re-settles after resources move, no cumulative gain).
Against a trained baseline the comparison is two-sided: in an easier, disembodied game a learner is more precise, while in the same embodied environment the reward-free swarm reaches ~65% of a validated oracle ceiling at zero training and leads until trained PPO and centralised-critic (CTDE) learners overtake it (~74-75%, 16 seeds, all above the swarm mean) after ~4,000 of 15,000 training steps - its advantage is in budget, not asymptote.
In this one setting we read it not as beating RL but as a strong zero-shot, reward-free operating point: a demonstration that the self-organizing physics of a minimal swarm can carry a collective close to the optimum RL seeks, with none of RL's machinery.
highlights: The explore/exploit trade-off is the core problem of reinforcement learning (RL).

papers.groupName: Agent / RSI / Agentic RL 主题
papers.title: Hidden Messages Between Diffusion Language Model Agents: Causal Evidence for Latent Communication
papers.summary:
Diffusion language models form answers through a sequence of revisable continuous states, but multi-agent systems usually discard those states and make agents communicate only after decoding text.
We ask whether one independent diffusion trajectory can pass a compact hidden message into another and, crucially, whether the receiver uses what that message means.
In Hidden Messages, a sender compresses its denoising state into four signed dense vectors; the receiver consumes them while retaining its own context, canvas, and trajectory.
Removing a message tests whether the channel matters; replacing it with a message from another example tests whether its content matters.
Across controlled tasks, derangement removes a +63.6-point advantage on Tiny-A2D and a +100.0-point advantage on Dream-7B, while targeted substitutions steer the receiver toward the substituted fact.
On QASC with the two supporting facts split across agents, matched communication reaches 80.8%, but a wrong-example message lowers accuracy to 46.8%, a content effect of +34.0 points.
The surprising result is temporal: one late transfer reaches 87.8%, exceeding four recurrent exchanges by +7.0 points.
These experiments provide causal evidence for continuous hidden communication between diffusion-LM agents and show that when information is transferred can matter more than how many times agents exchange it.
highlights: Hidden Messages Between Diffusion Language Model Agents

papers.groupName: Agent / RSI / Agentic RL 主题
papers.title: Parallel AI Agent Collaboration as Graph-Structured Distributed Block Optimization
papers.summary:
Parallel AI agents can produce useful local edits yet degrade a shared solution when their edits are combined.
We model this coordination problem as discrete block optimization with an exactly evaluable objective and a known dependency graph.
Independent sets certify compatible edits whose verified gains, measured against the same current solution, add exactly.
A coordinator constructs a safe compatible candidate and can also evaluate interacting edits to capture favorable interactions.
We prove that an optimal fractional coloring yields a merger that preserves a $1/\chi_f(G)$ fraction of the total verified local improvement, where $\chi_f(G)$ is the graph's fractional chromatic number.
This guarantee is tight among mergers that select a subset of the same proposals.
Under conditional local-improvement guarantees and a block error-bound condition, repeated collaboration converges geometrically in the objective gap.
The rate separates task structure, agent allocation, and computation cost, yielding a linear program for agent assignment and an explicit time-cost trade-off.
Code-repair experiments show that verified merging resolves conflicts between individually useful edits that cause naive merging to fail.
On larger conflict-free tasks, parallel agents reduce modeled completion time at higher input-token-equivalent cost.
On three public road networks, fractional integration retains 922 units of verified graph-cut improvement across 90 paired runs.
For route-search agents sharing exclusive access to vehicle routes, fractional scheduling reduces measured wall time by a median of 15% across twelve paired runs, with route-cost changes varying across runs.
highlights: Parallel AI Agent Collaboration as Graph
Parallel AI agents can produce useful local edits yet degrade a shared solution when their edits are combined.

papers.groupName: Agent / RSI / Agentic RL 主题
papers.title: Design and Tuning of Multi-Agent Systems Using Bayesian Evolutionary Optimization
papers.summary:
Designing effective multi-agent systems (MAS) remains a challenging and resource-intensive task.
We propose a Bayesian Evolutionary Optimization framework for automatically discovering task-specific MAS topologies.
The approach combines evolutionary operators to generate diverse workflow graphs with Bayesian optimization to focus cost intensive evaluations on promising candidates.
In contrast to LLM-based candidate selection, our approach uses a graph-aware Gaussian Process and Expected Improvement to provide an explicit selection criterion during evolutionary search.
We evaluate the method on BigCodeBench for code generation and on a tabular preprocessing benchmark using TabPFN.
On BigCodeBench, evolved architectures achieve the highest overall performance among the evaluated agent systems.
On temporal tabular datasets, optimized MAS preprocessing improves over the default TabPFN model on several tasks, while remaining competitive on IID datasets.
Overall, the results demonstrate the potential of Bayesian selection for guiding evolutionary MAS search under expensive evaluation budgets.
highlights: propose a Bayesian Evolutionary Optimization framework

papers.groupName: Agent / RSI / Agentic RL 主题
papers.title: Rethinking Agentic Model Orchestration for Time Series Forecasting
papers.summary:
Time series foundation models (TSFMs) perform unevenly across forecasting tasks.
Recent work uses agentic model orchestration (AMO) to select or combine TSFMs, often outperforming individual forecasters.
Yet these gains may reflect stronger or more complementary candidates rather than better orchestration.
To disentangle these effects, we introduce FairAMO, a controlled evaluation protocol with frozen candidate forecasts.
Experiments on GIFT-Eval show that AMO improves accuracy, but its gains are bounded by the candidate TSFMs.
The best orchestrators reduce MASE by less than 6% relative to the best single TSFM across all tasks.
These gains depend on complementarity (different candidates excel on different tasks) rather than the number of candidates.
Adding members yields diminishing returns, and a redundant member can erase these gains.
The value of historical evidence also saturates quickly.
A few recent windows capture all gains, and further history adds none.
These findings separate system-level forecasting gains from the contribution of orchestration itself.
highlights: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) perform unevenly across forecasting tasks.

papers.groupName: Agent / RSI / Agentic RL 主题
papers.title: TrustAgent-RFF: Agentic Diagnostic Planning for Reliable RF Fingerprinting under Domain Shift
papers.summary:
Radio frequency fingerprinting (RFF) models can achieve accuracy under source domain conditions but become unreliable when the receiver, distance, collection day, or environment changes.
Incorrect predictions in unseen domains may receive high softmax confidence, making confidence thresholding insufficient for trustworthy deployment.
We propose TrustAgent-RFF, a prediction level reliability framework for RFF that operates with a frozen in-phase and quadrature (I/Q) classifier without target domain labels.
For each device prediction, the framework acquires radio frequency evidence: counterfactual stability, prototype consistency, acquisition domain similarity, and signal quality.
A source calibrated trust estimator combines these diagnostics with classifier confidence, prediction margin, and evidence availability indicators.
Source derived lower tail penalties and cross module interactions reduce trust when diagnostic signals indicate weak support.
A large language model (LLM) based planner adaptively selects the next diagnostic action based on evidence, trust state, action costs, and remaining budget.
A deterministic source calibrated decision layer updates the prediction state as Accept, Reject, or Defer.
Experiments across five RFF datasets and classifier backbones reveal an average source to target accuracy drop of 38.7% and show that many incorrect target domain predictions remain highly confident.

papers.groupName: Agent / RSI / Agentic RL 主题
papers.title: From Atomic to Agentic: Towards Interpretable Evaluation of LLMs' Agentic Mathematical Capabilities
papers.summary:
Large Language Models (LLMs) are evolving from performing end-to-end mathematical reasoning to integrating agentic intelligence.
However, most existing math benchmarks evaluate only final answers.
This outcome-oriented evaluation provides limited diagnostic value for identifying process-level failures or rigorous logic, failing to guide the transformation of LLMs into robust agents.
To bridge this gap, we present a process-level benchmark designed to evaluate the inherent agentic mathematical reasoning abilities of LLMs.
Our framework aligns problem-solving agentic behaviors with a structured taxonomy of reusable mathematical atomic capabilities.
We design a comprehensive suite of planning, action, and feedback tasks across both textual and multimodal contexts, supported by an automated pipeline that synthesizes high-quality trajectories and produces fine-grained annotations via controlled LLM rewriting.
Experiments reveal that models with similar end-to-end accuracy can exhibit markedly different agentic capability profiles.
This demonstrates that process-level evaluation is crucial for interpreting the true potential of LLMs and guiding the development of next-generation mathematical agents.
highlights: Large Language Models (LLMs) are evolving from performing end-to-end mathematical reasoning to integrating agentic intel

papers.groupName: Agent / RSI / Agentic RL 主题
papers.title: Attention-based Classification for Indirect Prompt Injection
papers.summary:
Indirect prompt injection (IPI) attacks, in which adversarial instructions are embedded in external data processed by a language model, pose a significant threat to the integrity of deployed LLM agents.
Attention Tracker (Hung et al., 2025) is a recently proposed white-box detection method that identifies prompt injection attacks by monitoring how a model's attention is distributed between user task tokens and data tokens, claiming dataset-agnostic detection via a scalar focus score threshold.
In this paper, we provide the first evaluation of Attention Tracker in a realistic agentic IPI setting using the AgentDojo benchmark, finding that the dataset agnosticism claim does not hold.
We find that in agentic environments, long structured tool outputs subvert the fundamental assumptions Attention Tracker makes about attention that the method depends on and produces near-chance detection on AgentDojo across most model families.
We propose AttnDA, an extension replacing the scalar threshold with a Fisher Linear Discriminant Analysis classifier over the per-head focus score vector, and evaluate both methods in a cross-dataset setting spanning four benchmarks.
AttnDA improves detection performance across agentic and tool-integrated benchmarks, though transfer to AgentDojo remains challenging regardless of classifier choice.
A covariance ablation further shows that removing inter-head correlation structure substantially contributes to performance, with complex covariance assumptions causing significant degradation on cross-domain data.
These results indicate that the attentional distraction signal underlying focus-score-based detection does not transfer reliably to agentic environments, and that learned linear classifiers over head-level attention features offer improved detection performance, provided training data from the target deployment domain is available.
highlights: first evaluation of Attention Tracker in a realistic agentic IPI setting using the AgentDojo benchmark

papers.groupName: Agent / RSI / Agentic RL 主题
papers.title: The Reflexivity Threshold: A Phase Transition for Multi-Agent Performative Prediction
papers.summary:
Many learning systems are performative: once deployed, their predictions change the data distribution on which future models are trained.
In multi-agent settings, this feedback is routed through a network of interacting learners, so stability depends not only on the strength of performativity but also on who affects whom.
We study repeated retraining in multi-agent performative prediction and identify a spectral threshold that separates stable learning from worst-case learning obstruction.
Prior work often collapses cross-agent feedback into a scalar contraction constant, missing this network structure.
We instead introduce the reflexivity matrix $\Gamma$, which records how strongly one agent's deployment can move another agent's best response, defined from per-agent gradient sensitivities and curvature parameters.
The threshold occurs when the spectral radius of this matrix crosses one.
Below the threshold, repeated retraining converges geometrically to a unique performatively stable equilibrium, with cumulative excess loss bounded uniformly in the time horizon.
Above the threshold, we construct noisy supercritical instances in which every local-information learner incurs expected cumulative excess loss growing linearly for horizons up to order $1/(\rho(\Gamma)-1)$.
Together, these results characterize the threshold behavior through upper and lower bounds and recover the single-agent scalar threshold from prior work as a special case.
highlights: Many learning systems are performative: once deployed, their predictions change the data distribution on which future mo

papers.groupName: Agent / RSI / Agentic RL 主题
papers.title: RuleSmith: Multi-Agent LLMs for Automated Game Balancing
papers.summary:
Game balancing is a longstanding challenge requiring repeated playtesting, expert intuition, and extensive manual tuning.
We introduce RuleSmith, a framework that couples multi-agent LLM self-play with surrogate-based optimization over a parameterized rule space.
As a proof of concept, we build CivMini, a simplified civilization-style game with two asymmetric factions governed by 12 tunable parameters.
LLM agents interpret textual rulebooks and game states to propose actions that are validated by the game engine, yielding noisy estimates of faction win rates.
Our primary implementation uses Gaussian-process Bayesian optimization with Expected-Improvement-based adaptive sampling to allocate more evaluation games to promising candidates.
RuleSmith consistently finds near-balanced configurations: three independent optimization runs reach near-even empirical win rates in independent 200- and 300-game evaluations, and additional experiments with NTBEA and TPE show that the same self-play interface supports different search components.
Cross-model evaluations and small human studies provide preliminary evidence of transfer across player populations.
RuleSmith produces interpretable numerical rule adjustments without task-specific policy training.
Project and code: https://adonis-galaxy.github.io/RuleSmith-website/

papers.groupName: Agent / RSI / Agentic RL 主题
papers.title: GuideEvolve: Self-Evolving Agent Framework with Expert Guidance and 3Ts Mechanisms
papers.summary:
This study introduces GuideEvolve, a self-evolving agent framework incorporating expert guidance and three autonomous regulatory mechanisms, collectively termed the 3Ts: Think Fast and Slow, Throwback, and Termination by choice.
The framework addresses critical limitations in extant self-evolving agent paradigms through dual innovations: (1) a task-specific expert-evaluation-driven evolutionary pipeline, and (2) the integration of 3Ts mechanisms to facilitate cognitive optimization, performance recovery via temporal rollback, and adaptive termination protocols.
Empirical validation across the MGSM and MMLU benchmarks demonstrates that GuideEvolve attains performance metrics comparable to current state-of-the-art models (89.8% accuracy versus G\"odel Agent's 90.6% on MGSM; 89.1% versus 87.9% on MMLU), while exhibiting notably reduced variance (25-59%) and enhanced robustness.
Furthermore, the framework achieves a 100% evolution success rate, superior to the baseline's 82%, diminishes required optimization iterations by approximately 50% (from 30 iterations in baseline to 15.1 and 13.4 across tasks), and provides improved stability for production deployment.

papers.groupName: Agent / RSI / Agentic RL 主题
papers.title: Black-Box Red-Teaming of Multi-Agent Systems via Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary:
Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in multi-agent systems (MAS) to accomplish complex tasks.
Prior black-box red-teaming attacks mainly focus on single agents, but we find that these methods are far less effective in MAS, where multiple sub-agents may not directly interact with the user.
Therefore, we introduce ReMAS, the first reinforcement learning-based red-teaming framework tailored to MASs, which fine-tunes attacker LLMs to generate effective adversarial prompts for system prompt extraction.
The framework follows a two-step process: first, a rewrite stage refines base attack prompts to increase extraction success, and second, a template generation stage constructs attack templates that improve the likelihood of invoking specific sub-agents and thus revealing their system prompts.
Extensive experiments show that our method substantially improves attack success rates compared to existing black-box attacks, with transferability across different backend LLMs and MAS structures.
These results underscore the vulnerabilities of multi-agent systems and the importance of developing stronger defenses against adaptive black-box adversaries.
highlights: first reinforcement learning-based red-teaming framework tailored to MASs

papers.groupName: Agent / RSI / Agentic RL 主题
papers.title: CTBench: Evaluating Troubleshooting Capabilities of AI Agents in Realistic Telecom Network Operations
papers.summary:
While autonomous agents show promise for network operations, existing telecom troubleshooting evaluations fail to capture the partial observability and heterogeneity of real-world telecom environments.
We introduce CTBench, a public benchmark evaluating agent troubleshooting capabilities in root cause analysis (RCA) and path restoration.
Constructed by domain experts, CTBench features rich metadata and golden evidence trajectories, utilizing metrics that assess both final accuracy and diagnostic reasoning.
Our evaluation of state-of-the-art agents reveals that while they excel at path endpoint identification, they severely underperform in RCA.
Crucially, even when agents produce correct answers, they frequently fail to gather the requisite diagnostic evidence demanded in operational practice.
Finally, we demonstrate that increased computational expenditure does not guarantee improved diagnostic competence, highlighting critical gaps in current agent capabilities.
highlights: We introduce CTBench, a public benchmark evaluating agent troubleshooting capabilities in root cause analysis (RCA) and

papers.groupName: Agent / RSI / Agentic RL 主题
papers.title: LocalAgent: Collaborative Agentic Verification for Fine-Grained Instance-Level Consistency
papers.summary:
Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress in general visual understanding, yet they still struggle with fine-grained instance-level consistency verification, where the goal is to determine whether two images depict the exact same physical object under varying viewpoints, illumination, and backgrounds.
This task requires both global semantic perception and precise examination of subtle local evidence, since semantically similar objects may differ only in small suspicious regions.
To address this challenge, we propose LocalAgent, a collaborative agentic framework that integrates the complementary strengths of a generalist MLLM and lightweight specialist verifiers.
The MLLM first reasons globally to identify suspicious local regions, which are then delegated to a Local Evidence Verifier (LEV) toolkit for fine-grained appearance and geometric matching.
LEV comprises Local Appearance Consistency (LAC), which estimates appearance similarity under illumination and color changes, and Local Geometric Correspondence (LGC), which estimates spatial correspondence under viewpoint changes.
LEV returns structured scalar evidence that the MLLM integrates for the final decision.
We further introduce an auxiliary-capped reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) strategy, in which answer correctness dominates auxiliary tool-use and format signals, enabling the policy to learn when verification is necessary.
Experiments show that LocalAgent improves mean accuracy by 4.9% over the strongest CoT-RFT baseline while invoking a verifier on only 12.13% of samples and preserving the general multimodal capabilities of the underlying MLLM.
The open-source repository is available at https://github.com/Firefly-zoo/LocalAgent-main.
highlights: first reasons globally to identify suspicious local regions

featuredPapers.title: ChartEvo: Self-Evolving Agent Harnesses for Long-Tail Chart Reasoning
featuredPapers.authors: Qi Wang, Peijie Wang, Jun Cao
featuredPapers.summary:
Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have substantially advanced chart understanding and reasoning, yet their performance remains highly uneven across chart types. 多模态大型语言模型（ MLLM ）具有相当先进的图表理解和推理能力，但它们在各种图表类型中的表现仍然非常不平衡。
While modern MLLMs perform well on common charts, their accuracy drops sharply on long-tail charts with diverse visual structures and reasoning requirements. 虽然现代传销在常见图表上表现良好，但在具有不同视觉结构和推理要求的长尾图表上，其准确性急剧下降。
Tool-augmented agents can improve complex chart reasoning by introducing specialized visual capabilities, but manually engineering strategies and tools for the heterogeneous and evolving long tail is difficult to scale. 工具增强代理可以通过引入专门的视觉功能来改进复杂的图表推理，但针对异构且不断发展的长尾手动设计策略和工具很难扩展。
We introduce \textbf{ChartEvo}, a recursive self-improvement framework that enables chart agents to adapt to underperforming chart types through experience-driven harness-level self-improvement. 我们引入了\ textbf {ChartEvo} ，这是一个递归的自我提升框架，使图表代理能够通过体验驱动的线束级自我提升来适应表现不佳的图表类型。
ChartEvo jointly evolves reusable chart-specific Skills and executable Tools, while learning reusable local tool-call chains to compose evolved capabilities and control the inference overhead of tool-augmented reasoning. ChartEvo联合开发可重用的图表特定技能和可执行工具，同时学习可重用的本地工具调用链，以编写演进的功能并控制工具增强推理的推理开销。
On long-tail charts from ChartBench and ChartX, ChartEvo improves accuracy over its base MLLM, Qwen3.7-Plus, by \textbf{45.6\%} and \textbf{32.5\%}, respectively, demonstrating the effectiveness of recursive self-improvement for long-tail chart adaptation. 在ChartBench和ChartX的长尾图上， ChartEvo分别比其基础MLLM Qwen3.7-Plus提高了\ textbf {45.6\ %}和\ textbf {32.5\ %}的准确度，证明了递归自我改进对长尾图适应的有效性。

featuredPapers.title: S-Agent 2.0: Spatial Reasoning with a General Coding Agent
featuredPapers.authors: Rui Gong, Ruoyu Wang, Yalun Dai
featuredPapers.summary:
Spatial reasoning asks a model to work out where objects are in 3D space, how they relate to one another, and how they move. 空间推理要求模型确定物体在3D空间中的位置、它们如何相互关联以及它们如何移动。
Agentic VLMs have recently brought large improvements on such tasks by letting the model actively gather evidence with 3D perception tools instead of answering in a single pass. Agentic VLM最近对此类任务进行了大幅改进，让模型使用3D感知工具主动收集证据，而不是一次性回答。
Even so, on many questions the tools return the right evidence and the model still does not arrive at the correct answer: the gap between model and tools, where raw readings become usable conclusions, is left unfilled. 即便如此，在许多问题上，工具返回了正确的证据，而模型仍然没有得到正确的答案：模型和工具之间的差距，原始读数成为可用的结论，没有填补。
We present S-Agent 2.0, a spatial reasoning agent that equips an off-the-shelf general coding agent with a command-line perception toolkit, and we design the interface around one principle: help the VLM close the evidence loop: acquire scene evidence, remember it in a persistent scene memory, and interpret each reading in plain spatial language. 我们提出了S-Agent 2.0 ，这是一种空间推理代理，它为现成的通用编码代理配备了命令行感知工具包，我们围绕一个原则设计了界面：帮助VLM关闭证据循环：获取场景证据，将其记忆在持久的场景记忆中，并以简单的空间语言解释每次阅读。
This design keeps the full flexibility of a coding agent, and every reading it acts on stays grounded in the tools' geometry. 这种设计保持了编码代理的充分灵活性，并且每次读取都以工具的几何形状为基础。
On MMSI-Bench and ReVSI, the toolkit improves a strong open-source model, Qwen3.8-27B, by +13.9 and +20.5 points over the same agent without tools, and a strong closed-source model, Gemini-3.8-Flash, by +11.2 and +9.6 points. 在MMSI-Bench和ReVSI上，该工具包将强大的开源模型Qwen3.8-27B在没有工具的情况下比同一代理提高+13.9和+20.5分，并将强大的闭源模型Gemini-3.8-Flash提高+11.2和+9.6分。
With the open backbone S-Agent 2.0 reaches 66.5 on MMSI-Bench and 82.3 on ReVSI, ahead of the specialized system SpatialClaw on the same backbone (62.6 and 74.5), and with Gemini-3.8-Flash it reaches 74.1 and 90.5 against its 67.0 and 79.7. 借助开放主干网， S-Agent 2.0在MMSI-Bench上达到66.5 ，在ReVSI上达到82.3 ，领先于同一主干网（ 62.6和74.5 ）上的专用系统SpatialClaw ，借助Gemini-3.8-Flash ，其达到74.1和90.5 ，而其67.0和79.7。
Both tool gains shrink as the backbone grows more capable, but SpatialClaw's shrinks far more on ReVSI, from +13.2 to +2.7, while ours stays at +9.6. 随着骨干能力的增强，这两种工具都会收缩，但SpatialClaw在ReVSI上的收缩幅度要大得多，从+13.2收缩到+2.7 ，而我们的收缩幅度则保持在+9.6。
S-Agent 2.0 also works across different general coding agent harnesses, such as Codex and Claude Code. S-Agent 2.0还适用于不同的通用编码代理线束，例如Codex和Claude Code。

featuredPapers.title: IndusAgent: Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Cross-Category Industrial Anomaly Detection
featuredPapers.authors: Rongbin Tan, Fangfang Lin, Jinguo Luo
featuredPapers.summary:
Small defects in unfamiliar product categories can be difficult to distinguish from benign appearance variations in a global view. 在全球范围内，很难将不熟悉的产品类别中的小缺陷与良性外观变化区分开来。
Additional reasoning over the same view may leave this ambiguity unresolved. 对同一视图的其他推理可能会使这种模棱两可的问题得不到解决。
We introduce IndusAgent, a Qwen3-VL-8B inspection policy trained through supervised fine-tuning and tool-augmented reinforcement learning for cross-category industrial anomaly detection. 我们引入了IndusAgent ，这是一种Qwen3-VL-8B检测策略，通过监督微调和工具增强强化学习进行培训，用于跨类别工业异常检测。
The policy selects among six tools for cropping, enhancement, measurement, within-image comparison, texture analysis, and external visual opinions from Qwen3-VL-Max, then integrates returned observations into a structured diagnosis. 该策略从Qwen3-VL-Max的裁剪、增强、测量、图像内比较、纹理分析和外部视觉意见的六个工具中进行选择，然后将返回的观察结果集成到结构化诊断中。
Indus-CoT provides 3,000 trajectories from 26 Real-IAD categories, generated with actual tool feedback and screened against annotations after teacher generation. Indus-CoT提供来自26个Real-IAD类别的3,000条轨迹，这些轨迹通过实际工具反馈生成，并在教师生成后对照注释进行筛选。
GRPO optimizes an accuracy-gated objective that conditions localization, type, and tool rewards, including call costs, on final diagnostic correctness while retaining an independent format reward. GRPO优化了一个精度门控目标，该目标在最终诊断正确性方面为本地化、类型和工具奖励（包括呼叫成本）提供条件，同时保留独立的格式奖励。
Across five benchmarks, IndusAgent achieves 83.5% mean balanced accuracy, compared with 79.4% for direct Max inference under the common protocol. 在五个基准中， IndusAgent实现了83.5%的平均平衡精度，而在通用协议下，直接最大推断的准确率为79.4%。
Across three training seeds, the five-benchmark mean balanced accuracy is 80.5\% for a weight-matched ungated control and 83.5% for the gated policy. 在三个训练种子中，对于重量匹配的无门控控制，五基准平均平衡准确率为80.5\ % ，对于门控策略，平均平衡准确率为83.5%。
Evaluation uses disjoint product categories and a fixed defect vocabulary. 评估使用不相交的产品类别和固定的缺陷词汇。

featuredPapers.title: Web Agent Agentic Reinforcement Learning Decision Model Under Multi-Cost and Failure Risk
featuredPapers.authors: Qianli Ma, Limengxi Yue, Shuyang Xu
featuredPapers.summary:
Intelligent agent interactions in real-world web environments are commonly constrained by request budgets, time delays, anti-crawling restrictions, and operational failure risks. 现实Web环境中的智能代理交互通常受到请求预算、时间延迟、反爬网限制和操作故障风险的限制。
Strategies solely optimizing task success rates often exhibit unusable phenomena such as "high success but high cost" or "low risk but conservative failure." This paper proposes a constrained agentic reinforcement learning model for web agents, unifying page access, search requests, and external API calls into a unified long-term decision-making framework with associated costs. 仅优化任务成功率的策略通常表现出不可用的现象，例如“高成功但高成本”或“低风险但保守的失败”。“本文提出了一种用于Web代理的约束代理强化学习模型，将页面访问、搜索请求和外部API调用统一到具有相关成本的统一长期决策框架中。
It simultaneously incorporates cost budget constraints and tail risk control into the optimization objective: constructing a multidimensional cost vector comprising cumulative request count, total latency, and failure penalties to achieve budget compliance via Lagrange dual updates, while employing a CVaR risk term to suppress excessive exploration of high-failure-probability paths, thereby achieving an adaptive balance among "completion rate, cost, and risk."
  Experiments were conducted across 30-70 site/page templates and 800-1,500 end-to-end web tasks, including information extraction, price comparison, form submission, and cross-page navigation.
Interaction sequences spanned 20-120 steps with tool scales of 30-200. 交互序列跨越20-120个步骤，工具尺度为30-200。
Performance was benchmarked against unconstrained RL, budget-constrained RL, and rule-based/scripted web agents, quantifying task completion rates, cost-per-success, failure rates, and policy stability. 根据不受约束的RL、预算受限的RL和基于规则/脚本的Web代理对性能进行基准测试，量化任务完成率、每次成功成本、失败率和策略稳定性。
Results demonstrate that at equivalent completion rates, our method reduces C-PS by 22%-31% and lowers failure rates by 18%-26% under high failure penalties. 结果表明，在相同的完成率下，我们的方法在高故障罚款下可将C-PS降低22% -31% ，并将故障率降低18% -26%。
Under fixed budgets, task completion rates increase by 10%-16%, highlighting the necessity and effectiveness of constraint modeling for practical web agent deployment. 在固定预算下，任务完成率提高10% -16% ，凸显了约束建模在实际Web代理部署中的必要性和有效性。

featuredPapers.title: CoEvo-RSI: When Harnesses Evolve, Which Models Should Follow?
featuredPapers.authors: Jiaqi Su, Guibin Zhang, Jie-Jing Shao
featuredPapers.summary:
Model--harness co-evolution has emerged as a prominent paradigm for recursive self-improving (RSI) agents, jointly evolving their execution scaffolds and intrinsic capabilities. 模型- Harness协同进化已成为递归自我改善（ RSI ）代理的突出范例，共同发展其执行支架和内在能力。
We study the persistent yet often overlooked brain--body mismatch problem in this paradigm, where an evolving harness (body) demands behaviors its model (brain) has not learned or restricts capabilities it already possesses. 我们研究了这种范式中持续存在但经常被忽视的大脑-身体错配问题，在这种范式中，不断发展的线束（身体）要求其模型（大脑）尚未学习的行为或限制其已经拥有的能力。
We introduce CoEvo-RSI, a RSI framework that advances model--harness co-evolution through agent-driven, bidirectional historical inheritance. 我们引入了CoEvo-RSI ，这是一个RSI框架，它通过代理驱动的双向历史继承来推进模型- Harness协同进化。
Drawing on a shared evolutionary archive and execution feedback, a meta-agent coordinates harness development from historical designs with model checkpoint selection or merging and subsequent adaptation under the selected harness, aligning inherited capabilities with evolving execution requirements to reduce brain--body mismatch. 借助共享的进化存档和执行反馈，元代理通过模型检查点选择或合并以及所选线束下的后续适应来协调历史设计中的线束开发，使继承的能力与不断变化的执行要求保持一致，以减少脑-身体不匹配。
Using only supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on its own rejection-sampled trajectories, CoEvo-RSI makes Qwen3.5-9B competitive with larger models across diverse vertical applications, including multi-agent failure attribution, role-aware text-to-SQL, and smart-home instruction following. CoEvo-RSI仅在其自身的剔除采样轨迹上使用监督微调（ SFT ） ，使Qwen3.5-9B在不同的垂直应用中与更大的模型竞争，包括多代理失败归因、角色感知文本到SQL和智能家居指令跟踪。
It surpasses DeepSeek-V4-Pro on TraceElephant (+14.16 agent accuracy) and GLM-5.3 on HomeBench VM (+4.90 success rate), underscoring the need for brain--body alignment and the potential of bidirectional historical inheritance to advance agent co-evolution. 它超过了TraceElephant上的DeepSeek-V4-Pro （ +14.16药剂准确度）和HomeBench VM上的GLM-5.3 （ +4.90成功率） ，强调了大脑-身体对齐的必要性以及双向历史遗传的潜力，以促进药剂的共同进化。

featuredPapers.title: Trackable Skill Library Lifecycle Management for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
featuredPapers.authors: Xi Zhu, Yuanlin Duan, Changyi Yang
featuredPapers.summary:
Skill-augmented agentic RL has emerged as an effective approach to improving LLM agents on long-horizon tasks. 技能增强型代理强化学习已成为改进长期任务LLM代理的有效方法。
Despite this progress, individual skills may follow distinct trajectories as the policy evolves, with some becoming redundant after the model internalizes their capabilities, others remaining valuable as external scaffolding, and still others turning harmful. 尽管取得了这一进展，但随着政策的演变，个人技能可能会遵循不同的轨迹，其中一些技能在模型内化其能力后变得多余，另一些技能作为外部支架仍然具有价值，还有一些技能变得有害。
However, existing skill library systems fail to identify each skill's true contribution due to free-riding among co-retrieved skills, difficulty confounding across tasks, and the absence of skill-specific counterfactual evidence, which prevents reliable skill lifecycle management. 然而，现有的技能库系统由于在共同检索的技能之间搭便车、难以混淆任务以及缺乏特定技能的反事实证据而无法识别每项技能的真正贡献，这阻碍了可靠的技能生命周期管理。
We propose TrackRL, an agentic RL framework where skill tracking drives skill library full lifecycle management. 我们提出了TrackRL ，这是一个代理式RL框架，其中技能跟踪驱动技能库的整个生命周期管理。
Specifically, within each GRPO group, we turn grouped sampling into online randomized controlled experiments. 具体而言，在每个GRPO组中，我们将分组抽样转化为在线随机对照实验。
Independent random injection and within-group contrasts on the same task isolate each skill's true contribution, and reliability-weighted aggregation accumulates evidence across groups. 同一任务的独立随机注射和组内对比隔离了每项技能的真正贡献，可靠性加权聚合积累了跨组证据。
As evidence accumulates, we continuously track skill utility, which measures the skill's causal contribution as external scaffolding, and model mastery, which reflects how far the corresponding capability has been internalized. 随着证据的积累，我们不断跟踪技能效用，将技能的因果关系作为外部支架来衡量，以及模型掌握，这反映了相应能力的内化程度。
Along this line, we formulate skill lifecycle management as an evidence-gated state-transition process that governs each skill from generation and admission through protected incubation to retention, retirement, or removal, while a soft capacity bound controls library growth. 沿着这一思路，我们将技能生命周期管理制定为一个循证门控的状态转换过程，从生成和录取到受保护的孵化到保留、退休或移除，管理每个技能，而软容量绑定控制库增长。
Experiments show that TrackRL outperforms recent skill-augmented RL baselines in both library-assisted and skill-free evaluation, with further analyses revealing how skill value shifts during policy learning and how evidence-driven state transitions shape skill library evolution. 实验表明， TrackRL在图书馆辅助和无技能评估方面都优于最近的技能增强RL基线，进一步分析揭示了政策学习过程中技能价值的转变以及循证驱动的状态转变如何影响技能库的演变。
Our code is available at https://github.com/xizhu1022/TrackRL. 我们的代码可在https://github.com/xizhu1022/TrackRL上找到。

featuredPapers.title: Zephyrus-R1: Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Weather Reporting
featuredPapers.authors: Fengfei Yu, Marshall Fisher, Isadora White
featuredPapers.summary:
Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a key method for training AI models in scientific applications, but RL remains difficult when outputs cannot easily be verified against a known ground-truth answer. 强化学习（ RL ）已成为在科学应用中训练人工智能模型的关键方法，但当无法根据已知的地面真实答案轻松验证输出时， RL仍然很困难。
Natural-language weather forecast reports are one such domain: they translate atmospheric data into assessments of weather evolution, hazards, and uncertainty for both the general public and key decision-makers. 自然语言天气预报报告就是这样一个领域：它们将大气数据转化为公众和关键决策者对天气演变、灾害和不确定性的评估。
Unlike numerical weather-analysis questions, they admit many valid outputs, which limits deterministic verification. 与数值天气分析问题不同，它们承认许多有效的输出，这限制了确定性验证。
To address this, we develop Zephyrus-R1, a practical framework for RL on scientific weather forecast reporting. 为了解决这个问题，我们开发了Zephyrus-R1 ，这是科学天气预报报告的实用框架。
We focus on three key components of the agentic RL pipeline: reward design, curriculum learning, and an analysis of human-expert alignment. 我们专注于代理RL管道的三个关键组成部分：奖励设计、课程学习和人与专家对齐分析。
To encourage both report legibility and factual accuracy, we design a reward function that combines a meteorological rubric with bidirectional claim entailment, both evaluated against National Weather Service reference reports. 为了鼓励报告清晰度和事实准确性，我们设计了一个奖励函数，将气象分类和双向索赔相结合，两者都根据国家气象局参考报告进行了评估。
Our framework optimizes this reward in a simulated tool-calling environment, enabling vision-language agents to gather and analyze forecast evidence across regions and lead times before producing a report. 我们的框架在模拟工具调用环境中优化此奖励，使视觉语言代理能够在生成报告之前收集和分析跨地区和交付周期的预测证据。
We use annotations from three meteorologists to audit the claim labels produced by our LLM judges. 我们使用三位气象学家的注释来审核法学硕士评委制作的索赔标签。
Finally, a curriculum helps small models first develop tool use and scientific reasoning through RL on verifiable weather-analysis questions, then optimize the open-ended report reward. 最后，课程帮助小模型首先通过RL在可验证的天气分析问题上开发工具使用和科学推理，然后优化开放式报告奖励。
After training Qwen3.5-4B with Zephyrus-R1, we improve the mean across six judge-metric scores by 26% over the base model and achieve results competitive with frontier open-weight models. 在使用Zephyrus-R1训练Qwen3.5-4B之后，我们将六个判断指标的平均分比基本模型提高了26% ，并实现了与前沿开放权重模型竞争的结果。
For Qwen3.8-27B, we improve the same mean by 13% over the base model, by 6.7% over Kimi-K3, and by 2.7% over GPT-5.6-Luna. 对于Qwen3.8-27B ，我们将相同的平均值比基本模型提高了13% ，比Kimi-K3提高了6.7% ，比GPT-5.6-Luna提高了2.7%。

featuredPapers.title: HarnessPro: Recursive Harness Self-Improvement with Pareto Optimization for Performance-Cost Trade-offs
featuredPapers.authors: Zhuoshi Pan, ZhiYuan Feng, Yukuo Cen
featuredPapers.summary:
Harness development plays a crucial role in building capable AI agents. 线束开发在构建有能力的人工智能代理中起着至关重要的作用。
Recent approaches improve harnesses through recursive self-improvement (RSI), but their performance gains often come with higher execution costs. 最近的方法通过递归自我改进（ RSI ）来改进线束，但其性能提升通常伴随着更高的执行成本。
We introduce HarnessPro, a label-free method for evolving harnesses to improve task performance while reducing execution cost. 我们引入了HarnessPro ，这是一种无标签的方法，用于改进线束，以提高任务性能，同时降低执行成本。
In this setting, candidate harnesses are evaluated using LLM-generated tests without access to ground-truth solutions or official tests. 在此设置中，候选线束使用LLM生成的测试进行评估，而无需访问地面真相解决方案或官方测试。
Specialized agents diagnose execution trajectories, plan updates with different performance-cost priorities, and implement them as candidate harnesses. 专业代理诊断执行轨迹，使用不同的绩效成本优先级计划更新，并将其作为候选工具来实施。
Rather than returning a single harness, HarnessPro uses normalized weighted squared-distance selection to provide cost-focused (lite), balanced (medium), and performance-focused (heavy) harnesses for different deployment budgets. HarnessPro使用标准化加权平方距离选择，而不是返回单个线束，为不同的部署预算提供以成本为中心（精简版）、平衡型（中型）和以性能为中心（重型）的线束。
Selected harnesses enter the next iteration, where execution feedback guides further updates. 所选线束进入下一次迭代，其中执行反馈指导进一步的更新。
Our experiments cover Terminal-Bench 2, SWE-Bench Pro, and ProgramBench, using GPT-5.5 with Codex and GLM-5.2 with Claude Code. 我们的实验涵盖Terminal-Bench 2、SWE-Bench Pro和ProgramBench ，使用带有Codex的GPT-5.5和带有Claude Code的GLM-5.2。
Across these benchmarks using GPT-5.5 with Codex, the heavy mode of HarnessPro achieves an average pass-rate gain of 2.0 percentage points and an average per-task cost reduction of 26.1% relative to RHO. 在使用GPT-5.5和Codex的这些基准中， HarnessPro的重型模式实现了平均2.0个百分点的通过率增益，平均每项任务成本相对于RHO降低了26.1%。
This advantage also holds when using GLM-5.2 with Claude Code. 当将GLM-5.2与Claude Code一起使用时，这种优势也适用。
Code is available at https://github.com/pzs19/HarnessPro 代码可在https://github.com/pzs19/HarnessPro上获得

featuredPapers.title: Compile Once, Run Cheap: Frozen, Portable Skills for Embodied Agents, and What Recursive Self-Improvement Adds
featuredPapers.authors: Jingwen Bai, Guochao Bai, Canbo Zhang
featuredPapers.summary:
Embodied AI lacks the data-rich pretraining that gave language models their agents and skills, so new manipulation capability costs demonstrations per task or a frontier model in every episode. 具体的人工智能缺乏为语言模型提供代理和技能的丰富数据预训练，因此新的操作能力需要在每集的每个任务或前沿模型中进行演示。
We study a third route: a strong general model acts only as an offline author that writes, runs, diagnoses and repairs a manipulation skill in simulation until it passes an exam on layouts drawn after freezing; the frozen skill then runs as code alone or under a cheap caller that reads only its description. 我们研究了第三条路线：强大的通用模型仅充当离线作者，在模拟中编写、运行、诊断和修复操作技能，直到它通过对冻结后绘制的布局的考试；然后，冻结的技能作为代码单独运行或在仅读取其描述的廉价调用者下运行。
We call this skill-level recursive self-improvement Skill-RSI and specify a compile protocol (isolated, audited author; hidden validation layouts; no-feedback and inherit-only controls; tamper-evident ledger) and a reuse protocol that runs the identical files with executors from another model family. 我们将这种技能级别的递归自我提升称为Skill-RSI ，并指定编译协议（隔离、经审核的作者；隐藏验证布局；无反馈和仅继承控件；篡改可见分类账）和运行相同文件的重用协议，执行者来自另一个模型系列。
On 7 RoboTwin 2.0 tasks with cluttered tables, Claude Code compiled 4 tasks into 7 frozen skills, 5 from a first draft needing only qualification, at USD 4.29-8.22 of author cost each (USD 55 per skill counting the 13 failed campaigns). 在7个表格混乱的RoboTwin 2.0任务中， Claude Code将4个任务编译为7个冻结技能，其中5个来自仅需要资格的初稿，每个作者成本为4.29-8.22美元（每个技能55美元，计算13个失败的活动）。
The other three tasks did not compile in 18 campaigns, including five with GPT-6 and a pre-registered 150-layout run: on the hardest task every campaign scored 78-95 of 100 but had 3-16 safety aborts, failing the gate of 95% success with zero aborts; a 100-episode exam bounds an abort rate only to 3.6%. 其他三个任务在18个活动中没有编译，包括5个GPT-6和预先注册的150个布局运行：在最困难的任务中，每个活动的得分为78-95/100 ，但有3-16次安全中止，没有成功率为95 ％ ，中止次数为零； 100次检查的中止率仅为3.6 ％。
On hidden layouts, repair that inherits the previous version beat from-scratch rewriting in 8 of 8 controlled campaigns (sign test p = 0.004); an inherit-only lineage attributes most of the gap to inheritance, with development feedback adding a little (3 of 3, p = 0.125). 在隐藏布局上，在8个受控活动中的8个中继承先前版本从头开始重写的修复（符号测试p = 0.004 ） ；仅继承的谱系将大部分差距归因于继承，并添加了一些开发反馈（ 3/3 ， p = 0.125 ）。
Write-once campaigns found no detectable first-draft effect of practice (minimum detectable effect 14 points). 一次写入活动未发现实践的可检测的初稿效果（最低可检测效果14分）。
The frozen skills kept 148/150 successes on new layouts with no model and 147/150 with a DeepSeek-flash caller at USD 0.00028-0.00054 per episode; no direct-control baseline was run. 冻结的技能在没有模型的新布局上保持了148/150的成功，在每集0.00028-0.00054美元的DeepSeek闪存调用者中保持了147/150的成功；没有运行直接控制基线。

featuredPapers.title: MOSAIC: More LLMs, Less Cost through Collaborative Reasoning for Compiler Optimizations
featuredPapers.authors: Annabelle Sujun Tang, Christopher Priebe, Lianhui Qin
featuredPapers.summary:
LLM-guided compiler optimization has recently shown promise. LLM引导的编译器优化最近显示出希望。
However, current LLM-guided optimizers query a single LLM at every search step, so their cost grows with both that model's price and the search budget. 但是，当前的LLM引导优化器在每个搜索步骤查询单个LLM ，因此它们的成本会随着该模型的价格和搜索预算的增加而增加。
A smaller model is cheaper but degrades the search: in our experiments, a recent single-LLM optimizer reaches 10.2% (6.0%) lower speedup on GPU (CPU) with gpt-5-mini than with GPT-5.2. 较小的模型更便宜，但会降低搜索速度：在我们的实验中，最近的单LLM优化器在gpt-5-mini的GPU （ CPU ）上的加速比GPT-5.2低10.2 ％ （ 6.0 ％ ）。
Agentic multi-LLM frameworks add controllers, concurrent calls, and shared memory, whose overhead can offset the savings of cheaper models. Agentic多LLM框架增加了控制器、并发调用和共享内存，其开销可以抵消更便宜型号的节省。
This paper shows that the optimization search tree itself can coordinate heterogeneous LLMs: the tree already records which proposals improved the program, and we can augment the tree to record which model made them. 本文表明，优化搜索树本身可以协调异构LLM ：树已经记录了哪些建议改进了程序，我们可以增加树来记录哪个模型产生了它们。
That evidence can then be used to decide which model should propose next. 然后可以使用该证据来决定下一步应该提出哪个模型。
To this end, we introduce MOSAIC, in which each Monte Carlo tree search (MCTS) node records a program and the LLM that expands it, and the active LLM proposes both a compiler transformation and the LLM for the next step. 为此，我们引入了MOSAIC ，其中每个蒙特卡罗树搜索（ MCTS ）节点都记录了一个程序和扩展它的LLM ，并且活动的LLM提出了编译器转换和下一步的LLM。
We also contribute an LLM-aware UCT that favors smaller models and a course-alteration rule that invokes the largest model only after repeated small-model regressions. 我们还提供了一个支持较小模型的LLM感知UCT和一个仅在重复小模型回归后调用最大模型的课程变更规则。
Against that single-LLM optimizer run with GPT-5.2 alone and the same number of search iterations and tree parameters, on an NVIDIA GPU (Intel CPU), MOSAIC with eight LLMs improves the geometric-mean speedup on five kernels by 7.2% (14.4%) and the end-to-end Llama-3-8B speedup by 1.61x (1.41x), while reducing kernel compilation time by 1.95x (1.74x) and API cost by 4.47x (4.32x), with GPT-5.2 making only 23.1% (23.9%) of LLM calls. 针对仅使用GPT-5.2运行的单LLM优化器以及相同数量的搜索迭代和树参数，在NVIDIA GPU （ Intel CPU ）上，具有八个LLM的MOSAIC将五个内核的几何平均加速提高了7.2 ％ （ 14.4 ％ ） ，端到端的Llama-3-8B加速提高了1.61倍（ 1.41倍） ，同时将内核编译时间减少了1.95倍（ 1.74倍） ， API成本降低了4.47倍（ 4.32倍） ，而GPT-5.2仅占LLM调用的23.1 ％ （ 23.9 ％ ）。
With the same eight models, random or round-robin model choice improves over the single-LLM baseline by only 2.5% on CPU, showing that the gains come from letting the LLMs choose the next model rather than from mixing the pool at random. 使用相同的八个模型，随机或循环模型选择在CPU上仅比单个LLM基线提高2.5% ，这表明收益来自于让LLM选择下一个模型，而不是随机混合池。
highlights: LLM-guided compiler optimization has recently shown promise.

featuredPapers.title: RLTLDR: Self-improvement by Internalizing Self-generated Feedback
featuredPapers.authors: Michael Kirchhof, Eleonora Gualdoni, Andrew Szot
featuredPapers.summary:
The common paradigm of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is to let agents make multiple attempts at a task, and optimize towards the successful ones. 具有可验证奖励的强化学习（ RLVR ）的常见范例是让代理对一项任务进行多次尝试，并对成功的任务进行优化。
This becomes problematic in the realms of self-improvement, where tasks are so difficult that the agent has a low or even no chance of success, and where there are no teacher models or example solutions to distill from. 这在自我提升领域变得有问题，在这些领域，任务非常困难，代理成功的机会很低，甚至没有成功的机会，并且没有教师模型或示例解决方案可供提炼。
In this paper, we introduce RLTLDR. 在本文中，我们将介绍RLTLDR。
After each failed attempt, we show the policy the verifier outputs and let it write its own feedback, in the form of a single TL;DR insight. 每次尝试失败后，我们都会显示验证者输出的策略，并让它以单个TL; DR洞察的形式编写自己的反馈。
The next rollout is conditioned on all previous insights, and we sequentially sample rollouts until a solution is found. 下一次推出将以所有以前的见解为条件，我们会按顺序对推出进行抽样，直到找到解决方案。
Moreover, we enable backpropagation on the in-context insights to internalize a direct task to insight mapping. 此外，我们对上下文见解进行反向传播，以将直接任务内化为见解映射。
On challenging tool-calling and coding datasets (filtered to Pass@128=0), standard GRPO training of a Qwen 3.5 9B Thinking policy stays flat at a Pass@1 of 0% to 1%. 对于具有挑战性的工具调用和编码数据集（过滤为Pass @ 128 = 0 ） ， Qwen 3.5 9B思维策略的标准GRPO培训在Pass @ 1为0%至1%时保持不变。
RLTLDR breaks through this learning barrier, achieving a Pass@1 of 14-31% with insights in context during training and, crucially, 12-13% when no insight is in context at eval time. RLTLDR突破了这一学习障碍，在培训期间获得了有关背景的洞察力的14-31%的及格@ 1 ，至关重要的是，当评估时没有洞察力时，达到12-13%。
We identify that the key is the task to insight internalization. 我们认为关键是洞察内化的任务。
To study this further, we reduce our approach to SFTLDR, training only on (task, insight) tuples, without showing or backpropagating on any rollouts. 为了进一步研究这一点，我们减少了SFTLDR的方法，只对(task, insight)元组进行培训，而不会在任何推广中显示或反向传播。
Training on only 4k of these tuples recovers almost the full performance of RLTLDR and classical SFT on full rollouts. 在这些元组中，只有4k的训练几乎可以恢复RLTLDR和经典SFT在全面推广时的全部性能。
This demonstrates a promising compacted training paradigm of the form "on this sort of task, keep this sort of thing in mind", which we hope to inspire future research on. 这展示了“关于此类任务，请记住此类事情”形式的有前途的紧凑培训范式，我们希望能够启发未来的研究。
highlights: In this paper, we introduce RLTLDR.

featuredPapers.title: OpenCollab: A Multi-Agent Coding Framework with Programmable Collaboration and Controllable Runtime
featuredPapers.authors: Chun-Wah Hsu, Kai Gong, Yu Wu
featuredPapers.summary:
Multi-agent coding systems are designed to tackle complex software engineering tasks through collaboration. 多代理编码系统旨在通过协作处理复杂的软件工程任务。
However, existing evaluations typically assume configured organizations are followed faithfully, whereas reality differs. 然而，现有的评估通常假设已配置的组织被忠实地遵循，而现实情况则有所不同。
This behavioral gap, combined with differences in underlying system components, prevents clear attribution of observed gains. 这种行为差距，加上底层系统组件的差异，阻止了观察到的收益的明确归因。
To this end, we introduce OpenCollab, a multi-agent coding framework that provides a unified infrastructure for programmable collaboration and controllable runtime. 为此，我们推出了OpenCollab ，这是一个多代理编码框架，为可编程协作和可控运行时提供统一的基础设施。
Specifically, OpenCollab unifies organization design, enforces experimental control on a shared runtime, and tracks execution through fine-grained event streams. 具体而言， OpenCollab统一了组织设计，在共享运行时上实施实验性控制，并通过细粒度事件流跟踪执行。
On this basis, we define Adherence to quantify whether the declared organization is actually realized. 在此基础上，我们定义了遵守情况，以量化申报的组织是否真正实现。
Our experiments reveal that agents collaborate very differently across configurations: changing any single dimension shifts Adherence, from 47.2% to as high as 97.2%. 我们的实验表明，客服代表在不同配置之间的协作方式非常不同：改变任何单一维度将遵守率从47.2%提高到97.2%。
Furthermore, extensive agentic coding benchmarks show that OpenCollab (Duo) establishes new SOTA performance compared to the mainstream harnesses such as Mini-SWE-agent, OpenHands, Codex CLI, and Claude Code, showing that a well-designed organization can outperform strong existing harnesses, while OpenCollab's single-agent configuration uses the fewest tokens across all evaluated suites. 此外，广泛的代理编码基准测试表明，与Mini-SWE-agent、OpenHands、Codex CLI和Claude Code等主流线束相比， OpenCollab （ Duo ）建立了新的SOTA性能，这表明精心设计的组织可以超越强大的现有线束，而OpenCollab的单代理配置在所有评估套件中使用的代币最少。
OpenCollab establishes a unified multi-agent infrastructure for easy programmable collaboration and controlled causal evaluation. OpenCollab建立了统一的多代理基础设施，可轻松实现可编程协作和受控因果评估。

featuredPapers.title: EGI-BENCH: An Enterprise General Intelligence Benchmark Suite
featuredPapers.authors: Zhiwei Liu, Zhujun Lan, Jielin Qiu
featuredPapers.summary:
Enterprise adoption of LLMs in agentic workflows is gated by evaluations that span a wide arc of abilities: CRM operations, heterogeneous-document retrieval, personal data understanding, multi-turn planning, tool use, function calling, long-horizon research, and long-context software engineering. 企业在代理工作流程中采用LLM是由跨越广泛能力的评估所决定的： CRM操作、异构文档检索、个人数据理解、多轮规划、工具使用、函数调用、长视野研究和长上下文软件工程。
These evaluations live today in separate repositories with divergent runners, dependencies, and scoring conventions, which makes cross-benchmark comparison difficult and obscures what a single aggregate number actually represents. 如今，这些评估存在于具有不同的运行器、依赖关系和评分约定的单独存储库中，这使得跨基准比较变得困难，并模糊了单个汇总数字实际代表的内容。
We release EGI-BENCH, a unified LLM agent benchmark suite that consolidates eight enterprise facing agent benchmarks (CRMARENA, HERB, PERSONABENCH, USERBENCH, MCP-UNIVERSE, MCPEVAL, BENCHFORCE, LOCOBENCH) behind a single command-line interface with two runtime-budgeted execution modes. 我们发布了EGI-BENCH ，这是一个统一的LLM代理基准套件，它将八个面向企业的代理基准（ CRMARENA、HERB、PERSONABENCH、USERBENCH、MCP-UNIVERSE、MCPEVAL、BENCHFORCE、LOCOBENCH ）整合在一个具有两种运行时预算执行模式的单一命令行界面之后。
On top of the suite we define the Enterprise General Intelligence (EGI) Score, a six-dimensional framework (M1-M6) whose buckets are populated by fine-grained sub-metrics routed from each benchmark rather than by benchmark-level averages. 在套件之上，我们定义了企业通用智能（ EGI ）分数，这是一个六维框架（ M1-M6 ） ，其桶由从每个基准路由的细粒度子指标填充，而不是由基准级平均值填充。
We describe the suite, the sub-metric routing, and the quick/deep budgets, and report results for fourteen frontier and cost-efficient LLMs spanning the GPT, Claude, and Gemini families under quick mode. 我们描述了套件、子度量路由和快速/深度预算，并报告了在快速模式下跨GPT、Claude和Gemini系列的14个前沿和具有成本效益的LLM的结果。
Top-line EGI ranges from 39.6 (GPT-4o mini) to 65.6 (gpt-5.5), and no single model dominates every capability axis: gpt-5.5 leads task outcome, planning, and retrieval grounding; Claude Sonnet 4.5 leads tool actioning and safety/abstention; and Claude Haiku 4.5 leads engineering quality. 顶线EGI范围从39.6 （ GPT-4o mini ）到65.6 （ gpt-5.5 ） ，没有单一模型主导每个能力轴： gpt-5.5引领任务结果、规划和检索接地； Claude Sonnet 4.5引领工具操作和安全/弃权； Claude Haiku 4.5引领工程质量。
Code is available at https://github.com/SalesforceAIResearch/egi-bench. 优惠码可在https://github.com/SalesforceAIResearch/egi-bench上获得。

featuredPapers.title: How Intervention History Changes AI Agent Sabotage on Subsequent Tasks
featuredPapers.authors: Daniel Saeedi, Amirali Aghazadeh
featuredPapers.summary:
AI control evaluations often reset agents' memory between tasks, although deployed agents may retain records of prior interventions. 人工智能控制评估通常会在任务之间重置代理的记忆，尽管部署的代理可能会保留先前干预的记录。
We ask whether learning that an earlier attack was caught changes an agent's ability to evade defer-to-trusted (DtT), a protocol that replaces suspicious work with a trusted model's solution. 我们询问，得知较早的攻击被发现是否会改变代理逃避延迟信任（ DtT ）的能力， DtT是一种用可信模型的解决方案取代可疑工作的协议。
Herein, we study cross-episode adaptation: whether intervention history changes attack behavior on a subsequent task with different objectives and a fresh environment. 在这里，我们研究了跨情节适应：干预历史是否改变了具有不同目标和新鲜环境的后续任务的攻击行为。
We evaluate this using ControlArena's Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and SHADE-Arena as testbeds, where agents must complete a main task while covertly pursuing a harmful side objective. 我们使用ControlArena的基础设施即代码（ IaC ）和SHADE-Arena作为测试平台进行评估，其中代理必须完成主要任务，同时秘密追求有害的辅助目标。
For each successor task, we pair a history-conditioned attempt with the model's no-history attempt. 对于每个后续任务，我们将历史条件尝试与模型的无历史尝试配对。
The retained history either states that the previous submission was replaced or additionally includes the trusted model's replacement. 保留的历史记录要么声明先前提交已被替换，要么额外包括可信模型的替换。
For Claude Opus 4.8 on IaC, intervention history reduces successful sabotage. 对于IaC的Claude Opus 4.8 ，干预史减少了成功的破坏活动。
Completion of both the main and side objectives falls from 77% to 12% when the agent is told about the replacement and to 38% when it is also shown the trusted model's replacement, while main task success remains essentially unchanged. 当代理被告知更换时，主要目标和侧面目标的完成率从77%下降到12% ，当代理也显示可信模型的替换时，完成率降至38% ，而主要任务的成功率基本保持不变。
Condensing the history weakens this effect, suggesting that the retained context matters and limiting attribution to intervention feedback alone. 浓缩历史会削弱这种效果，表明保留的背景很重要，并限制仅归因于干预反馈。
GPT-5.4 shows no significant change in successful sabotage on the same IaC benchmark. GPT-5.4显示相同IaC基准的成功破坏没有显著变化。
On SHADE-Arena, GPT-5's successful sabotage rate decreases, but the reduction is not significant. 在SHADE-Arena上， GPT-5的成功破坏率降低，但降低幅度不大。
Across the tested models, history conditions, and deferral thresholds, intervention history never increases the rate of successful sabotage that survives DtT. 在测试的模型、历史条件和延迟阈值中，干预历史从未增加DtT存活的成功破坏率。
These results show that intervention history can change subsequent attack behavior, but its effect depends on both the model and the retained context. 这些结果表明，干预历史可以改变后续的攻击行为，但其影响取决于模型和保留的上下文。
highlights: AI control evaluations often reset agents' memory between tasks, although deployed agents may retain records of prior in
For each successor task, we pair a history-conditioned attempt with the model's no-history attempt.

featuredPapers.title: IDEAgent: Agentic Quality-Diversity Search for Research Idea Generation
featuredPapers.authors: Varun Gumma, Navonil Majumder, Soumitra Sinhahajari
featuredPapers.summary:
Large Language Models (LLMs) have significantly advanced the automation of scientific discovery. 大型语言模型（ LLM ）大大推进了科学发现的自动化。
However, existing systems share a core limitation: they optimize ideas independently for either Quality or Diversity. 然而，现有的系统有一个核心限制：它们独立地优化创意，以实现质量或多样性。
This often results in closely related ideas or large sets of trivial, unsound, or unclear concepts. 这通常会导致密切相关的想法或大量琐碎、不健全或不清楚的概念。
We instead argue that research ideation should be framed as a conjunction of Quality and Diversity objectives, i.e., a Quality-Diversity (QD) search. 相反，我们认为研究理念应被视为质量和多样性目标的结合，即质量-多样性（ QD ）搜索。
Accordingly, we introduce IDEAgent, a multi-agent framework that tracks idea evolution through lineages. 因此，我们引入了IDEAgent ，这是一个通过谱系跟踪创意演变的多智能体框架。
We jointly drive Quality using multi-objective feedback for repair and refinement, while Diversity is achieved through lightweight sequential memory and explicit comparison against completed ideas, historical variants, and rejected proposals. 我们使用多目标反馈进行维修和改进，共同推动质量，而多元化则通过轻量级顺序记忆以及与已完成的想法、历史变体和被拒绝的提案的明确比较来实现。
To evaluate this joint objective, we develop Yield, a metric that computes the largest mutually diverse set of ideas satisfying predefined quality thresholds. 为了评估这一共同目标，我们开发了收益率指标，该指标计算了满足预定义质量阈值的最大的相互多样化的想法集。
Across 32 topics spanning 8 CS domains, IDEAgent outperforms the best baseline by 3.89x on Yield, while achieving Yield of at least 2 on 8x as many topics. 在横跨8个CS域的32个主题中， IDEAgent在Yield上的表现优于最佳基线3.89倍，而在8倍的主题上实现了至少2倍的Yield。
We further analyze quality improvements, showing that repair and refinement improve logical rigor and clarity while preserving non-obviousness. 我们进一步分析质量改进，表明维修和改进可以提高逻辑严谨性和清晰度，同时保持非显而易见性。
Lastly, we extend IDEAgent to two algorithm discovery tasks for verifiable quality judgment and find that it still consistently outperforms all baselines, and yields the largest set of high-quality and diverse programs that beat a trivial/standard baseline. 最后，我们将IDEAgent扩展到两个算法发现任务，以实现可验证的质量判断，并发现它仍然始终如一地优于所有基线，并产生了超过琐碎/标准基线的最大一组高质量和多样化的程序。
To encourage future research on QD-search-based ideation, we open-source IDEAgent at https://github.com/declare-lab/IDEAgent. 为了鼓励未来对基于QD搜索的构思的研究，我们在https://github.com/declare-lab/IDEAgent上开源了IDEAgent。

featuredPapers.title: AM-Bench: A Unified Taxonomy and Evaluation Suite for Agentic Misalignment
featuredPapers.authors: Eric Zhang, Terry Jingchen Zhang, Chijioke Ugwuanyi
featuredPapers.summary:
As LLM-based agents are deployed with increasing autonomy in real-world environments, a critical failure mode emerges: agentic misalignment, where agents choose harmful actions over failure. 随着基于LLM的代理在现实环境中以越来越大的自主权进行部署，出现了一种关键的故障模式：代理错位，即代理选择有害操作而不是故障。
However, existing safety benchmarks primarily evaluate whether agents comply with explicitly harmful instructions, leaving the conditions that cause agents to choose harmful actions poorly understood. 但是，现有的安全基准主要评估客服代表是否遵守了明显有害的指示，导致客服代表选择有害行为的条件知之甚少。
To address this limitation, we propose AM-Bench, a unified taxonomy and 35 scenario evaluation benchmark spanning seven industries for agentic misalignment grounded in the fraud triangle, a well-established criminological framework explaining goal-directed misconduct. 为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了AM-Bench ，这是一个跨越七个行业的统一分类法和35个场景评估基准，基于欺诈三角形，这是一个完善的犯罪学框架，可以解释目标导向的不当行为。
We adapt this framework to agentic environments and construct our evaluation suite and detection systems along three dimensions: perceived threat, perceived opportunity, and reasoning. 我们将此框架适应代理环境，并沿着三个维度构建我们的评估套件和检测系统：感知威胁、感知机会和推理。
We operationalize each dimension into structured subcategories rooted in prior theory: five threat categories derived from the instrumental convergence thesis, seven opportunity categories drawn from the Emergent Strategic Reasoning Risks (ESRR) taxonomy, and a novel four-question binary reasoning framework synthesized from prior literature. 我们将每个维度可操作化为植根于先前理论的结构化子类别：源自工具收敛论的五个威胁类别，源自新兴战略推理风险（ ESRR ）分类法的七个机会类别，以及从先前文献中合成的新型四问题二元推理框架。
Our evaluation of 10 frontier models reveals a 62-percentage-point gap in misalignment across scenarios, with Gemini 3 Flash and Gemini 3.1 Pro exhibiting the highest levels of agentic misalignment while Claude Sonnet 4.6 displays near-zero rates across all conditions. 我们对10个前沿模型的评估显示，不同场景之间的错位差距为62个百分点，其中Gemini 3 Flash和Gemini 3.1 Pro在所有条件下都表现出最高水平的代理错位，而Claude Sonnet 4.6在所有条件下的错位率接近于零。
Our reasoning framework further reveals that models may exhibit harmful behaviours without explicit situational awareness or explanation, complicating both mitigation and detection. 我们的推理框架进一步揭示，模型可能在没有明确的态势感知或解释的情况下表现出有害行为，从而使缓解和检测变得复杂。
AM-Bench scenarios and code are available at https://github.com/AI4Collaboration/Agentic-Misalignment-Bench AM-Bench场景和代码可在https://github.com/AI4Collaboration/Agentic-Misalignment-Bench上获得
