Recursive harness evolution can automate their design, but how it can reliably discover generalizable systems from limited, noisy, and repeatedly reused feedback remains unclear. 递归线束的演进可以实现其设计的自动化，但它如何从有限、嘈杂和重复使用的反馈中可靠地发现可推广的系统尚不清楚。
We study this question in agentic video understanding, where rich multimodal evidence and coupled mechanisms make harness optimization challenging. 我们在代理视频理解中研究这个问题，丰富的多模态证据和耦合机制使线束优化具有挑战性。
We first introduce VHarness-BRSI, a recursive self-improvement framework that evolves video harnesses around a frozen vision-language model. 我们首先介绍VHarness-BRSI ，这是一个递归自我改进框架，围绕冻结的视觉语言模型发展视频线束。
Analyzing over 4,000 evolved candidates, we find it competitive with hand-engineered systems but identify three interconnected failure modes: validation overfitting, search-budget dilution, and the early-experience trap. 我们分析了4000多名进化的候选者，发现它与手工系统有竞争力，但确定了三种相互关联的故障模式：验证过拟合、搜索预算稀释和早期体验陷阱。
We trace all three to a common root: the same imperfect validation evidence drives both harness revisions and the proposer's search strategy. 我们将这三者追溯到一个共同的根源：相同的不完美验证证据推动了线束修订和提案者的搜索策略。
We therefore propose VHarness-SRSI, an evidence-governed framework in which every search decision rests on evidence that is transferable, sufficient, and gathered before the search commits. 因此，我们提出了VHarness-SRSI ，这是一个证据管理框架，其中每个搜索决定都依赖于在搜索提交之前可转移、充分和收集的证据。
It restricts the proposer to content-free feedback, informs exploration with instrumented warm-up experiments, and develops mechanisms in isolated probe-race branches before factorial composition and joint refinement. 它将提议者限制为无内容反馈，通过仪器预热实验为探索提供信息，并在析因组合和关节细化之前在孤立的探针-竞赛分支中开发机制。
Across four video understanding benchmarks, VideoHarness-SRSI improves the equally weighted mean held-out score by 6.2% relative to VideoHarness-BRSI and reduces the mean validation-test gap by 37.9%. 在四个视频理解基准中， VideoHarness-SRSI相对于VideoHarness-BRSI将同等加权的平均保留分数提高了6.2% ，并将平均验证测试差距缩小了37.9%。
Reliable harness evolution thus depends on how search is organized and informed, not only on how well it optimizes validation performance. 因此，可靠的线束进化取决于搜索的组织和知情方式，而不仅仅是它优化验证性能的程度。

featuredPapers.title: Can LLMs predict the outcomes of machine learning experiments?
featuredPapers.authors: Ayush Bansal, Aldo Pareja, Sean Klein
featuredPapers.summary:
Recent advances in AI make Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) increasingly plausible. 人工智能的最新进展使递归自我改进（ RSI ）变得越来越合理。
Large Language Models (LLMs) can already propose, select, and run Machine Learning (ML) experiments. 大型语言模型（ LLM ）已经可以提出、选择和运行机器学习（ ML ）实验。
However, the space of possible design choices in ML is vast. 然而，机器学习中可能的设计选择空间是巨大的。
An LLM that proposes an experiment needs a reliable intuition of whether it is worth running given the timing constraints of long training runs. 提出实验的LLM需要一个可靠的直觉，即考虑到长时间训练运行的时间限制，它是否值得运行。
In this work, we measure such intuition in current frontier LLMs by evaluating how accurately they predict the impact of self-generated ML experiment ideas before these are put into training runs. 在这项工作中，我们通过评估当前前沿LLM在投入训练运行之前预测自生ML实验想法影响的准确程度来衡量这种直觉。
To this end, we construct a dataset of 288 LLM-proposed ideas on eight MLE-bench tasks. 为此，我们构建了一个包含288个LLM提出的关于八个MLE-bench任务的想法的数据集。
We then prompt five frontier LLMs (GPT-6 Astra, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Fable 5.1, Kimi K3, and GLM-5.3) to predict the impact of each idea and compare their predictions with the actual outcomes after training. 然后，我们提示五位前沿LLM （ GPT-6 Astra、Claude Opus 5.5、Claude Fable 5.1、Kimi K3和GLM-5.3 ）预测每个想法的影响，并将他们的预测与培训后的实际结果进行比较。
We report four main findings. 我们报告了四个主要发现。
First, LLM predictions are substantially better than random chance but far from accurate: even the best model, Claude Opus 5.5, explains only half of the variance in outcomes (R^2 = 0.49). 首先， LLM预测大大优于随机机会，但远非准确：即使是最好的模型， Claude Opus 5.5 ，也只能解释结果方差的一半（ R ^ 2 = 0.49 ）。
Second, we notice that all tested models systematically underestimate the magnitude of the changes. 其次，我们注意到所有测试模型都系统地低估了变化的幅度。
Third, prediction quality varies widely across tasks. 第三，不同任务的预测质量差异很大。
Finally, the choice of the coding harness that actually implements the ideas has little effect on outcomes, and we find no evidence of self-preference. 最后，实际实现这些想法的编码线束的选择对结果几乎没有影响，我们没有发现自我偏好的证据。
Higher reasoning settings and additional context lead to modest gains. 更高的推理设置和额外的背景会导致适度的收益。
Overall, our results show that current LLMs have useful but limited intuition about which ML ideas will work. 总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，当前的LLM对哪些ML创意有效有着有用但有限的直觉。
We release our dataset to support further study. 我们发布数据集以支持进一步的研究。
highlights: Recent advances in AI make Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) increasingly plausible.
Large Language Models (LLMs) can already propose, select, and run Machine Learning (ML) experiments.

featuredPapers.title: AlphaBet: Reinforcement Learning for LLM Event Forecasting Agents
featuredPapers.authors: Liqin Ye, Rongzhi Zhang, Xin Liu
featuredPapers.summary:
Forecasting an unresolved event requires finding relevant evidence and deciding how strongly it supports each outcome. 预测未解决的事件需要找到相关证据，并决定其对每个结果的支持程度。
Yet outcome-based training of Large Language Model (LLM) forecasters often begins with preassembled evidence at a single prediction date, leaving evidence acquisition outside the learning loop. 然而，大型语言模型（ LLM ）预测人员的基于结果的培训通常始于单个预测日期的预组装证据，而将证据获取置于学习循环之外。
We introduce AlphaBet, an agentic reinforcement learning (RL) framework that trains a single LLM policy to search, reason, and report probabilities across multiple pre-resolution dates. 我们引入了AlphaBet ，这是一个代理强化学习(RL)框架，用于训练单个LLM策略，以便在多个预解析日期中搜索、推理和报告概率。
Each dated forecast is scored by a proper scoring rule against the eventual outcome, allowing one resolved event to supervise decisions under different information states. 每个过时的预测都根据适当的评分规则对最终结果进行评分，从而允许一个已解决的事件监督不同信息状态下的决策。
We decompose forecasting regret into an evidence-acquisition gap and a probability-reporting gap, and show that Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)'s standard-deviation normalization can distort the reporting target under multi-class proper scores. 我们将预测遗憾分解为证据获取缺口和概率报告缺口，并表明组相对策略优化（ GRPO ）的标准偏差归一化可以在多类正确分数下扭曲报告目标。
On GLM-4.5-Air, AlphaBet reduces the Brier score from 0.731 to 0.626 on Forecast-Dojo and from 0.612 to 0.528 on FutureX. 在GLM-4.5-Air上， AlphaBet将Forecast-Dojo上的Brier评分从0.731降至0.626 ，在FutureX上从0.612降至0.528。
Controlled ablations attribute these gains to multi-date training and show that they come from improvements in both information acquisition and probability reporting. 受控消融将这些收益归因于多日期培训，并表明它们来自信息获取和概率报告的改进。
Our empirical results validate that GRPO's std normalization degrades proper-scoring-rule performance while leaving top-outcome accuracy largely unchanged. 我们的实证结果验证了GRPO的STD归一化会降低正确的评分规则性能，同时保持最高结果的准确性基本不变。
highlights: Forecasting an unresolved event requires finding relevant evidence and deciding how strongly it supports each outcome.

featuredPapers.title: Benchmarking and Enhancing Agentic Causal Discovery
featuredPapers.authors: Pingchuan Ma, Rui Ding, Shuai Wang
featuredPapers.summary:
LLM agents can now run causal discovery algorithms on a dataset and report what comes out. LLM代理现在可以在数据集上运行因果发现算法并报告结果。
Whether they do more than that, such as noticing where an algorithm went wrong and fixing it with further tests, is hard to tell from current benchmarks. 他们是否做得更多，例如注意到算法出错的地方并通过进一步的测试来修复它，很难从当前的基准中分辨出来。
Most of them give the variables meaningful names, and an LLM shown only the names of the T\"ubingen cause-effect pairs already gets 99% of the directions right. 他们中的大多数给了变量有意义的名称，并且仅显示T\ "ubingen因果对的名称的LLM已经获得了99 ％的方向正确。
With the names removed, the data are usually clean enough that picking a better algorithm than PC closes most of the gap. 删除名称后，数据通常足够干净，以至于选择比PC更好的算法可以缩小大部分差距。
We introduce Heuresis, a benchmark of anonymous simulated datasets whose mechanisms range from linear Gaussian to heavy-tailed. 我们引入Heuresis ，这是匿名模拟数据集的基准，其机制范围从线性高斯到重尾。
For each family of datasets it separates what a better existing algorithm can gain from what only a closer look at the data can gain, and it traces every edge an agent changes. 对于每个数据集系列，它将更好的现有算法从只有仔细查看数据才能获得的收益分开，并跟踪代理更改的每个边缘。
Every family leaves a gap that none of the algorithms, the router and the two causal-discovery foundation models we ran can close, so a score above the best chosen algorithm has to come from using the data. 每个家庭都留下了一个我们运行的算法、路由器和两个因果发现基础模型都无法填补的空白，因此使用数据必须获得高于最佳选择的算法的分数。
We instantiate the benchmark with an agent harness and three LLMs, GPT-6.1 Sol, Claude Opus 5.5 and Qwen 3.8 Flash. 我们使用代理线束和三个LLM （ GPT-6.1 SOL、Claude Opus 5.5和Qwen 3.8 Flash ）实例化基准。
GPT-6.1 Sol surpasses the best chosen algorithm on all six families, by 14% adjacency F1 on the most difficult one, and Claude Opus 5.5 does so by 7.4% there. GPT-6.1 SOL在所有六个系列中都超过了最佳选择算法，在最困难的系列中相邻F1的比例为14% ， Claude Opus 5.5在这方面的比例为7.4%。
A third of the true edges the two agents restore on the two hardest families appear in no algorithm's output. 两个智能体在两个最难的族上恢复的真实边缘的三分之一出现在没有算法的输出中。
The code and data will be publicly released to facilitate future work. 代码和数据将公开发布，以方便未来的工作。

featuredPapers.title: Tree-Aware Posterior Distillation for Long-Horizon Agentic Reinforcement Learning
featuredPapers.authors: Heming Zou, Qi Wang, Yixiu Mao
featuredPapers.summary:
Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has become a scalable post-training paradigm for large language models. 具有可验证奖励的强化学习已成为大型语言模型的可扩展训练后范例。
However, training agents over long-horizon interactions presents two challenges: using only terminal rewards makes turn-level credit assignment sparse and high-variance, while sequential mini-batch updates on a fixed rollout batch introduce policy staleness as the current policy drifts from the behavior policy. 然而，通过长距离交互培训代理存在两个挑战：仅使用终端奖励会使回合级信用分配稀疏且高方差，而固定推出批次的连续小批量更新会随着当前策略偏离行为策略而导致策略失效。
Existing approaches obtain denser credit via learned critics, process reward models, or on-policy distillation, but they rely on a value network, step-level annotations, or a stronger external teacher that increase training complexity. 现有的方法通过学习批评、流程奖励模型或策略提炼获得更密集的信誉，但它们依赖于价值网络、阶梯级注释或更强大的外部教师，从而增加了培训复杂性。
Meanwhile, importance sampling and clipping mitigate policy drift, but they do not specify a finite target that stops sequential updates from overshooting. 与此同时，重要性采样和裁剪可以缓解策略漂移，但它们没有指定阻止连续更新超调的有限目标。
In this work, we introduce TreeOPSD, a critic-free, tree-aware posterior self-distillation framework for long-horizon agentic reinforcement learning. 在这项工作中，我们引入了TreeOPSD ，这是一种无批评、树感知的后验自馏框架，用于长视野代理强化学习。
Treating each interaction turn as a tree node, TreeOPSD branches alternative continuations from shared prefixes and recursively backs up terminal rewards into implicit turn-level credit. 将每个交互转换视为树节点， TreeOPSD从共享前缀分支替代延续，并递归地将终端奖励备份为隐式转换级信用。
It then maps each credit to a closed-form, bounded teacher distribution parameterized by the likelihood ratio relative to the frozen behavior policy. 然后，它将每个学分映射到一个封闭形式的、有界的教师分布，该分布由相对于冻结行为策略的似然比参数化。
Minimizing the divergence between this teacher and the student policy recovers the policy-gradient direction as the tangent at the behavior policy while bounding updates toward a finite target across sequential mini-batches. 最小化该教师和学生策略之间的差异可以恢复策略梯度方向，作为行为策略的切线，同时跨越连续的小批次将更新限制在有限目标上。
Empirically, TreeOPSD improves agentic capabilities across several competitive benchmarks and model scales, especially for long-horizon tasks, e.g., raising the average accuracy of Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 by 4.97 points over GRPO on the Deep Research setting. 根据经验， TreeOPSD在多个竞争基准和模型尺度上提高了代理能力，特别是对于长期任务，例如，在Deep Research设置上， Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507的平均准确度比GRPO提高4.97分。
highlights: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has become a scalable post-training paradigm for large language models.

featuredPapers.title: Group-Graph Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon Agentic Reinforcement Learning
featuredPapers.authors: Yunan Wang, Minghui Song, Zihan Zhang
featuredPapers.summary:
Group-based Reinforcement Learning (RL) has significantly enhanced Large Language Models (LLMs) in agentic scenarios. 基于群体的强化学习（ RL ）在代理场景中显著增强了大型语言模型（ LLM ）。
To achieve finer-grained policy updates, recent agentic RL frameworks have shifted from trajectory-level to step-level training. 为了实现更细粒度的策略更新，最近的代理RL框架已从轨迹级转变为步骤级培训。
However, long-horizon agentic RL suffers from severe reward sparsity and delay, as feedback is often deferred for dozens of interaction steps. 然而，长时间代理RL遭受严重的奖励稀疏和延迟，因为反馈通常延迟数十个交互步骤。
While existing step-level frameworks refine training granularity, their credit assignment remains coarse-grained and still treats agent exploration as isolated, linear trajectories. 虽然现有的步骤级框架完善了培训粒度，但其学分分配仍然是粗粒度的，并且仍然将座席探索视为孤立的线性轨迹。
This oversimplified perspective ignores the inherent graph structure of state transitions, leading to high-variance state-value estimation and myopic, localized credit assignment. 这种过度简化的观点忽略了状态转换的固有图结构，导致高方差状态值估计和短视的局部信用分配。
To overcome these critical bottlenecks, we propose Group-Graph Policy Optimization (G2PO), a novel group-based RL algorithm tailored for multi-turn agentic tasks. 为了克服这些关键瓶颈，我们提出了组图策略优化（ G2PO ） ，这是一种针对多圈代理任务量身定制的新型基于组的RL算法。
G2PO explicitly transforms linear interaction trajectories into a global state-transition graph. G2PO明确地将线性交互轨迹转换为全局状态转换图。
By aggregating identical observations across different trajectories, we introduce group-aggregation state-value estimation that reduces sampling variance and trajectory-dependent bias. 通过聚合不同轨迹上的相同观测值，我们引入了组聚合状态值估计，从而减少了采样方差和轨迹相关偏差。
Furthermore, we redefine agent actions as transitions between state nodes and propose an edge-centric advantage estimation strategy. 此外，我们将代理行为重新定义为状态节点之间的转换，并提出了一种以边缘为中心的优势估计策略。
By globally standardizing Temporal Difference (TD) errors across the entire graph, G2PO explicitly identifies and prioritizes critical transitions that drive absolute task progress. 通过在整个图表中全局标准化时间差异（ TD ）错误， G2PO明确识别并优先考虑推动绝对任务进度的关键转换。
Extensive experiments on representative long-horizon benchmarks-WebShop, ALFWorld, and AppWorld-demonstrate that G2PO substantially outperforms state-of-the-art prompt-based and RL baselines, achieving remarkable success rate improvements of up to 22.2% over GRPO. 对具有代表性的长期基准WebShop、ALFWorld和AppWorld进行的大量实验表明， G2PO大大优于最先进的基于提示和RL的基线，实现了比GRPO高达22.2%的显着成功率提升。
highlights: outperforms state-of-the-art prompt-based and RL baselines

featuredPapers.title: Towards Agentic Cloud Engineering: Graph and Loop Engineering with a Zero-Trust Agent Harness
featuredPapers.authors: Sagar Srinivas Sakhinana, Venkataramana Runkana
featuredPapers.summary:
Agentic AI is enabling cloud-based workflows in which autonomous agents reason over operational state, invoke authorized tools, modify software and infrastructure, deploy services, verify execution outcomes, and adapt across long-horizon, multistep tasks. Agentic AI正在支持基于云的工作流，其中自治代理可以推理操作状态、调用授权工具、修改软件和基础设施、部署服务、验证执行结果以及跨越长时间、多步骤任务进行调整。
Engineering such workflows requires explicit mechanisms for workflow progression, constrained execution, failure recovery, and verifiable completion. 设计此类工作流程需要工作流程进度、受限执行、故障恢复和可验证完成的明确机制。
We present Agentic Cloud Workflow Engineering, an agentic AI framework that transforms natural-language agentic cloud-engineering tasks into validated code repositories and verified operational cloud deployments for automating cloud-based agentic workflows. 我们介绍Agentic Cloud Workflow Engineering ，这是一个代理AI框架，可将自然语言代理云工程任务转换为经过验证的代码存储库和经验证的操作云部署，以实现基于云的代理工作流的自动化。
The framework separates three complementary concerns: graph engineering specifies long-horizon workflow progression and verification-dependent transitions; loop engineering provides bounded diagnosis, repair or re-planning, retry, and re-verification; and agent harness engineering enforces zero-trust execution through identity, authorization, policy-scoped capabilities, isolation, and runtime safeguards. 该框架将三个互补的问题分开：图形工程指定了长时间的工作流进展和依赖验证的转换；循环工程提供有限的诊断、修复或重新规划、重试和重新验证；代理线束工程通过身份、授权、策略范围功能、隔离和运行时保护来强制执行零信任。

featuredPapers.title: Lean4AgenticRL: Advancing Agentic RL with Verifiable Multi-level Process Rewards
featuredPapers.authors: Ruida Wang, Gerald Friedland, Tong Zhang
featuredPapers.summary:
Enhancing the agentic capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) to tackle complex software engineering (SWE) and general terminal-usage problems is a pressing challenge.
Current state-of-the-art LLMs often go through large-scale agentic Reinforcement Learning (RL).
However, they mostly rely on high-level outcome rewards, with minimal consideration of low-level toolcall and mid-level workflow-stage rewards, which makes the training less effective.
To overcome this limitation, we propose **Lean4AgenticRL**, which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first framework that grounds multi-level process rewards in the unified Lean4 formalization schema for open-ended agentic RL.
**Lean4AgenticRL** first builds a *problem-specific workflow* system that balances the agent's own capability and controllability during execution, laying the foundation for further verification.
Subsequently, our workflow formalization and multi-level reward annotation methods enable agent behavior verification within a general harness system.
It provides multi-level rewards to support more effective agentic RL with the workflow-stage-normalized GRPO algorithm.
Using **Lean4AgenticRL**, we train **LAR-9B/27B**, a family of models with enhanced agentic capability.
Extensive experiments indicate that our model outperforms the leading model of similar size.
**LAR-27B** achieves **77.3%** on TerminalBench-2.1.
On average, our models outperform the base model by **9.89%** and surpass the second-best model of comparable size we know by **5.07%**.
These results indicate the potential of integrating formal methods in enhancing open-ended agentic RL.

featuredPapers.title: AOI: Turning Failed Trajectories into Training Signals for Autonomous Cloud Diagnosis
featuredPapers.authors: Pei Yang, Wanyi Chen, Asuka Yuxi Zheng
featuredPapers.summary:
Large language model (LLM) agents offer a promising data-driven approach to automating Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), yet their enterprise deployment is constrained by three challenges: restricted access to proprietary data, unsafe action execution under permission-governed environments, and the inability of closed systems to improve from failures.
We present AOI (Autonomous Operations Intelligence), a trainable multi-agent framework formulating automated operations as a structured trajectory learning problem under security constraints.
Our approach integrates three key components.
First, a trainable diagnostic system applies Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to distill expert-level knowledge into locally deployed open-source models, enabling preference-based learning without exposing sensitive data.
Second, a read-write separated execution architecture decomposes operational trajectories into observation, reasoning, and action phases, allowing safe learning while preventing unauthorized state mutation.
Third, a Failure Trajectory Closed-Loop Evolver mines unsuccessful trajectories and converts them into corrective supervision signals, enabling continual data augmentation.
Evaluated on the AIOpsLab benchmark, our contributions yield cumulative gains.
(1) The AOI runtime alone achieves 66.3% best@5 success on all 86 tasks, outperforming the prior state-of-the-art (41.9%) by 24.4 points.
(2) Adding Observer GRPO training, a locally deployed 14B model reaches 42.9% avg@1 on 63 held-out tasks with unseen fault types, surpassing Claude Sonnet 4.5.
(3) The Evolver converts 37 failed trajectories into diagnostic guidance, improving end-to-end avg@5 by 4.8 points while reducing variance by 35%.

featuredPapers.title: Think More or Read More? A Token-Budget Theory of Reasoning with Shared Context
featuredPapers.authors: Manh Nguyen, Sunil Gupta, Hung Le
featuredPapers.summary:
Reasoning systems increasingly improve answers by incorporating additional context into the model's input, from multi-agent debate, where agents read their peers' responses, to self-refinement, where a model revisits its own drafts.
In these systems, communication consumes context as one agent's output becomes another's input.
We study the regime where token reading and generation draw on one fixed token window, so every token spent reading is a token that cannot be spent reasoning.
We develop a \textbf{token-budget theory} that formalizes this trade-off, modeling accuracy as a function of the reasoning budget remaining after reading and aggregating votes with a Condorcet jury model that permits correlated errors.
For multi-agent debate, the theory gives a closed-form prediction for the optimal number of agents.
This quantity is estimated from single-agent measurements, allowing the optimal group size to be determined without running debate, and the same accounting extends to a heterogeneous set of different models.
We empirically verify our theory and show that, at the predicted group size, our method outperforms strong baselines under the tightest calibration spend, where debate-calibrated rules can afford only one or two questions.
Self-refinement obeys the same accounting, with its own draft in place of a peer message.
The theory further predicts that communication pays only when the gain in the accuracy ceiling exceeds the reasoning room spent on reading, with this condition tightening as the window shrinks.
Across five open models and four reasoning tasks, self-consistency matches or beats deployed debate at $93$\% of $980$ matched window-and-group-size settings, with the gap being largest under tight windows and nearly disappearing at a loose one, consistent with the theory.
Under a shared window, how much room a model has left to \textit{think matters more than what it reads}.

featuredPapers.title: GRAFT-ATHENA: Self-Improving Agentic Teams for Autonomous Discovery and Evolutionary Numerical Algorithms
featuredPapers.authors: Juan Diego Toscano, Zhaojie Chai, George Em Karniadakis
featuredPapers.summary:
Language-model agents plan, execute, and evaluate scientific workflows.
However, the problem--method relationships guiding their choices remain implicit, so plausible outputs can violate the assumptions of the scientific problem.
We introduce Graph Reduction to Adaptive Factored Trees (GRAFT), which makes this problem-to-method map explicit as an expandable probabilistic structure of admissible problems, methods, and dependencies.
Because this structure follows scientific semantics, knowledge from documentation, papers, and domain experts can be encoded, while factorization keeps the structure tractable.
Semantic fingerprints of encoded problems measure their similarity, so expertise and experience guide related problems.

The representation retains evaluated outcomes and incorporates new methods, allowing scientific knowledge and experience to accumulate.

featuredPapers.title: Don't Retrain, Remix: Adaptation of Web Agents using Mixture Hypernetworks
featuredPapers.authors: Md Farhan Ishmam, Minh Pham Dinh, Kenneth Marino
featuredPapers.summary:
The web is not static or uniform.
Websites that serve the same purpose can look and navigate very differently.
Even within a single site, successive redesigns can change how familiar features are presented and accessed.
Humans adapt to this by recognizing familiar interaction patterns and reusing what they already know.
We give web agents a similar ability with WebMix, a mixture hypernetwork that adapts them to unseen interfaces by composing previously trained low-rank adapters.
WebMix begins with a bank of adapters trained on source interfaces.
At deployment, a scout agent explores the target interface and summarizes its observations into a compact manual.
A lightweight router uses this manual to predict mixing coefficients over the adapter bank, which combine the existing adapters into a new one for inference.
Adapting to a new interface takes only a scouting run and a forward pass, without gradient updates on the target.
With Qwen and Llama models, we evaluate domain transfer on TimeWarp and WebArena-Lite-v2, and version transfer on TimeWarp.
In all three settings, WebMix matches or outperforms in-context learning and LoRA baselines, often matching the average success of specialists trained directly on those interfaces.
On TimeWarp domain transfer, it gains about 8 percentage points on average over the best baseline with both models.
These gains do not come at the cost of seen interfaces, where WebMix keeps its lead, and extend to version transfer.
Adapting to a new interface can therefore rely on exploration and composition instead of retraining.

featuredPapers.authors: Qirui Liu, Hao Chen, Yi Wen

To address this, we propose Grounded Credit Assignment (GCA), which uses verifiable sub-outcomes (evidence retrieval and answer correctness) to correct search and answer credit separately: a wrong answer is blamed more than the search that found the evidence, and a correct answer that bypasses retrievable evidence is credited less.
Never negative on evidence-finding search, the correction does not shrink with the grounding gap; capped at 10% of each token's advantage, it never overrides the outcome signal.

featuredPapers.title: Audit-First VAPO: Risk-Certified Selective Updates under Imperfect Verification
featuredPapers.authors: Miaobo Hu, Shuhao Hu, Xiaobo Guo
featuredPapers.summary:
Imperfect verifiers can assign a harmful update direction even when clipping and regularization bound its magnitude.
We introduce Audit-First VAPO, which separates discrete directional admission from continuous magnitude control.
An observation-only accept-appeal-abstain policy uses a finite secondary-verification budget; its action trace is frozen before clean labels are joined.
Simultaneous finite-sample bounds then certify selected harmful risk, coverage, and verifier-call rate over a predeclared policy family.
Conditional Hoeffding-Azuma bounds account for the dependence induced by shared budgets, and rollout or verifier changes initiate a new certification stage.
After admission, a bounded trust-clip-KL actuator controls magnitude.
We evaluate two models on two reasoning benchmarks against static RLVR, matched-random selection, confidence thresholding, noise correction, and verifier augmentation.
On Qwen3.5-0.8B and GSM8K at target risk $\rho=0.08$, RC-VAPO achieves 74.1% accuracy, selected harmful risk 0.0697, coverage 0.4125, and relative verifier cost $1.16\times$.
At matched coverage and update magnitude, its selected-risk difference from matched random is -0.0260 with paired 95% interval $[-0.0364,-0.0157]$.
Across asymmetric, confidence-dependent, and correlated-verifier noise, the certificate is satisfied on 57 of 60 independent runs.
These comparisons isolate informative directional selection from proposal suppression, update shrinkage, and additional verifier computation.

featuredPapers.title: InstAgent: A Recursively Self-Improving Agent Operating System for Heterogeneous Robot Collaboration
featuredPapers.authors: Haoyang Luo, Junhao Qin, Jingyan Cao
featuredPapers.summary:
Heterogeneous robot teams enable complex, long-horizon tasks by combining complementary sensing, mobility, and manipulation capabilities across multiple embodiments.
Yet existing systems struggle to retain execution-time corrections as reusable experience, maintain task-relevant context memory across space and time for reliable handoffs, and explicitly represent the inter-robot dependencies required for structured collaboration.
In order to address these challenges, we present InstAgent, a recursively self-improving (RSI) Agent Operating System for heterogeneous robot collaboration.
InstAgent organizes team behaviors as agentic behavior trees (BTs) that explicitly model capability assignment, inter-robot dependencies and handoff checks.
The RSI mechanism updates these collaboration programs from execution feedback and preserves successful revisions for reuse in future tasks, while shared multimodal spatio-temporal memory provides context for planning and handoff validation.
Experiments on 20 real-world multi-robot tasks with three high-level models show consistent gains in task success, first-attempt completion, and execution efficiency.

featuredPapers.title: UniField++: A Unified Agentic Framework with Loop Reasoning for MRI Field-Strength Enhancement
featuredPapers.authors: Yiyang Lin, Chenhui Wang, Tianliang Yao
featuredPapers.summary:
MRI field-strength enhancement seeks to combine the accessibility of low-field scanners with the image quality of high-field scanners.
Yet, existing methods remain prone to anatomical hallucinations, as uniform processing leaves difficult brain regions insufficiently examined and scarce paired data limit their learning of how tissue contrast and anatomical visibility change across field strengths.
To address these challenges, we propose UniField++, a two-agent framework that unifies enhancement tasks across multiple field-strength transitions, including 64mT-to-3T and 3T-to-7T.
Unified learning allows both the VLM-based planner and the flow-matching-based enhancer to draw on field-dependent image characteristics observed across tasks, rather than relying on a single transition.
Trained with radiologists' annotations of hallucination-prone regions and corresponding correction plans, the planner predicts regional risk and formulates targeted restoration strategies.
Guided by these plans, the enhancer performs loop reasoning along the flow-matching trajectory, repeatedly processing high-risk regions for additional refinement.
Together, cross-transition learning and risk-guided refinement support anatomically faithful enhancement across field strengths.
Across the evaluated tasks, UniField++ improves PSNR by an average of 2.74 dB and SSIM by 14.05 percentage points over comparison methods, with corresponding gains of 3.97 dB and 13.92 percentage points over the ablation baseline.
It also maintains enhancement quality on an external cohort with an unseen field strength and improves downstream whole-brain segmentation Macro Dice by an average of 0.1457 over the original low-field images.
Code is available at https://github.com/CUHK-AIM-Group/UniField_plusplus.

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: Can LLMs predict the outcomes of machine learning experiments?
papers.summary:
Recent advances in AI make Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) increasingly plausible. 人工智能的最新进展使递归自我改进（ RSI ）变得越来越合理。
Large Language Models (LLMs) can already propose, select, and run Machine Learning (ML) experiments. 大型语言模型（ LLM ）已经可以提出、选择和运行机器学习（ ML ）实验。
However, the space of possible design choices in ML is vast. 然而，机器学习中可能的设计选择空间是巨大的。
An LLM that proposes an experiment needs a reliable intuition of whether it is worth running given the timing constraints of long training runs. 提出实验的LLM需要一个可靠的直觉，即考虑到长时间训练运行的时间限制，它是否值得运行。
In this work, we measure such intuition in current frontier LLMs by evaluating how accurately they predict the impact of self-generated ML experiment ideas before these are put into training runs. 在这项工作中，我们通过评估当前前沿LLM在投入训练运行之前预测自生ML实验想法影响的准确程度来衡量这种直觉。
To this end, we construct a dataset of 288 LLM-proposed ideas on eight MLE-bench tasks. 为此，我们构建了一个包含288个LLM提出的关于八个MLE-bench任务的想法的数据集。
We then prompt five frontier LLMs (GPT-6 Astra, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Fable 5.1, Kimi K3, and GLM-5.3) to predict the impact of each idea and compare their predictions with the actual outcomes after training. 然后，我们提示五位前沿LLM （ GPT-6 Astra、Claude Opus 5.5、Claude Fable 5.1、Kimi K3和GLM-5.3 ）预测每个想法的影响，并将他们的预测与培训后的实际结果进行比较。
We report four main findings. 我们报告了四个主要发现。
First, LLM predictions are substantially better than random chance but far from accurate: even the best model, Claude Opus 5.5, explains only half of the variance in outcomes (R^2 = 0.49). 首先， LLM预测大大优于随机机会，但远非准确：即使是最好的模型， Claude Opus 5.5 ，也只能解释结果方差的一半（ R ^ 2 = 0.49 ）。
Second, we notice that all tested models systematically underestimate the magnitude of the changes. 其次，我们注意到所有测试模型都系统地低估了变化的幅度。
Third, prediction quality varies widely across tasks. 第三，不同任务的预测质量差异很大。
Finally, the choice of the coding harness that actually implements the ideas has little effect on outcomes, and we find no evidence of self-preference. 最后，实际实现这些想法的编码线束的选择对结果几乎没有影响，我们没有发现自我偏好的证据。
Higher reasoning settings and additional context lead to modest gains. 更高的推理设置和额外的背景会导致适度的收益。
Overall, our results show that current LLMs have useful but limited intuition about which ML ideas will work. 总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，当前的LLM对哪些ML创意有效有着有用但有限的直觉。
We release our dataset to support further study. 我们发布数据集以支持进一步的研究。
highlights: Recent advances in AI make Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) increasingly plausible.
Large Language Models (LLMs) can already propose, select, and run Machine Learning (ML) experiments.

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: AlphaBet: Reinforcement Learning for LLM Event Forecasting Agents
papers.summary:
Forecasting an unresolved event requires finding relevant evidence and deciding how strongly it supports each outcome. 预测未解决的事件需要找到相关证据，并决定其对每个结果的支持程度。
Yet outcome-based training of Large Language Model (LLM) forecasters often begins with preassembled evidence at a single prediction date, leaving evidence acquisition outside the learning loop. 然而，大型语言模型（ LLM ）预测人员的基于结果的培训通常始于单个预测日期的预组装证据，而将证据获取置于学习循环之外。
We introduce AlphaBet, an agentic reinforcement learning (RL) framework that trains a single LLM policy to search, reason, and report probabilities across multiple pre-resolution dates. 我们引入了AlphaBet ，这是一个代理强化学习(RL)框架，用于训练单个LLM策略，以便在多个预解析日期中搜索、推理和报告概率。
Each dated forecast is scored by a proper scoring rule against the eventual outcome, allowing one resolved event to supervise decisions under different information states. 每个过时的预测都根据适当的评分规则对最终结果进行评分，从而允许一个已解决的事件监督不同信息状态下的决策。
We decompose forecasting regret into an evidence-acquisition gap and a probability-reporting gap, and show that Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)'s standard-deviation normalization can distort the reporting target under multi-class proper scores. 我们将预测遗憾分解为证据获取缺口和概率报告缺口，并表明组相对策略优化（ GRPO ）的标准偏差归一化可以在多类正确分数下扭曲报告目标。
On GLM-4.5-Air, AlphaBet reduces the Brier score from 0.731 to 0.626 on Forecast-Dojo and from 0.612 to 0.528 on FutureX. 在GLM-4.5-Air上， AlphaBet将Forecast-Dojo上的Brier评分从0.731降至0.626 ，在FutureX上从0.612降至0.528。
Controlled ablations attribute these gains to multi-date training and show that they come from improvements in both information acquisition and probability reporting. 受控消融将这些收益归因于多日期培训，并表明它们来自信息获取和概率报告的改进。
Our empirical results validate that GRPO's std normalization degrades proper-scoring-rule performance while leaving top-outcome accuracy largely unchanged. 我们的实证结果验证了GRPO的STD归一化会降低正确的评分规则性能，同时保持最高结果的准确性基本不变。
highlights: Forecasting an unresolved event requires finding relevant evidence and deciding how strongly it supports each outcome.

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: Benchmarking and Enhancing Agentic Causal Discovery
papers.summary:
LLM agents can now run causal discovery algorithms on a dataset and report what comes out. LLM代理现在可以在数据集上运行因果发现算法并报告结果。
Whether they do more than that, such as noticing where an algorithm went wrong and fixing it with further tests, is hard to tell from current benchmarks. 他们是否做得更多，例如注意到算法出错的地方并通过进一步的测试来修复它，很难从当前的基准中分辨出来。
Most of them give the variables meaningful names, and an LLM shown only the names of the T\"ubingen cause-effect pairs already gets 99% of the directions right. 他们中的大多数给了变量有意义的名称，并且仅显示T\ "ubingen因果对的名称的LLM已经获得了99 ％的方向正确。
With the names removed, the data are usually clean enough that picking a better algorithm than PC closes most of the gap. 删除名称后，数据通常足够干净，以至于选择比PC更好的算法可以缩小大部分差距。
We introduce Heuresis, a benchmark of anonymous simulated datasets whose mechanisms range from linear Gaussian to heavy-tailed. 我们引入Heuresis ，这是匿名模拟数据集的基准，其机制范围从线性高斯到重尾。
For each family of datasets it separates what a better existing algorithm can gain from what only a closer look at the data can gain, and it traces every edge an agent changes. 对于每个数据集系列，它将更好的现有算法从只有仔细查看数据才能获得的收益分开，并跟踪代理更改的每个边缘。
Every family leaves a gap that none of the algorithms, the router and the two causal-discovery foundation models we ran can close, so a score above the best chosen algorithm has to come from using the data. 每个家庭都留下了一个我们运行的算法、路由器和两个因果发现基础模型都无法填补的空白，因此使用数据必须获得高于最佳选择的算法的分数。
We instantiate the benchmark with an agent harness and three LLMs, GPT-6.1 Sol, Claude Opus 5.5 and Qwen 3.8 Flash. 我们使用代理线束和三个LLM （ GPT-6.1 SOL、Claude Opus 5.5和Qwen 3.8 Flash ）实例化基准。
GPT-6.1 Sol surpasses the best chosen algorithm on all six families, by 14% adjacency F1 on the most difficult one, and Claude Opus 5.5 does so by 7.4% there. GPT-6.1 SOL在所有六个系列中都超过了最佳选择算法，在最困难的系列中相邻F1的比例为14% ， Claude Opus 5.5在这方面的比例为7.4%。
A third of the true edges the two agents restore on the two hardest families appear in no algorithm's output. 两个智能体在两个最难的族上恢复的真实边缘的三分之一出现在没有算法的输出中。
The code and data will be publicly released to facilitate future work. 代码和数据将公开发布，以方便未来的工作。
highlights: surpasses the best chosen algorithm on all six families
LLM agents can now run causal discovery algorithms on a dataset and report what comes out.

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: Tree-Aware Posterior Distillation for Long-Horizon Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary:
Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has become a scalable post-training paradigm for large language models. 具有可验证奖励的强化学习已成为大型语言模型的可扩展训练后范例。
However, training agents over long-horizon interactions presents two challenges: using only terminal rewards makes turn-level credit assignment sparse and high-variance, while sequential mini-batch updates on a fixed rollout batch introduce policy staleness as the current policy drifts from the behavior policy. 然而，通过长距离交互培训代理存在两个挑战：仅使用终端奖励会使回合级信用分配稀疏且高方差，而固定推出批次的连续小批量更新会随着当前策略偏离行为策略而导致策略失效。
Existing approaches obtain denser credit via learned critics, process reward models, or on-policy distillation, but they rely on a value network, step-level annotations, or a stronger external teacher that increase training complexity. 现有的方法通过学习批评、流程奖励模型或策略提炼获得更密集的信誉，但它们依赖于价值网络、阶梯级注释或更强大的外部教师，从而增加了培训复杂性。
Meanwhile, importance sampling and clipping mitigate policy drift, but they do not specify a finite target that stops sequential updates from overshooting. 与此同时，重要性采样和裁剪可以缓解策略漂移，但它们没有指定阻止连续更新超调的有限目标。
In this work, we introduce TreeOPSD, a critic-free, tree-aware posterior self-distillation framework for long-horizon agentic reinforcement learning. 在这项工作中，我们引入了TreeOPSD ，这是一种无批评、树感知的后验自馏框架，用于长视野代理强化学习。
Treating each interaction turn as a tree node, TreeOPSD branches alternative continuations from shared prefixes and recursively backs up terminal rewards into implicit turn-level credit. 将每个交互转换视为树节点， TreeOPSD从共享前缀分支替代延续，并递归地将终端奖励备份为隐式转换级信用。
It then maps each credit to a closed-form, bounded teacher distribution parameterized by the likelihood ratio relative to the frozen behavior policy. 然后，它将每个学分映射到一个封闭形式的、有界的教师分布，该分布由相对于冻结行为策略的似然比参数化。
Minimizing the divergence between this teacher and the student policy recovers the policy-gradient direction as the tangent at the behavior policy while bounding updates toward a finite target across sequential mini-batches. 最小化该教师和学生策略之间的差异可以恢复策略梯度方向，作为行为策略的切线，同时跨越连续的小批次将更新限制在有限目标上。
Empirically, TreeOPSD improves agentic capabilities across several competitive benchmarks and model scales, especially for long-horizon tasks, e.g., raising the average accuracy of Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 by 4.97 points over GRPO on the Deep Research setting. 根据经验， TreeOPSD在多个竞争基准和模型尺度上提高了代理能力，特别是对于长期任务，例如，在Deep Research设置上， Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507的平均准确度比GRPO提高4.97分。
highlights: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has become a scalable post-training paradigm for large language models.

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: Towards Agentic Cloud Engineering: Graph and Loop Engineering with a Zero-Trust Agent Harness
papers.summary:
Agentic AI is enabling cloud-based workflows in which autonomous agents reason over operational state, invoke authorized tools, modify software and infrastructure, deploy services, verify execution outcomes, and adapt across long-horizon, multistep tasks. Agentic AI正在支持基于云的工作流，其中自治代理可以推理操作状态、调用授权工具、修改软件和基础设施、部署服务、验证执行结果以及跨越长时间、多步骤任务进行调整。
Engineering such workflows requires explicit mechanisms for workflow progression, constrained execution, failure recovery, and verifiable completion. 设计此类工作流程需要工作流程进度、受限执行、故障恢复和可验证完成的明确机制。
We present Agentic Cloud Workflow Engineering, an agentic AI framework that transforms natural-language agentic cloud-engineering tasks into validated code repositories and verified operational cloud deployments for automating cloud-based agentic workflows. 我们介绍Agentic Cloud Workflow Engineering ，这是一个代理AI框架，可将自然语言代理云工程任务转换为经过验证的代码存储库和经验证的操作云部署，以实现基于云的代理工作流的自动化。
The framework separates three complementary concerns: graph engineering specifies long-horizon workflow progression and verification-dependent transitions; loop engineering provides bounded diagnosis, repair or re-planning, retry, and re-verification; and agent harness engineering enforces zero-trust execution through identity, authorization, policy-scoped capabilities, isolation, and runtime safeguards. 该框架将三个互补的问题分开：图形工程指定了长时间的工作流进展和依赖验证的转换；循环工程提供有限的诊断、修复或重新规划、重试和重新验证；代理线束工程通过身份、授权、策略范围功能、隔离和运行时保护来强制执行零信任。
Workflow progression and completion require machine-checkable repository, deployment, and runtime evidence, with recovery constrained by explicit operational bounds and termination criteria. 工作流的进展和完成需要机器可检查的存储库、部署和运行时证据，恢复受明确的操作界限和终止标准的限制。
We instantiate the framework on Google Cloud and evaluate repository completeness, controlled execution, evidence-gated progression, operational deployment, and bounded recovery. 我们在Google Cloud上实例化该框架，并评估存储库的完整性、受控执行、证据门限进度、运营部署和有限恢复。
Experimental results show that executions terminate with either a verified operational cloud deployment or an auditable terminal failure under bounded recovery. 实验结果表明，在有限恢复下，执行终止于经过验证的运营云部署或可审计的终端故障。
The framework provides a unified engineering architecture for cloud-based workflows spanning Agentic DevOps, Agentic CloudOps, Agentic SRE/AIOps, Agentic SecOps, Agentic DataOps, Agentic MLOps/LLMOps, AgentOps, Agentic RAG/GraphRAG, and related cloud-engineering domains. 该框架为跨Agentic DevOps、Agentic CloudOps、Agentic SRE/AIOps、Agentic SecOps、Agentic DataOps、Agentic MLOps/LLMOps、AgentOps、Agentic RAG/GraphRAG和相关云工程域的基于云的工作流提供了统一的工程架构。
highlights: Engineering such workflows requires explicit mechanisms for workflow progression, constrained execution, failure recover

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: FormInv: A Measurement Protocol for Semantic Invariance in Mathematical Reasoning Benchmarks
papers.summary:
A paraphrase-quality audit of MathCheck (ICLR 2025) detected 4 semantically incorrect paraphrases in 129 groups (3.1%); removing them drops GPT-4o from rank 2 to rank 4 and elevates Claude Haiku and DeepSeek V3 above it. 对MathCheck （ ICLR 2025 ）的释义质量审计在129个组（ 3.1 ％ ）中检测到4个语义不正确的释义；将其删除将GPT-4o从2级降至4级，并将Claude Haiku和DeepSeek V3提升至其之上。
Cross-model unanimity found these errors automatically for under $10; in our own dataset the same protocol found that 47% of auto-generated connective-variation paraphrases were semantically incorrect. 跨模型一致性自动发现这些错误低于$ 10 ；在我们自己的数据集中，相同的协议发现47%的自动生成的连接变体释义在语义上不正确。
That flaw compounds a deeper measurement gap. 这个缺陷加剧了更深的测量差距。
On the theorems every model answers correctly in canonical form, a semantically equivalent rewording still flips the answer for 5-42% of them: Claude Haiku 4.5 flips a known-correct answer about 9x as often as DeepSeek V3 (41.9% vs. 在定理上，每个模型都以规范形式正确回答，语义等效的重写仍然翻转了其中5-42%的答案： Claude Haiku 4.5翻转已知正确答案的频率是DeepSeek V3的9倍（ 41.9% vs.
4.7% on the 43 theorems all models share), a difficulty-controlled gap we call the Conditional Inconsistency Rate (CIR). 所有模型共享的43个定理的4.7% ） ，这是一个难度控制的差距，我们称之为条件不一致率（ CIR ）。
The CIR ranking replicates on an independent 103-theorem set. CIR排名在独立的103定理集上进行复制。
Raw Semantic Consistency Rates (SCR) span 50-82% across 9 models, but this spread is mostly a mechanical consequence of compounding accuracy over k ~ 6 paraphrases; what CIR isolates is the within-theorem clustering of failures. 原始语义一致性率（ SCR ）跨越9个模型的50-82 ％ ，但这种扩散主要是k ~ 6个释义的复合精度的机械结果； CIR隔离的是失败的定理内聚类。
Because no model dominates on all paraphrase families, the families a benchmark includes implicitly fix its model ranking (a No-Free-Benchmark corollary). 由于没有模型在所有释义家族中占主导地位，因此基准家族包括隐式固定其模型排名（ No-Free-Benchmark推论）。
FormInv supplies the audit protocol, CIR and SCR as invariance measures, evaluated on 9 models across 366-811 items whose canonical statements are Lean4-verified, and FormInvSelector for regime-aware model selection. FormInv提供审计协议、CIR和SCR作为不变性度量，在366-811个项目的9个模型上进行评估，其规范语句经过Lean4验证，以及FormInvSelector用于制度感知模型选择。
highlights: That flaw compounds a deeper measurement gap.

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: OxyGen: Unified KV Cache Management for VLA Inference under Multi-Task Parallelism
papers.summary:
Embodied AI agents increasingly require parallel execution of multiple tasks, such as manipulation, conversation, and memory construction, from shared observations under distinct time constraints. 具体化的人工智能代理越来越需要在不同的时间限制下从共享观察中并行执行多个任务，例如操作、会话和记忆构建。
Recent Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) Vision-Language-Action Models (VLAs) support such heterogeneous outputs, yet existing inference systems incur redundant computation and resource contention when serving concurrent tasks on-device. 最近的混合变换器（ MoT ）视觉-语言-动作模型（ VLA ）支持这种异构输出，但现有的推理系统在设备上服务并发任务时会产生冗余计算和资源争用。
We identify isolated KV cache management as the root cause. 我们将孤立的KV缓存管理确定为根本原因。
To address this, we propose unified KV cache management, an inference design that treats the KV cache as a first-class shared resource across tasks and control cycles. 为了解决这个问题，我们提出了统一的KV缓存管理，这是一种推理设计，将KV缓存视为跨任务和控制周期的一流共享资源。
This abstraction enables two key optimizations: cross-task KV sharing eliminates redundant prefill of shared observations, while cross-frame continuous batching batches unfinished language requests from different frames and advances them within a per-frame decoding budget. 这种抽象实现了两个关键优化：跨任务KV共享消除了共享观测值的冗余预填充，而跨帧连续批处理批处理来自不同帧的未完成语言请求，并在每帧解码预算范围内推进它们。
We implement this design in OxyGen and evaluate $\pi_{0.5}$ on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 and Jetson AGX Thor. 我们在OxyGen中实施此设计，并在NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090和Jetson AGX Thor上评估$\ pi_{0.5} $。
OxyGen achieves up to 3.7$\times$ speedup over isolated execution, delivering over 200 tokens/s language throughput and 70 Hz action frequency simultaneously on RTX 4090. OxyGen在独立执行上实现了高达3.7 $\ times $的加速，在腾讯通4090上同时提供超过200个令牌/秒的语言吞吐量和70 Hz的操作频率。
We also validate the design on Xiaomi-Robotics-0 and StarVLA across different backbones and expert configurations. 我们还在小米机器人-0和StarVLA上验证了不同骨干和专家配置的设计。
We further demonstrate the inference gains on a humanoid robot with on-board Jetson AGX Thor. 我们进一步演示了搭载Jetson AGX Thor的人形机器人的推理增益。
highlights: We identify isolated KV cache management as the root cause.

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: EgoP$^{2}$C: Internalizing Plan-Perceive-Compose for Spatial Reasoning in Egocentric Video
papers.summary:
Answering complex spatial reasoning questions from egocentric video requires determining what evidence is needed, acquiring targeted observations, and combining them through multiple reasoning steps. 从以自我为中心的视频中回答复杂的空间推理问题需要确定需要哪些证据，获得有针对性的观察，并通过多个推理步骤将它们结合起来。
Existing vision-language models (VLMs) struggle to perform this process reliably. 现有的视觉语言模型（ VLM ）难以可靠地执行此过程。
Agentic systems address this challenge by querying external vision and geometry tools, but training their reasoning leaves these tools unchanged, so inaccurate observations can still lead to incorrect answers. Agentic系统通过查询外部视觉和几何工具来应对这一挑战，但训练他们的推理不会改变这些工具，因此不准确的观察结果仍可能导致错误的答案。
We introduce EgoP$^{2}$C, a framework that internalizes a plan-perceive-compose process within a single VLM. 我们引入了EgoP $ ^ {2} $ C ，这是一个在单个VLM中内化计划-感知-组合流程的框架。
To this end, we first train specialized Planner and Perception teachers using separate adapters (Dual-LoRA), then fine-tune the corresponding experts in a mixture-of-experts (MoE) student under their supervision. 为此，我们首先使用单独的适配器（ Dual-LoRA ）培训专业规划师和感知教师，然后在其监督下对专家混合（ MoE ）学生的相应专家进行微调。
We subsequently train the student on trajectories generated by its current policy using a segment-level extension of multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD), assigning different trajectory segments to different supervisors. 随后，我们使用多教师策略蒸馏（ MOPD ）的段级扩展对学生进行当前策略生成的轨迹培训，将不同的轨迹段分配给不同的主管。
The Planner teacher supervises which evidence-seeking questions to ask, when to stop gathering evidence, and how to compose the final answer. 规划师教师负责监督要问哪些取证问题、何时停止收集证据以及如何撰写最终答案。
The Perception teacher supervises the video-grounded answers to those questions. 感知老师监督这些问题的视频接地答案。
At inference, the student executes this adaptive workflow end-to-end, without external spatial tools. 在推断时，学生在没有外部空间工具的情况下，端到端地执行这种自适应工作流程。
Across three spatial reasoning benchmarks, EgoP$^{2}$C students built from Qwen3-VL-8B and SenseNova-SI-1.3-8B outperform their base models by an average of 9.2 and 7.5 percentage points, respectively. 在三个空间推理基准中，由Qwen3-VL-8B和SenseNova-SI-1.3-8B构建的EgoP $ ^ {2} $ C学生的表现分别平均优于其基础模型9.2和7.5个百分点。
Across both backbones, EgoP$^{2}$C reduces inference FLOPs by 65.8-66.3% and achieves $1.29$-$1.49\times$ speedups over their shared Dual-LoRA teacher. 在两个骨干中， EgoP $ ^ {2} $ C比其共享的Dual-LoRA老师减少了65.8-66.3%的推理FLOP ，并实现了$ 1.29 $ - $ 1.49\倍的$加速。
highlights: outperform their base models by an average of 9
first train specialized Planner and Perception teachers using separate adapters (Dual-LoRA)
Existing vision-language models (VLMs) struggle to perform this process reliably.

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: AOI: Turning Failed Trajectories into Training Signals for Autonomous Cloud Diagnosis
papers.summary:
Large language model (LLM) agents offer a promising data-driven approach to automating Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), yet their enterprise deployment is constrained by three challenges: restricted access to proprietary data, unsafe action execution under permission-governed environments, and the inability of closed systems to improve from failures.
We present AOI (Autonomous Operations Intelligence), a trainable multi-agent framework formulating automated operations as a structured trajectory learning problem under security constraints.
Our approach integrates three key components.
First, a trainable diagnostic system applies Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to distill expert-level knowledge into locally deployed open-source models, enabling preference-based learning without exposing sensitive data.
Second, a read-write separated execution architecture decomposes operational trajectories into observation, reasoning, and action phases, allowing safe learning while preventing unauthorized state mutation.
Third, a Failure Trajectory Closed-Loop Evolver mines unsuccessful trajectories and converts them into corrective supervision signals, enabling continual data augmentation.
Evaluated on the AIOpsLab benchmark, our contributions yield cumulative gains.
(1) The AOI runtime alone achieves 66.3% best@5 success on all 86 tasks, outperforming the prior state-of-the-art (41.9%) by 24.4 points.
(2) Adding Observer GRPO training, a locally deployed 14B model reaches 42.9% avg@1 on 63 held-out tasks with unseen fault types, surpassing Claude Sonnet 4.5.
(3) The Evolver converts 37 failed trajectories into diagnostic guidance, improving end-to-end avg@5 by 4.8 points while reducing variance by 35%.

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: Don't Retrain, Remix: Adaptation of Web Agents using Mixture Hypernetworks
papers.summary:
The web is not static or uniform.
Websites that serve the same purpose can look and navigate very differently.
Even within a single site, successive redesigns can change how familiar features are presented and accessed.
Humans adapt to this by recognizing familiar interaction patterns and reusing what they already know.
We give web agents a similar ability with WebMix, a mixture hypernetwork that adapts them to unseen interfaces by composing previously trained low-rank adapters.
WebMix begins with a bank of adapters trained on source interfaces.
At deployment, a scout agent explores the target interface and summarizes its observations into a compact manual.
A lightweight router uses this manual to predict mixing coefficients over the adapter bank, which combine the existing adapters into a new one for inference.
Adapting to a new interface takes only a scouting run and a forward pass, without gradient updates on the target.
With Qwen and Llama models, we evaluate domain transfer on TimeWarp and WebArena-Lite-v2, and version transfer on TimeWarp.
In all three settings, WebMix matches or outperforms in-context learning and LoRA baselines, often matching the average success of specialists trained directly on those interfaces.
On TimeWarp domain transfer, it gains about 8 percentage points on average over the best baseline with both models.
These gains do not come at the cost of seen interfaces, where WebMix keeps its lead, and extend to version transfer.
Adapting to a new interface can therefore rely on exploration and composition instead of retraining.
highlights: outperforms in-context learning and LoRA baselines

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: Grounded Credit Assignment in Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Search Agents
papers.summary:
Outcome-reward reinforcement learning such as GRPO gives every token of a search-agent rollout the same advantage, although the rollout exercises two capabilities: finding evidence and using it.
We show that accuracy improves without grounding: Search-R1 raises accuracy on all seven QA benchmarks, yet on Bamboogle the evidence-supported share of correct answers falls from 84.0% to 42.9%.
We attribute this to GRPO's credit assignment: rollouts that retrieve answer-bearing evidence are favoured in aggregate only in proportion to their accuracy gain over the rest, a grounding gap that answering from memory or misusing evidence shrinks or reverses.
To address this, we propose Grounded Credit Assignment (GCA), which uses verifiable sub-outcomes (evidence retrieval and answer correctness) to correct search and answer credit separately: a wrong answer is blamed more than the search that found the evidence, and a correct answer that bypasses retrievable evidence is credited less.
Never negative on evidence-finding search, the correction does not shrink with the grounding gap; capped at 10% of each token's advantage, it never overrides the outcome signal.
Without extra models, rollouts, or training stages, GCA improves average EM over Search-R1 by 5.7 (Qwen2.5-3B) and 6.3 points (Qwen3-30B-A3B) and raises this share from 76.9% to 93.4%.
highlights: Grounded Credit Assignment in Reinforcement Learning for Multi

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: Tool Recommendation for Multi-Step Agents: Finding Every Tool a Task Needs
papers.summary:
A multi-step agent task fails when a single tool it needs is missing, yet the tools an agent may need are too many to list: the roughly 8,200 tools on the platform we study have definitions that together exceed the context window of any model we evaluate.
We present Tool Recommendation, a deployed system that gives an agent all of them, hundreds of times more than a typical MCP server exposes, through a fixed interface of three tools.
It runs at the gateway between agent and tools, executing every call under the end user's own credentials and checking it against the user's consent for each service and the tools the agent may use.
We evaluate it on both a public retrieval benchmark and billed end-to-end session cost.
On ToolRet, Tool Recommendation places every tool a query needs in the top ten 57% more often than BM25, a lexical ranking that commercial tool search offers, and compares favorably with published systems up to nine times its size.
In paired multi-step workflows, its first recommendation covered every required tool in 93% of Codex sessions, and against a fixed list of 100 tools it cut input tokens by 17% with Codex and 40% with Claude Code and the total bill in all 14 runs, by up to 40%, with no change in task completion.
highlights: exceed the context window of any model we evaluate
first recommendation covered every required tool in 93% of Codex sessions
We evaluate it on both a public retrieval benchmark and billed end-to-end session cost.

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: Audit-First VAPO: Risk-Certified Selective Updates under Imperfect Verification
papers.summary:
Imperfect verifiers can assign a harmful update direction even when clipping and regularization bound its magnitude.
We introduce Audit-First VAPO, which separates discrete directional admission from continuous magnitude control.
An observation-only accept-appeal-abstain policy uses a finite secondary-verification budget; its action trace is frozen before clean labels are joined.
Simultaneous finite-sample bounds then certify selected harmful risk, coverage, and verifier-call rate over a predeclared policy family.
Conditional Hoeffding-Azuma bounds account for the dependence induced by shared budgets, and rollout or verifier changes initiate a new certification stage.
After admission, a bounded trust-clip-KL actuator controls magnitude.
We evaluate two models on two reasoning benchmarks against static RLVR, matched-random selection, confidence thresholding, noise correction, and verifier augmentation.
On Qwen3.5-0.8B and GSM8K at target risk $\rho=0.08$, RC-VAPO achieves 74.1% accuracy, selected harmful risk 0.0697, coverage 0.4125, and relative verifier cost $1.16\times$.
At matched coverage and update magnitude, its selected-risk difference from matched random is -0.0260 with paired 95% interval $[-0.0364,-0.0157]$.
Across asymmetric, confidence-dependent, and correlated-verifier noise, the certificate is satisfied on 57 of 60 independent runs.
These comparisons isolate informative directional selection from proposal suppression, update shrinkage, and additional verifier computation.

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: When to Forget: Risk-Controlled Context Adaptation for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.summary:
Long-horizon agents learn from failure, but the value of a failure record can change as execution progresses.
We study when retaining, compressing, or removing the same history block improves subsequent execution relative to full-history KEEP.
We introduce RECAP, a framework that combines matched context interventions, execution-relational prediction, and independent policy certification.
Matched environment states and rollout seeds measure success and continuation prompt-cost differences; prefix-only relations between a failure block and the current execution propose promising edits.
Independent task bundles then select a policy subject to harmful-intervention and non-positive-benefit risk constraints under a fixed measurement protocol.
A five-seed longitudinal case holds both the failure block and its summary fixed: compression fails at an early state and becomes a cost-saving intervention at a later state.
Across five backbones, RECAP produces positive paired-success saving estimates with backbone-specific reliability-efficiency tradeoffs.
On Hunyuan-A13B, it edits 43.24% of retained checkpoints while matching KEEP's observed 91.89% continuation success and reducing unconditional mean continuation prompt cost by 4,619.8 tokens (2.13%).
The framework provides an execution-level reference for deciding when to forget: retain history by its value to what comes next.
highlights: Long-horizon agents learn from failure, but the value of a failure record can change as execution progresses.

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: The Ephemeral Cost of Switching Optimizers Across LLM Training Stages
papers.summary:
Recent work suggests that switching optimizers between pretraining and subsequent training stages incurs a performance cost, but systematic investigation of this phenomenon is lacking.
We study the mismatch between AdamW and Muon optimizers by pretraining 1.2B Llama-3 models from scratch while varying the proportion of updates taken with each optimizer, and similarly interpolating between the two optimizers during continued pretraining and supervised fine-tuning (SFT).
Surprisingly, we find little evidence of a meaningful optimizer mismatch penalty: final performance is largely explained by the independent effects of the pretraining and post-training optimizers, with downstream performance generally improving as the proportion of Muon updates during SFT increases.
Although matching the pretraining optimizer can reduce forgetting during SFT, this does not translate into improved final benchmark performance.
We further evaluate AdamW and Muon for task-general SFT of open-weight models, across the Llama and Qwen families up to 14B parameters, where Muon remains competitive with AdamW, despite these models having been pretrained with AdamW.
Together, our results suggest that the choice of optimizer for post-training can be made largely independently of the optimizer used during pretraining.

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: Reusing Calibration Gains across Model Representations
papers.summary:
Scale calibration learns an update for one model representation.
We study how much of that update can be reused by another representation of the same pretrained model.
Our transfer procedure extracts positive group-wise gains and installs them in the recipient's weights or native quantization scales without recipient-side optimization.
On a quantized recipient, it preserves integer codes, zero points and storage layout.
For a Qwen3-1.7B floating-point/GPTQ INT3 pair, bidirectional transfer retains 76.9-90.5% of the text-loss improvement from recipient-specific calibration on fresh WikiText and C4 cohorts excluded from project development.
Shuffling the same gain values within each projection worsens both recipients, showing that their learned group assignment matters after transfer.
A Llama-3.2-3B control keeps the initial native tensors at all four calibrated projections identical and changes nine projections elsewhere.
Cross-installation retains 98.6-99.3% of the text-calibration benefit, alongside a small, resolved preference for each recipient's own gain.
These results quantify both the adaptation carried by a reusable calibration update and the remaining benefit of recipient-specific training.
highlights: Scale calibration learns an update for one model representation.
We study how much of that update can be reused by another representation of the same pretrained model.

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: When Is Language-Model Advice Worth Buying? A Matched-Budget Study of Predictive Gating in Reinforcement Learning
authors: Abu Sa-Adat Mohamed Moon-Im Al Ahsan
papers.summary:
Language-model advice can accelerate reinforcement learning, but every call has a price, and a returned suggestion may be unparsable, unsafe to execute, or no better than the agent's own action.
We introduce certified predictive advice gating, a cost-aware controller that forecasts possible advisor responses, values the action actually executed after parsing, execution checks, and cache reuse, and requests advice only when a calibrated lower bound on that value covers the price.
Our analysis separates the gap of executed advice, cumulative regret under an intervention-stable fallback, and myopic acquisition loss.
On BabyAI GoToObj with Qwen2.5-1.5B and 7B advisors, the gate improves return over no advice by paired $0.029\pm0.016$ and $0.030\pm0.015$ while using more than $97\%$ fewer calls than always asking.
Matched-budget comparisons, however, do not resolve an advantage over an early query schedule, so the gain reflects economical advice volume rather than demonstrated state selection.
Groupwise calibration raises coverage on positive-value opportunities from $0.47$ to $0.85$, still below the $0.90$ target.
A separate headroom-aware gate reports paired gains over an early schedule of $0.032\pm0.012$ and $0.029\pm0.011$ on GoToObj and $0.027\pm0.011$ and $0.028\pm0.012$ on GoToObjDoor, and adds BabyAI and ALFWorld success, decision-stratum coverage, and component timing.
These results separate return gains, query placement, and execution screening; finite-sample deployment guarantees remain unestablished.

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: Beyond Generation: Using Multimodal LLMs as Detectors of LLM-Generated Deepfake Facial Images
papers.summary:
As image generation models become increasingly capable of producing highly realistic content, traditional forensic techniques are struggling to keep up.
This paper investigates whether MLLMs can instead be used as a form of forensic analysis by identifying synthetic media.
Specifically, the study aims to determine whether these models detect fake images by recognising physical inconsistencies, or whether they rely on digital artefacts such as embedded watermarks.
Six MLLMs (GPT-4o, GPT-5, GPT-5.2, Gemini 2.5, Gemini 3, and Seed 1.6) are benchmarked using a dataset of 400 images.
Fifty images are authentic photographs, while the remaining 350 are generated using seven leading image models: Gemini 3, Gemini 2.5, Flux.2 Pro, GPT-Image-1, GPT-Image-1.5, Seedream 4.0, and Seedream 4.5.
The evaluation is structured in three stages: single-image classification, pairwise comparison, and a focused "self-detection" experiment on Gemini.
Several MLLMs achieved a high detection accuracy, with GPT-5.2 reaching a peak of 97.9% in the pairwise experiment, against specific generators and an overall mean pairwise accuracy of 82.5% by identifying structural or physical inconsistencies within images.
However, results from the self-detection experiment indicate that the presence of invisible SynthID watermarks leads to a 10% reduction in Gemini's detection accuracy compared to the clean control group.
One possible explanation is that SynthID embedding reduces some of the visible artefacts the models rely on for detection.
These results imply that MLLMs can detect structural artefacts without relying on watermarks, but performance varies substantially across model generations.
The findings also suggest that SynthID embedding may suppress some of the structural artefacts used during detection.
highlights: This paper investigates whether MLLMs can instead be used as a form of forensic analysis by identifying synthetic media.

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: Xiaomi-Lens-0 Technical Report
papers.summary:
Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) answer questions about whole images well, yet they still struggle with fine-grained region understanding.
A key reason is that text-only supervision never specifies which regions support an answer.
To close this gap, we present Xiaomi-Lens-0, a 4B MLLM built on Qwen3.5 that predicts masks from its own visual representations.
Specifically, a lightweight decoder combines vision-encoder patch features with visual latents, the language model's mask-token states, so mask supervision reaches the shared backbone without an additional segmentation encoder.
Because each latent decodes to a mask, the model can interleave reasoning with region-specific latents and thus think with visual latents, while grounded reasoning traces supervise the regions it visits during chain-of-thought.
As a result, across all eight RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, and RefCOCOg splits, Xiaomi-Lens-0 gains 5.6 points on average over Qwen3.5 in referring comprehension and achieves the highest segmentation cIoU among compared models.
Moreover, it surpasses Qwen3.5 across all perception benchmarks.
Homepage: \href{https://seerray-lab.github.io/Xiaomi-Lens-0}{this https URL}

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: LoongSage: A Production-Grade, High-Efficiency Agentic RL Framework for Frontier LLMs with Validated Recipes
papers.summary:
Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a critical phase in the post-training pipeline of large language models (LLMs).
As the frontier of LLM capabilities shifts from static reasoning to agentic tasks--characterized by external tool invocation, multi-turn interactions, and long-horizon decision-making--existing mainstream RL frameworks have grown increasingly unwieldy, raising the overhead of adoption, usage, and debugging.
To address these challenges, we present LoongSage, an agent-native, fully asynchronous RL framework with a lightweight core of roughly 14K lines of code.
Built upon Megatron for distributed training and SGLang for high-throughput inference, LoongSage centralizes orchestration within a single controller process and encapsulates all GPU-resident components as Ray actors.
It introduces AgentFlow, a unified execution paradigm that orchestrates both white-box and black-box agents.
For asynchronous execution, it integrates sliding-window strategies that bound trajectory staleness, and employs TransferMesh, a topology-aware synchronization mechanism that routes weights after each step over the fastest transport available to each receiver.
Beyond agentic RL, LoongSage incorporates a memory-efficient Teacher Manager that decouples the scaling of teacher models from GPU memory constraints, natively supporting Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation.
Extensive evaluations across four complete training runs, spanning complex reinforcement learning and multi-teacher distillation, demonstrate that task rewards improve steadily while the train-inference gap is kept under continuous control, and the fully asynchronous pipeline removes synchronous idle bubbles, sustaining hardware utilization.
