featuredPapers.title: SpecForge: Recursive Self-Improvement for Coding Agents via Behavioral Specifications
featuredPapers.authors: Yutong Cheng, Haifeng Chen, Peng Gao
featuredPapers.summary:
Coding agents based on frozen language models can improve their performance by refining the external context they rely on, without updating model weights. 基于冻结语言模型的编码代理可以通过优化其所依赖的外部上下文来提高其性能，而无需更新模型权重。
We study recursive self-improvement through behavioral specifications: natural-language code documentation that describes the behavior of program entities and guides agents in generating correct code. 我们通过行为规范研究递归自我改进：自然语言代码文档，描述程序实体的行为，并指导代理生成正确的代码。
We formulate a self-improvement loop in which an agent generates code from its current specifications, evaluates it with execution-verified tests, and refines the specifications based on observed failures. 我们制定了一个自我改进循环，其中代理根据其当前规范生成代码，通过执行验证测试对其进行评估，并根据观察到的故障完善规范。
The improved specifications then guide subsequent generation, progressively improving the agent's understanding of the codebase. 然后，改进的规范指导后续生成，逐步提高代理对代码库的理解。
However, recursive refinement is challenging because program entities are interdependent. 然而，递归细化具有挑战性，因为程序实体是相互依赖的。
Improving the specification of one entity can inadvertently degrade the correctness of others, a phenomenon we call output coupling. 改进一个实体的规范可能会无意中降低其他实体的正确性，这种现象我们称之为输出耦合。
This creates a whack-a-mole effect in which local improvements cause regressions elsewhere, preventing consistent progress. 这产生了一种鼹鼠效应，其中局部改善会导致其他地方的倒退，从而阻止持续的进展。
We introduce SpecForge, a multi-frontier tree search framework that addresses this challenge with three mechanisms: (i) Pareto-guided state selection preserves complementary specification states and prevents premature commitment; (ii) dependency-constrained entity selection prioritizes callee-before-caller refinement; and (iii) error-diversified expansion explores multiple refinements using different subsets of test failures. 我们引入了SpecForge ，这是一个多前沿树搜索框架，通过三种机制解决这一挑战： （ i ）帕累托引导的状态选择保留了互补的规范状态并防止过早的承诺； （ ii ）依赖性受限的实体选择优先考虑被调用方在调用方之前的细化；以及（ iii ）错误多样化扩展探索使用不同子集的测试失败的多个细化。
On DevEval+, SpecForge achieves the best performance across five backbone models, including a 94.9% solve rate with Claude-4.5-Sonnet and a 5.7-percentage-point average improvement over the strongest baseline. 在DevEval +上， SpecForge在五个骨干模型中实现了最佳性能，包括Claude-4.5-Sonnet的解决率为94.9% ，平均比最强基线提高了5.7个百分点。
The improved specifications also make the agent better at tasks outside the loop: they transfer to cross-language translation and to new-feature implementation, where they outperform the benchmark-provided requirement documents. 改进的规范还使代理更好地执行循环外的任务：它们转移到跨语言翻译和新功能实现，在那里它们的表现优于基准提供的需求文档。

featuredPapers.title: Get In, Decide, Prove: A Merchant-Side Readiness Benchmark for Agentic Commerce
featuredPapers.authors: Adrian de Valois-Franklin, Alex Bogdan, Anas Ibrahim
featuredPapers.summary:
AI agents now browse and buy on people's behalf, and benchmarks measure how well the agents perform. 人工智能代理现在代表人们浏览和购买，基准衡量代理的表现。
Far less is known about the other side of the transaction: whether a merchant's website lets an agent in, publishes terms precise enough to decide a purchase, and leaves evidence of what was agreed. 对交易的另一方面知之甚少：商家的网站是否允许代理进入，发布足够精确的条款以决定购买，并留下已达成协议的证据。
This paper presents a merchant-side benchmark built on those three questions and reports a pilot of it. 本文提出了基于这三个问题的商家侧基准，并报告了其试点。
The central measurement, decision sufficiency, rates each criterion of a concrete buyer mandate (total cost, cancellation or return terms, service date, variant identity) as determinate, indeterminate, or unknown from the merchant's own published evidence. 根据商家自己公布的证据，中央测量、决策充分性、具体买家授权的每个标准（总成本、取消或退货条款、服务日期、变体身份）为确定、不确定或未知。
Readiness scores carry their evidence coverage and missingness bounds; access is reported separately for a declared bot, a declared headless browser, and a user-present browser; and each observed term is mapped to the RAILS admissibility class of the evidence that could support it in a dispute. 准备情况分数包含其证据覆盖范围和缺失范围；对于已声明的机器人、已声明的无头浏览器和用户存在的浏览器，访问权限分别报告；并且每个观察到的术语都映射到可能在争议中支持其的证据的轨道可接受性类别。
Four large merchants received the full assessment: three refused the declared profiles at their offer pages, and no mandate could be confirmed as met, because each merchant left a total or a refund term undetermined. 四家大型商家接受了完整的评估：三家商家在其优惠页面上拒绝了已申报的个人资料，并且无法确认是否符合要求，因为每家商家都留下了总额或未确定的退款期限。
An access census of 555 sites of merchants that two payment processors publicly name as clients found the home page unreadable to both declared profiles at 105 sites (18.9%). 对两家支付处理商公开命名为客户的555个商家网站的访问普查发现， 105个网站（ 18.9% ）的两个已声明的个人资料都无法读取主页。
A declared assessment of 330 merchants, scored by deterministic rules without a rater, found that evidence coverage rather than the score decides who can be ranked: 115 merchants (35%) reached the ranking threshold, rankable profiles scored a median of 89 to 90, and material terms was the one pillar well below the others, because the all-in total was decidable at 18 merchants. 在没有评分者的情况下，对330家商家进行了公开评估，发现证据覆盖率而不是得分决定了谁可以排名： 115家商家（ 35 ％ ）达到了排名门槛，可排名的个人资料得分中位数为89至90 ，而物质条件是远低于其他的一个支柱，因为总共18家商家是可以决定的。
The pilot shows that the measurements can be taken; it does not validate them or rank merchants, and the weights and the projected clearing band await validation against outcomes. 试点表明可以进行测量；它不会验证它们或对商家进行排名，并且权重和预计的清算区间正在等待对结果的验证。

featuredPapers.title: Verifier-Harness Co-Evolution for Training-Free Self-Improvement on Open-Ended Tasks
featuredPapers.authors: Tianyi Xu, Yaolun Zhang, Yiran Wu
featuredPapers.summary:
Training-free self-improvement lets an agent use feedback to revise the response it is about to return and to update the harness state that shapes how it handles later tasks. 无需培训的自我提升可让客服代表使用反馈来修改即将返回的回复，并更新影响其处理后续任务的方式的线束状态。
On open-ended tasks that feedback rarely comes from reference answers or executable tests, so the agent has to rely on a model-based verifier. 在开放式任务中，反馈很少来自参考答案或可执行测试，因此代理必须依赖于基于模型的验证器。
When the verifier is wrong, the current response can get worse, and misleading experience can persist across the task stream. 当验证者出错时，当前的响应可能会变得更糟，并且误导性体验可能会在任务流中持续存在。
A verifier that never changes also grows stale as the agent's responses improve and task demands shift. 随着客服代表的回应有所改善，任务需求发生变化，永远不会改变的验证者也会变得陈旧。
We introduce Unified Co-Evolution (UCoE), a training-free method that evolves an executable verifier program together with the agent's harness state while all model parameters stay fixed. 我们引入了统一协同进化（ UCoE ） ，这是一种无需培训的方法，可将可执行验证程序与代理的线束状态一起进化，同时所有模型参数保持不变。
UCoE synthesizes candidate verifier programs and tests them on response contrasts, pairs of responses that differ in one declared property and have a known preferred side. UCoE合成候选验证程序，并根据响应对比度对它们进行测试，这些响应对在一个声明的属性中不同，并且具有已知的首选侧。
It selects the candidate whose discrimination on its weakest contrast family is highest, a quantity we call driving capacity. 它选择对最弱对比度家族的歧视最高的候选人，我们称之为驾驶能力。
The selected verifier diagnoses one weakness in each draft, guides a single repair, decides which response is served, and determines whether the accepted repair may enter the harness state. 所选验证者诊断每个草案中的一个弱点，指导单个维修，决定提供哪个响应，并确定接受的维修是否可能进入线束状态。
As tasks complete, their diagnostics seed new candidate verifiers, which must beat the current verifier on the same contrasts before adoption. 随着任务的完成，他们的诊断会播种新的候选验证器，这些验证器在采用之前必须在相同的对比度上击败当前的验证器。
Across six open-ended benchmarks, UCoE averages 59.00% preference against matched direct generation with Qwen3-8B and 57.19% with Qwen3.8-27B, margins of 9.00 and 7.19 percentage points. 在六个开放式基准中， UCoE的平均偏好率为59.00 ％ ， Qwen3-8B为57.19 ％ ， Qwen3.8-27B为57.19 ％ ，利润率为9.00和7.19个百分点。
On three verifiable benchmarks, the same method raises the mean from 36.06% for direct generation to 38.48%. 在三个可验证的基准上，相同的方法将直接发电的平均值从36.06%提高到38.48%。
Code is available at https://github.com/tianyi0216/Unified-Co-Evolution. 优惠码可在https://github.com/tianyi0216/Unified-Co-Evolution上获得。

featuredPapers.title: ECG-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Targeted Electrocardiogram Waveform Evolution
featuredPapers.authors: Xiaoliang Wang, Zhuo Chen, Chuanyang Zheng
featuredPapers.summary:
Electrocardiogram (ECG) models need supervision that targets evolving weaknesses and remains faithful to waveform evidence. 心电图（ ECG ）模型需要针对不断变化的弱点进行监督，并始终忠实于波形证据。
We introduce ECG-RSI, a recursive self-improvement framework combining verified waveform synthesis with feedback-guided intervention search. 我们引入了ECG-RSI ，这是一种将经过验证的波形合成与反馈引导的干预搜索相结合的递归自我改进框架。
Signal remeasurement verifies waveform edits; construction errors guide generator repair, while learner errors motivate interventions compared on a separate selection set. 信号重新测量验证波形编辑；构造错误指导生成器修复，而学习者错误激励干预措施在单独的选择集上进行比较。
Across seven benchmarks, three rounds raise Qwen3.5-35B-A3B's mean question-answering accuracy from 34.57% to 56.04% and mean classification F1 from 24.27 to 34.03. 在七个基准中，三轮将Qwen3.5-35B-A3B的平均问答准确率从34.57%提高到56.04% ，平均分类F1从24.27提高到34.03。
Across the retained trajectory, the preferred supervision shifts from direct reinforcement to confusion-focused contrasts. 在保留的轨迹上，首选的监督从直接强化转变为以混乱为中心的对比。
Continued feedback correction yields diminishing external gains. 持续的反馈修正会减少外部收益。
These results motivate separating error diagnosis from intervention selection and checking whether gains on the feedback set transfer to independent benchmarks. 这些结果促使将错误诊断与干预选择分开，并检查反馈集的增益是否转移到独立的基准。

featuredPapers.title: Output Discipline Sets the Floor: A Falsification-Guided, Model-Agnostic Agent Protocol for Auditable Hypothesis-Driven Decision Making
featuredPapers.authors: Jing Liu, Yongxing Qi, Ping Yao
featuredPapers.summary:
What binds large language models on auditable, hypothesis-driven decision tasks, where every candidate can be checked against the evidence? 是什么将大型语言模型与可审计、假设驱动的决策任务结合在一起，每个候选人都可以根据证据进行检查？
On the public TCMEval-SDT benchmark for Traditional Chinese Medicine syndrome differentiation (200 cases), the binding constraint is output discipline and reasoning structure, not model capability alone: two years of model scaling move zero-shot scores by only -0.03 to +0.08, while output-discipline failures (non-terminating reasoning, format non-compliance, large run-to-run spread) persist even in frontier models. 在中医辨证的公共TCMEval-SDT基准（ 200例）上，约束约束是输出纪律和推理结构，而不仅仅是模型能力：两年的模型缩放仅将零点得分移动了-0.03到+0.08 ，而输出纪律失效（非终止推理，格式不合规，大量运行到运行传播）甚至在前沿模型中仍然存在。
We test this with a model-agnostic agent framework formalizing decision making as a five-stage closed loop, enforced by a candidate x evidence matrix falsification protocol: every candidate is judged against every evidence item, at least half of the candidates must be falsified before a conclusion is licensed, and survivors are emitted in a machine-verifiable single-line format. 我们使用与模型无关的代理框架对此进行测试，该框架将决策形式化为五个阶段的闭环，通过候选x证据矩阵伪造协议强制执行：根据每个证据项目来判断每个候选，在获得许可之前必须至少有一半的候选人被伪造，并且幸存者以机器可验证的单行格式发出。
Across five base models, the effect is sign-conditional on zero-shot output discipline: it rescues models whose discipline fails (DeepSeek-V4-Flash: +0.267/+0.271, entirely termination rescue), reduces a high-variance model's run-to-run standard deviation from 0.218 to 0.007 (Kimi K3), and significantly costs already-disciplined models (-0.087 to -0.120 on budget-matched Qwen3-4B/32B). 在五个基本模型中，对零射输出纪律的影响是符号条件的：它挽救纪律失败的模型（ DeepSeek-V4-Flash ： +0.267/+0 .271 ，完全终止挽救） ，将高方差模型的运行标准差从0.218降至0.007 （ Kimi K3 ） ，并显著降低已有纪律的模型的成本（预算匹配的Qwen3-4B/32B为-0.087至-0.120 ）。
Ablations attribute the cost to the candidate-bounded format layer and show the effect is independent of injected knowledge content (protocol-knowledge decoupling). 消融将成本归因于候选受限的格式层，并显示效果独立于注入的知识内容（协议-知识解耦）。
The protocol also transfers to misinformation-robust mathematical reasoning, detecting injected false premises at 89.8% recall with a 6.8% false-positive rate (MCC 0.54; a flag-everything baseline scores 0) and restoring accuracy to the no-misinformation ceiling. 该方案还转向错误信息强健的数学推理，以89.8%的召回率检测注射虚假前提，假阳性率为6.8% （ MCC 0.54 ；标记一切基线得分0 ） ，并恢复无错误信息上限的准确性。
Where zero-shot output discipline is weak, the reasoning protocol sets the floor; base-model capability always sets the ceiling. 在零拍输出纪律较弱的地方，推理协议设定底线；基本模型能力始终设定上限。

featuredPapers.title: LLM Agents for Automated Post-Training via Structured Recipe Optimization
featuredPapers.authors: Ruohong Liu, Bohan Tang, Lekang Jiang
featuredPapers.summary:
Automated post-training transforms pre-trained large language models (LLMs) into models capable of handling diverse domains by automatically constructing and optimizing a recipe of coupled decisions over data sources, data processing, cross-domain composition, and training configuration under a limited experimental budget. 自动训练后，在有限的实验预算下，通过自动构建和优化数据源、数据处理、跨域组合和训练配置的耦合决策配方，将预训练的大型语言模型（ LLM ）转换为能够处理不同领域的模型。
Existing automation either searches predefined recipe spaces that enable systematic optimization but remain fixed rather than adapting their available choices to the target tasks, or uses open-ended agents that discover task-specific choices but leave them implicit in trial-level edits, limiting their systematic reuse and recombination across trials. 现有的自动化要么搜索预定义的配方空间，以实现系统优化，但保持固定状态，而不是根据目标任务调整其可用选择，要么使用开放式代理来发现特定任务的选择，但将其隐含在试用级编辑中，从而限制它们在试用中的系统重用和重组。
To fill this gap, we introduce optimization over a task-adapted recipe space, a novel paradigm that can adapt the recipe space itself to the target tasks while representing its choices explicitly for systematic reuse, recombination, and joint optimization. 为了填补这一空白，我们引入了任务适应配方空间的优化，这是一种新颖的范式，可以使配方空间本身适应目标任务，同时明确表示其选择以进行系统重用、重组和关节优化。
We instantiate this paradigm with Structured Recipe Optimization (SRO), comprising an LLM-based Recipe-Space Designer that constructs the task-adapted recipe space and a Multi-Domain Recipe Optimizer that uses structured trial evidence to guide LLM candidate construction and multi-objective Bayesian trial selection. 我们使用结构化配方优化（ SRO ）实例化此范式，其中包括基于LLM的配方空间设计器（构建任务适应的配方空间）和多域配方优化器（使用结构化试验证据来指导LLM候选人构建和多目标贝叶斯试验选择）。
Extensive experiments show that SRO achieves the highest average score in all evaluated target-model and agent-LLM combinations. 广泛的实验表明，在所有评估的目标模型和Agent-LLM组合中， SRO达到了最高的平均分数。
In joint post-training across three capability domains and six benchmarks, SRO reaches 41.1 versus 15.4 for the strongest baseline on Qwen3-1.7B with GPT-5.4, and 53.8 versus 40.8 on Qwen3-4B with DeepSeek-V4-Flash. 在跨三个能力域和六个基准的联合训练后， SRO在Qwen3-1.7B和GPT-5.4上的最强基线分别达到41.1和15.4 ，在Qwen3-4B和DeepSeek-V4-Flash上的最强基线分别达到53.8和40.8。
Our code is available at https://github.com/RuohLiuq/SRO. 我们的代码可在https://github.com/RuohLiuq/SRO上找到。

featuredPapers.title: Humans vs. Machines: A Comparison With AI Agents in Software Reverse Engineering
featuredPapers.authors: Samuele Doria, Stefano De Rosa, Ruoyu Wang
featuredPapers.summary:
Can an autonomous AI agent reverse engineer a binary as well as a skilled human analyst? 自主人工智能代理可以对二进制文件进行逆向工程，也可以对熟练的人类分析师进行逆向工程吗？
Do they adopt the same strategy, and can agents scale to real-world programs? 他们是否采用相同的策略，代理是否可以扩展到现实世界的计划？
We compare human and LLM-based software reverse engineering (SRE): nine models tackle two compact static-analysis challenges previously solved by human analysts, scored with a common understanding rubric, and we record their complete interactions with IDA Pro. 我们比较了人类和基于LLM的软件逆向工程（ SRE ） ：九个模型解决了之前由人类分析师解决的两个紧凑的静态分析挑战，并使用共同的理解评分标准进行评分，我们记录了他们与IDA Pro的完整交互。
This lets us compare not only what humans and agents recover, but also how they investigate a binary. 这不仅可以让我们比较人类和智能体的恢复情况，还可以让我们比较他们如何调查二进制文件。
The best agents (GPT-5.5 Pro, Claude Opus 4.8, and Kimi K3) achieve statistically human-competitive understanding on both tasks, while weaker models remain far behind. 最好的代理（ GPT-5.5 Pro、Claude Opus 4.8和Kimi K3 ）在这两项任务上都实现了统计学上的人类竞争理解，而较弱的模型仍然远远落后。
Ablations show that the gap depends on code representation and workflow demands, not on model capability alone: open-weight models improve substantially with richer code representations, whereas frontier models show no significant change. 消融表明，差距取决于代码表示和工作流需求，而不仅仅取决于模型能力：开放权重模型随着更丰富的代码表示而大幅改善，而前沿模型则没有显着变化。
Similar success rates hide different workflows. 类似的成功率会隐藏不同的工作流程。
Humans repeatedly revisit functions and follow local program structure; strong agents jump across the binary, retrieve information broadly, and rarely return to inspected code, a behavior we call greedy fetching. 人类反复重温函数并遵循本地程序结构；强代理跳过二进制文件，广泛检索信息，很少返回到被检查的代码，这种行为我们称之为贪婪获取。
This strategy is not fixed: given semantically richer code, agents fetch less without losing understanding. 这种策略不是固定的：给定语义更丰富的代码，代理获取更少而不会失去理解。
Because greedy fetching aggregates large amounts of code in the agent's context, we measure context-window saturation across 4,000 real-world binaries: large windows accommodate many programs, but larger applications and lower-level representations quickly exhaust them. 由于贪婪获取在代理的上下文中聚合了大量代码，因此我们测量了4,000个真实世界二进制文件的上下文窗口饱和度：大窗口可容纳许多程序，但较大的应用程序和较低级别的表示会很快耗尽它们。
Autonomous reverse engineering is becoming competitive, with a large speed advantage, but scaling it will require better navigation, selective retrieval, and persistent analysis state, not merely larger context windows. 自主逆向工程正在变得具有竞争力，具有很大的速度优势，但扩展它将需要更好的导航、选择性检索和持久分析状态，而不仅仅是更大的上下文窗口。
highlights: Can an autonomous AI agent reverse engineer a binary as well as a skilled human analyst?

featuredPapers.title: LLM Value Functions for Credit Assignment in Agentic RL
featuredPapers.authors: Kaijie Zhu, Weixiang Yan, Omar Attia
featuredPapers.summary:
Reinforcement learning (RL) for large language model (LLM) agents remains challenging in long-horizon tasks with sparse outcome rewards, where assigning credit to individual actions is difficult. 大型语言模型（ LLM ）代理的强化学习（ RL ）在具有稀疏结果奖励的长期任务中仍然具有挑战性，在这些任务中，很难为个人行为分配信用。
Methods such as GRPO assign the same trajectory-level advantage to all actions, while critic-based methods require learning an additional value function that can be costly and unstable. 诸如GRPO之类的方法为所有操作分配相同的轨迹级优势，而基于批评者的方法需要学习一个额外的价值函数，这可能是昂贵和不稳定的。
We introduce LLM Value Function RL (LVRL), which uses the pretrained knowledge and in-context learning ability of an LLM to estimate policy-aware state values without finetuning a separate critic. 我们引入了LLM值函数RL （ LVRL ） ，它使用LLM的预训练知识和上下文学习能力来估计策略感知状态值，而无需微调单独的批评者。
LVRL conditions the value model on group context and calibrates its predictions using known values at the initial and terminal states, enabling step-level credit assignment from estimated value differences. LVRL根据组上下文调整价值模型，并使用初始和最终状态下的已知值校准其预测，从而实现从估计值差异的阶梯级信用分配。
We further extend this idea to learning from an expert policy through on-policy distillation (OPD), introducing LLM Value Function OPD (LVOPD), which focuses teacher supervision on actions associated with decreases in estimated value. 我们进一步扩展了这一理念，通过政策提炼（ OPD ）从专家政策中学习，引入了LLM价值函数OPD （ LVOPD ） ，将教师监督的重点放在与估计价值降低相关的行动上。
We evaluate our approach across diverse agentic benchmarks: AppWorld, BabyAI, and SWE-bench Verified. 我们在不同的代理基准上评估我们的方法： AppWorld、BabyAI和SWE-bench Verified。
Across policy scales (4B to 32B), LVRL consistently and substantially outperforms both GRPO and PPO. 在政策量表（ 4B至32B ）中， LVRL的表现始终如一且大幅优于GRPO和PPO。
On AppWorld and SWE-bench Verified, LVRL yields absolute improvements of up to 13.6 and 8.6 percentage points over GRPO. 在AppWorld和SWE-bench Verified上， LVRL比GRPO提高了高达13.6和8.6个百分点。
Notably, on tasks requiring extended exploration like BabyAI, LVRL bridges the gap from total failure to 75.0% success. 值得注意的是，在像BabyAI这样需要扩展探索的任务上， LVRL弥合了从完全失败到75.0%成功的差距。
Furthermore, LVOPD yields consistent improvements over standard distillation baselines on AppWorld. 此外， LVOPD在AppWorld上的标准蒸馏基线上产生了一致的改进。
Finally, Monte-Carlo analysis confirms that our frozen critic accurately identifies semantic pitfalls and recoveries, proving that LVRL extracts robust, policy-aware step-level credit from sparse terminal outcomes. 最后，蒙特卡洛分析证实，我们的冷冻评论家准确地识别了语义陷阱和恢复，证明LVRL从稀疏的终端结果中提取了稳健的、具有政策意识的阶梯级信用。
highlights: We evaluate our approach across diverse agentic benchmarks: AppWorld, BabyAI, and SWE-bench Verified.

featuredPapers.title: Drafting Agents, Not Just Tokens: Speculative Recursive Self-Improvement for Agentic Systems
featuredPapers.authors: Xin Xu, Ke Cheng, Hao Wang
featuredPapers.summary:
Improving an agent through successive revisions requires balancing exploration and evaluation under a limited budget. 通过连续修订改进代理需要在有限的预算下平衡探索和评估。
A narrow search can miss useful sequences of edits, while fully evaluating every intermediate version can exhaust the budget before those sequences yield a verified improvement. 狭隘的搜索可能会错过有用的编辑序列，而充分评估每个中间版本可能会在这些序列产生经过验证的改进之前耗尽预算。
We introduce Speculative Recursive Self-Improvement (SpecRSI), which drafts executable successor agents before their predecessors are fully evaluated, while requiring complete verification before adoption. 我们引入了推测递归自我改进（ SpecRSI ） ，它在可执行后继代理的前身得到充分评估之前起草可执行后继代理，同时要求在采用之前进行完整的验证。
Verification-Aware Tree Search (VATS) allocates the budget between further edits and outstanding checks using the predicted verified return of a continuation. 验证感知树搜索（ VATS ）使用预测的连续验证回报，在进一步编辑和未完成检查之间分配预算。
Group Verification Optimization (GVO) learns the improver from completed searches while keeping the real evaluator fixed. 组验证优化（ GVO ）从已完成的搜索中学习改进者，同时保持真实评估者的固定状态。
In the main scientific comparison, terminal gains exceed Janus by 33.3%--40.0%. 在主要的科学比较中，终端增益超过Janus 33.3% --40.0%。
Additional evaluations show that SpecRSI outperforms Janus in all 50 scientific backbone--task pairs and exceeds MetaRSI-v1 by 1.85%--2.38% in macro-average system score across twenty backbones. 其他评估显示， SpecRSI在所有50个科学骨干（任务对）中的表现优于Janus ，并且在20个骨干的宏观平均系统得分中超过MetaRSI-v1 1.85% - -2.38%。
Coding-validation success reaches 69.4% versus HGM's 64.3% at a 20.8% lower target-cost index. 编码验证成功率达到69.4% ，而HGM为64.3% ，目标成本指数较低20.8%。

featuredPapers.title: DeltaTTG: Training Multi-Turn Agents with a Token-to-Go Progress Meter
featuredPapers.authors: Xuyan Ye, Xiyan Fu, Shengda Fan
featuredPapers.summary:
Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) for multi-turn agents relies on sparse terminal rewards that say little about individual steps. 针对多回合座席的可验证奖励强化学习（ RLVR ）依赖于稀疏的终端奖励，而这些终端奖励对单个步骤的影响很小。
Within-group step comparisons depend on reliable state matching and sufficiently diverse sampled outcomes, while direct step scoring may require costly external evaluators, human annotations, or task-specific heuristics. 组内分步比较依赖于可靠的状态匹配和足够多样化的采样结果，而直接分步评分可能需要昂贵的外部评估人员、人工注释或特定任务的启发式方法。
We introduce DeltaTTG to learn a reusable progress signal through a shared progress meter, using low-cost supervision from diverse policies' recorded trajectories without task-specific progress rules. 我们引入DeltaTTG ，通过共享进度计学习可重用的进度信号，使用来自不同政策记录轨迹的低成本监督，而无需特定任务的进度规则。
Its supervision target, Token-to-Go (TTG), the number of tokens remaining to be generated until task completion, serves as an observable proxy for remaining completion effort. 其监督目标Token-to-Go （ TTG ） ，即在任务完成之前剩余待生成的代币数量，可作为剩余完成工作的可观察代理。
During actor training, changes in the frozen meter's estimates redistribute outcome-derived advantages across steps without altering the reward, preserving each trajectory's advantage sign and token-average scale. 在演员培训期间，冻结仪表估计值的变化在不改变奖励的情况下跨步骤重新分配结果派生的优势，保留每个轨迹的优势符号和令牌平均尺度。
On ALFWorld, PaperSearchQA, and BFCLv3, DeltaTTG improves the average score over GRPO by 5.7 and 7.2 points with Qwen3-4B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, respectively, outperforms all compared RL baselines on average, and keeps actor-training GPU-hours close to GRPO. 在ALFWorld、PaperSearchQA和BFCLv3上， DeltaTTG分别使用Qwen3-4B和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct将GRPO的平均分数提高了5.7和7.2分，平均优于所有比较RL基线，并使参与者培训GPU小时接近GRPO。
Further experiments show improved sample efficiency and out-of-domain performance, and support the meter's ability to distinguish step quality and guide test-time action selection across actor sizes. 进一步的实验表明，提高了样本效率和域外性能，并支持仪表区分步骤质量和引导跨演员大小的测试时间动作选择的能力。
The code is available at https://github.com/Xuyan923r/DeltaTTG. 该代码可在https://github.com/Xuyan923r/DeltaTTG上获得。
highlights: outperforms all compared RL baselines on average

featuredPapers.title: GIFT-Eval-CTX: A Benchmark For Contextual Forecasting Model Evaluation
featuredPapers.authors: Xu Liu, Hanshu Yan, Taha Aksu
featuredPapers.summary:
Contextual forecasting seeks to improve time series forecasting by incorporating forward-looking information, such as planned events, external conditions, and expert expectations. 情境预测旨在通过整合前瞻性信息（如计划事件、外部条件和专家期望）来改进时间序列预测。
However, reliable evaluation remains difficult: existing benchmarks often have limited domain coverage, lack standardized history-future splits, or provide text that is not guaranteed to inform the future. 然而，可靠的评估仍然很困难：现有的基准通常具有有限的领域覆盖范围，缺乏标准化的历史-未来分割，或者提供的文本不能保证为未来提供信息。
We introduce GIFT-Eval-CTX, a benchmark that isolates whether forecasting methods can translate verified future information into accurate numerical trajectories. 我们引入了GIFT-Eval-CTX ，这是一个基准，用于隔离预测方法是否可以将经过验证的未来信息转化为准确的数字轨迹。
Built upon GIFT-Eval, GIFT-Eval-CTX contains 10,000 instances across 20 datasets. GIFT-Eval-CTX基于GIFT-Eval构建，包含20个数据集中的10,000个实例。
Each instance provides structured effects derived from the realized future: Macro effects describe horizon-wide behavior, while Micro effects specify localized changes. 每个实例都提供源自已实现未来的结构化效果：宏观效果描述整个视野范围内的行为，而微观效果指定局部变化。
We construct these annotations with an agentic pipeline combining LLM-based discovery and deterministic code validation. 我们使用基于LLM的发现和确定性代码验证相结合的代理流水线构建这些注释。
We benchmark TSFMs, frontier LLMs, and tool-using agentic systems. 我们对TSFM、前沿LLM和使用工具的代理系统进行基准测试。
The results show that structured effects reduce aggregate relative MASE by 40.7% for GPT-5.6 Sol and 29.6% for Claude Opus 4.8 relative to history-only prompting. 结果表明，相对于纯历史提示， GPT-5.6 Sol和Claude Opus 4.8的结构化效应使聚合相对MASE降低了40.7% ，而Claude Opus 4.8的结构化效应使聚合相对Mase降低了29.6%。
The evaluated MoiraiAgent system achieves the best overall result. 经过评估的MoiraiAgent系统实现了最佳的整体效果。
We further analyze the contributions of structured effects and agentic systems to performance, and identify opportunities for future research. 我们进一步分析了结构效应和代理系统对绩效的贡献，并确定了未来研究的机会。
highlights: Built upon GIFT-Eval, GIFT-Eval-CTX contains 10,000 instances across 20 datasets.

featuredPapers.title: APT: Feedback-Driven Agentic Post-Training for Text-to-Image Generation
featuredPapers.authors: Sirui Zhang, Fangyun Wei, Dong Chen
featuredPapers.summary:
Post-training is crucial for improving text-to-image models, yet existing pipelines typically rely on manually curated training data and fixed training distributions. 训练后对于改进文本到图像模型至关重要，但现有的管道通常依赖于手动策划的训练数据和固定的训练分布。
We introduce APT (Agentic Post-Training), a fully automated framework that adaptively post-trains a base model according to its evolving capability profile. 我们引入了APT （ Agentic Post-Training ） ，这是一个完全自动化的框架，可根据其不断发展的能力配置文件自适应地对基本模型进行后期训练。
APT coordinates three agents to construct evaluation sets from user requirements, diagnose model-specific strengths and failure modes, and generate reinforcement learning data with an adaptive prompt distribution that emphasizes underperforming capabilities. APT协调三个代理从用户需求构建评估集，诊断模型特定的优势和失败模式，并生成具有自适应提示分布的强化学习数据，该分布强调表现不佳的能力。
By repeatedly evaluating, diagnosing, and updating the generator, APT lets the current model's behavior shape its next training tasks, forming a feedback loop inspired by recursive self-improvement. 通过反复评估、诊断和更新生成器， APT让当前模型的行为塑造其下一个训练任务，形成一个受递归自我改进启发的反馈循环。
For general-purpose settings without user-specified evaluation scenarios, we further develop an evaluation harness that enables broad and diverse evaluation set generation. 对于没有用户指定评估场景的通用设置，我们进一步开发了一种评估线束，可实现广泛而多样的评估集生成。
Experiments across multiple base models, benchmarks, and generation architectures demonstrate that APT is model-agnostic, benchmark-agnostic, architecture-agnostic, and fully automated. 跨多个基本模型、基准和生成架构的实验表明， APT与模型无关、与基准无关、与架构无关且完全自动化。

featuredPapers.title: Tev: Scaling Long-Horizon Agentic Environments with Dense Progress Rewards
featuredPapers.authors: Wenbo Hu, Shraman Pramanick, Krishna Kumar Singh
featuredPapers.summary:
Long-horizon agents have drawn growing attention for their ability to work autonomously -- from hours to days -- on economically valuable tasks, a capability essential to automated discovery and recursive self-improvement (RSI). 长期代理因其能够自主工作（从几小时到几天）执行具有经济价值的任务的能力而受到越来越多的关注，这是自动发现和递归自我改进（ RSI ）所必需的能力。
Yet open-source models still struggle on long-horizon tasks, largely for lack of both training data and a working recipe, and scaling both is hard: long, complex tasks are difficult to curate and verify, and their rewards are sparse. 然而，开源模型仍然在长期任务上苦苦挣扎，主要是因为缺乏训练数据和工作配方，两者都很难扩展：冗长、复杂的任务很难策划和验证，而且它们的回报很少。
We address both. 我们同时处理这两个问题。
First, we introduce Tev-Gym, the first long-horizon agent training dataset with verifiable, dense, progressive rewards -- 1,170 verified task environments across 7 domains. 首先，我们介绍了Tev-Gym ，这是第一个具有可验证、密集、渐进奖励的长视野座席培训数据集--跨7个领域的1,170个经过验证的任务环境。
It is built on a latent-world-first approach that first constructs a latent world: a complete and correct hidden specification of the task domain, workflow, and expected state after each step. 它建立在潜在世界第一方法之上，该方法首先构建了一个潜在世界：每个步骤后任务域、工作流程和预期状态的完整和正确的隐藏规范。
Each task is then progressively rendered from this specification into an agent-facing environment, enabling controllable complexity and a natural progress metric. 然后，每个任务都从本规范逐渐渲染到面向代理的环境中，从而实现可控的复杂性和自然进度指标。
Second, we turn this metric into a training recipe: via progress-potential reward shaping (PPRS), we convert progress into a dense per-step reward that improves training efficiency and makes otherwise-intractable tasks trainable. 其次，我们将这个指标转化为培训方案：通过进度-潜力奖励塑造（ PPRS ） ，我们将进度转化为密集的每步奖励，从而提高培训效率，并使本来棘手的任务成为可培训的任务。
Training with this recipe yields Tev-27B, which achieves substantial gains on the Agents' Last Exam computing and math sciences domains (ALE-CM), matching GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5 at Pass@5. 使用此配方的培训产生了Tev-27B ，它在代理的期末考试计算和数学科学领域（ ALE-CM ）上取得了可观的收益，与GPT-6 Astra和Claude Opus 5在Pass @ 5相匹配。
Despite training only on ALE-related data, it generalizes to the Terminal-Bench (TB) 3.0 and 4.0 subsets, surpassing GLM 5.2 and Gemini 3.7 Flash, and reaches Claude Opus 4.8-level performance on middle-horizon tasks such as TB 2.1. 尽管仅在ALE相关数据上进行训练，但它推广到终端台（ TB ） 3.0和4.0子集，超过GLM 5.2和Gemini 3.7 Flash ，并在TB 2.1等中间水平任务上达到Claude Opus 4.8级性能。
highlights: first long-horizon agent training dataset with verifiable

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: Video-Browser: Towards Open-web Agentic Video Browsing
papers.summary:
Autonomous agents are shifting information seeking from passive retrieval toward proactive, open-ended research, yet this progress has largely bypassed video, one of the web's richest sources of evidence. 自主代理正在将寻求的信息从被动检索转向主动、开放式的研究，但这一进展在很大程度上绕过了视频，视频是网络上最丰富的证据来源之一。
We formalize Agentic Video Browsing, in which an agent must query video search engines, decide which returned videos to watch, and answer questions grounded in their visual content. 我们将Agentic Video Browsing正式化，在Agentic Video Browsing中，客服代表必须查询视频搜索引擎，决定要观看哪些返回的视频，并回答基于其视觉内容的问题。
To study this setting reproducibly, we introduce Video-BrowseComp, a benchmark and infrastructure suite with 660 human-annotated questions at three difficulty levels, paired online and offline evaluation tracks, and a fixed video search stack of roughly 12,000 videos spanning over 2,000 hours for evaluation and training-data construction. 为了可重复地研究此设置，我们引入了Video-BrowseComp ，这是一个基准和基础设施套件，包含三个难度级别的660个人工注释问题，配对在线和离线评估轨道，以及大约12,000个视频的固定视频搜索堆栈，跨越2,000多个小时，用于评估和培训数据构建。
Our analysis reveals that the main bottleneck lies before video understanding: agents often fail to find the answer-bearing video at all. 我们的分析表明，主要的瓶颈在于视频理解：客服代表往往根本无法找到含有答案的视频。
This bottleneck stems from two coupled challenges. 这一瓶颈源于两个相互关联的挑战。
Search engines index textual metadata such as titles and tags, whereas questions often target implicit visual or cross-source evidence absent from these surface forms; and exhaustively inspecting the many returned videos is prohibitively expensive. 搜索引擎索引标题和标签等文本元数据，而问题通常针对这些表面形式中缺少的隐含视觉或跨源证据；彻底审查许多返回的视频是非常昂贵的。
We propose Video-Browser, an evidence-surfacing agent that improves both sides of search. 我们推荐Video-Browser ，这是一种证据展示代理，可改善搜索的两面性。
A Translation Memory helps the Planner phrase queries by analogy to past question-to-query transformations that successfully surfaced their target videos, and a Watcher performs sparse visual screening over returned candidates, retaining only videos that plausibly contain answer-bearing evidence for later dense verification. 翻译记忆库通过类比过去成功呈现其目标视频的问答转换来帮助规划师进行短语查询，而观察者对返回的候选人进行稀疏的视觉筛选，仅保留可能包含答案证据的视频，以便日后进行密集验证。
On the offline track, Video-Browser raises overall accuracy from 11.6% to 27.3% with Qwen3-VL-8B and from 39.8% to 45.1% with Gemini-3.1-Pro over the corresponding ReAct search agents, showing that better query formulation and post-search candidate selection improve end-to-end browsing performance. 在离线轨道上， Video-Browser使用Qwen3-VL-8B将整体准确率从11.6%提高到27.3% ，使用Gemini-3.1-Pro将整体准确率从39.8%提高到45.1% ，优于相应的ReAct搜索代理，这表明更好的查询公式和搜索后候选选择提高了端到端的浏览性能。
highlights: Our analysis reveals that the main bottleneck lies before video understanding: agents often fail to find the answer-bear

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: Verifier-Grounded Agentic RL for Provably Correct Code
papers.summary:
Reinforcement learning for code usually rewards passing tests, which a model can do while remaining wrong on the inputs the tests do not cover. 代码的强化学习通常会奖励通过测试，模型可以在测试未覆盖的输入上保持错误的情况下执行此操作。
A program verifier instead decides whether a program satisfies a formal specification for all inputs. 相反，程序验证器决定程序是否满足所有输入的形式规范。
Language models are almost always paired with verifiers at inference time only, and turning a verifier into a reward raises two difficulties. 语言模型几乎总是仅在推理时与验证器配对，而将验证器转化为奖励会带来两个困难。
It reports only acceptance or rejection, which gives no gradient when every attempt fails, and a policy can cheat it, most simply by telling it to assume what the proof was supposed to establish. 它只报告接受或拒绝，每次尝试失败时都不会给出梯度，政策可以欺骗它，最简单的方法是让它假设证据应该建立什么。
We build an agentic environment and reward that address both. 我们构建了一个代理环境，并奖励这两者。
The reward reads the verifier's diagnostics rather than its verdict, scoring a candidate by the weighted fraction of proof obligations it discharges, extended with hidden probes from a reference proof's annotations. 奖励读取验证者的诊断而不是其判决，根据其履行的证明义务的加权分数对候选者进行评分，并从参考证明的注释中扩展隐藏探针。
An integrity audit outranks the verifier, rejecting any candidate that alters the specification or assumes what it was meant to prove. 诚信审计的排名高于验证者，拒绝任何改变规范或假设其目的是证明的候选人。
The model works as an agent against a live verifier over many turns, with a separately trained proof specialist as a frozen collaborator. 该模型在多个回合中作为代理与实时验证者对抗，并由经过单独培训的证明专家作为冻结的合作者。
Across Qwen3 models from 1.7B to 14B and a 35B Qwen3.6 mixture-of-experts model, held-out verification on code generation rises from 66.1% to 93.5% on DafnyBench and from 56.3% to 100% on SWE-Proof. 在从1.7B到14B的Qwen3模型和35B Qwen3.6混合专家模型中， DafnyBench的代码生成验证从66.1%上升到93.5% ， SWE-Proof从56.3%上升到100%。
This reward leads every other training signal we compare, including a binary pass-or-fail reward trained under otherwise identical settings, with the widest margin on code generation. 这种奖励领先于我们比较的所有其他训练信号，包括在其他相同设置下训练的二进制通过或失败奖励，并且在代码生成上的余量最大。
When the agent must also deliver the repository patch, graded by each project's withheld tests, the fraction of held-out issues it resolves rises from 59.6% to 72.5%. 当代理还必须提供存储库补丁时，根据每个项目的扣留测试进行分级，其解决的扣留问题的比例从59.6%上升到72.5%。
Evaluated unchanged on three verification suites withheld from training, the checkpoints improve on all of them, including one whose language and verifier are absent from training. 对三个未接受培训的验证套件进行评估后，所有检查点都得到了改善，其中包括一个语言和验证者缺席培训的检查点。
highlights: Reinforcement learning for code usually rewards passing tests, which a model can do while remaining wrong on the inputs

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: SWE-Spot: Building Small Repo-Experts with Repository-Centric Learning
papers.summary:
The deployment of coding agents in privacy-sensitive and resource-constrained environments drives the demand for capable open-weight Small Language Models (SLMs). 在隐私敏感和资源受限的环境中部署编码代理，推动了对功能强大的开放式小型语言模型(SLM)的需求。
However, they suffer from a fundamental capability gap: unlike frontier large models, they lack the inference-time strong generalization to handle complicated, unfamiliar codebases. 然而，它们存在根本的能力差距：与前沿大型模型不同，它们缺乏处理复杂、不熟悉的代码库的推理时间强泛化。
We identify that the prevailing Task-Centric Learning (TCL) approach, which scales exposure across disparate repositories, fails to address this limitation. 我们发现，主流的以任务为中心的学习（ TCL ）方法未能解决这一局限性，该方法在不同的存储库中扩展暴露。
In response, we propose Repository-Centric Learning (RCL), a shift that prioritizes vertical, single-repository depth over horizontal, single-task breadth for SLM training. 作为回应，我们提出了以存储库为中心的学习（ RCL ） ，这种转变优先考虑了SLM培训的垂直、单存储库深度而不是水平、单任务广度。
To accomplish this depth, we design a four-unit Repository-Centric Experience, transforming static codebases into interactive learning signals, to train SWE-Spot-4B, a family of highly compact models built as repo-specialized experts. 为了实现这一深度，我们设计了一个由四个单元组成的以存储库为中心的体验，将静态代码库转换为交互式学习信号，以培训SWE-Spot-4B ，这是一个高度紧凑的模型系列，作为存储库专业化专家构建。
Under controlled comparisons with the same teacher and data budget, RCL consistently outperforms TCL across tasks, teachers, model scales, and programming languages. 在同一教师和数据预算的受控比较下， RCL在任务、教师、模型量表和编程语言方面始终优于TCL。
On seven target repositories, SWE-Spot-4B experts match or exceed existing open-weight models up to $8\times$ larger (e.g., CWM by Meta, Qwen3-Coder-30B) and surpass or match efficiency-focused commercial models (e.g., GPT-4.1-mini, GPT-5-nano) across multiple SWE tasks. 在七个目标存储库中， SWE-Spot-4B专家匹配或超过现有的开放权重模型，最高可达$ 8\ times $ （例如， Meta的CWM ， Qwen3-Coder-30B ） ，并在多个SWE任务中超过或匹配以效率为重点的商业模型（例如， GPT-4.1-mini ， GPT-5-nano ）。
Further analysis reveals that RCL yields higher training and inference efficiency, deep knowledge acquisition, and can scale to repository-cluster experts. 进一步分析表明， RCL可以产生更高的培训和推理效率，深度知识获取，并可以扩展到存储库集群专家。
Our work emphasizes that for building efficient intelligence, repository mastery is a distinct, necessary, and practical dimension that complements general coding capability. 我们的工作强调，为了构建高效的智能，存储库掌握是一个独特、必要和实用的维度，是对一般编码能力的补充。

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: Harness^2: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World
papers.summary:
LLM agents' capabilities depend not only on their underlying models but also on their execution harnesses. LLM代理的能力不仅取决于其基础模型，还取决于其执行利用。
Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a promising approach to automatically evolve these harnesses. 递归自我改进（ RSI ）提供了一种有希望的方法来自动发展这些线束。
However, deploying RSI in open-world settings still faces two critical challenges. 然而，在开放世界中部署RSI仍然面临两个关键挑战。
First, open-world tasks are typically unseen during the harness design phase and novel at test time, leaving no ground-truth verifiers to reliably guide online harness edits. 首先，开放世界的任务在线束设计阶段通常是看不到的，在测试时是新颖的，没有留下可靠地指导在线束编辑的地面真相验证器。
Second, the RSI process remains highly task-specific and fails to generalize to novel scenarios. 其次， RSI过程仍然具有高度的任务特定性，无法推广到新颖的场景。
We introduce Harness^2, a plug-and-play, recursive agent harnessing framework that addresses these challenges through two connected levels of recursion. 我们引入了线束^ 2 ，这是一个即插即用的递归代理利用框架，通过两个相互关联的递归级别来解决这些挑战。
Task-level recursion refines the current task's harness using a contrastive Propose-Probe-Compose step that reliably guides edits without ground-truth verifiers, and can be scaled further via parallel or sequential recursion. 任务级递归使用对比的Propose-Probe-Compose步骤来优化当前任务的线束，该步骤在没有地面真实性验证器的情况下可靠地指导编辑，并且可以通过并行或顺序递归进一步缩放。
Harnessing-level recursion then extracts experience from these edits to update a continual improvement harness, enabling the agent to better adapt to future tasks. 利用级别递归然后从这些编辑中提取经验，以更新持续改进利用，使代理能够更好地适应未来的任务。
Across three professional benchmarks and four model-harness configurations, a single step consistently improves GLM-5 and Gemini 3.5 Flash over their base harnesses, yielding gains of up to 11.5 points on WorkBuddy-Bench, 4.5 points on JobBench, and 11.8 percentage points on LAB, with further gains as the task-level recursion budget increases. 在三个专业基准和四个模型线束配置中，单一步骤不断改进GLM-5和Gemini 3.5 Flash的基础线束，在WorkBuddy-Bench上获得高达11.5分的收益，在JobBench上获得4.5分，在实验室获得11.8个百分点，随着任务级递归预算的增加，进一步获得收益。
highlights: LLM agents' capabilities depend not only on their underlying models but also on their execution harnesses.

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: EvoCowork: A Benchmark for Real-World Office Tasks
papers.summary:
Office workflows are a demanding testbed for self-improving agents because their deliverables must be correct, natively editable, and mutually consistent. 对于自我改进的代理而言， Office工作流是一个苛刻的测试平台，因为它们的可交付成果必须正确、本机可编辑且相互一致。
A central question is whether gains on feedback tasks reflect reusable procedures rather than task-specific fixes. 一个核心问题是，反馈任务的收益是否反映了可重复使用的程序，而不是特定于任务的修复。
We introduce EvoCowork, a 240-task benchmark for evaluating harness-level recursive self-improvement across four office modalities, with model weights held fixed. 我们引入了EvoCowork ，这是一个240项任务的基准，用于评估四种办公模式的线束级递归自我改进，模型权重保持不变。
The benchmark covers presentations, documents, spreadsheets, and cross-office workflows, and scores submitted artifacts for content, native structure, formulas, cross-file consistency, and visual quality where needed. 该基准涵盖演示文稿、文档、电子表格和跨部门工作流程，并在需要时对提交的内容、原生结构、公式、交叉文件一致性和视觉质量进行评分。
Its protocol separates feedback, revision selection, and final testing: methods learn from single-modality tasks, then are evaluated on unseen single-modality tasks and cross-office workflows under a shared initial harness and explicit budgets. 其协议将反馈、修订选择和最终测试分开：方法从单模态任务中学习，然后在共享的初始线束和显式预算下根据看不见的单模态任务和跨部门工作流程进行评估。
In static evaluations of two models and four harnesses, the best configuration scores 42.25 overall and 30.62 on cross-office tasks. 在两种型号和四种线束的静态评估中，最佳配置总体得分为42.25 ，跨部门任务得分为30.62。
Starting from the same MSA harness with GLM 5.3, ACE and AHE improve in-domain scores by 4.90 and 2.64 points, respectively, but change cross-office scores by only +0.03 and -1.72. 从与GLM 5.3相同的MSA线束开始， ACE和AHE分别将域内分数提高了4.90和2.64分，但仅将跨部门分数提高了+0.03和-1.72。
Thus, gains on the file types that provide feedback do not necessarily transfer to coordinated workflows. 因此，提供反馈的文件类型的增益不一定会转移到协调的工作流中。
EvoCowork makes this distinction explicit while recording the capability, transfer, and cost of harness evolution. EvoCowork在记录线束演进的能力、转移和成本的同时，明确了这一区别。
Code and task packages: https://github.com/DeepThinkingZhouLiu/cowork-evolution-benchmark. 代码和任务包： https://github.com/DeepThinkingZhouLiu/cowork-evolution-benchmark。
highlights: A central question is whether gains on feedback tasks reflect reusable procedures rather than task-specific fixes.

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: Trace Evolution Bench: Measuring Whether Agents Improve from Their Own Environment Traces
papers.summary:
Self-evolving agents are usually scored by endpoint Gain: held-out success after an update minus success before. 自我进化药剂通常按终点增益评分：更新后保持成功减去之前的成功。
That difference can credit a frozen rescore as evolution. 这种差异可以归功于冻结的重新评分作为进化。
We introduce Trace Evolution Bench (TEB), a protocol that separates that rescore from a context or weight update, together with three frozen 80/20/40 packs. 我们引入了Trace Evolution Bench （ TEB ） ，这是一种将重新评分与上下文或权重更新分开的协议，以及三个冷冻的80/20/40内容包。
An update is accepted only when validation does not fall, held-out identifiers never enter the update, and a text update is not ranked with a weight update. 只有在验证未失败、保留标识符从未进入更新以及文本更新未与权重更新进行排名时，才接受更新。
The primary scoreboard is coding, graded by hidden unit tests in a closed workspace. 主要记分牌是编码，由封闭工作空间中的隐藏单元测试评分。
On that pack (40 held-out tasks, one family), DeepSeek v4 Pro under no_evolve never changes its policy yet moves 7.5, 5.0, and 12.5 percentage points across three seeds. 在该包（ 40个未完成的任务，一个系列）上， no_evolve下的DeepSeek v4 Pro从未更改其策略，但在三个种子中移动了7.5、5.0和12.5个百分点。
Of nine text-update cells inspired by GEPA, ACE, and ExpeL, seven have positive excess above that seed's own band, and one gepa_llm seed moves down by the width of its band (-12.5, regression 0.48). 在受GEPA、ACE和ExpeL启发的九个文本更新细胞中，七个细胞的正过剩高于种子自己的条带，一个gepa_llm种子向下移动其条带的宽度（ -12.5 ，回归0.48 ）。
GLM and MiniMax do not reproduce that seven-of-nine pattern. GLM和MiniMax不重现九分之七的模式。
No method stays above its own band on every seed of all three models: GLM has two paired cells above their own bands, and MiniMax expel_llm seed 44 is a third (regression 0.30). 在所有三个模型的每个种子上，没有方法保持在自己的带之上： GLM在自己的带之上有两个成对的细胞，而MiniMax EXPEL_LLM种子44是第三个（回归0.30 ）。
The methods were fixed on a validation screen before held-out was read. 在读取保留的方法之前，将方法固定在验证屏幕上。
Office, graded by rule-bounded delivery, and manufacturing table QA are separate packs: office DeepSeek does not exceed its own bands (widest 17.5 points), and manufacturing has no paired positive excess beyond its seed band. Office （按受规则约束的交付分级）和制造表QA是单独的包装： Office DeepSeek不超过自己的频带（最宽的17.5分） ，制造业没有超出其种子频带的成对正过剩。

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: SpecForge: Recursive Self-Improvement for Coding Agents via Behavioral Specifications
papers.summary:
Coding agents based on frozen language models can improve their performance by refining the external context they rely on, without updating model weights. 基于冻结语言模型的编码代理可以通过优化其所依赖的外部上下文来提高其性能，而无需更新模型权重。
We study recursive self-improvement through behavioral specifications: natural-language code documentation that describes the behavior of program entities and guides agents in generating correct code. 我们通过行为规范研究递归自我改进：自然语言代码文档，描述程序实体的行为，并指导代理生成正确的代码。
We formulate a self-improvement loop in which an agent generates code from its current specifications, evaluates it with execution-verified tests, and refines the specifications based on observed failures. 我们制定了一个自我改进循环，其中代理根据其当前规范生成代码，通过执行验证测试对其进行评估，并根据观察到的故障完善规范。
The improved specifications then guide subsequent generation, progressively improving the agent's understanding of the codebase. 然后，改进的规范指导后续生成，逐步提高代理对代码库的理解。
However, recursive refinement is challenging because program entities are interdependent. 然而，递归细化具有挑战性，因为程序实体是相互依赖的。
Improving the specification of one entity can inadvertently degrade the correctness of others, a phenomenon we call output coupling. 改进一个实体的规范可能会无意中降低其他实体的正确性，这种现象我们称之为输出耦合。
This creates a whack-a-mole effect in which local improvements cause regressions elsewhere, preventing consistent progress. 这产生了一种鼹鼠效应，其中局部改善会导致其他地方的倒退，从而阻止持续的进展。
We introduce SpecForge, a multi-frontier tree search framework that addresses this challenge with three mechanisms: (i) Pareto-guided state selection preserves complementary specification states and prevents premature commitment; (ii) dependency-constrained entity selection prioritizes callee-before-caller refinement; and (iii) error-diversified expansion explores multiple refinements using different subsets of test failures. 我们引入了SpecForge ，这是一个多前沿树搜索框架，通过三种机制解决这一挑战： （ i ）帕累托引导的状态选择保留了互补的规范状态并防止过早的承诺； （ ii ）依赖性受限的实体选择优先考虑被调用方在调用方之前的细化；以及（ iii ）错误多样化扩展探索使用不同子集的测试失败的多个细化。
On DevEval+, SpecForge achieves the best performance across five backbone models, including a 94.9% solve rate with Claude-4.5-Sonnet and a 5.7-percentage-point average improvement over the strongest baseline. 在DevEval +上， SpecForge在五个骨干模型中实现了最佳性能，包括Claude-4.5-Sonnet的解决率为94.9% ，平均比最强基线提高了5.7个百分点。
The improved specifications also make the agent better at tasks outside the loop: they transfer to cross-language translation and to new-feature implementation, where they outperform the benchmark-provided requirement documents. 改进的规范还使代理更好地执行循环外的任务：它们转移到跨语言翻译和新功能实现，在那里它们的表现优于基准提供的需求文档。

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: Verifier-Harness Co-Evolution for Training-Free Self-Improvement on Open-Ended Tasks
papers.summary:
Training-free self-improvement lets an agent use feedback to revise the response it is about to return and to update the harness state that shapes how it handles later tasks. 无需培训的自我提升可让客服代表使用反馈来修改即将返回的回复，并更新影响其处理后续任务的方式的线束状态。
On open-ended tasks that feedback rarely comes from reference answers or executable tests, so the agent has to rely on a model-based verifier. 在开放式任务中，反馈很少来自参考答案或可执行测试，因此代理必须依赖于基于模型的验证器。
When the verifier is wrong, the current response can get worse, and misleading experience can persist across the task stream. 当验证者出错时，当前的响应可能会变得更糟，并且误导性体验可能会在任务流中持续存在。
A verifier that never changes also grows stale as the agent's responses improve and task demands shift. 随着客服代表的回应有所改善，任务需求发生变化，永远不会改变的验证者也会变得陈旧。
We introduce Unified Co-Evolution (UCoE), a training-free method that evolves an executable verifier program together with the agent's harness state while all model parameters stay fixed. 我们引入了统一协同进化（ UCoE ） ，这是一种无需培训的方法，可将可执行验证程序与代理的线束状态一起进化，同时所有模型参数保持不变。
UCoE synthesizes candidate verifier programs and tests them on response contrasts, pairs of responses that differ in one declared property and have a known preferred side. UCoE合成候选验证程序，并根据响应对比度对它们进行测试，这些响应对在一个声明的属性中不同，并且具有已知的首选侧。
It selects the candidate whose discrimination on its weakest contrast family is highest, a quantity we call driving capacity. 它选择对最弱对比度家族的歧视最高的候选人，我们称之为驾驶能力。
The selected verifier diagnoses one weakness in each draft, guides a single repair, decides which response is served, and determines whether the accepted repair may enter the harness state. 所选验证者诊断每个草案中的一个弱点，指导单个维修，决定提供哪个响应，并确定接受的维修是否可能进入线束状态。
As tasks complete, their diagnostics seed new candidate verifiers, which must beat the current verifier on the same contrasts before adoption. 随着任务的完成，他们的诊断会播种新的候选验证器，这些验证器在采用之前必须在相同的对比度上击败当前的验证器。
Across six open-ended benchmarks, UCoE averages 59.00% preference against matched direct generation with Qwen3-8B and 57.19% with Qwen3.8-27B, margins of 9.00 and 7.19 percentage points. 在六个开放式基准中， UCoE的平均偏好率为59.00 ％ ， Qwen3-8B为57.19 ％ ， Qwen3.8-27B为57.19 ％ ，利润率为9.00和7.19个百分点。
On three verifiable benchmarks, the same method raises the mean from 36.06% for direct generation to 38.48%. 在三个可验证的基准上，相同的方法将直接发电的平均值从36.06%提高到38.48%。
Code is available at https://github.com/tianyi0216/Unified-Co-Evolution. 优惠码可在https://github.com/tianyi0216/Unified-Co-Evolution上获得。

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: ECG-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Targeted Electrocardiogram Waveform Evolution
papers.summary:
Electrocardiogram (ECG) models need supervision that targets evolving weaknesses and remains faithful to waveform evidence. 心电图（ ECG ）模型需要针对不断变化的弱点进行监督，并始终忠实于波形证据。
We introduce ECG-RSI, a recursive self-improvement framework combining verified waveform synthesis with feedback-guided intervention search. 我们引入了ECG-RSI ，这是一种将经过验证的波形合成与反馈引导的干预搜索相结合的递归自我改进框架。
Signal remeasurement verifies waveform edits; construction errors guide generator repair, while learner errors motivate interventions compared on a separate selection set. 信号重新测量验证波形编辑；构造错误指导生成器修复，而学习者错误激励干预措施在单独的选择集上进行比较。
Across seven benchmarks, three rounds raise Qwen3.5-35B-A3B's mean question-answering accuracy from 34.57% to 56.04% and mean classification F1 from 24.27 to 34.03. 在七个基准中，三轮将Qwen3.5-35B-A3B的平均问答准确率从34.57%提高到56.04% ，平均分类F1从24.27提高到34.03。
Across the retained trajectory, the preferred supervision shifts from direct reinforcement to confusion-focused contrasts. 在保留的轨迹上，首选的监督从直接强化转变为以混乱为中心的对比。
Continued feedback correction yields diminishing external gains. 持续的反馈修正会减少外部收益。
These results motivate separating error diagnosis from intervention selection and checking whether gains on the feedback set transfer to independent benchmarks. 这些结果促使将错误诊断与干预选择分开，并检查反馈集的增益是否转移到独立的基准。

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: Output Discipline Sets the Floor: A Falsification-Guided, Model-Agnostic Agent Protocol for Auditable Hypothesis-Driven Decision Making
papers.summary:
What binds large language models on auditable, hypothesis-driven decision tasks, where every candidate can be checked against the evidence? 是什么将大型语言模型与可审计、假设驱动的决策任务结合在一起，每个候选人都可以根据证据进行检查？
On the public TCMEval-SDT benchmark for Traditional Chinese Medicine syndrome differentiation (200 cases), the binding constraint is output discipline and reasoning structure, not model capability alone: two years of model scaling move zero-shot scores by only -0.03 to +0.08, while output-discipline failures (non-terminating reasoning, format non-compliance, large run-to-run spread) persist even in frontier models. 在中医辨证的公共TCMEval-SDT基准（ 200例）上，约束约束是输出纪律和推理结构，而不仅仅是模型能力：两年的模型缩放仅将零点得分移动了-0.03到+0.08 ，而输出纪律失效（非终止推理，格式不合规，大量运行到运行传播）甚至在前沿模型中仍然存在。
We test this with a model-agnostic agent framework formalizing decision making as a five-stage closed loop, enforced by a candidate x evidence matrix falsification protocol: every candidate is judged against every evidence item, at least half of the candidates must be falsified before a conclusion is licensed, and survivors are emitted in a machine-verifiable single-line format. 我们使用与模型无关的代理框架对此进行测试，该框架将决策形式化为五个阶段的闭环，通过候选x证据矩阵伪造协议强制执行：根据每个证据项目来判断每个候选，在获得许可之前必须至少有一半的候选人被伪造，并且幸存者以机器可验证的单行格式发出。
Across five base models, the effect is sign-conditional on zero-shot output discipline: it rescues models whose discipline fails (DeepSeek-V4-Flash: +0.267/+0.271, entirely termination rescue), reduces a high-variance model's run-to-run standard deviation from 0.218 to 0.007 (Kimi K3), and significantly costs already-disciplined models (-0.087 to -0.120 on budget-matched Qwen3-4B/32B). 在五个基本模型中，对零射输出纪律的影响是符号条件的：它挽救纪律失败的模型（ DeepSeek-V4-Flash ： +0.267/+0 .271 ，完全终止挽救） ，将高方差模型的运行标准差从0.218降至0.007 （ Kimi K3 ） ，并显著降低已有纪律的模型的成本（预算匹配的Qwen3-4B/32B为-0.087至-0.120 ）。
Ablations attribute the cost to the candidate-bounded format layer and show the effect is independent of injected knowledge content (protocol-knowledge decoupling). 消融将成本归因于候选受限的格式层，并显示效果独立于注入的知识内容（协议-知识解耦）。
The protocol also transfers to misinformation-robust mathematical reasoning, detecting injected false premises at 89.8% recall with a 6.8% false-positive rate (MCC 0.54; a flag-everything baseline scores 0) and restoring accuracy to the no-misinformation ceiling. 该方案还转向错误信息强健的数学推理，以89.8%的召回率检测注射虚假前提，假阳性率为6.8% （ MCC 0.54 ；标记一切基线得分0 ） ，并恢复无错误信息上限的准确性。
Where zero-shot output discipline is weak, the reasoning protocol sets the floor; base-model capability always sets the ceiling. 在零拍输出纪律较弱的地方，推理协议设定底线；基本模型能力始终设定上限。
highlights: What binds large language models on auditable, hypothesis-driven decision tasks, where every candidate can be checked ag

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: LLM Agents for Automated Post-Training via Structured Recipe Optimization
papers.summary:
Automated post-training transforms pre-trained large language models (LLMs) into models capable of handling diverse domains by automatically constructing and optimizing a recipe of coupled decisions over data sources, data processing, cross-domain composition, and training configuration under a limited experimental budget. 自动训练后，在有限的实验预算下，通过自动构建和优化数据源、数据处理、跨域组合和训练配置的耦合决策配方，将预训练的大型语言模型（ LLM ）转换为能够处理不同领域的模型。
Existing automation either searches predefined recipe spaces that enable systematic optimization but remain fixed rather than adapting their available choices to the target tasks, or uses open-ended agents that discover task-specific choices but leave them implicit in trial-level edits, limiting their systematic reuse and recombination across trials. 现有的自动化要么搜索预定义的配方空间，以实现系统优化，但保持固定状态，而不是根据目标任务调整其可用选择，要么使用开放式代理来发现特定任务的选择，但将其隐含在试用级编辑中，从而限制它们在试用中的系统重用和重组。
To fill this gap, we introduce optimization over a task-adapted recipe space, a novel paradigm that can adapt the recipe space itself to the target tasks while representing its choices explicitly for systematic reuse, recombination, and joint optimization. 为了填补这一空白，我们引入了任务适应配方空间的优化，这是一种新颖的范式，可以使配方空间本身适应目标任务，同时明确表示其选择以进行系统重用、重组和关节优化。
We instantiate this paradigm with Structured Recipe Optimization (SRO), comprising an LLM-based Recipe-Space Designer that constructs the task-adapted recipe space and a Multi-Domain Recipe Optimizer that uses structured trial evidence to guide LLM candidate construction and multi-objective Bayesian trial selection. 我们使用结构化配方优化（ SRO ）实例化此范式，其中包括基于LLM的配方空间设计器（构建任务适应的配方空间）和多域配方优化器（使用结构化试验证据来指导LLM候选人构建和多目标贝叶斯试验选择）。
Extensive experiments show that SRO achieves the highest average score in all evaluated target-model and agent-LLM combinations. 广泛的实验表明，在所有评估的目标模型和Agent-LLM组合中， SRO达到了最高的平均分数。
In joint post-training across three capability domains and six benchmarks, SRO reaches 41.1 versus 15.4 for the strongest baseline on Qwen3-1.7B with GPT-5.4, and 53.8 versus 40.8 on Qwen3-4B with DeepSeek-V4-Flash. 在跨三个能力域和六个基准的联合训练后， SRO在Qwen3-1.7B和GPT-5.4上的最强基线分别达到41.1和15.4 ，在Qwen3-4B和DeepSeek-V4-Flash上的最强基线分别达到53.8和40.8。
Our code is available at https://github.com/RuohLiuq/SRO. 我们的代码可在https://github.com/RuohLiuq/SRO上找到。
highlights: Extensive experiments show that SRO achieves the highest average score in all evaluated target-model and agent-LLM combi

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: Humans vs. Machines: A Comparison With AI Agents in Software Reverse Engineering
papers.summary:
Can an autonomous AI agent reverse engineer a binary as well as a skilled human analyst? 自主人工智能代理可以对二进制文件进行逆向工程，也可以对熟练的人类分析师进行逆向工程吗？
Do they adopt the same strategy, and can agents scale to real-world programs? 他们是否采用相同的策略，代理是否可以扩展到现实世界的计划？
We compare human and LLM-based software reverse engineering (SRE): nine models tackle two compact static-analysis challenges previously solved by human analysts, scored with a common understanding rubric, and we record their complete interactions with IDA Pro. 我们比较了人类和基于LLM的软件逆向工程（ SRE ） ：九个模型解决了之前由人类分析师解决的两个紧凑的静态分析挑战，并使用共同的理解评分标准进行评分，我们记录了他们与IDA Pro的完整交互。
This lets us compare not only what humans and agents recover, but also how they investigate a binary. 这不仅可以让我们比较人类和智能体的恢复情况，还可以让我们比较他们如何调查二进制文件。
The best agents (GPT-5.5 Pro, Claude Opus 4.8, and Kimi K3) achieve statistically human-competitive understanding on both tasks, while weaker models remain far behind. 最好的代理（ GPT-5.5 Pro、Claude Opus 4.8和Kimi K3 ）在这两项任务上都实现了统计学上的人类竞争理解，而较弱的模型仍然远远落后。
Ablations show that the gap depends on code representation and workflow demands, not on model capability alone: open-weight models improve substantially with richer code representations, whereas frontier models show no significant change. 消融表明，差距取决于代码表示和工作流需求，而不仅仅取决于模型能力：开放权重模型随着更丰富的代码表示而大幅改善，而前沿模型则没有显着变化。
Similar success rates hide different workflows. 类似的成功率会隐藏不同的工作流程。
Humans repeatedly revisit functions and follow local program structure; strong agents jump across the binary, retrieve information broadly, and rarely return to inspected code, a behavior we call greedy fetching. 人类反复重温函数并遵循本地程序结构；强代理跳过二进制文件，广泛检索信息，很少返回到被检查的代码，这种行为我们称之为贪婪获取。
This strategy is not fixed: given semantically richer code, agents fetch less without losing understanding. 这种策略不是固定的：给定语义更丰富的代码，代理获取更少而不会失去理解。
Because greedy fetching aggregates large amounts of code in the agent's context, we measure context-window saturation across 4,000 real-world binaries: large windows accommodate many programs, but larger applications and lower-level representations quickly exhaust them. 由于贪婪获取在代理的上下文中聚合了大量代码，因此我们测量了4,000个真实世界二进制文件的上下文窗口饱和度：大窗口可容纳许多程序，但较大的应用程序和较低级别的表示会很快耗尽它们。
Autonomous reverse engineering is becoming competitive, with a large speed advantage, but scaling it will require better navigation, selective retrieval, and persistent analysis state, not merely larger context windows. 自主逆向工程正在变得具有竞争力，具有很大的速度优势，但扩展它将需要更好的导航、选择性检索和持久分析状态，而不仅仅是更大的上下文窗口。
highlights: Can an autonomous AI agent reverse engineer a binary as well as a skilled human analyst?

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: DeltaTTG: Training Multi-Turn Agents with a Token-to-Go Progress Meter
papers.summary:
Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) for multi-turn agents relies on sparse terminal rewards that say little about individual steps. 针对多回合座席的可验证奖励强化学习（ RLVR ）依赖于稀疏的终端奖励，而这些终端奖励对单个步骤的影响很小。
Within-group step comparisons depend on reliable state matching and sufficiently diverse sampled outcomes, while direct step scoring may require costly external evaluators, human annotations, or task-specific heuristics. 组内分步比较依赖于可靠的状态匹配和足够多样化的采样结果，而直接分步评分可能需要昂贵的外部评估人员、人工注释或特定任务的启发式方法。
We introduce DeltaTTG to learn a reusable progress signal through a shared progress meter, using low-cost supervision from diverse policies' recorded trajectories without task-specific progress rules. 我们引入DeltaTTG ，通过共享进度计学习可重用的进度信号，使用来自不同政策记录轨迹的低成本监督，而无需特定任务的进度规则。
Its supervision target, Token-to-Go (TTG), the number of tokens remaining to be generated until task completion, serves as an observable proxy for remaining completion effort. 其监督目标Token-to-Go （ TTG ） ，即在任务完成之前剩余待生成的代币数量，可作为剩余完成工作的可观察代理。
During actor training, changes in the frozen meter's estimates redistribute outcome-derived advantages across steps without altering the reward, preserving each trajectory's advantage sign and token-average scale. 在演员培训期间，冻结仪表估计值的变化在不改变奖励的情况下跨步骤重新分配结果派生的优势，保留每个轨迹的优势符号和令牌平均尺度。
On ALFWorld, PaperSearchQA, and BFCLv3, DeltaTTG improves the average score over GRPO by 5.7 and 7.2 points with Qwen3-4B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, respectively, outperforms all compared RL baselines on average, and keeps actor-training GPU-hours close to GRPO. 在ALFWorld、PaperSearchQA和BFCLv3上， DeltaTTG分别使用Qwen3-4B和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct将GRPO的平均分数提高了5.7和7.2分，平均优于所有比较RL基线，并使参与者培训GPU小时接近GRPO。
Further experiments show improved sample efficiency and out-of-domain performance, and support the meter's ability to distinguish step quality and guide test-time action selection across actor sizes. 进一步的实验表明，提高了样本效率和域外性能，并支持仪表区分步骤质量和引导跨演员大小的测试时间动作选择的能力。
The code is available at https://github.com/Xuyan923r/DeltaTTG. 该代码可在https://github.com/Xuyan923r/DeltaTTG上获得。
highlights: outperforms all compared RL baselines on average

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: GIFT-Eval-CTX: A Benchmark For Contextual Forecasting Model Evaluation
papers.summary:
Contextual forecasting seeks to improve time series forecasting by incorporating forward-looking information, such as planned events, external conditions, and expert expectations. 情境预测旨在通过整合前瞻性信息（如计划事件、外部条件和专家期望）来改进时间序列预测。
However, reliable evaluation remains difficult: existing benchmarks often have limited domain coverage, lack standardized history-future splits, or provide text that is not guaranteed to inform the future. 然而，可靠的评估仍然很困难：现有的基准通常具有有限的领域覆盖范围，缺乏标准化的历史-未来分割，或者提供的文本不能保证为未来提供信息。
We introduce GIFT-Eval-CTX, a benchmark that isolates whether forecasting methods can translate verified future information into accurate numerical trajectories. 我们引入了GIFT-Eval-CTX ，这是一个基准，用于隔离预测方法是否可以将经过验证的未来信息转化为准确的数字轨迹。
Built upon GIFT-Eval, GIFT-Eval-CTX contains 10,000 instances across 20 datasets. GIFT-Eval-CTX基于GIFT-Eval构建，包含20个数据集中的10,000个实例。
Each instance provides structured effects derived from the realized future: Macro effects describe horizon-wide behavior, while Micro effects specify localized changes. 每个实例都提供源自已实现未来的结构化效果：宏观效果描述整个视野范围内的行为，而微观效果指定局部变化。
We construct these annotations with an agentic pipeline combining LLM-based discovery and deterministic code validation. 我们使用基于LLM的发现和确定性代码验证相结合的代理流水线构建这些注释。
We benchmark TSFMs, frontier LLMs, and tool-using agentic systems. 我们对TSFM、前沿LLM和使用工具的代理系统进行基准测试。
The results show that structured effects reduce aggregate relative MASE by 40.7% for GPT-5.6 Sol and 29.6% for Claude Opus 4.8 relative to history-only prompting. 结果表明，相对于纯历史提示， GPT-5.6 Sol和Claude Opus 4.8的结构化效应使聚合相对MASE降低了40.7% ，而Claude Opus 4.8的结构化效应使聚合相对Mase降低了29.6%。
The evaluated MoiraiAgent system achieves the best overall result. 经过评估的MoiraiAgent系统实现了最佳的整体效果。
We further analyze the contributions of structured effects and agentic systems to performance, and identify opportunities for future research. 我们进一步分析了结构效应和代理系统对绩效的贡献，并确定了未来研究的机会。
highlights: Built upon GIFT-Eval, GIFT-Eval-CTX contains 10,000 instances across 20 datasets.

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: Tev: Scaling Long-Horizon Agentic Environments with Dense Progress Rewards
papers.summary:
Long-horizon agents have drawn growing attention for their ability to work autonomously -- from hours to days -- on economically valuable tasks, a capability essential to automated discovery and recursive self-improvement (RSI). 长期代理因其能够自主工作（从几小时到几天）执行具有经济价值的任务的能力而受到越来越多的关注，这是自动发现和递归自我改进（ RSI ）所必需的能力。
Yet open-source models still struggle on long-horizon tasks, largely for lack of both training data and a working recipe, and scaling both is hard: long, complex tasks are difficult to curate and verify, and their rewards are sparse. 然而，开源模型仍然在长期任务上苦苦挣扎，主要是因为缺乏训练数据和工作配方，两者都很难扩展：冗长、复杂的任务很难策划和验证，而且它们的回报很少。
We address both. 我们同时处理这两个问题。
First, we introduce Tev-Gym, the first long-horizon agent training dataset with verifiable, dense, progressive rewards -- 1,170 verified task environments across 7 domains. 首先，我们介绍了Tev-Gym ，这是第一个具有可验证、密集、渐进奖励的长视野座席培训数据集--跨7个领域的1,170个经过验证的任务环境。
It is built on a latent-world-first approach that first constructs a latent world: a complete and correct hidden specification of the task domain, workflow, and expected state after each step. 它建立在潜在世界第一方法之上，该方法首先构建了一个潜在世界：每个步骤后任务域、工作流程和预期状态的完整和正确的隐藏规范。
Each task is then progressively rendered from this specification into an agent-facing environment, enabling controllable complexity and a natural progress metric. 然后，每个任务都从本规范逐渐渲染到面向代理的环境中，从而实现可控的复杂性和自然进度指标。
Second, we turn this metric into a training recipe: via progress-potential reward shaping (PPRS), we convert progress into a dense per-step reward that improves training efficiency and makes otherwise-intractable tasks trainable. 其次，我们将这个指标转化为培训方案：通过进度-潜力奖励塑造（ PPRS ） ，我们将进度转化为密集的每步奖励，从而提高培训效率，并使本来棘手的任务成为可培训的任务。
Training with this recipe yields Tev-27B, which achieves substantial gains on the Agents' Last Exam computing and math sciences domains (ALE-CM), matching GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5 at Pass@5. 使用此配方的培训产生了Tev-27B ，它在代理的期末考试计算和数学科学领域（ ALE-CM ）上取得了可观的收益，与GPT-6 Astra和Claude Opus 5在Pass @ 5相匹配。
Despite training only on ALE-related data, it generalizes to the Terminal-Bench (TB) 3.0 and 4.0 subsets, surpassing GLM 5.2 and Gemini 3.7 Flash, and reaches Claude Opus 4.8-level performance on middle-horizon tasks such as TB 2.1. 尽管仅在ALE相关数据上进行训练，但它推广到终端台（ TB ） 3.0和4.0子集，超过GLM 5.2和Gemini 3.7 Flash ，并在TB 2.1等中间水平任务上达到Claude Opus 4.8级性能。
highlights: first long-horizon agent training dataset with verifiable

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: Detecting Multi-Agent Collusion Through Multi-Agent Interpretability
papers.summary:
As LLM agents are increasingly deployed in multi-agent systems, they introduce risks of covert coordination that may evade standard forms of human oversight. 随着LLM代理越来越多地部署在多代理系统中，它们引入了可能逃避标准形式的人类监督的秘密协调风险。
While linear probes on model activations have shown promise for detecting deception in single-agent settings, collusion is inherently a multi-agent phenomenon, and the use of internal representations for detecting collusion between agents remains unexplored. 虽然模型激活的线性探针已显示出在单代理设置中检测欺骗的前景，但勾结本质上是一种多代理现象，并且使用内部表示来检测代理之间的勾结仍未得到探索。
We introduce NARCBench, a benchmark for evaluating collusion detection under environment distribution shift, and propose five probing techniques that aggregate per-agent deception scores to classify scenarios at the group level, evaluated across four open-weight models (Qwen3-32B, Llama-3.1-70B, DeepSeek-R1 32B, GPT-OSS-20B) and six probe architectures. 我们引入了NARCBench ，这是评估环境分布变化下的勾结检测的基准，并提出了五种探测技术，汇总每个代理的欺骗分数，以便在组级别对场景进行分类，这些技术在四个开放权重模型（ Qwen3-32B ， Llama-3.1-70B ， DeepSeek-R1 32B ， GPT-OSS-20B ）和六个探测架构中进行了评估。
We frame this as a distributed anomaly detection problem, identifying three collusion signatures that map onto distinct anomaly types and detection paradigms. 我们将其视为分布式异常检测问题，识别映射到不同异常类型和检测范式的三个勾结特征。
Every model reaches 1.00 AUROC in-distribution; on our strongest model (Llama-3.1-70B), our five probing techniques achieve 0.73 to 0.93 AUROC when transferred zero-shot to structurally different multi-agent scenarios and 0.99 to 1.00 on a steganographic blackjack card-counting task, with detection performance scaling with model capability. 每个模型都达到1.00 AUROC分布；在我们最强的模型（ Llama-3.1-70B ）上，我们的五种探测技术在将零点转移到结构不同的多代理场景时实现0.73至0.93 AUROC ，在隐写二十一点卡片计数任务中实现0.99至1.00 ，并具有模型功能的检测性能缩放。
We find that no single probing technique dominates across all collusion types, consistent with the framework's prediction that different anomaly types require different detection paradigms. 我们发现，没有单一的探测技术在所有勾结类型中占主导地位，这与框架的预测一致，即不同的异常类型需要不同的检测范式。
This work takes a step toward multi-agent interpretability: extending white-box inspection from single models to multi-agent contexts, where detection requires aggregating signals across agents. 这项工作朝着多Agent可解释性迈出了一步：将白盒检查从单个模型扩展到多Agent上下文，其中检测需要跨Agent聚合信号。
These results suggest that model internals provide a complementary signal to text-level monitoring for detecting multi-agent collusion. 这些结果表明，模型内部为文本级监控提供了补充信号，用于检测多智能体勾结。
Code and data available at https://github.com/aaronrose227/narcbench. 代码和数据可在https://github.com/aaronrose227/narcbench上获得。

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: Verifiable Process Rewards for Agentic Reasoning
papers.summary:
Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) has improved the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), yet existing approaches predominantly rely on sparse outcome-level feedback, posing a substantial credit-assignment challenge in long-horizon agentic tasks. 可验证奖励强化学习（ RLVR ）提高了大型语言模型（ LLM ）的推理能力，但现有方法主要依赖于稀疏的结果级反馈，在长期代理任务中构成了巨大的信用分配挑战。
In this work, we study structured agentic reasoning problems that admit symbolic or algorithmic task-solving oracles. 在这项工作中，我们研究了承认符号或算法任务解决预言的结构化代理推理问题。
We propose Verifiable Process Rewards (VPR), a training framework that repurposes such task oracles as action-level process verifiers, providing dense rewards for intermediate actions and enabling fine-grained credit assignment. 我们提出了可验证流程奖励（ VPR ） ，这是一种培训框架，将此类任务预言机重新用作行动级流程验证器，为中间行动提供密集的奖励，并实现细粒度的信用分配。
We instantiate VPR in three distinct settings: a search-based oracle for Sokoban, a constraint-based oracle for Sudoku, and a posterior-based oracle for Minesweeper. 我们在三种不同的设置中实例化VPR ：基于搜索的Sokoban预言机，基于约束的Sudoku预言机，以及基于后台的Minesweeper预言机。
To optimize policies with these rewards, we introduce oracle-guided state-group rollout and locally normalized optimization. 为了利用这些奖励优化策略，我们引入了oracle引导的状态组推出和局部归一化优化。
Empirically, VPR-trained Qwen3-4B outperforms outcome-reward GRPO and VinePPO across all three training environments. 根据经验， VPR培训的Qwen3-4B在所有三个培训环境中都优于结果奖励GRPO和VinePPO。
When jointly trained on math data and all three game environments, VPR achieves the highest average general-reasoning performance and strongest agentic results among the compared training configurations. 当在数学数据和所有三个游戏环境中联合训练时， VPR在比较的训练配置中实现了最高的平均一般推理性能和最强的代理结果。
To further assess its applicability to more general agentic tool-use settings, we apply VPR-style action-level supervision to $\tau^2$-bench using an expert LLM as a reference policy and observe improved performance over outcome-reward GRPO on held-out tasks. 为了进一步评估其对更通用的代理工具使用设置的适用性，我们使用专家LLM作为参考政策，将VPR风格的动作级监督应用于$\ tau ^ 2 $ -bench ，并观察到在未完成的任务上，结果奖励GRPO的表现有所改善。
Together, these results position VPR as a promising approach for leveraging reliable task oracles to improve agentic reasoning, while highlighting its dependence on the availability and reliability of task oracles and the challenge of extending intermediate verification to less structured, open-ended environments. 总之，这些结果将VPR定位为一种有前途的方法，可以利用可靠的任务预言机来改进代理推理，同时强调其对任务预言机可用性和可靠性的依赖，以及将中间验证扩展到结构化程度较低的开放式环境的挑战。
highlights: outperforms outcome-reward GRPO and VinePPO across all three training environments
In this work, we study structured agentic reasoning problems that admit symbolic or algorithmic task-solving oracles.

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: Do Agents Know When They Succeed? Calibrating Agent Confidence from Internal Representations
papers.summary:
As agentic systems getting adopted rapidly in safety critical applications, it is vital to measure the confidence associated with the agentic actions. 随着代理系统在安全关键应用中迅速采用，衡量与代理操作相关的信心至关重要。
In comparison to the traditional machine learning systems, agentic workflows have complex failure modes with planning, tool invocation and dynamic environment interactions. 与传统的机器学习系统相比，代理工作流程具有复杂的故障模式，包括计划、工具调用和动态环境交互。
In this paper, we investigate whether model's internal representations provide stronger signals of eventual task success in multi-turn agentic setups. 在本文中，我们研究了模型的内部表示是否在多回合代理设置中提供了最终任务成功的更强信号。
We introduce two complementary methods: Latent Trajectory Dynamics (LTD), which summarizes changes in residual-stream representations across an interaction trajectory, and the Action Representation Probe (ARP), which predicts success from representations formed at action decisions. 我们引入了两种互补的方法：潜在轨迹动力学（ LTD ） ，它总结了交互轨迹中残差流表示的变化，以及动作表示探针（ ARP ） ，它根据行动决策中形成的表示来预测成功。
Across three interactive benchmarks (Bash, SQL, Python) and three model families (Qwen14B, Qwen7B, DeepSeek6.7B), our methods consistently outperform surface level generation and sequence-based calibration baselines providing a zero-overhead reliability monitor that requires neither prompt alterations nor multi-sample rollouts. 在三个交互式基准（ Bash、SQL、Python ）和三个模型系列（ Qwen14B、Qwen7B、DeepSeek6.7B ）中，我们的方法始终优于表面水平生成和基于序列的校准基线，提供了一个既不需要及时更改也不需要多样本部署的零开销可靠性监视器。
highlights: outperform surface level generation and sequence-based calibration baselines providing a zero-overhead reliability monit

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: VETR: Execution-Grounded Self-Improving Agent for Symbolic Graphics Reasoning
papers.summary:
Visual agents for symbolic graphics reasoning depend on executable world representations, yet continued improvement remains bottlenecked by ambiguous supervision from final renders. 符号图形推理的可视化代理依赖于可执行世界表示，但最终渲染的模糊监督仍是持续改进的瓶颈。
Recent agentic systems refine scenes through repeated interaction, but they lack mechanisms to recursively extract actionable evidence from execution traces, overlooking which proposed symbolic edits survived, disappeared, or interfered during program execution. 最近的代理系统通过反复交互来完善场景，但它们缺乏从执行痕迹中递归提取可操作证据的机制，忽略了在程序执行过程中幸存、消失或干扰的拟议符号编辑。
To address this, we propose VETR (Verified Execution Trajectories for Refinement), a framework that enables agentic recursive self-improvement over executable world representations for symbolic graphics reasoning. 为了解决这个问题，我们提出了VETR （ Verified Execution Trajectories for Refinement ） ，这是一个框架，可以对可执行世界表示进行代理递归自我改进，以进行符号图形推理。
Within each task, VETR retains aligned program/render records with bounded runtime observations and introduces an execution refiner that compiles observed writes and state changes into constrained alternative programs. 在每个任务中， VETR保留具有有界运行时观察的对齐程序/渲染记录，并引入执行精简器，将观察到的写入和状态更改编译为受约束的替代程序。
The refiner validates their endpoints and preservation conditions against captured runtime state; the ordinary visual verifier then assesses goal relevance. 精简器根据捕获的运行时状态验证其端点和保存条件；然后，普通视觉验证器评估目标相关性。
Repair construction makes no additional language-model calls, but can require additional executions. 修复构造不进行额外的语言模型调用，但可能需要额外的执行。
Evaluations on BlenderGym (280 tasks) and BlenderBench (27 released tasks) with GPT-5.6-luna and Qwen3.8-27B show that VETR consistently outperforms existing refinement strategies, including BlenderAlchemy and VIGA. 使用GPT-5.6-luna和Qwen3.8-27B对BlenderGym （ 280项任务）和BlenderBench （ 27项已发布的任务）进行的评估表明， VETR始终优于现有的改进策略，包括BlenderAlchemy和VIGA。
Controlled ablations evaluate the contributions of execution refinement and role-asymmetric evidence organization under fixed generator-interaction caps. 受控消融评估固定生成器-交互上限下执行细化和角色-非对称证据组织的贡献。

papers.groupName: 重点跟进（产业界 / 端云结合）
papers.title: TENET: One Step Toward Test-Driven Development for Repository-Level Code Generation
papers.summary:
Test-Driven Development (TDD) is a widely adopted practice that requires developers to create and execute tests alongside implementation. 测试驱动开发（ TDD ）是一种广泛采用的做法，要求开发人员在实施时创建和执行测试。
With recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs), developers can shift from manually writing the code to defining tests as executable specifications and delegating code synthesis to AI agents. 随着大型语言模型（ LLM ）的最新进展，开发人员可以从手动编写代码转向将测试定义为可执行规范并将代码合成委托给AI代理。
However, enabling repository-level TDD under developer-written tests is challenging, requiring: (1) specification enhancement: identifying a concise yet representative test subset from large suites with rich task semantics; (2) retrieval augmentation: using tests to guide reasoning and context retrieval; and (3) test-driven refinement: interpreting test feedback for iterative improvement. 然而，在开发人员编写的测试下启用存储库级TDD具有挑战性，需要： （ 1 ）规范增强：从具有丰富任务语义的大型套件中识别一个简洁而具有代表性的测试子集； （ 2 ）检索增强：使用测试来指导推理和上下文检索； （ 3 ）测试驱动的细化：解释测试反馈以进行迭代改进。
We propose TENET, an agentic framework for repository-level code generation under the TDD paradigm. 我们提出了TENET ，这是一种在TDD范式下用于存储库级代码生成的代理框架。
TENET includes: (1) a test harness mechanism that selects a concise test suite to maximize diversity of the target usage scenarios; (2) a tailored agent toolset for efficient retrieval and debugging; and (3) a reflection-based refinement workflow that iteratively analyzes failures and updates implementations. TENET包括： （ 1 ）选择简洁测试套件的测试线束机制，以最大限度地提高目标使用场景的多样性； （ 2 ）用于高效检索和调试的定制代理工具集；以及（ 3 ）迭代分析故障和更新实现的基于反射的细化工作流程。
TENET consistently outperforms the strongest baselines across backbones, achieving 69.08% and 81.77% Pass@1 on RepoCod and RepoEval with Claude Sonnet 4, improving by 9.49 and 2.17 percentage points, respectively. TENET的表现始终优于最强劲的骨干基线，在RepoCod和RepoEval上分别达到69.08%和81.77%合格@ 1 ， Claude Sonnet 4分别提高了9.49和2.17个百分点。
Additionally, we present the first systematic study of how test suite characteristics influence LLM agent performance in TDD settings. 此外，我们首次系统地研究了测试套件特性如何影响TDD设置中的LLM代理绩效。
highlights: outperforms the strongest baselines across backbones
first systematic study of how test suite characteristics influence LLM agent performance in TDD settings
